abstract.text: CONTEXT: Despite widespread concern regarding the quality and safety of health care, and a Medicare Quality Improvement Organization (QIO) program intended to improve that care in the United States, there is only limited information on whether quality is improving. OBJECTIVE: To track national and state-level changes in performance on 22 quality indicators for care of Medicare beneficiaries. DESIGN, PATIENTS, AND SETTING: National observational cross-sectional studies of national and state-level fee-for-service data for Medicare beneficiaries during 1998-1999 (baseline) and 2000-2001 (follow-up). MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Twenty-two QIO quality indicators abstracted from state-wide random samples of medical records for inpatient fee-for-service care and from Medicare beneficiary surveys or Medicare claims for outpatient care. Absolute improvement is defined as the change in performance from baseline to follow-up (measured in percentage points for all indicators except those measured in minutes); relative improvement is defined as the absolute improvement divided by the difference between the baseline performance and perfect performance (100%). RESULTS: The median state's performance improved from baseline to follow-up on 20 of the 22 indicators. In the median state, the percentage of patients receiving appropriate care on the median indicator increased from 69.5% to 73.4%, a 12.8% relative improvement. The average relative improvement was 19.9% for outpatient indicators combined and 11.9% for inpatient indicators combined (P<.001). For all but one indicator, absolute improvement was greater in states in which performance was low at baseline than those in which it was high at baseline (median r = -0.43; range: 0.12 to -0.93). When states were ranked on each indicator, the state's average rank was highly stable over time (r = 0.93 for 1998-1999 vs 2000-2001). CONCLUSIONS: Care for Medicare fee-for-service plan beneficiaries improved substantially between 1998-1999 and 2000-2001, but a much larger opportunity remains for further improvement. Relative rankings among states changed little. The improved care is consistent with QIO activities over this period, but these cross-sectional data do not provide conclusive information about the degree to which the improvement can be attributed to the QIOs' quality improvement efforts.

10.1001/jama.289.3.305.abstractZh: 背景：尽管人们对医疗保健的质量和安全存在广泛担忧，并且美国有 Medicare 质量改进组织计划旨在改善这一状况，但关于质量是否有所改善的信息却非常有限。目的：跟踪 Medicare 受益人护理方面22项质量指标在国家和州级的表现变化。设计、研究对象及环境：对1998-1999年（基线期）和2000-2001年（随访期）的 Medicare 受益人按服务收费方式提供的全国性和州级数据进行全国性观察性横断面研究。主要结果指标：从州级随机样本的医疗记录中摘取的22项质量指标，以及从 Medicare 受益人调查或门诊护理的 Medicare 索赔中获得的指标。绝对改善定义为从基线到随访期间的表现变化（除以分钟为单位衡量的指标外，均以百分点表示）；相对改善定义为绝对改善除以基线表现与完美表现之间的差异（100%）。结果：在22项指标中，有20项指标在州级的表现从基线到随访期间有所改善。在基线期，获得适当护理的患者比例在20项指标中从69.5%增加到73.4%，相对改善率为12.8%。门诊指标的综合平均相对改善率为19.9%，住院指标的综合平均相对改善率为11.9%（P<0.001）。除了一个指标外，所有指标在基线时表现较低的州，其绝对改善程度都高于基线时表现较高的州（中位数r=-0.43；范围：0.12至-0.93）。当各州根据每个指标进行排名时，各州的平均排名随时间变化幅度很小（1998-1999年与2000-2001年的相关系数均为0.93）。结论：1998-1999年与2000-2001年间，医疗保险按服务收费计划的护理质量有显著改善，但仍有很大的改进空间。各州之间的相对排名变化不大。这种护理质量的改善与同期质量改进项目的活动一致，但这些横截面数据并不能提供关于这种改善在多大程度上可以归因于质量改进项目的努力的确切信息。

abstract.text: An ongoing debate exists among health care researchers about the mechanism that allocates physicians across medical specialties, and appropriate policy measures to correct imbalances that may arise from time to time. Most researchers believe that choice of residency program by medical school graduates is key to understanding how physicians are distributed across specialties, but there is much disagreement about whether economic or non-economic factors are most influential in determining this choice. We undertake an empirical investigation of two potentially important economic factors: income and leisure. To do so, we specify a two way error component regression model to estimate the effects of expected earnings and available leisure time, and uncertainty of earnings and leisure, on specialty choices of medical residents. Our findings indicate that economic factors are an important influence in the specialty choice process; in particular, medical residents are attracted to specialties that offer the prospect of longer and more certain annual vacations, higher earnings, shorter residency programs, and more certain work schedules. Our results suggest that employment contracts that provide generous annual vacation time and promise regular weekly work schedules may be more effective than increased earnings in correcting the current perceived shortage of primary care physicians.

10.1002/hec.682.abstractZh: 在医疗保健研究领域，关于如何分配医生到不同医学专业领域的机制以及如何制定适当的政策措施来纠正由此产生的不平衡问题，一直存在争议。大多数研究者认为，医学院毕业生选择住院医师项目是理解医生如何分配到不同专业领域的关键，但关于决定这一选择的因素是经济因素还是非经济因素，存在很大分歧。我们对两个可能重要的经济因素进行了实证研究：收入和闲暇时间。为此，我们建立了一个双向误差成分回归模型，以估计预期收入、可用闲暇时间以及收入与闲暇时间的不确定性对住院医师专业选择的影响。我们的研究结果表明，经济因素在专业选择过程中起着重要作用；具体而言，住院医师倾向于选择那些能够提供更长时间、更稳定的年度休假、更高收入、更短的住院医师培训时间以及更稳定的工作安排的专业。我们的研究还表明，提供充足年度休假时间和承诺每周固定工作时间的雇佣合同，可能比增加收入更能有效解决当前初级保健医生短缺的问题。

abstract.text: It is widely assumed that health care costs can be reduced considerably by providing care in appropriate health care institutions without unnecessary technological overhead. This assumption has been tested in a prospective study. Conventional discharge after hip fracture surgery was compared with an early discharge policy in which patients were discharged to a nursing home with specialised facilities for rehabilitation. We compared costs for both strategies from a societal perspective, using comprehensive and detailed data on type of residence and all kinds of medical consumption during a 4-month follow-up period. As expected, early discharge reduced the hospital stay (with 13 days, p=0.001). More patients were discharged to a nursing home (76% versus 53%). Total medical costs during follow-up were reduced from an average of euro;15338 to euro;14281, representing relatively small and not significant savings (p=0.3). There are two explanations for this unexpected result. First, costs incurred by hip fracture patients were relatively less while in hospital. Hence, nursing home costs almost equalled hospital costs per admission day. Second, compared with the conventionally discharged group early discharged patients were subjected to more medical procedures during the first post-operative days. We conclude that: (1). early discharge shifted rather than reduced costs; (2). the details of costing have a major influence on the cost-effectiveness of alternative discharge policies.

10.1002/hec.690.abstractZh: 人们普遍认为，通过在合适的医疗机构提供医疗服务，可以大幅降低医疗成本，而无需额外的技术投入。这一假设已在一项前瞻性研究中得到了验证。研究比较了髋部骨折手术后常规出院政策与提前出院政策下的成本，在提前出院政策下，患者会被送到设有专业康复设施的养老院。我们从社会角度比较了两种策略下的成本，使用了关于居住类型和各种医疗消费的全面详细数据，并进行了为期4个月的随访。正如预期的那样，提前出院减少了住院时间（13天，p=0.001）。更多患者被送到养老院（76%对比53%）。随访期间的总医疗成本从平均15338欧元降低到14281欧元，虽然节省幅度相对较小且不显著（p=0.3）。这一意外结果有两种可能的解释。首先，髋部骨折患者在医院期间产生的成本相对较低。因此，养老院的成本几乎等于每次住院日的医院成本。其次，与常规出院的患者相比，提前出院的患者在术后前几天需要接受更多的医疗程序。我们得出结论：（1）提前出院只是转移了成本，而非真正降低了成本；（2）成本计算的细节对替代出院政策的经济效益有着重要影响。

abstract.text: Despite the widespread use of quality-adjusted life years (QALY) in economic evaluation studies, their utility-theoretic foundation remains unclear. A model for preferences over health, money, and time is presented in this paper. Under the usual assumptions of the original QALY-model, an additive separable presentation of the utilities in different periods exists. In contrast to the usual assumption that QALY-weights do solely depend on aspects of health-related quality of life, wealth-standardized QALY-weights might vary with the wealth level in the presented extension of the original QALY-model resulting in an inconsistent measurement of QALYs. Further assumptions are presented to make the measurement of QALYs consistent with lifetime preferences over health and money. Even under these strict assumptions, QALYs and WTP (which also can be defined in this utility-theoretic model) are not equivalent preference-based measures of the effects of health technologies on an individual level. The results suggest that the individual WTP per QALY can depend on the magnitude of the QALY-gain as well as on the disease burden, when health influences the marginal utility of wealth. Further research seems to be indicated on this structural aspect of preferences over health and wealth and to quantify its impact.

10.1002/hec.697.abstractZh: 尽管质量调整生命年（QALY）在经济学评估研究中被广泛使用，但其效用理论基础仍不清楚。本文提出了一个关于对健康、金钱和时间的偏好模型。在原始QALY模型的常见假设下，不同时期效用是可加且可分离的。与通常假设QALY权重仅取决于健康相关生活质量的假设不同，在原始QALY模型的扩展中，财富标准化的QALY权重可能会随财富水平的变化而变化，从而导致QALY的测量出现不一致性。进一步假设旨在使QALY的测量与对健康和金钱的终身偏好保持一致。即使在这些严格假设下，QALY和WTP（也可以在这个效用理论模型中定义）也不是等价偏好基础下的健康技术对个人影响的衡量指标。结果表明，个体每QALY的WTP可能取决于QALY增益的大小以及疾病负担，当健康影响财富的边际效用时。看来需要进一步研究这种对健康和财富的偏好结构方面，并量化其影响。

abstract.text: This article addresses and challenges some common perceptions in the statistical assessment of costs and cost-effectiveness in health economics. Cost data typically exhibit highly skew distributions. Two techniques whose validity does not depend on any specific form of underlying distribution are the bootstrap and methods based on asymptotic normality of sample means. These methods are generally thought to be appropriate for the analysis of cost data. We argue that, even when these methods are technically valid, they may often lead to inefficient and even misleading inferences. It is important to apply methods that recognise the skewness in cost data. We further demonstrate that it may also be important to incorporate relevant prior information in a Bayesian analysis.

10.1002/hec.699.abstractZh: 本文针对健康经济学中成本与成本效益统计评估中的一些常见观点提出了质疑。成本数据通常呈现出高度偏态的分布。有两种技术其有效性并不依赖于任何特定的分布形式，即自助法以及基于样本均值渐近正态性的方法。这些方法通常被认为适用于成本数据的分析。我们认为，即使这些技术在技术上有效，它们也常常会导致低效甚至误导性的推断。因此，采用能够识别成本数据偏态性的方法是非常重要的。我们进一步指出，在贝叶斯分析中纳入相关的先验信息同样重要。

abstract.text: Health care expenditure has increased substantially in all Western industrialized countries in the last decades. The necessity to contain the increase in health care expenditure has motivated the analysis of its determinants to explain differences across countries and health systems. However, recent studies have questioned the use of cross section data arguing that health systems are too different to allow for such comparisons. In this paper we investigate whether this criticism is really justified. We analyze the variations of health care expenditure in OECD countries relative to income, population aging and technological change. Our analysis is based on pooled cross section data and time series. Firstly, formulating error correction models for individual countries we demonstrate that in almost all cases the investigated variables are cointegrated. Secondly, we use a bootstrap framework for inference and examine whether the influence of explanatory variables is unique across countries. Applying recursive estimation procedures we find evidence for cross country homogeneity during the period 1961-1979. In the last two decades health care dynamics become more and more country specific thus indicating divergence of health systems and the growing importance of country-specific effects in the explanation of differences in health care expenditure.

10.1002/hec.700.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，所有西方工业化国家的医疗支出都大幅增加了。为了控制医疗支出的增长，人们开始分析其决定因素，以解释不同国家和医疗体系之间的差异。然而，最近的研究对使用横截面数据提出了质疑，认为不同医疗体系之间的差异太大，无法进行此类比较。在本文中，我们探讨了这种批评是否确实合理。我们分析了经合组织国家中医疗支出与收入、人口老龄化和技术变革之间的关系。我们的分析基于汇总横截面数据和时间序列数据。首先，针对各个国家建立了误差修正模型，结果表明在几乎所有情况下，所研究的变量都是共整合的。其次，我们使用自助法框架进行推断，并检验解释变量的影响是否在不同国家中是相同的。通过应用递归估计程序，我们发现1961-1979年期间各国家之间的医疗支出具有同质性。在过去的二十年里，医疗支出的动态性越来越具有国家特异性，这表明医疗体系出现了分化，而国家特定因素在解释医疗支出差异方面的重要性日益凸显。

abstract.text: This paper considers the potential impact of medical school indebtedness and other variables on the propensity of US doctors to enter academic medicine. Probit models provide some evidence that indebtedness reduces the likelihood that physicians will choose academic medicine as their primary activity. Nevertheless, the magnitude of this effect is not large. As indebtedness may be endogenous, the probits are rerun using an instrumental variables approach. These estimates imply that over time indebtedness may have an important impact on the propensity of physicians to enter academic medicine.

10.1002/hec.701.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医学院债务状况及其他变量对美国医生选择学术医学的倾向可能产生的潜在影响。Probit模型表明，债务状况会降低医生选择学术医学作为主要职业的可能性。不过，这种影响的幅度并不大。由于债务状况可能是内生变量，因此采用工具变量方法重新进行了Probit模型的估计。这些估计结果表明，随着时间的推移，债务状况可能会对医生选择学术医学的倾向产生重要影响。

abstract.text: Widespread use of antibiotics is considered the major driving force behind the development of antibiotic resistance. The benefits of exceeding the welfare-maximizing level of antibiotic use are below the costs of resistance created by this excess quantity of antibiotics used, thereby resulting in a welfare deadweight loss. This paper uses a simple economic model to examine the theoretical and empirical aspects of the welfare loss generated by resistance and analyzes its policy implications. The annual deadweight loss associated with outpatient prescriptions for amoxicillin in the United States is estimated at US dollars 225 million.

10.1002/hec.702.abstractZh: 广泛使用抗生素被认为是导致抗生素耐药性发展的主要驱动力。超过最大化福利水平的抗生素使用所带来的好处，低于因过量使用抗生素而产生的耐药性成本，从而导致福利损失。本文采用一个简单的经济模型来研究耐药性造成的福利损失的理论和实证方面，并分析其政策含义。在美国，每年因门诊处方阿莫西林而产生的福利损失估计为2.25亿美元。

abstract.text: The usual implementation of contingent valuation (CV), in the context of priorities setting for allocation of public funds in health care, is to develop as many surveys as there are programmes, i.e. to perform separate evaluations (SE). In the EuroWill project, three health programmes (for heart disease, breast cancer and a service of helicopter ambulance) were however simultaneously evaluated, i.e. a joint evaluation (JE) was performed. The paper examines the issue of the econometric techniques that should be used to estimate WTP values obtained in the context of JE by comparing the application of independent OLS regressions for each programme versus simultaneous estimations using seemingly unrelated regressions (SUR) on data of the French EuroWill survey. It shows that separate estimations may lead to misspecifications because they cannot take into account that JE exogenously provides a reference structure to the respondent which affects the estimates of WTP for each programme. Therefore, the potential advantage of JE versus SE as an elicitation technique in CV studies applied to health care (to better control the referents used by respondents for evaluating different programmes) only holds if simultaneous rather than independent techniques are used in the estimation of WTPs.

10.1002/hec.703.abstractZh: 在公共资金分配优先级的设定中，通常的做法是依据项目数量来开展相关调查，即分别进行单独的评估。然而，在EuroWill项目中，三个健康项目（针对心脏病、乳腺癌以及直升机救护车服务）被同时进行了评估，即进行了联合评估。本文探讨了在联合评估中应使用哪些计量经济技术来估算受访者的支付意愿值。通过比较每个项目的独立OLS回归与对EuroWill调查数据的联合回归，发现单独估算可能导致误判，因为联合评估为受访者提供了一个参考框架，这会影响对每个项目支付意愿的估算结果。因此，如果将联合评估与单独评估结合使用，那么联合评估作为支付意愿估算技术的优势才能显现，这有助于更好地控制受访者用于评估不同项目的参照标准。

abstract.text: In studies of peer group behavior, the direct measure of peer group behavior is often not available, and so is replaced by perceptions from survey respondents. This study shows that regression estimators are inconsistent when the correctly measured independent variable of group behavior is replaced with perceived measures from survey respondents. The inconsistency is due to three sources: projection of own behavior onto the group, rescaling the marginal effect of the group, and simple random measurement error. We discuss why each effect may cause inconsistency, derive formulas for the probability limit to quantify their effects, and illustrate with three examples of adolescent smoking and drinking.

10.1002/hec.705.abstractZh: 在关于同伴群体行为的研究中，直接衡量同伴群体行为的指标往往无法获得，因此需要通过调查受访者提供的感知数据来替代。本研究表明，当正确测量的同伴群体行为独立变量被调查受访者的感知数据所替代时，回归估计结果会变得不一致。这种不一致性源于三个原因：将自身行为投射到群体中、重新调整群体的边际效应，以及简单的随机测量误差。我们讨论了这些原因为何会导致不一致性，推导了量化这些效应的概率极限公式，并通过三个青少年吸烟和饮酒的例子进行了说明。

abstract.text: We consider assumptions about preferences implicit in the person trade-off exercises used to derive health-related quality of life measures for the Global and US Burden of Disease Projects. Because these methods and their results have the potential of being adopted by other researchers, a critical review of this methodology and its assumptions is warranted. Exercise participants are told that quality of life valuation is approached using two different questions to reveal logical inconsistencies in each person's responses. An inconsistency is claimed to exist if a participant's two responses violate a particular mathematical relationship, and participants are forced to modify their responses to satisfy that relationship. We demonstrate that this supposed 'logical' relationship need not hold for logically consistent, rational individuals, and we prove that the relationship will in fact hold only for a particular class of social value functions exhibiting two characteristics that may not be consistent with the preferences of some participants. These results imply that the forced modification may invalidate some responses, as it may require some participants to provide final answers that are inconsistent with their true preferences. We then discuss preference characterizations in the existing person trade-off literature, from which this relationship may have been derived.

10.1002/hec.707.abstractZh: 我们考虑了在用于推导全球和美国疾病负担项目中与健康相关的生活质量指标的人体权衡研究中隐含的偏好假设。由于这些方法及其结果有可能被其他研究者采用，因此有必要对这种方法论及其假设进行严格的审查。运动参与者被告知，生活质量评估是通过两个不同问题来进行的，以揭示每个人回答中的逻辑不一致性。如果参与者的两个回答违反了特定的数学关系，则被认为存在不一致性，参与者被迫修改他们的回答以满足这一关系。我们证明，这种所谓的“逻辑”关系并不适用于逻辑上一致、理性的个体，并且我们证明，这种关系实际上只适用于一类具有两个特征的社会价值函数，这些特征可能与某些参与者的偏好不一致。这些结果意味着，强制修改可能会使一些回答无效，因为它可能要求一些参与者提供与其真实偏好不一致的最终答案。然后，我们讨论了现有人体权衡文献中的偏好特征，这种关系可能就是从这些文献中得出的。

abstract.text: The theory of the learning curve states that learning effects are of particular importance in industries, where human skills play an important role. Consequently, one would expect to find large learning effects for surgical procedures because the physician's experience is quite important for this type of work. For hospitals, there exists indeed a well-documented effect that shows a positive relationship between the number of a certain type of surgery being performed and its resulting quality (volume-outcome relationship). Empirical analyses of the impact of learning on the average cost of a procedure, however, have noted a conspicuous absence of learning effects. Using a mechanism design approach, the paper analyzes a model of quality and cost-management for a hospital, where learning effects are included into the cost function and asymmetric information exists between management and physician. It seeks to answer the question, whether recommendations from a symmetric information scenario with respect to learning carry over to a health care setting, where informational problems tend to be pronounced and severe. If surgery volume interacts with physicians' informational rents, an optimal management reaction to the presence of learning may result in a policy, which is the exact opposite of the one under symmetric information.

10.1002/hec.708.abstractZh: 学习曲线理论指出，在学习效应方面，工业领域尤为重要，因为人类技能在这一领域起着重要作用。因此，人们预计在外科手术领域会观察到显著的学习效应，因为医生的经验对于这类工作来说至关重要。对于医院而言，确实存在一种有充分文献记载的效应，即某种类型手术的数量与其质量之间存在正相关关系（即数量与质量的关系）。然而，对学习对手术平均成本影响的实证分析却发现，学习效应几乎不存在。本文采用机制设计方法，分析了一个医院的质量与成本管理模型，其中将学习效应纳入成本函数，并考虑了管理层与医生之间存在的非对称信息情况。本文旨在探讨，在信息问题较为突出且严重的医疗环境中，从对称信息情景中得出的关于学习的建议是否仍然适用。如果手术数量与医生的信息租金之间存在相互作用，那么针对学习现象的最佳管理反应可能会与对称信息情景下的管理策略完全相反。

abstract.text: Prior economic research provides mixed evidence on the impact of cigarette prices on youth smoking. This paper empirically tests the effects of various price measures on youth demand for cigarettes using data collected in a recent nationally representative survey of 17 287 high school students. In addition to commonly used cigarette price measures, the study also examined the effect of price as perceived by the students. This unique information permits the study of the effect of teen-specific price on cigarette demand. The analysis employed a two-part model of cigarette demand based on a model developed by Cragg (1971) in which the propensity to smoke and the intensity of the smoking habit are modeled separately. The results confirm that higher cigarette prices, irrespective of the way they are measured, reduce probability of youth cigarette smoking. There is also some evidence of negative price effect on smoking intensity, but it is sensitive to the price measure used in the model. The largest impact on cigarette demand has the teen-specific, perceived price of cigarettes.

10.1002/hec.709.abstractZh: 先前的经济研究对于香烟价格对青少年吸烟行为的影响提供了不同的研究结果。本文利用一项针对17,287名高中学生的全国性代表性调查数据，实证检验了各种价格因素对青少年香烟需求的影响。除了常用的香烟价格指标外，研究还考察了学生感知到的价格对香烟需求的影响。这一独特的信息使得能够研究青少年感知价格对香烟需求的影响。分析采用了Cragg（1971）提出的香烟需求双部分模型，其中吸烟倾向和吸烟习惯的强度分别被单独建模。研究结果表明，无论价格如何衡量，较高的香烟价格都会降低青少年吸烟的概率。此外，还有一些证据表明价格对吸烟习惯的强度有负面影响，但这种影响会受到模型中使用的价格指标的影响。对香烟需求影响最大的因素是青少年感知到的香烟价格。

abstract.text: This study is motivated by the potential problem of using observational data to draw inferences about treatment outcomes when experimental data are not available. We compare two statistical approaches, ordinary least-squares (OLS) and instrumental variables (IV) regression analysis, to estimate the outcomes (three-year post-treatment survival) of three treatments for early stage breast cancer in elderly women: mastectomy (MST), breast conserving surgery with radiation therapy (BCSRT), and breast conserving surgery only (BCSO). The primary data source was Medicare claims for a national random sample of 2907 women (age 67 or older) with localized breast cancer who were treated between 1992 and 1994. Contrary to randomized clinical trial (RCT) results, analysis with the observational data found highly significant differences in survival among the three treatment alternatives: 79.2% survival for BCSO, 85.3% for MST, and 93.0% for BCSRT. Using OLS to control for the effects of observable characteristics narrowed the estimated survival rate differences, which remained statistically significant. In contrast, the IV analysis estimated survival rate differences that were not significantly different from 0. However, the IV-point estimates of the treatment effects were quantitatively larger than the OLS estimates, unstable, and not significantly different from the OLS results. In addition, both sets of estimates were in the same quantitative range as the RCT results.We conclude that unadjusted observational data on health outcomes of alternative treatments for localized breast cancer should not be used for cost-effectiveness studies. Our comparisons suggest that whether one places greater confidence in the OLS or the IV results depends on at least three factors: (1) the extent of observable health information that can be used as controls in OLS estimation, (2) the outcomes of statistical tests of the validity of the instrumental variable method, and (3) the similarity of the OLS and IV estimates. In this particular analysis, the OLS estimates appear to be preferable because of the instability of the IV estimates.

10.1002/hec.710.abstractZh: 本研究的动机源于在缺乏实验数据的情况下，使用观察性数据来推断治疗结果可能存在的问题。我们比较了两种统计方法：普通最小二乘法（OLS）和工具变量（IV）回归分析，以估计三种针对老年女性早期乳腺癌的治疗方法的效果（三年后的生存情况）。这三种治疗方法分别是：乳房切除术（MST）、保乳手术加放疗（BCSRT）以及仅进行保乳手术（BCSO）。主要数据来源是Medicare索赔记录，样本为2907名年龄在67岁或以上的女性，她们在1992年至1994年间接受了局部乳腺癌治疗。与随机临床试验（RCT）的结果不同，基于观察性数据的分析发现三种治疗方法的生存率存在显著差异：BCSO的生存率为79.2%，MST为85.3%，BCSRT为93.0%。使用OLS方法来控制可观测特征的影响后，估计的生存率差异有所缩小，但仍具有统计学意义。相比之下，IV分析估计的生存率差异并不显著。然而，IV点估计的治疗效果在数量上大于OLS估计的结果，且不稳定，与OLS结果没有显著差异。此外，这两组估计结果与RCT结果在数量上是一致的。我们得出结论，对于局部乳腺癌替代疗法的健康结果，不应使用未经调整的观察性数据来进行成本效益分析。我们的比较表明，是否更信任OLS估计结果还是工具变量估计结果，至少取决于三个因素：(1)在OLS估计中可以作为控制变量的可观测健康信息的范围；(2)对工具变量方法有效性的统计测试结果；(3)OLS估计与工具变量估计的相似性。在这项特定的分析中，由于工具变量估计的不稳定性，OLS估计似乎更为可取。

abstract.text: This paper studies the relationship between health status and insurance participation, and between insurance status and medical use in the context of a social health insurance with an equalization fund (SHIEF). Under this system, revenues from a mandatory payroll tax are collected into a single pool (equalization fund) that reimburses for-profit insurance companies according to a capitated formula. Although competition should induce insurers to control costs without reducing the quality of service necessary to attract consumers, limitations in the capitation formula might induce insurers to select against bad risks, and limitations in the contribution system might induce more healthy individuals to evade enrollment. A three-equation model having social health insurance, private health insurance, and using medical services is estimated using a 1997 Colombian household survey. Consistent with similar studies, participation in SHIEF increases medical care use. On the other hand, the evidence on selection is somewhat mixed: individuals who report good health status are more likely to participate in SHIEF, while those without a chronic condition are less likely to participate in SHIEF.

10.1002/hec.711.abstractZh: 本文研究了在具有均衡基金的社会医疗保险制度下，健康状况与保险参与率之间的关系，以及保险状态与医疗服务使用之间的关系。在该制度下，强制性的工资税收入被汇集到一个单一的基金中，该基金根据包干公式向营利性保险公司提供补偿。虽然竞争应促使保险公司控制成本而不降低服务质量以吸引消费者，但包干公式的局限性可能会促使保险公司选择风险较低的项目；而缴费制度的局限性则可能促使更健康的人群选择不参保。本文利用1997年哥伦比亚家庭调查数据，建立了一个包含社会医疗保险、私人医疗保险以及医疗服务使用的三方程模型。与类似研究一致，参与均衡基金制度会增加医疗服务的使用。另一方面，关于选择行为的证据则较为复杂：报告健康状况良好的个体更有可能参与均衡基金制度，而没有慢性疾病的个体则不太可能参与该制度。

abstract.text: By focusing exclusively on consumer benefit, previous studies of the effects of managed care have ignored important hospital efficiency gains. This study uses the HCUP sample of hospitals for 1992-1996 to estimate a stochastic frontier model of hospital technical efficiency. After controlling for hospital and market area variables, the study finds strong evidence that increased managed care insurance in a given market is associated with improved technical efficiency in the area's hospitals, especially in tertiary cases. Using Battese and Coelli's one-stage method (1995), the coefficients estimates are more efficient than for two-stage methods found in the literature.

10.1002/hec.712.abstractZh: 以往关于管理式医疗效应的研究仅关注消费者利益，而忽视了医院效率的提升。本研究采用1992-1996年的HCUP医院样本，建立了医院技术效率的随机前沿模型。在控制医院和市场区域变量后，研究发现，在特定市场中增加管理式医疗保险确实有助于提高该地区医院的技术效率，尤其是在三级医院中。采用Battese和Coelli的一阶段方法（1995年），得到的系数估计比文献中采用的两阶段方法更为有效。

abstract.text: Using an experimental conjoint-analysis like approach, preferences for resource allocation were studied. An interactive survey was developed which was published in the World Wide Web. A convenience sample of undergraduate students participated in the study. Subjects were confronted with nine pairwise scenarios describing hypothetical patient groups in need of life-saving treatments. The patient groups presented differed in terms of their health-related lifestyle, socioeconomic status, age, life expectancy, quality of life after treatment and whether they had received extensive medical care in the past. Participants were asked to allocate a finite budget to each patient group. All attributes used in this study significantly influenced respondents' preferences on how to allocate the budget between patient groups. The general importance of attributes used in the QALY approach is supported by this study with quality of life being a central criterion. The distributional patterns observed were, however, different from those expected when rigorously adhering to the QALY framework: In only a very small fraction of allocations subjects distributed the entire budget strictly on the patient group expecting the highest QALY gain. The vast majority of responders was willing to trade efficiency for a more equal distribution of resources. The approach described can be used to analyze the importance people place on different attributes in resource allocation decisions and to study preferences for the final distribution of resources.

10.1002/hec.713.abstractZh: 采用实验性联合分析方法，研究了人们对资源分配的偏好。研究人员开发了一个互动调查工具，并将其发布在万维网上。研究对象为一组本科生，他们被要求为九个成对情景分配有限的预算，这些情景描述了需要救命治疗的假设患者群体。这些患者群体在健康相关生活方式、社会经济地位、年龄、预期寿命、治疗后的生活质量以及过去是否接受过广泛医疗护理等方面存在差异。参与者需要为每个患者群体分配预算。研究中使用的所有属性都显著影响了受访者对预算分配方式的偏好。本研究支持了QALY方法中所使用的属性的重要性，其中生活质量是一个核心标准。然而，观察到的分配模式与严格遵循QALY框架时预期的有所不同：只有极少数情况下，参与者会严格根据预期能获得最高QALY收益的患者群体来分配全部预算。绝大多数受访者愿意牺牲效率来换取更均衡的资源分配。所描述的方法可用于分析人们在资源分配决策中对不同属性的重视程度，以及他们对最终资源分配方式的偏好。

abstract.text: Quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs) calculated from time tradeoff (TTO) based preferences have a time preference component. To impose a conventional discount rate on these implicitly discounted QALYs introduces some degree of double discounting. The purpose of this study was to determine the magnitude of the double discounting effect and the effectiveness of a suggested method for avoiding double discounting in a TTO-based QALY model. Our analysis used holistic and composite preference scores obtained with the TTO technique in a prior study of four hypothetical treatment paths in type 2 diabetes. Discounted composite preference scores were significantly discrepant from holistic preference scores. Adjusting TTO-based quality weights prior to external discounting reduced the discrepancy only slightly. Since time preference effects may vary with health state context, the double discounting effect needs further investigation.

10.1002/hec.718.abstractZh: 质量调整生命年（QALYs）是根据时间权衡（TTO）偏好计算得出的，其中包含了时间偏好成分。在这些隐含折现的QALYs上施加传统的折现率会导致一定程度的双重折现现象。本研究的目的是确定双重折现效应的程度，以及一种建议方法的有效性，该方法旨在避免在基于TTO的QALY模型中出现双重折现现象。我们的分析使用了先前研究中通过TTO技术获得的整体和复合偏好评分，该研究涉及了2型糖尿病的四种假设治疗路径。折现后的复合偏好评分与整体偏好评分存在显著差异。在外部折现之前调整基于TTO的质量权重，仅略微减少了这种差异。由于时间偏好效应可能随健康状态的不同而发生变化，因此双重折现效应需要进一步研究。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether the responsiveness of health care utilization to cost-sharing varies by health status and the implications of such heterogeneity. First, we show theoretically that if health care utilization of those in poor health is less responsive to cost sharing, this, combined with the skewness of health expenditures in health status, leads to overestimates of the effect of cost sharing. This bias is exacerbated when elasticities are generalized to populations with greater expenditure skewness. Second, we show empirically that cost-sharing responsiveness does differ by health status using data from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey. Medicare beneficiaries are stratified into health status groups based on activity of daily living (ADL) impairments and self-reported health status. Separately, for each of the health status groups, we estimate the effect of Medigap insurance on Part B utilization using a two-part expenditure model. We find that the change in expenditures associated with Medigap is smaller for those in poorer health. For example, when stratified using ADLs, Medigap insurance increases expenditures for 'healthy' groups by 36.4%, while the increase for the 'sick' group is 12.7%. Results are qualitatively the same for different forms of supplemental insurance and different methods of health status stratification. We develop a test to demonstrate that adjusting our results for selection bias would result in estimates of greater heterogeneity. Our results imply that a lowerbound estimate of the bias from neglecting heterogeneity is about 2-7%.

10.1002/hec.725.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医疗服务的利用对费用分担的响应是否因健康状况而异，以及这种异质性所带来的影响。首先，我们从理论上表明，如果健康状况较差的人群对费用分担的响应较低，那么这种响应与医疗支出的偏斜性相结合，会导致对费用分担效果的高估。当弹性被推广到支出偏斜性更大的群体时，这种偏差会进一步加剧。其次，我们通过Medicare当前受益人调查的数据实证分析，发现医疗服务的利用对费用分担的响应确实因健康状况而异。Medicare受益人根据日常生活活动能力障碍和自我报告的健康状况被划分为不同的健康状态组。对于每一个健康状态组，我们使用两部分支出模型来估计Medigap保险对B部分服务利用的影响。我们发现，对于健康状况较差的人群来说，与Medigap保险相关的支出变化较小。例如，在使用日常生活活动能力作为分层标准时，Medigap保险使“健康”群体的支出增加了36.4%，而“患病”群体的支出仅增加了12.7%。对于不同形式的补充保险和不同的健康状况分层方法，结果在定性上是一致的。我们开发了一个测试，以证明调整结果以排除选择偏差会导致估计的异质性更大。我们的结果表明，忽略异质性的偏差的低估值约为2-7%。

abstract.text: This paper uses the Nepal Living Standards Survey, a nationally representative sample of households from 1996, to investigate the determinants of household out-of-pocket health expenditures. The analysis uses a multi-equation joint estimation to control for endogeneity of sickness and provider choice. The results of this analysis indicate several interesting findings. First, common unobserved factors were found to be statistically significant determinants of illness, choice of provider, and health expenditures, and may cause bias to parameter estimates if not controlled. Second, the income elasticity is estimated to be 1.10, with income having both a direct effect on health expenditure, and an indirect effect through likelihood of illness and the type of provider that is chosen. Third, housing and sanitary conditions were found to have a substantial effect on illness, and as a result, out-of-pocket health care expenditures. Fourth, despite the fact that urban, ill individuals who seek care are more likely to utilize care in more expensive settings, average health care expenditure among the urban sample was found to be substantially lower than among the rural sample, partly due to a lower likelihood of reporting illnesses and injuries and of using any type of health care provider.

10.1002/hec.727.abstractZh: 本文采用1996年进行的尼泊尔生活水平调查数据，该调查涵盖了全国代表性家庭样本，以研究家庭自付医疗支出的决定因素。分析通过多方程联合估计方法，控制了疾病发生与医疗服务选择的内生性。分析结果表明，一些有趣的发现如下：首先，一些共同的未观测因素被证实是疾病、医疗服务选择及医疗支出的统计显著决定因素，如果不加以控制，可能会导致参数估计的偏差。其次，收入弹性估计值为1.10，表明收入不仅直接影响医疗支出，还通过影响疾病发生概率和医疗服务选择类型产生间接影响。第三，住房和卫生条件对疾病及自付医疗支出有显著影响。第四，尽管城市中的患病个体更可能寻求昂贵的医疗服务，但城市样本的平均医疗支出明显低于农村样本，这在一定程度上是由于城市居民报告疾病和受伤的可能性较低，以及使用医疗服务的可能性也较低。

abstract.text: This paper examines the factors beyond NHS dentists' remuneration which may explain the variations in the public/private mix in general dental practitioners' workload in the UK. Given that NHS dentistry is subject to a fixed price system, the study focused mainly on non-income supply-side factors. Using data from a postal survey of a national random sample of dentists practising in the NHS in England in 1997, the study found that the strategies adopted by dentists in the management of NHS lists and the evidence that dentists spent significantly more time in private consultations compared with NHS consultations support concerns over equity of access to dental care and the quality of NHS dentistry. Dentists' attitudes to NHS and private dentistry revealed considerable ambiguity towards the NHS. While, on the one hand, the lack of sufficient demand for private dentistry emerged as a strong reason for remaining in the NHS, on the other, there was evidence that equity in access to dental treatment is still seen as an important principle. The implications of these findings in the context of recent discussion of the future of NHS dentistry are considered.

10.1002/hec.728.abstractZh: 本文探讨了影响英国公共与私人诊所牙医工作负荷差异的因素，这些因素并非仅由NHS牙医的薪酬决定。鉴于NHS牙科服务采用固定价格体系，本研究主要关注非收入方面的因素。通过1997年对英格兰NHS系统下执业牙医进行的邮政调查数据，研究发现牙医在管理NHS诊所时采用的策略，以及他们认为在私人诊所中花费的时间明显多于在NHS诊所的时间，这些都与对牙科护理公平性和可及性的关注相关。牙医对NHS和私人牙科的态度显示出相当大的模糊性：一方面，私人牙科需求不足成为他们继续留在NHS体系内的一个重要原因；另一方面，也有证据表明，获得牙科治疗的机会公平性仍然被视为一个重要原则。本文还讨论了这些发现对于近期关于NHS牙科未来发展的讨论的意义。

abstract.text: This paper discusses different design techniques for stated preference surveys in health economic applications. In particular, we focus on different design techniques, i.e. how to combine the attribute levels into alternatives and choice sets, for choice experiments. Design is a vital issue in choice experiments since the combination of alternatives in the choice sets will determine the degree of precision obtainable from the estimates and welfare measures. In this paper we compare orthogonal, cyclical and D-optimal designs, where the latter allows expectations about the true parameters to be included when creating the design. Moreover, we discuss how to obtain prior information on the parameters and how to conduct a sequential design procedure during the actual experiment in order to improve the precision in the estimates. The designs are evaluated according to their ability to predict the true marginal willingness to pay under different specifications of the utility function in Monte Carlo simulations. Our results suggest that the designs produce unbiased estimations, but orthogonal designs result in larger mean square error in comparison to D-optimal designs. This result is expected when using correct priors on the parameters in D-optimal designs. However, the simulations show that welfare measures are not very sensitive if the choice sets are generated from a D-optimal design with biased priors.

10.1002/hec.729.abstractZh: 本文讨论了在健康经济应用中进行陈述偏好调查的不同设计技术。具体而言，我们关注如何将属性水平组合成替代方案和选择集，以用于选择实验。设计在选择实验中是一个至关重要的问题，因为选择集中替代方案的组合将决定估计值和福利度量所能获得的精确度。本文比较了正交设计、循环设计和D最优设计，其中后一种设计在创建设计时允许包含对真实参数的预期。此外，我们还讨论了如何获取参数的先验信息，以及如何在实际实验过程中进行序列设计，以提高估计值的精确度。这些设计通过蒙特卡洛模拟来评估其在预测不同效用函数规格下的真实边际支付意愿方面的能力。我们的结果表明，这些设计能够产生无偏估计，但正交设计的平均平方误差比D最优设计要大。当在D最优设计中使用正确的参数先验时，这一结果是可以预期的。然而，模拟显示，如果选择集是从具有偏差先验的D最优设计生成的，那么福利度量并不非常敏感。

abstract.text: Experiments concerned with modelling individual preferences are based on the assumption of completeness i.e. it is assumed that individuals have well-defined preferences for any choice they are presented with. However, this may not be the case for goods such as health care, where individuals are not used to making choices. If this assumption is violated, the large body of experimental economic literature eliciting patient preferences in health care may be challenged. This paper reports the results of a discrete choice experiment carried out to examine the assumption of complete preferences within health care. The tests carried out are based on the comparison of preferences for three different goods for which different levels of formed preferences are expected: a supermarket; dentist consultation and bowel cancer screening. The results do not provide sufficient evidence to support this hypothesis. However, further research is required before these results are generalised.

10.1002/hec.730.abstractZh: 关于个体偏好建模的实验基于完全性的假设，即假设个体对于所面临的任何选择都有明确的偏好。然而，对于诸如医疗保健这样的商品来说，情况可能并非如此，因为个体并不习惯于做出选择。如果这一假设被违反，那么大量关于在医疗保健领域获取个体偏好的实验经济学文献可能会受到质疑。本文报告了一项离散选择实验的结果，该实验旨在检验在医疗保健领域完全偏好假设的有效性。实验基于三种不同商品的偏好比较，这些商品分别包括超市、牙科咨询和结肠癌筛查。实验结果并未提供足够的证据来支持这一假设。不过，在将这些结果推广到其他领域之前，还需要进一步的研究。

abstract.text: The person trade-off (PTO) is increasingly being used to elicit preferences in health. This paper explores the measurement properties of the PTO method in the context of a study about how members of the public prioritise between patients of different ages. In particular, it considers whether PTO responses satisfy the transitivity principle; that is, whether one PTO response can be inferred from two other PTO responses. The results suggest that very few responses to PTO questions satisfy cardinal transitivity condition. However, this study has produced results that suggest that cardinal transitivity will hold, on average, when respondents who fail to satisfy the ordinal transitivity condition have been excluded from the analysis. This suggests that future PTO studies should build in checks for ordinal transitivity.

10.1002/hec.731.abstractZh: “人-时间权衡”（Person-Trade-off，PTO）方法越来越多地被用于收集关于健康方面的偏好信息。本文探讨了在一项关于公众如何区分不同年龄患者的问题研究中，PTO方法的测量特性。具体而言，本文研究了PTO回应是否满足传递性原则，即是否可以从两个其他PTO回应中推断出一个回应。研究结果表明，极少数的PTO回应满足传递性条件。然而，该研究的结果表明，当那些不满足传递性条件的受访者被排除在分析之外时，传递性条件平均来说仍然成立。这表明，未来的PTO研究应该加入对传递性条件的检验。

abstract.text: Objectives This paper asks whether measles vaccination can reduce socioeconomic differentials in under five mortality rates (U5MR) in a setting characterized by extreme poverty and high levels of childhood mortality. Design Longitudinal cohort study based on quasi experimental design. Setting Data come from the phased introduction of a measles vaccine intervention in Matlab, Bangladesh in 1982. Subjects There were 16 270 Bangladeshi children aged 9-60 months. Intervention The intervention cohort received measles vaccine. Main outcome measures Socioeconomic differentials in U5MR between the lowest and highest socioeconomic status (SES) quintiles in a cohort of 8135 vaccinated children and a cohort of unvaccinated age matched controls. Mantel-Haenszel rate ratios for the lowest to highest SES quintile were computed. SES was measured by factor analysis of maternal schooling, land holdings, dwelling size, and number of rooms. Results The U5MR ratio of lowest SES to highest was 2.27 (95% CI=1.62-3.19) in the unvaccinated population and 1.42 (95%CI=0.94-2.15) in the vaccinated population. The difference between unvaccinated and vaccinated U5MR ratios was statistically significant (p<0.10) and robust across alternative measures of SES. Conclusion Children from the poorest quintile were more than twice as likely to die as those from the least quintile in the absence of measles vaccination. Universal distribution of measles vaccination largely nullified SES related mortality differentials within a high mortality population of children.

10.1002/hec.732.abstractZh:
目的：本文旨在探讨在极端贫困和儿童死亡率高的背景下，麻疹疫苗接种是否能够降低五岁以下儿童死亡率的社会经济差异。  
设计：基于准实验设计的纵向队列研究。  
背景数据：数据来源于1982年孟加拉国马德拉斯地区分阶段引入麻疹疫苗干预措施的情况。  
研究对象：共有16,270名9至60个月大的孟加拉国儿童。  
干预措施：接受麻疹疫苗接种的队列。  
主要结果：在8135名接种疫苗的儿童和未接种疫苗的年龄匹配对照组中，最低社会经济地位与最高社会经济地位五分位数的五岁以下儿童死亡率存在显著的社会经济差异。计算了最低与最高社会经济地位五分位数的Mantel-Haenszel比率。社会经济地位通过母亲教育水平、土地持有量、住宅面积以及房间数量的因素分析来衡量。  
结果：在未接种疫苗的人群中，最低社会经济地位与最高社会经济地位五分位数的五岁以下儿童死亡率之比为2.27（95%置信区间：1.62-3.19），而在接种疫苗的人群中这一比例为1.42（95%置信区间：0.94-2.15）。未接种疫苗与接种疫苗人群之间的五岁以下儿童死亡率差异具有统计学意义（p<0.10），且这种差异在不同社会经济地位衡量指标下均显著。  
结论：在没有麻疹疫苗接种的情况下，最贫困五分位数的儿童死亡风险是最低五分位数的两倍多。在儿童死亡率高的群体中，麻疹疫苗的普遍接种在很大程度上消除了与社会经济地位相关的死亡率差异。

abstract.text: The criterion of cost-effectiveness in health management may be given a welfare-theoretical justification if people are risk neutral with respect to life years. With risk aversion, the optimal allocation of health expenditures changes: Compared to the cost-effective allocation, more resources should be allocated to health conditions for which the expected outcomes even after treatment are worse than average. The consequences of medical interventions are usually not known with certainty. Given this type of uncertainty, simple application of cost-effectiveness analysis would recommend maximization of expected health benefits given the health budget. We show that when people are risk averse with respect to the number of life years they live, the uncertainty associated with different types of interventions should play a role in allocating the health budget.

10.1002/hec.733.abstractZh: 在健康管理中，成本效益的标准可以在人们对于生命年数风险中立的情况下得到福利理论上的解释。如果人们存在风险厌恶，那么健康支出的最优分配就会发生变化：与成本效益最优分配相比，应该将更多的资源分配给那些即使经过治疗后的预期结果也低于平均水平的健康状况。医疗干预的后果通常并不确定。鉴于这种不确定性，简单的成本效益分析会建议根据健康预算最大化预期健康收益。我们表明，当人们对于所生活的生命年数存在风险厌恶时，不同类型干预措施所带来的不确定性应该在分配健康预算时发挥作用。

abstract.text: This paper examines selection and matching incentives of performance-based contracting (PBC) in a model of patient heterogeneity, provider horizontal differentiation and asymmetric information. Treatment effectiveness is affected by the match between a patient's illness severity and a provider's treatment intensity. Before PBC, a provider's revenue is unrelated to treatment effectiveness; therefore, providers supply treatments even if their treatment intensities do not match with the patients' severities. Under PBC, budget allocation is positively related to treatment performance; patient-provider mismatch is reduced because patients are referred more often. Using data from the state of Maine, we show that PBC leads to more referrals and better match between illness severity and treatment intensity. Moreover, we find that PBC has a positive but insignificant effect on dumping.

10.1002/hec.734.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在患者异质性、医疗服务提供者水平差异以及信息不对称的情况下，基于绩效的合同安排的选择与匹配激励机制。治疗效果受到患者疾病严重程度与医疗服务提供者治疗强度之间匹配程度的影响。在基于绩效的合同安排出现之前，医疗服务提供者的收入与治疗效果无关；因此，即使治疗强度与患者疾病严重程度不匹配，医疗服务提供者仍会提供治疗服务。在基于绩效的合同安排下，预算分配与治疗效果呈正相关；由于患者更频繁地被推荐给医疗服务提供者，患者与医疗服务提供者之间的不匹配程度降低。通过缅因州的数据分析，我们发现基于绩效的合同安排能够增加推荐次数，并改善疾病严重程度与治疗强度之间的匹配程度。此外，我们还发现基于绩效的合同安排对“倾销行为”有积极但不显著的影响。

abstract.text: The need to ensure adequate numbers of motivated health professionals is at the forefront of the modernisation of the UK NHS. The aim of this paper is to assess current understanding of the labour supply behaviour of nurses, and to propose an agenda for further research. In particular, the paper reviews American and British economics literature that focuses on empirical econometric studies based on the classical static labour supply model. American research could be classified into first generation, second generation and recent empirical evidence. Advances in methods mirror those in the general labour economics literature, and include the use of limited dependent variable models and the treatment of sample selection issues. However, there is considerable variation in results, which depends on the methods used, particularly on the effect of wages. Only one study was found that used UK data, although other studies examined the determinants of turnover, quit rates and job satisfaction. The agenda for further empirical research includes the analysis of discontinuities in the labour supply function, the relative importance of pecuniary and non-pecuniary job characteristics, and the application of dynamic and family labour supply models to nursing research. Such research is crucial to the development of evidence-based policies.

10.1002/hec.737.abstractZh: 确保拥有足够数量的积极性高的医疗专业人员是英国国家医疗服务体系现代化进程中的首要任务。本文旨在评估目前对护士劳动力供给行为的理解，并提出进一步研究的建议。具体而言，本文回顾了美国及英国关于基于经典静态劳动力供给模型的实证计量经济学研究文献。美国的研究可以分为第一代、第二代以及最近的实证证据。方法上的进步与一般的劳动力经济学文献相似，包括使用有限依赖变量模型以及处理样本选择问题。然而，研究结果存在很大差异，这主要取决于所使用的方法，尤其是工资因素的影响。只有一项研究使用了英国的数据，而其他研究则探讨了员工流动、辞职率和工作满意度的影响因素。进一步的实证研究议程包括分析劳动力供给函数的不连续性、金钱与非金钱工作特征的相对重要性，以及将动态和家庭劳动力供给模型应用于护理研究。这类研究对于制定基于证据的政策至关重要。

abstract.text: Three measures of the value of time - willingness to pay (WTP) for a reduction in travel time, willingness to accept (WTA) a monetary compensation to forgo it, and the wage rate - are evaluated and compared. WTP and WTA were estimated from the two-part regressions of time price, using contingent valuation methods with primary survey data. Systematic differences are found in comparisons of WTP and WTA with the wage rate.

10.1002/hec.738.abstractZh: 对时间价值的三个衡量指标进行了评估与比较：对减少旅行时间的支付意愿（WTP）、为放弃该时间而愿意接受的金钱补偿意愿（WTA），以及工资率。支付意愿和接受意愿是通过对时间价格进行两部分回归分析来估算的，使用的是基于初步调查数据的条件价值评估方法。在比较支付意愿、接受意愿与工资率时，发现了系统性的差异。

abstract.text: There is evidence in the economics literature that restrictions on Medicaid funding for abortion reduces the demand for abortion. The unresolved question is whether such restrictions also increase safe sex (that is, pregnancy avoidance) behavior among women. This study explores that issue using state-level gonorrhea rates among women for 1975-1995. The rationale is that sexual behavior that leads to greater risk of accidental pregnancies is likely to be highly correlated with sexual behavior leading to greater risk of STD infection. Since gonorrhea has an incubation period of about a week, and is transmitted almost exclusively through sexual intercourse, a change in sexual behavior should soon be followed by a change in gonorrhea rates. The study used a partial adjustment model with lagged-dependent variables estimated using Arellano-Bond's GMM method. Results fail to find any statistically significant evidence that Medicaid funding restrictions are effective in reducing gonorrhea rates. This finding is robust to a variety of alternate specifications and tests. This suggests that restrictions on Medicaid funding for abortion fail to promote safe sex behavior among women.

10.1002/hec.740.abstractZh: 经济学文献中有证据表明，对堕胎的Medicaid资金限制会降低对堕胎的需求。尚未解决的问题是，这种限制是否也会增加女性采取安全性行为（即避免怀孕）的行为。本研究利用1975年至1995年间各州的女性淋病发病率数据来探讨这一问题。研究认为，导致意外怀孕风险增加的性行为，很可能与导致性传播疾病感染风险增加的性行为高度相关。由于淋病的潜伏期约为一周，且几乎只能通过性行为传播，因此性行为的变化应很快伴随着淋病发病率的变化。研究采用了部分调整模型，并使用Arellano-Bond的GMM方法估计滞后依赖变量。研究结果并未发现任何统计上显著的证据表明，对堕胎的Medicaid资金限制能够有效降低淋病发病率。这一发现在不同替代模型和检验中均保持稳定。这表明，对堕胎的Medicaid资金限制未能促进女性采取安全性行为。

abstract.text: Logical inconsistencies in survey respondents' valuations of hypothetical health states - represented by the EQ-5D, for example - present a conundrum as to whether or not their responses ought to be included for estimating social 'tariffs'. A 'logical inconsistency' occurs when a state that 'in logical terms' is unambiguously less severe than another is assigned a lower value. Excluding such responses is defensible on data quality grounds but puts at risk the representativeness of the estimated tariff, given it is meant to represent the preferences of 'society'. This paper explores the rationale for and effect of excluding, to varying degrees, responses distinguished by the number of pairwise inconsistencies they contain, and reports equations for two tariffs that arise from contrasting approaches. The data are from a random sample of adult New Zealanders whose visual analogue scale valuations for a selection of EQ-5D states were collected in 1999 via a postal survey to which 1360 people responded (a 50% response rate). We conclude that there is no simple, generalisable 'rule' to guide exclusions and therefore researchers ought to explore the sensitivity of their estimated tariffs (and ultimately QALY estimates) to alternative treatments of logically inconsistent responses.

10.1002/hec.741.abstractZh: 调查受访者对假设健康状态的评估中存在逻辑上的不一致性，例如使用EQ-5D来表示这些状态。这种不一致性使得是否应该将这些回答纳入社会“价格”估算中成为一个难题。所谓“逻辑上的不一致”，是指一个在逻辑上明显比另一个更轻的状态却被赋予了较低的价值。从数据质量的角度来看，排除这些回答是合理的，但这会危及估算出的“价格”的代表性，因为该“价格”旨在反映“社会”的偏好。本文探讨了不同程度排除这些回答的理由和影响，并提出了两种基于不同方法的“价格”估算公式。数据来自1999年新西兰成年人随机样本，通过邮寄调查收集了他们对一系列EQ-5D状态的视觉模拟评分，共有1360人参与调查，响应率为50%。我们得出结论，没有一种简单、可推广的“规则”来指导排除这些回答，因此研究人员应该研究他们的估算出的“价格”（以及最终的QALY估算）对逻辑上不一致回答的不同处理方式的影响。

abstract.text: This paper seeks to enlighten the readers on the potential complexities involved in including cost variables in conjoint analysis, with the aim of emphasising that interpretation of implicit WTP values should be tackled with caution. To illustrate the potential pitfalls, a large data set from a recent Danish study is applied. The data consists of 1991 interviews in which participants are required to perform three discrete choice tasks regarding choice of hospitals, and three choice tasks involving health-care systems in general. Model comparisons are performed which test the effect of (1) the cost range applied and (2) the effect of including a dummy variable to represent the utility associated with payment per se. A wider cost range including higher payments is associated with lower parameter weights associated with the payment variable, and thus increased WTP values. Including a dummy variable to explain utility associated with payment per se has significant effects on the model incurring some of the other variables to become insignificant, and others to change sign. Results suggest that inclusion of a two-dimensional structure to explain the relationship between cost and utility may avoid erroneous conclusions and give rise to significant changes in implicit WTP estimates.

10.1002/hec.742.abstractZh: 本文旨在向读者阐明在联合分析中纳入成本变量所涉及的潜在复杂性，并强调应谨慎对待对隐性支付意愿值的解释。为了说明潜在的陷阱，本文引用了丹麦最近的一项大型研究数据。该数据包含1991年的访谈记录，参与者需要完成三项关于医院选择的离散选择任务，以及三项关于医疗体系选择的任务。通过模型比较，检验了以下因素的影响：(1)所应用的成本范围；(2)使用虚拟变量来表示与支付本身相关的效用。更宽的成本范围以及更高的支付金额与支付变量的参数权重较低相关，从而导致支付意愿值增加。使用虚拟变量来解释与支付本身相关的效用对模型有显著影响，导致部分其他变量变得不显著，而另一些变量的符号发生变化。结果表明，采用二维结构来解释成本与效用之间的关系可以避免错误的结论，并可能导致隐性支付意愿估计值的显著变化。

abstract.text: State Medicaid programs are turning increasingly to managed care to control expenditures, although the types of managed care programs in use have changed dramatically. Little is known about the influence of the shifting Medicaid managed care arena on treatment decisions. This paper investigates factors affecting the selection of treatments for depression by providers participating in either of two Medicaid managed care programs. Of particular interest is the influence of medication price on the choice of treatment, since one vehicle through which managed care organizations can reduce total expenditures is by increasing the price sensitivity of participating providers. We take a new approach by phrasing the problem as a discrete choice, using a nested multinomial logit model for the analyses. Contrary to earlier literature, we find some evidence that physicians in both programs do take price into consideration when selecting among treatment options. HMO providers in particular demonstrate increased price sensitivity in the two most commonly prescribed categories of antidepressants.

10.1002/hec.743.abstractZh: 州级医疗补助计划越来越多地采用管理式护理来控制支出，尽管所使用的管理式护理计划类型已经发生了巨大变化。关于这种变化的医疗补助管理式护理对治疗决策的影响，目前了解甚少。本文研究了参与两种医疗补助管理式护理计划的医疗服务提供者在选择抑郁症治疗方法时的因素。特别值得关注的是药物价格对治疗选择的影响，因为管理式护理组织可以通过提高参与提供者的价格敏感度来减少总支出。我们采用一种新的方法，将问题表述为离散选择问题，并使用嵌套多项逻辑模型进行分析。与早期的研究不同，我们发现两个计划中的医生在选择治疗方案时确实会考虑价格因素。特别是HMO提供者，在两种最常见的抗抑郁药类别中表现出更高的价格敏感度。

abstract.text: This paper seeks to analyse the findings of an extensive household survey, uncovering interesting evidence of variation in health-seeking behaviour across rural and urban areas due, it is suggested, to differences in real costs, quality of care, and perceptions of the value of health and health care. It is shown that, ceteris paribus, urban households in Kazakhstan are more likely to consult, to be admitted to hospital, to report illness, and will spend relatively more on health care. The data suggest the need for further qualitative study into the factors underlying these patterns leading to strategies to increase the quality, acceptability and affordability of rural health services. This is important given the decline in health indicators such as life expectancy in Kazakhstan and the increased burden on households of funding health care in a time of economic insecurity and deterioration of public services.

10.1002/hec.749.abstractZh: 本文旨在分析一项广泛的家庭调查的结果，发现农村与城市地区在健康寻求行为上存在差异，这可能是由于实际成本、护理质量以及对健康与医疗保健价值的认知差异所致。研究表明，在其他条件相同的情况下，哈萨克斯坦的城市家庭更有可能寻求医疗帮助、被医院收治、报告疾病，并且会在医疗保健上花费更多的资金。这些数据表明，需要进一步进行定性研究，以了解导致这些模式的因素，并制定策略来提高农村医疗服务的质量、可接受性和 affordability。鉴于哈萨克斯坦的卫生指标如预期寿命的下降，以及在经济不稳定和公共服务恶化的情况下，家庭在医疗保健上的负担加重，这一点尤为重要。

abstract.text: We evaluated three questions that commonly arise when unit costing exercises for multinational trials are conducted: (1). In countries where investigators plan to collect hospital unit cost estimates for a selected set of diagnoses, how should one estimate unit costs for the remaining diagnoses observed in the trial for which cost data were not collected? (2). For how many hospital diagnoses should estimates be obtained? (3). For how many countries should they be obtained? We addressed these questions using unit cost data collected in four western European countries and three relative value measures from the US Medicare diagnosis-related group (DRG) payment system. We found that the arithmetic mean length of stay from the US DRG payment system was a good predictor of unit costs in four countries in Europe. We also found that the imputation error decreased as the number of hospital diagnoses and countries sampled increased, but that the rate of reduction in error shrank. Finally, we found that - given the existence of a reliable method for cost imputation - from a pure information standpoint, it is better to obtain estimates for fewer hospital diagnoses from more countries than the reverse.

10.1002/hec.750.abstractZh: 我们评估了在跨国试验中进行单位成本计算时常见的三个问题：(1)在研究人员计划收集选定诊断组医院单位成本估计数据的国家，应如何估算试验中未收集成本数据的其余诊断的单元成本？(2)应该为多少个医院诊断获取估计值？(3)应该为多少个国家获取这些估计值？我们使用在四个西欧国家收集的单位成本数据以及来自美国Medicare诊断相关组支付系统的三种相对价值衡量标准来解决这些问题。我们发现，来自美国Medicare支付系统的平均住院天数在欧洲四个国家是单位成本的良好预测指标。我们还发现，随着医院诊断数量和抽样国家的增加，估算误差会减小，但误差减少的速率逐渐降低。最后，我们发现——鉴于存在可靠的成本估算方法——从纯粹的信息角度来看，从更多国家获取较少医院诊断的估计值比相反的情况更为有利。

abstract.text: The World Health Report 2000 focuses on the performance of health-care systems around the globe. The report uses efficiency measurement techniques to create a league table of health-care systems, highlighting good and bad performers. Efficiency is measured using panel data methods. This paper suggests that the WHO's estimation procedure is too narrow and that contextual information is hidden by the use of one method. This paper uses and validates a range of parametric and non-parametric empirical methods to measure efficiency using the WHO data. The rankings obtained are compared to the WHO league table and we demonstrate that there are trends and movements of interest within the league tables. We recommend that the WHO broaden its range of techniques in order to reveal this hidden information.

10.1002/hec.751.abstractZh: 《2000年世界卫生报告》重点关注全球各卫生系统的表现。该报告采用效率测量技术，编制了一份卫生系统排行榜，并突出表现优秀和较差的卫生系统。效率的衡量采用了面板数据方法。本文指出，世界卫生组织的估算方法过于狭隘，且单一方法未能充分揭示上下文信息。本文运用了一系列参数化与非参数化的实证方法，利用世界卫生组织的数据来衡量效率。所得排名与世界卫生组织排行榜进行了对比，我们发现排行榜中存在一些值得关注的趋势和变化。我们建议世界卫生组织扩大技术手段的运用范围，以便揭示这些隐藏的信息。

abstract.text: The study aimed to estimate the value of the change in health in Sweden 1980/81 to 1996/97. Quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) for men and women at specific ages were estimated for 1980/81, 1988/89 and 1996/97, by combining survival rates and health state scores. Data from the Swedish Survey of Living Conditions (n = 39,966) were used to estimate age-specific health state scores. Responses to selected survey questions were mapped into the EQ-5D measure, using the UK EQ-5D index tariff to derive health state scores. The monetary value of a QALY was assumed to be 100,000 dollars. Life expectancy for infants increased by 3.68 years for males and 2.70 years for females between 1980/81 and 1996/97. Average health status decreased in younger age groups whereas it increased in older age groups. Expected QALYs for infants increased by 2.64 for males and 0.54 for females. With 3% discounting the gain was 0.11 QALYs (11,000 dollars) among males and a loss by 0.58 QALYs (58,000 dollars) among females. The corresponding gain in discounted QALYs for a 75-year-old was 1.15 (115,000 dollars) and 0.80 (80,000 dollars), respectively. It is concluded that older persons have experienced considerable health gains whereas the health gains have been small or non-existent for younger women.

10.1002/hec.754.abstractZh: 本研究旨在估算1980/81至1996/97年间瑞典健康状况的变化价值。通过结合生存率和健康状态评分，估算了1980/81年、1988/89年和1996/97年特定年龄段的男性和女性的质量调整生命年（QALYs）。使用瑞典生活条件调查的数据（n = 39,966）来估算特定年龄的健康状态评分。将选定的调查问题答案转换为EQ-5D指标，并利用英国EQ-5D指数价格表来得出健康状态评分。假设一个QALY的货币价值为100,000美元。1980/81年至1996/97年间，婴儿的预期寿命分别增加了3.68年和2.70年。年轻年龄组的平均健康状况下降，而老年年龄组则有所改善。婴儿的预期QALYs分别增加了2.64和0.54。经过3%的贴现后，男性获得的收益为0.11 QALYs（11,000美元），而女性则损失了0.58 QALYs（58,000美元）。对于75岁的老年人，相应的收益分别为1.15 QALYs（115,000美元）和0.80 QALYs（80,000美元）。研究结论表明，老年人群体的健康状况有所改善，而年轻女性的健康状况改善幅度较小或不存在。

abstract.text: Contingent valuation (CV) has been criticised for being too hypothetical, with expressed values bearing little relation to actual values. The magnitude of this divergence, however, depends upon how realistic and believable the contingent market is. This paper presents an overview of five key aspects in the construction of the contingent market: (i) scenario development and presentation; (ii) payment vehicle; (iii) expression of risk; (iv) time period of valuation; and (v) survey administration. CV studies in health care since 1985, totalling 111, are critically reviewed with respect to these five aspects. It is concluded that CV studies in health care have performed poorly in the construction, specification and presentation of the contingent market, and that there has been little, if any, improvement in this respect over the last 15 years. Suggestions are made concerning why this may be the case, and how the construction of the contingent market may be improved in future.

10.1002/hec.755.abstractZh: 偶然估值方法因过于假设性而受到批评，其表达出的价值与实际价值之间几乎没有关联。然而，这种差异的幅度取决于偶然市场本身的现实性和可信度。本文概述了构建偶然市场时五个关键方面：(i) 情景的开发和呈现；(ii) 支付方式；(iii) 风险表达；(iv) 估值的时间段；以及(v) 调查管理。自1985年以来，关于医疗保健领域的偶然估值研究共有111项，这些研究在五个方面的表现都值得批判性地评估。研究结论表明，医疗保健领域的偶然估值研究在构建、规范及呈现偶然市场方面表现不佳，过去15年中在这方面几乎没有改进。文章还提出了关于为何会出现这种情况的建议，并探讨了未来如何改进偶然市场的构建方式。

abstract.text: Perceived quality of private and public health care, income and insurance premium are among the determinants of demand for private health insurance (PHI). In the context of a model in which individuals are expected utility maximizers, the non purchasing choice can result in consuming either public health care or private health care with full cost paid out-of-pocket. This paper empirically analyses the effect of the determinants of the demand for PHI on the probability of purchasing PHI by estimating a pseudo-structural model to deal with missing data and endogeneity issues. Our findings support the hypothesis that the demand for PHI is indeed driven by the quality gap between private and public health care. As expected, PHI is a normal good and a rise in the insurance premium reduces the probability of purchasing PHI albeit displaying price elasticities smaller than one in absolute value for different groups of individuals.

10.1002/hec.756.abstractZh: 私人医疗和公共医疗的感知质量、收入以及保险费用等因素，都是影响私人健康保险需求的因素之一。在一个个体追求效用最大化的模型背景下，不购买私人健康保险的选择可能导致消费者选择公共医疗或私人医疗，但需全额自付费用。本文通过构建一个伪结构模型来应对缺失数据和内生性问题，实证分析了这些因素对购买私人健康保险概率的影响。我们的研究结果支持这样一个假设：私人健康保险的需求确实受到私人医疗与公共医疗之间质量差距的驱动。正如预期的那样，私人健康保险是一种正常商品，保险费用的上升会降低购买私人健康保险的概率，尽管不同群体的价格弹性都小于1。

abstract.text: In many countries, social health insurance systems are being reformed in favor of more competition among insurers, while premiums are community rated by regulation. The implicit incentives for insurers to engage in risk selection can only be curtailed using appropriate systems of risk-adjusted equalization payments among insurers. To develop these systems, predictors of individual utilization patterns have to be identified, e.g. via regression analysis using previous utilization data. In some countries such as Germany, such data are hardly ever available. In the early nineties, a number of sickness funds participated in an experiment in which individual utilization data were collected. Our data set covers more than 70,000 members of company sickness funds over a 5-year period. We analyze socio-demographic determinants of utilization which could be used as risk adjusters in a risk equalization scheme. Our results suggest that besides age and sex, the set of risk adjusters should include income, family status and a dummy for the last year of life.

10.1002/hec.757.abstractZh: 在许多国家，社会健康保险体系正在进行改革，以促进保险公司之间的竞争，同时保费则通过法规进行社区评估。要限制保险公司进行风险选择的隐性激励，只能通过适当的保险公司间风险调整补偿机制来实现。为了建立这样的机制，需要识别出个人使用模式的预测因素，例如通过利用以往的使用数据进行回归分析。在一些国家，如德国，这类数据几乎无法获得。在九十年代初，一些疾病基金参与了一项实验，该实验收集了个人使用数据。我们的数据集涵盖了5年间超过70,000名公司疾病基金成员的数据。我们分析了可能作为风险调整因素的社会人口学决定因素。我们的研究结果表明，除了年龄和性别之外，风险调整因素还应包括收入、家庭状况以及生命最后一年的虚拟变量。

abstract.text: Cost-efficiency targets, used to encourage downward pressure on hospital unit costs, have been employed within the UK NHS for many years. There has been considerable speculation that these targets create incentives to reduce beds and increase occupancy rates at the expense of holding spare capacity to accommodate fluctuations in emergency admissions. This research used panel data for the period 1994/1995-1999/2000, supplemented by a series of semi-structured interviews, to explore the strategies Trusts employ to reduce unit costs. No relationship could be found between published targets and changes in unit costs, nor that targets were successful in reducing the dispersion of unit costs over time. Interviews revealed that efficiency gains required of Trusts, usually dictated by the local health economy, often bore no correspondence to the national or regional published targets. Results further indicated that contrary to prior speculation, Trusts divide into two distinct groups, those with high occupancy rates and those with a high proportion of free beds to accommodate emergencies, with Trust characteristics displaying stability over time. A pressing need for future work is the development of measures to encourage efficiency that take account of quality improvement.

10.1002/hec.758.abstractZh: 成本效率目标被英国国家医疗服务体系用于长期鼓励医院单位成本的下降。有观点认为，这些目标会促使医院减少床位数量并提高入住率，而牺牲了为应对急诊人次波动而保留的备用床位能力。本研究利用1994/1995至1999/2000年的面板数据，并结合一系列半结构化访谈，探讨了各医疗机构为降低单位成本所采取的策略。研究发现，公布的成本效率目标与单位成本的变化之间并无关联，且这些目标在降低单位成本波动方面并未取得显著效果。访谈显示，医疗机构所需的效率提升通常受当地医疗经济状况的制约，而这些要求往往与国家和地区的公布目标不符。研究结果还表明，与之前的推测相反，医疗机构可分为两类：一类是入住率较高的医疗机构，另一类是拥有大量免费床位的医疗机构，用于应对急诊情况。此外，医疗机构的特征随时间保持稳定。未来的研究需要开发能够同时促进效率提升和品质改善的评估方法。

abstract.text: This paper uses new cross-country data to assess the relationship between public spending on health care and the health status of the poor. Data are drawn from two sources: (i) existing data on health status by income quintile tabulated from demographic health surveys in 44 countries; and (ii) our estimates of the health status of the poor in over 70 countries drawn from a new technique in decomposing social indicators. Our estimates confirm that the poor have significantly worse health status than the nonpoor and the regression results provide new evidence that public spending on health care matters more to them. However, the results suggest that increased public spending alone will not be sufficient to significantly improve health status.

10.1002/hec.759.abstractZh: 本文利用新的跨国数据来评估公共医疗保健支出与贫困人口健康状况之间的关系。数据来源于两个渠道：(i) 来自44个国家的人口健康调查中的按收入五分位数划分的现有健康状况数据；以及(ii) 通过一种新的社会指标分解技术得出的70多个国家中贫困人口健康状况的估算结果。我们的估算表明，贫困人口的健康状况明显低于非贫困人口，回归分析结果进一步证明，公共医疗保健支出对他们来说更为重要。然而，结果表明，仅靠增加公共支出并不足以显著改善贫困人口的健康状况。

abstract.text: There are a number of perspectives that an individual could be asked to adopt in studies designed to elicit preferences for use in informing resource allocation decisions in health care. This paper develops a conceptual framework that clearly distinguishes between six different perspectives. It is argued that the appropriate perspective to use depends on normative considerations and the particular policy context to which it will be applied. We suggest a future research agenda that explicitly addresses these considerations and which involves direct empirical investigation into the effect of perspective on preferences.

10.1002/hec.760.abstractZh: 在旨在引出对资源分配决策中使用的偏好意见的研究中，个人可能需要采纳多种视角。本文提出了一个概念框架，明确区分了六种不同的视角。我们认为，应使用的适当视角取决于规范性的考量以及该视角所适用的具体政策环境。我们建议未来的研究议程应明确考虑这些因素，并涉及对视角对偏好影响的直接实证研究。

abstract.text: The World Health Organisation's (WHO) approach to the measurement of health system efficiency is briefly described. Four arguments are then presented. First, equity of finance should not be a criterion for the evaluation of a health system and, more generally, the same objectives and importance weights should not be imposed upon all countries. Secondly, the numerical value of the importance weights do not reflect their true importance in the country rankings. Thirdly, the model for combining the different objectives into a single index of system performance is problematical and alternative models are shown to alter system rankings. The WHO statistical analysis is replicated and used to support the fourth argument which is that, contrary to the author's assertion, their methods cannot separate true inefficiency from random error. The procedure is also subject to omitted variable bias. The econometric model for all countries has very poor predictive power for the subset of OECD countries and it is outperformed by two simpler algorithms. Country rankings based upon the model are correspondingly unreliable. It is concluded that, despite these problems, the study is a landmark in the evolution of system evaluation, but one which requires significant revision.

10.1002/hec.761.abstractZh: 本文简要描述了世界卫生组织在衡量卫生系统效率方面的做法。随后提出了四个论点：首先，财政公平不应作为评估卫生系统的标准，更普遍地说，不应对所有国家施加相同的目标和重要性权重。其次，重要性权重的数值并不能反映它们在国家排名中的真实重要性。第三，将不同目标合并为单一系统绩效指数的模型存在问题，其他模型则能够改变系统排名。世界卫生组织的统计分析被重新应用，以支持第四个论点，即与作者所述相反，他们的方法无法区分真正的低效率与随机误差。该程序还受到遗漏变量偏差的影响。针对所有国家的计量经济模型在OECD国家子集中具有非常差的预测能力，其表现不如两种更简单的算法。基于该模型的国别排名因此不可靠。尽管存在这些问题，这项研究仍然是系统评估领域的一个里程碑，但还需要进行重大修订。

abstract.text: In the recent past, considerable effort in health economics has been made on applying stated preference methods such as contingent valuation and choice experiments. Despite this increased use, there is still considerable scepticism concerning the value of these approaches. The application of contingent valuation in environmental economics has a long history and has been widely accepted. Whilst choice experiments were introduced to the environmental and health economics literature at a similar time, the wider acceptance of monetary measures of benefit in environmental economics has meant that they have also been more widely applied. The purpose of this paper is to identify some of the key issues and debates that have taken place in the environmental economics literature, summarise the state of the art with respect to these issues, and consider how health economists have addressed these issues. Important areas for future research in health economics are identified.

10.1002/hec.763.abstractZh: 在最近的历史中，健康经济学领域在应用诸如条件价值评估选择和实验等偏好表达方法方面做出了相当大的努力。尽管这些方法的应用日益广泛，但人们对这些方法的价值仍持怀疑态度。条件价值评估在环境经济学中的应用有着悠久的历史，并且已被广泛接受。虽然选择和实验方法在环境与健康经济学文献中的引入时间相近，但由于环境经济学中货币化利益衡量方法的广泛接受，这些方法也得到了更广泛的应用。本文旨在识别环境经济学文献中存在的若干关键问题和争议，总结这些问题的现状，并探讨健康经济学家是如何解决这些问题的。同时，本文还指出了健康经济学未来研究的重要领域。

abstract.text: In this paper it is argued that the separation of elements associated with the time spent by the patient is not conducted in a consistent way. This is the case for income (for which there at least has been some attention) and for other time elements like lost unpaid work, leisure and role-functioning. The use of general rather than specific preferences in health state assessments makes the separation of time-elements into costs and effects difficult. While costs are calculated specifically for the patient group under study, effects are normally derived from preferences in the general public. The characteristics of these two groups in terms of (the opportunity of) spending time on activities need not coincide. The use of specific time-group valuations of health states may be a good alternative to using general health state valuations.

10.1002/hec.764.abstractZh: 本文认为，与患者所花费时间相关的各项要素之间的划分并未得到一致的处理。对于收入这一要素（至少已经有一些研究关注），以及其他时间要素，如失去的无偿工作、休闲和角色功能活动，都未能进行恰当的划分。在健康状态评估中，使用一般偏好而非特定偏好使得将时间要素划分为成本和效应变得困难。虽然成本是针对所研究的特定患者群体进行计算的，但效应通常是从一般公众的偏好中推导出来的。这两组人在时间分配上的特点并不一定相同。因此，使用特定时间群体的健康状态评估，可能是替代使用一般健康状态评估的一个好方法。

abstract.text: Estimating elasticities of cigarette demand has become commonplace amongst economists and policymakers. Synthesizing the various elasticities into a coherent message is quite challenging, however, as the point estimates are obtained using quite disparate modeling techniques and data. In this study, we perform a meta-analysis to explore factors that influence variations within and across studies. Empirical results suggest that demand specification, data issues, and estimation methodology have varying degrees of influence on reported estimates of price, income, and advertising elasticities.

10.1002/hec.765.abstractZh: 在经济学家和政策制定者中，估算香烟需求的弹性已成为常见做法。然而，将各种弹性综合成一个连贯的结论却相当具有挑战性，因为这些点估计是通过不同的建模技术和数据获得的。在这项研究中，我们进行了元分析，以探讨影响不同研究之间差异的因素。实证结果表明，需求模型设定、数据问题以及估计方法对价格、收入和广告弹性的报告估计值有着不同程度的影响。

abstract.text: When collecting patient-level resource use data for statistical analysis, for some patients and in some categories of resource use, the required count will not be observed. Although this problem must arise in most reported economic evaluations containing patient-level data, it is rare for authors to detail how the problem was overcome. Statistical packages may default to handling missing data through a so-called 'complete case analysis', while some recent cost-analyses have appeared to favour an 'available case' approach. Both of these methods are problematic: complete case analysis is inefficient and is likely to be biased; available case analysis, by employing different numbers of observations for each resource use item, generates severe problems for standard statistical inference. Instead we explore imputation methods for generating 'replacement' values for missing data that will permit complete case analysis using the whole data set and we illustrate these methods using two data sets that had incomplete resource use information.

10.1002/hec.766.abstractZh: 在收集患者级资源使用数据以进行统计分析时，对于某些患者和某些资源使用类别，所需的计数数据可能缺失。尽管这个问题在大多数包含患者级数据的经济评估中都会出现，但很少有作者详细说明如何解决这个问题。统计软件默认采用所谓的“完整案例分析”来处理缺失数据，而一些最新的成本分析则倾向于采用“可用案例”的方法。这两种方法都存在问题：完整案例分析效率低下且可能存在偏差；而“可用案例”分析方法通过为每项资源使用项目分配不同数量的观测数据，会给标准统计推断带来严重问题。因此，我们探索了用于生成缺失数据“替代值”的插补方法，这些方法能够允许使用整个数据集进行完整案例分析。我们通过两个资源使用信息不完整的数据集来说明这些方法的应用。

abstract.text: In recent work, the concentration index has been widely used as a measure of income-related health inequality. The purpose of this note is to illustrate two different methods for decomposing the overall health concentration index using data collected from a Short Form (SF-36) survey of the general Australian population conducted in 1995. For simplicity, we focus on the physical functioning scale of the SF-36. Firstly we examine decomposition 'by component' by separating the concentration index for the physical functioning scale into the ten items on which it is based. The results show that the items contribute differently to the overall inequality measure, i.e. two of the items contributed 13% and 5%, respectively, to the overall measure. Second, to illustrate the 'by subgroup' method we decompose the concentration index by employment status. This involves separating the population into two groups: individuals currently in employment; and individuals not currently employed. We find that the inequality between these groups is about five times greater than the inequality within each group. These methods provide insights into the nature of inequality that can be used to inform policy design to reduce income related health inequalities.

10.1002/hec.767.abstractZh: 在最近的研究中，浓度指数被广泛用作衡量与收入相关的健康不平等的指标。本文旨在说明两种不同的方法，这些方法用于分解1995年对澳大利亚普通人群进行的简短健康问卷（SF-36）调查所收集的数据得出的整体健康浓度指数。为简化分析，我们重点关注SF-36中的身体功能指标。首先，我们通过将身体功能指标的浓度指数分解为其中的十个单项指标来进行分解。结果表明，这些单项指标对整体不平等程度的贡献不同，其中两项指标分别贡献了13%和5%的不平等程度。其次，为了说明“按子组分解”的方法，我们按就业状态对浓度指数进行分解。这涉及将人群分为两组：目前就业的个人和目前未就业的个人。我们发现，这两组之间的不平等程度大约是组内不平等程度的五倍。这些方法为我们提供了对不平等本质的洞察，有助于制定政策以减少与收入相关的健康不平等。

abstract.text: In a pilot study we investigate whether the inferences we draw about people's preferences towards health care treatments are altered if we vary the procedure that is used to elicit these preferences. In a conventional time trade-off (TTO) question, respondents express their preferences towards treatment by comparing a period of ill-health with a shorter period in a higher quality of life. In our less conventional TTO question, we vary the procedure by asking respondents their preferences towards treatment by comparing a period of ill-health with a longer period in a lower quality of life. The quantitative data are equivocal about whether preferences for treatment differ between the conventional and unconventional questions. The qualitative data support the notion of contrasting issues in the questions that involve prolonging time in a lower quality of life and appear to account for a failure to find quantitative differences in all of the questions.

10.1002/hec.768.abstractZh: 在一项试点研究中，我们探讨了如果改变引出人们偏好偏好医疗治疗的方式，我们对人们医疗治疗偏好的推断是否会发生变化。在传统的时间权衡问题中，受访者通过将一段健康状况不佳的时期与一段生活质量较高的时期进行比较来表达他们对治疗的偏好。而在我们不太传统的这种时间权衡问题中，我们通过让受访者将一段健康状况不佳的时期与一段生活质量较低的时期进行比较来表达他们对治疗的偏好。定量数据表明，在传统问题和不传统的问题之间，对治疗的偏好是否存在差异尚不确定。定性数据则支持这样一种观点，即涉及在较低生活质量下延长时间的问题与涉及在较低生活质量下延长时间的问题之间存在差异，这似乎可以解释为什么在所有问题中都未能发现定量上的差异。

abstract.text: Systematic violations of expected utility theory (EU) have been reported in the context of both money and health outcomes. Rank-dependent utility theory (RDU) is currently the most popular and influential alternative theory of choice under circumstances of risk. This paper reports a test of the descriptive performance of RDU compared to EU in the context of health. When one of the options is certain, violations of EU that can be explained by RDU are found. When both options are risky, no evidence that RDU is a descriptive improvement over EU is found, though this finding may be due to the low power of the tests.

10.1002/hec.769.abstractZh: 在金钱和健康结果的相关领域，系统性地违反了期望效用理论（EU）的现象已被报道。在风险情境下，依赖排名的效用理论（RDU）目前是最受欢迎且最具影响力的选择理论替代方案。本文报告了在健康领域，RDU与EU在描述性表现上的对比测试。当其中一个选项确定时，可以发现可以用RDU来解释的EU的违反现象。而当两个选项都具有风险性时，并未发现RDU在描述性上优于EU的证据，尽管这一发现可能是由于测试的功效较低所致。

abstract.text: Markov models have traditionally been used to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of competing health care technologies that require the description of patient pathways over extended time horizons. Discrete event simulation (DES) is a more flexible, but more complicated decision modelling technique, that can also be used to model extended time horizons. Through the application of a Markov process and a DES model to an economic evaluation comparing alternative adjuvant therapies for early breast cancer, this paper compares the respective processes and outputs of these alternative modelling techniques. DES displays increased flexibility in two broad areas, though the outputs from the two modelling techniques were similar. These results indicate that the use of DES may be beneficial only when the available data demonstrates particular characteristics.

10.1002/hec.770.abstractZh: 马尔可夫模型传统上被用于评估需要描述患者路径在较长时间范围内的竞争性医疗保健技术的成本效益。离散事件仿真是一种更为灵活但更复杂的决策建模技术，同样可以用于模拟较长时间范围的情况。本文通过将马尔可夫过程和离散事件仿真模型应用于比较早期乳腺癌替代辅助治疗方法的经济评估，比较了这两种建模技术的过程和输出结果。尽管两种建模技术的输出结果相似，但离散事件仿真在两个方面表现出更高的灵活性。这些结果表明，只有在现有数据能够体现特定特征的情况下，使用离散事件仿真才可能具有优势。

abstract.text: Purpose To study the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for a proposed community-based health insurance (CBI) scheme in order to provide information about the relationship between the premium that is required to cover the costs of the scheme and expected insurance enrollment levels. In addition, factors that influence WTP were to be identified. Methods Data were collected from a household survey using a two-stage cluster sampling approach, with each household having the same probability of being selected. Interviews were conducted with 2414 individuals and 705 household heads. The take-it-or-leave-it (TIOLI) and the bidding game were used to elicit WTP. Results The average individual was willing to pay 2384 (elicited by the TIOLI) or 3191 (elicited by the bidding game) CFA (3.17 US dollars or 4.25 US dollars) to join CBI for him/herself. The head of household agreed to pay from 6448 (elicited by the TIOLI) or 9769 (elicited by the bidding game) CFA (8.6 US dollars or 13.03 US dollars) to join the health insurance scheme for his/her household. These results were influenced by household and individual ability-to-pay, household and individual characteristics, such as age, sex and education. The two methods yielded similar patterns of estimated WTP, in that higher WTP was obtained for higher income level, higher previous medical expenditure, higher education, younger people and males. A starting point bias was found in the case of the bidding game. Conclusions Both TIOLI and bidding game methods can elicit a value of WTP for CBI. The value elicited by the bidding game is higher than by the TIOLI, but the two approaches yielded similar patterns of estimated WTP. WTP information can be used for setting insurance premium. When setting the premiums, it is important to consider differences between the real market and the theoretical one, and between the WTP and the cost of benefits package. The beneficiaries of CBI should be enrolled at the level of households or villages in order to protect vulnerable groups such as women, elders and the poor.

10.1002/hec.771.abstractZh:
目的  本研究旨在探讨对拟议中的社区基础医疗保险计划（CBI）的支付意愿，以了解所需保费与预期参保水平之间的关系。此外，还旨在识别影响支付意愿的因素。  
方法  通过两阶段聚类抽样方法从家庭调查中收集数据，每个家庭被选中的概率相同。对2414名个人和705位户主进行了访谈。采用“接受或放弃”模型和“竞标游戏”模型来引出支付意愿。  
结果  平均个人愿意为自己参加CBI支付2384（通过“接受或放弃”模型得出）或3191（通过竞标游戏得出）CFA（3.17美元或4.25美元）。户主则愿意为参加家庭医疗保险支付6448（通过“接受或放弃”模型得出）或9769（通过竞标游戏得出）CFA（8.6美元或13.03美元）。这些结果受到家庭和个人支付能力、年龄、性别和教育程度等个人特征的影响。两种方法的估计支付意愿模式相似，即收入较高、既往医疗支出较多、教育程度较高、年龄较轻和男性群体的支付意愿更高。在竞标游戏模型中发现了起始点偏差。  
结论  无论是“接受或放弃”模型还是竞标游戏模型都能得出CBI的支付意愿值。竞标游戏模型得出的支付意愿值高于“接受或放弃”模型，但两种方法得出的估计支付意愿模式相似。支付意愿信息可用于设定保险保费。在设定保险费时，需要考虑实际市场与理论市场之间的差异，以及消费者支付意愿与福利包成本之间的区别。中央基本养老保险的受益者应以家庭和村庄为单位进行参保，以保护妇女、老年人和贫困人口等弱势群体。

abstract.text: Stated preference methods are used to estimate the value that people place on health care. The data that emerges from these studies is used to guide health policy.
