However, relatively little is known about how individuals make decisions in a preference elicitation task. Two methods (willingness to pay and conjoint analysis) are considered within the context of the literature from psychology (and also environmental economics) regarding how people construct preferences, process information, and make decisions. There is substantial evidence that individuals employ heuristics (cognitive shortcuts) in order to simplify tasks they are presented with. The use of heuristics implies that people ignore much of the information they are presented with and make decisions which would not be considered rational in the economic sense. These stated preference methods assume that individuals trade between the different attributes of a good or service when making decisions - an assumption that other theories predict is wrong. The implications of this are discussed.

10.1002/hec.772.abstractZh: 陈述偏好方法被用来估算人们对医疗保健的估值。从这些研究中得出的数据被用于指导卫生政策。然而，关于个体在偏好调查任务中如何做出决策，目前了解甚少。本文在心理学（以及环境经济学）文献的背景下，探讨了两种方法——支付意愿分析和联合分析。有大量证据表明，个体在面临任务时会使用启发式思维（即认知捷径）来简化问题。使用启发式思维意味着人们会忽略大部分提供的信息，从而做出在经济意义上并不理性的决策。这些陈述偏好方法假设个体在做出决策时会权衡商品或服务的不同属性——而这一假设被其他理论所否定。本文讨论了这一现象的影响。

abstract.text: Ordinary least squares (OLS) and stochastic frontier (SF) analyses are commonly used to estimate industry-level and firm-specific efficiency. Using cross-sectional data for English public hospitals, a total cost function based on a specification developed by the English Department of Health is estimated. Confidence intervals are calculated around the OLS residuals and around the inefficiency component of the SF residuals. Sensitivity analysis is conducted to assess whether conclusions about relative performance are robust to choices of error distribution, functional form and model specification. It is concluded that estimates of relative hospital efficiency are sensitive to estimation decisions and that little confidence can be placed in the point estimates for individual hospitals. The use of these techniques to set annual performance targets should be avoided.

10.1002/hec.773.abstractZh: 普通最小二乘法和随机前沿分析法常被用于估计行业层面和企业的效率。以英国公立医院的横截面数据为基础，根据英国卫生部制定的模型，估算了总成本函数。对普通最小二乘残差以及随机前沿分析法残差中的效率低下部分，分别计算了置信区间。通过敏感性分析，评估了关于相对绩效的结论在误差分布、函数形式和模型规格选择变化时的稳健性。研究结果表明，相对医院效率的估计对估计决策非常敏感，对于单个医院的点估计，可信度较低。因此，应避免使用这些技术来设定年度绩效目标。

abstract.text: Statistical models have been used to assess the influence of clinical and demographic factors on hospital charge and length of stay (LOS). Hospital costs constitute a significant proportion of overall expenditure in health care. With escalating costs, knowing the correlates of LOS and in-hospital cost is important for decisions on allocating resources. However, hospital charge and LOS are correlated. We describe two regression models that permit estimation of mean charges as a function of patient hospital stay and adjust for the influence of patient characteristics and treatment procedures on LOS and charge. In the first model, the mean charge over a specified duration is a weighted average of the expected cumulative charge, with weighting determined by the distribution of LOS. The second model for LOS and charge explicitly accounts for their correlation and yields estimates of the average charge per average LOS. The methods are applied to assess mean charges and mean charge per day by cardiac procedure in a cohort of patients hospitalized for acute myocardial infarction, while adjusting for the impact of patient demographic and clinical factors on LOS and charge. For relatively short hospital stays, and when only total hospital charges are available, these models provide a flexible approach to estimating summary measures on resource use while controlling for the effects of covariates on LOS and charge.

10.1002/hec.774.abstractZh: 统计模型已被用于评估临床和人口统计因素对医院费用及住院时间的影响。医院成本在医疗保健总支出中占有重要比例。随着成本的不断上升，了解住院时间和医院费用的相关因素对于资源分配决策至关重要。然而，医院费用与住院时间之间存在相关性。我们描述了两种回归模型，这些模型能够估算出患者住院时间对应的平均费用，并调整患者特征和治疗程序对住院时间和费用的影响。在第一个模型中，特定时间段内的平均费用是根据住院时间分布确定的加权平均值。第二个模型则明确考虑了住院时间和费用之间的相关性，并得出平均住院时间对应的平均费用估算值。这些方法被应用于评估急性心肌梗塞患者住院期间心脏手术的平均费用及每日平均费用，同时调整了患者人口统计和临床因素对住院时间和费用的影响。对于住院时间相对较短的情况，当仅有总医院费用数据时，这些模型提供了一种灵活的方法，可以在控制协变量对住院时间和费用影响的同时，估算资源使用的汇总指标。

abstract.text: This paper identifies and discusses a number of methodological issues that require consideration when applying preference-based approaches to the measurement of the health status of children. It is argued that the decision about which dimensions of health status to incorporate into health state descriptions or classifications should depend, in part, upon whether the measure will be used to inform resource allocation within or across age groups. In addition, the paper identifies and discusses a number of methodological issues surrounding the appropriate respondents for descriptions and valuations of health status in different contexts; potential sources of bias in the description and valuation processes; and the psychometric integrity of alternative measurement approaches.

10.1002/hec.775.abstractZh: 本文指出了在采用基于偏好的方法衡量儿童健康状况时需要考虑的一系列方法论问题。文章认为，关于将哪些健康状况的维度纳入健康状态描述或分类的决定，应部分取决于该测量方法是否用于指导不同年龄组内的资源分配。此外，文章还探讨了在不同情境下描述和评估健康状况所涉及的方法论问题，包括描述和评估过程中可能出现的偏见来源，以及不同测量方法的心理测量完整性。

abstract.text: This paper presents and compares two threshold approaches to measuring the fairness of health care payments, one requiring that payments do not exceed a pre-specified proportion of pre-payment income, the other that they do not drive households into poverty. We develop indices for 'catastrophe' that capture the intensity of catastrophe as well as its incidence and also allow the analyst to capture the degree to which catastrophic payments occur disproportionately among poor households. Measures of poverty impact capturing both intensity and incidence are also developed. The arguments and methods are empirically illustrated with data on out-of-pocket payments from Vietnam in 1993 and 1998. This is not an uninteresting application given that 80% of health spending in that country was paid out-of-pocket in 1998. We find that the incidence and intensity of 'catastrophic' payments - both in terms of pre-payment income as well as ability to pay - were reduced between 1993 and 1998, and that both incidence and intensity of 'catastrophe' became less concentrated among the poor. We also find that the incidence and intensity of the poverty impact of out-of-pocket payments diminished over the period in question. Finally, we find that the poverty impact of out-of-pocket payments is primarily due to poor people becoming even poorer rather than the non-poor being made poor, and that it was not expenses associated with inpatient care that increased poverty but rather non-hospital expenditures.

10.1002/hec.776.abstractZh: 本文提出了两种衡量医疗支付公平性的阈值方法，一种要求支付金额不超过预付费收入的一定比例，另一种则要求支付金额不会使家庭陷入贫困。我们开发了“灾难性”指标，用于捕捉灾难性的强度、发生频率，并允许分析师了解灾难性支付在贫困家庭中的不成比例发生程度。同时，我们还开发了能够同时反映强度和频率的贫困影响衡量指标。通过1993年和1998年越南的实付医疗费用数据，对这些论点和方法进行了实证分析。鉴于1998年该国80%的医疗费用是实付的，这一研究并非毫无意义。我们发现，从预付费收入和支付能力来看，“灾难性”支付的发生频率和强度在1993年至1998年间有所下降，且“灾难性”支付在贫困人群中的集中程度也降低了。此外，我们还发现，在相关时期内，实付医疗费用的贫困影响发生频率和强度都有所下降。最后，我们发现，实付医疗费用的贫困影响主要是由于贫困人口变得更加贫困，而非非贫困人口变得贫困；增加贫困的是非住院支出，而非住院护理相关的费用。

abstract.text: The use of willingness to pay to value the benefits of health care is increasing. Much of this work assumes that health preferences are well formed or 'complete' and readily revealed if the right question is asked in the right way. We examined this assumption, seeking evidence in a mixed-methods study that explored the meaning and implications of vague responses to a payment-scale based willingness to pay exercise.One-half of the sample said that their vagueness meant that their maximum willingness to pay was actually greater than the amount that they had previously said it was. Thirty percent agreed that they would probably pay pound 10 more than a sum that they had previously said they would most definitely not pay, if they found this to be the cost of the vaccine. Interview data supported the view that the payment scale had failed to elicit the maximum willingness to pay and that some participants used the information on cost to help clarify their values, in contrast to the theory underpinning willingness to pay. The results suggest a need to consider values-clarification in health economic evaluations.

10.1002/hec.777.abstractZh: 使用支付意愿来评估医疗保健的效益变得越来越普遍。许多研究假设健康偏好是明确或“完整”的，如果以正确的方式提出正确的问题，这些偏好就会很容易被揭示出来。我们对此假设进行了检验，通过一项混合方法研究来探讨对支付意愿模糊回答的含义和含义。一半的样本表示，他们的模糊回答意味着他们的最大支付意愿实际上比他们之前所说的要高。30%的人同意，如果疫苗的成本是10英镑，他们可能会比之前所说的支付更多10英镑。访谈数据支持这样的观点：支付意愿的评估未能引出最大的支付意愿，一些参与者利用成本信息来帮助明确他们的价值观，这与支付意愿的理论相悖。结果表明，在健康经济评估中需要考虑价值观的明确化。

abstract.text: Economic evaluation generally limits outcome measurement to the valuation of health outcomes produced by interventions without considering the impact of processes on utility. We test for process utility by comparing utility measurements for alternative approaches to managing abnormal Pap smears in the context of a fixed outcome. The impact of health care interventions on individual well-being was not confined to health outcomes. Aggressive and conservative follow-up approaches were associated with statistically significant differences in utilities. We also found that relative preferences among different processes may depend on the particular circumstances or pathologies being considered.

10.1002/hec.783.abstractZh: 经济评估通常仅关注干预措施对健康结果的影响，而忽略了这些过程对效用的影响。我们通过比较不同管理方法在固定结果情境下的效用测量值，来检验过程的效用。医疗干预对个人福祉的影响并不仅限于健康结果。积极和保守的随访方法在效用上存在统计学上的显著差异。我们还发现，不同过程之间的相对偏好可能取决于所考虑的具体情况或病理特征。

abstract.text: A key theoretical prediction concerning willingness to pay is that it is positively correlated with benefit size and is assessed by testing the 'sensitivity to scale (scope)'. 'External' (between-sample) sensitivity tests are usually regarded as less powerful than 'internal' (within-subject) tests. However, the latter may suffer from 'anchoring' effects. This paper studies the statistical power of these tests by questioning the distributional assumption of empirical data. We present an integrated model to capture both internal and external variations, while controlling for sample heterogeneity, applied to data from a survey estimating the value of reducing symptom-days. Results indicate that once data is properly transformed, WTP becomes 'scale sensitive' and consistent with diminishing marginal utility theory.

10.1002/hec.786.abstractZh: 关于支付意愿的一个关键理论预测是，支付意愿与收益大小呈正相关，这一结论是通过测试“规模敏感性”来确定的。通常认为，“外部”敏感性测试（样本间比较）的效度低于“内部”敏感性测试（同一受试者在不同样本中的比较）。然而，后者可能会受到“锚定效应”的影响。本文通过质疑实证数据的分布假设，研究了这些测试的统计效力。我们提出了一个综合模型，以同时考虑内部和外部的变异，并控制样本异质性，该模型应用于一项调查的数据，该调查旨在估算减少症状天数的价值。结果表明，一旦数据经过适当转换，支付意愿就会变得“规模敏感”，并且与边际效用递减理论相符。

abstract.text: There remains disagreement about the preferred utility-based measure of health-related quality of life for use in constructing quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). The recent development of a new measure, the SF-6D, has highlighted this issue. The SF-6D and EuroQol EQ-5D measure health-related utilities on a scale where 0 represents death and 1 represents full health, and both have utility scores generated from random samples of the general UK population. This study explored whether, in a large sample of liver transplant patients, the two instruments provide similar results. The empirical data highlight important variation in the results generated from the use of the two instruments. The data are consistent with a view that the SF-6D does not describe health states at the lower end of the utility scale but is more sensitive than EQ-5D in detecting small changes towards the top of the scale.

10.1002/hec.787.abstractZh: 关于用于构建质量调整生命年（QALYs）的健康相关生活质量的最佳效用基准指标，目前仍存在分歧。新开发的SF-6D指标进一步凸显了这一问题。SF-6D和EuroQol EQ-5D都采用0代表死亡、1代表完全健康的尺度来衡量健康相关效用，两者的效用评分均来自英国普通人群的随机样本。本研究探讨了在大量肝移植患者样本中，这两种指标是否能得出相似的结果。实证数据表明，使用这两种指标得到的结果存在显著差异。这些数据支持这样一种观点：SF-6D无法准确描述效用尺度较低端的健康状况，但在检测效用尺度较高端的小变化方面，SF-6D比EQ-5D更为敏感。

abstract.text: The cost-effectiveness of new health care technologies is conditional upon who receives what therapy and under what circumstances. Understanding this heterogeneity in cost-effectiveness, health care payers often limit reimbursement of therapies to a more restrictive sub-group of patients than that indicated in a product's licensing. Such limits may be based upon clinical or demographic criteria that are prognostic of costs, outcomes or both. However, there is little guidance on how to estimate and interpret stratified cost-effectiveness analysis. In this paper we present a framework for estimating the benefits from stratification that permits consideration of both the opportunity cost resulting from a lack of adherence with criteria and the efficiency loss associated with incorporating equity concerns.

10.1002/hec.788.abstractZh: 新型医疗技术的成本效益取决于谁在何种情况下接受何种治疗。为了理解这种成本效益的异质性，医疗支付方通常会将治疗费用的报销范围限制在比产品许可说明中规定的更狭窄的患者群体中。这些限制可能基于能够预测费用、治疗效果或两者兼有的临床或人口统计标准。然而，关于如何估算和解释分层成本效益分析的方法，目前缺乏明确的指导。在本文中，我们提出了一个估算分层带来的效益的框架，该框架能够同时考虑由于未遵循这些标准而导致的机会成本，以及与考虑公平问题相关的效率损失。

abstract.text: Background The SF-6D is a new health state classification and utility scoring system based on 6 dimensions ('6D') of the Short Form 36, and permits a "bridging" transformation between SF-36 responses and utilities. The Health Utilities Index, mark 3 (HUI3) is a valid and reliable multi-attribute health utility scale that is widely used. We assessed within-subject agreement between SF-6D utilities and those from HUI3. Methods Patients at increased risk of sudden cardiac death and participating in a randomized trial of implantable defibrillator therapy completed both instruments at baseline. Score distributions were inspected by scatterplot and histogram and mean score differences compared by paired t-test. Pearson correlation was computed between instrument scores and also between dimension scores within instruments. Between-instrument agreement was by intra-class correlation coefficient (ICC). Results SF-6D and HUI3 forms were available from 246 patients. Mean scores for HUI3 and SF-6D were 0.61 (95% CI 0.60-0.63) and 0.58 (95% CI 0.54-0.62) respectively; a difference of 0.03 (p<0.03). Score intervals for HUI3 and SF-6D were (-0.21 to 1.0) and (0.30-0.95). Correlation between the instrument scores was 0.58 (95% CI 0.48-0.68) and agreement by ICC was 0.42 (95% CI 0.31-0.52). Correlations between dimensions of SF-6D were higher than for HUI3. Conclusions Our study casts doubt on the whether utilities and QALYs estimated via SF-6D are comparable with those from HUI3. Utility differences may be due to differences in underlying concepts of health being measured, or different measurement approaches, or both. No gold standard exists for utility measurement and the SF-6D is a valuable addition that permits SF-36 data to be transformed into utilities to estimate QALYs. The challenge is developing a better understanding as to why these classification-based utility instruments differ so markedly in their distributions and point estimates of derived utilities.

10.1002/hec.789.abstractZh:
背景  
SF-6D是一种新的健康状态分类和效用评分系统，基于Short Form 36的6个维度，并允许在SF-36反应和效用之间进行“桥梁”转换。健康效用指数3级（HUI3）是一种有效且可靠的多属性健康效用尺度，被广泛使用。我们评估了SF-6D效用与HUI3效用的内部一致性。  

方法  
具有突发心脏死亡高风险并参与植入式除颤器治疗随机试验的患者在基线时完成了这两种工具的评分。通过散点图和直方图检查评分分布，并通过配对t检验比较平均评分差异。计算了工具评分之间的相关性，以及工具内各维度评分之间的相关性。工具间的一致性通过类内相关系数（ICC）进行评估。  

结果  
共有246名患者提供了SF-6D和HUI3的评分数据。HUI3和SF-6D的平均评分分别为0.61（95%置信区间0.60-0.63）和0.58（95%置信区间0.54-0.62），差异为0.03（p<0.03）。HUI3和SF-6D的评分区间分别为（-0.21至1.0）和（0.30-0.95）。工具评分之间的相关性为0.58（95%置信区间0.48-0.68），一致性通过ICC为0.42（95%置信区间0.31-0.52）。SF-6D各维度之间的相关性高于HUI3。  

结论  
我们的研究对通过SF-6D估算的效用和QALYs是否与HUI3的估算结果相当提出了质疑。效用差异可能是由于测量健康概念的不同、测量方法的不同，或两者兼有的原因。目前尚无效用测量的黄金标准，而SF-6D作为一种有价值的补充，能够将SF-36数据转换为效用，以估算QALYs。挑战在于更好地理解，为什么这些基于分类的效用工具在分布和派生效用的点估计上存在如此显著的差异。

abstract.text: There are strong theoretical arguments for including future costs for related and unrelated medical care and non-medical expenditures within economic evaluations. Nevertheless, there is limited data on how inclusion of such costs affects the cost effectiveness of medical interventions in practice. For a low-cost intervention that improves survival in end-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients, we sought to determine how the inclusion of future costs for related medical care (i.e. dialysis and transplantation) and for unrelated medical care and non-medical expenditure would affect the magnitude of the cost per QALY ratio. We performed a cost-utility analysis comparing hemodialysis using a synthetic dialyser (the current treatment of choice in Canada) with the historical gold-standard treatment (use of a cellulose dialyser). We contrasted the results of the analysis including and excluding various measures of future costs. While the inclusion of future costs for unrelated medical care and non-medical expenditures had a significant impact on the cost per QALY ratio, the size of the cost per QALY ratio was most sensitive to inclusion of future costs for related medical care. Our analysis shows that even relatively inexpensive interventions that extend survival of dialysis patients may not be cost-effective since, by extending survival, the extra outpatient dialysis costs that are incurred are large. Inclusion of such costs (which, in and of itself, is methodologically correct) in economic evaluations in this area may mitigate against the acceptance of interventions that are relatively inexpensive themselves but which improve patient survival.

10.1002/hec.790.abstractZh: 有强有力的理论依据支持在经济评估中纳入与医疗相关及无关的医疗费用和非医疗支出。然而，关于将这些成本纳入对医疗干预措施成本效益影响的数据非常有限。对于一种能够改善终末期肾病患者生存期的低成本干预措施，我们试图确定将未来相关医疗护理成本（如透析和移植）以及无关医疗支出纳入评估后，每QALY成本比率的变化情况。我们进行了成本-效用分析，比较了使用合成透析器进行血液透析（加拿大目前的首选治疗方法）与历史上的黄金标准治疗方法（使用纤维素透析器）。我们对比了包含和排除各种未来成本指标后的分析结果。虽然将无关医疗支出和非医疗支出纳入成本计算对每QALY成本比率有显著影响，但每QALY成本比率的变化对相关医疗护理成本的纳入最为敏感。我们的分析表明，即使是对透析患者生存时间有显著延长且成本相对较低的干预措施，也可能不具备成本效益，因为延长生存时间所带来的额外门诊透析成本相当高。在经济学评估中纳入这些成本（本身在方法上是正确的），或许有助于避免接受那些本身成本较低但能改善患者生存时间的干预措施。

abstract.text: We recently completed a study which demonstrated that the costs of health technology assessment (HTA) by randomised controlled trial (RCT) can be reduced by substituting routine datasets for data designed and collected specifically for a trial. This cost reduction, however, had the effect of reducing the quality of the research output. In the present study we attempted to tease out the values attached to the 'better' information provided by designed data RCTs using a mock grants committee. Two valuation techniques, implied values and willingness to pay, were used. Ex ante valuations were determined by comparing alternative research proposals - a more costly version using designed data and a cheaper version using routine data. Ex post valuations were determined by comparing results of both versions. The exercise was performed on four exemplar studies. Overall, the committee expressed a general lack of trust towards routine data both ex ante and ex post and placed high values on the better information from the designed data studies - particularly information on preferences. This suggests that currently available routine datasets are not perceived to be able to provide efficient alternatives to designed data for RCTs.

10.1002/hec.791.abstractZh: 我们最近完成了一项研究，该研究表明，通过用专门为试验设计和收集的数据替代常规数据集，可以降低随机对照试验（RCT）中的健康技术评估成本。然而，这种成本降低会导致研究质量下降。在本研究中，我们尝试使用模拟的资助委员会来评估“更优质”的数据所提供的信息的价值。我们采用了两种估值方法：隐含价值和支付意愿。事前估值是通过比较不同的研究提案来确定的——一种使用设计数据的成本更高的版本，另一种使用常规数据的成本较低的版本。事后估值则是通过比较这两种版本的结果来确定的。这项研究针对了四个示例研究进行了分析。总体而言，委员会在事前和事后都对常规数据缺乏信任，并且认为设计数据研究所提供的更优质信息具有更高的价值——尤其是关于偏好的信息。这表明，目前可用的常规数据集被认为无法为RCT提供与设计数据相当的高效替代方案。

abstract.text: Contracts have played a central role in public sector reforms in developed countries over the last decade, and research increasingly highlights their varied nature. In low and middle income countries the use of contracts is encouraged but little attention has been paid to features of the setting that may influence their operation. A qualitative case study was used to examine different dimensions of a contract with private GPs in South Africa. Features of the contract are compared with the notions of classical and relational contracts. Formal aspects of the contract such as design, monitoring and resort to sanctions were found to offer little control over its outcome. The relational rather than classical model of contracting offered a more meaningful framework of analysis, with social and institutional factors found to play an important role. In particular, the individual nature of GP practices highlighted the role played by individual motivation where a contract exercised little formal control. Due to the similarity of factors likely to be present, results are argued to be relevant in many other LMIC settings, and policy-makers considering contracts for clinical services are advised to consider the possibility of experiencing a similar outcome.

10.1002/hec.792.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，合同在发达国家的公共部门改革中发挥了核心作用，相关研究越来越多地揭示了合同的多样性。在低收入和中等收入国家，合同的运用得到了鼓励，但对其运作可能受到影响的特定环境因素却鲜有关注。一项定性案例研究用于考察南非私人全科医生合同中不同的维度。将合同的特点与经典合同和关系合同的概念进行了比较。研究发现，合同的正式方面，如设计、监控以及制裁措施，对合同结果的控制作用有限。关系型而非经典型合同模式提供了更有意义的分析框架，社会与制度因素在其中发挥了重要作用。特别是全科医生工作的个体性质，凸显了个体动机在合同执行中的重要性，而合同在形式上的控制作用相对较弱。由于可能存在类似的因素，这些研究结果被认为在许多其他低收入中等收入国家也具有相关性。因此，考虑使用合同来提供临床服务的政策制定者应考虑到可能出现类似结果的可能性。

abstract.text: In conjoint analysis (CA) studies, choosing between scenarios with multiple health attributes may be demanding for respondents. This study examined whether simplifying the choice task in CA designs, by using a design with more overlap of attribute levels, provides advantages over standard minimal-overlap methods. Two experimental conditions, minimal and increased-overlap discrete choice CA designs, were administered to 353 respondents as part of a larger HIV testing preference survey. In the minimal-overlap survey, all six attribute levels were allowed to vary. In the increased-overlap survey, an average of two attribute levels were the same between each set of scenarios. We hypothesized that the increased-overlap design would reduce cognitive burden, while minimally impacting statistical efficiency. We did not find any significant improvement in consistency, willingness to trade, perceived difficulty, fatigue, or efficiency, although several results were in the expected direction. However, evidence suggested that there were differences in stated preferences. The results increase our understanding of how respondents answer CA questions and how to improve future surveys.

10.1002/hec.798.abstractZh: 在联合分析研究中，让受访者在具有多个健康属性的情景之间进行选择可能会带来挑战。本研究探讨了在联合分析设计中，通过使用属性水平重叠更多的设计来简化选择任务，是否比标准的最小重叠方法具有优势。作为更大规模的HIV测试偏好调查的一部分，我们对353名受访者进行了两种实验条件的联合分析：最小重叠设计和增加重叠的离散选择联合分析设计。在最小重叠调查中，所有六个属性水平都可以发生变化。在增加重叠调查中，每组情景中平均有两个属性水平是相同的。我们假设增加重叠的设计能够减少认知负担，同时对统计效率的影响最小。我们没有发现一致性、交易意愿、感知难度、疲劳或效率方面的显著改善，尽管一些结果符合预期。然而，有证据表明，受访者对选项的偏好存在差异。这些结果增进了我们对受访者如何回答联合分析问题以及如何改进未来调查的理解。

abstract.text: A willingness to pay (WTP) per quality-adjusted-life year (QALY) of DKK 88,000 was estimated on the basis of elicited preferences for health states. The WTP per QALY estimate presented here differs considerably from that implied in contingent valuation studies, suggesting that WTP for reducing risk of death is based on other preference structures than is ex post WTP for improvements in quality of life. Results further suggest that different preference structures may exist when respondents are faced with WTP questions in which case elimination of minor health problems are associated with negligible utility.

10.1002/hec.799.abstractZh: 基于对健康状态的偏好，估计了每质量调整生命年（QALY）为88,000丹麦克朗的支付意愿。这里提出的每QALY支付意愿估计值与条件价值评估研究中得出的结果有很大差异，这表明减少死亡风险的支付意愿基于与其他偏好结构不同的基础，而实际对生活质量改善的支付意愿则并非如此。研究结果进一步表明，当受访者面临支付意愿问题时，可能存在不同的偏好结构，在这种情况下，消除轻微的健康问题所带来的效用可以忽略不计。

abstract.text: The hospital length-of-stay and the discharge destination of a Medicare patient are the outcomes of one decision process involving the interests of the patient, the hospital, and the firms offering covered post-hospital care. We use a competing risk hazard estimation procedure and adjust for unobserved heterogeneity with a non-parametric technique to identify significant factors in the decision process. A patient's health and socio-economic characteristics, the availability of informal care, local market area conditions, and Medicare policies influence length-of-stay and discharge destination. The substitution we find between hospital and post-hospital care and among post-hospital care alternatives has policy implications for Medicare.

10.1002/hec.800.abstractZh: 医疗保险患者的住院时间和出院去向是一个决策过程的结果，该过程涉及患者、医院以及提供覆盖性术后护理的公司的利益。我们采用了一种竞争风险风险估计方法，并使用非参数技术来消除未观察到的异质性，以识别决策过程中的重要因素。患者的健康和社会经济特征、非正式护理的可用性、当地市场条件以及医疗保险政策都会影响住院时间和出院去向。我们发现的医院与术后护理之间的替代性以及不同术后护理选择之间的替代性，对医疗保险政策具有影响。

abstract.text: This paper describes and analyzes trends in health economics articles indexed in the economics literature from 1991 to 2000, demonstrating the robust state of publication in the field during the past decade. While articles, pages, and the number of journals increased, single authorship declined dramatically from almost half of articles published to only one-third, and papers with four or more authors increased three-fold. Over three-fourths of articles were analyses of healthcare markets or health production, while policy oriented articles constituted the third largest share. Author concentration ratios decreased almost by half and the Herfindhal-Hirschman index of author concentration declined from 14 in 1991 to only 4 in 1999.

10.1002/hec.802.abstractZh: 本文对1991至2000年间经济学文献中收录的健康经济学文章的趋势进行了描述与分析，显示出该领域在过去十年中的活跃出版状况。虽然文章数量、期刊数量以及期刊总数都有所增加，但单一作者的文章比例却大幅下降，从几乎一半的文章减少到仅三分之一，而四名或更多作者共同撰写的论文比例则增加了三倍。超过四分之三的文章是对医疗市场或健康生产的研究，而以政策为导向的文章则占第三大比例。作者的集中程度几乎减少了一半，Herfindhal-Hirschman指数显示，作者的集中程度从1991年的14降至1999年的仅4。

abstract.text: This note explores the implications for measuring socioeconomic inequality in health of choosing one measure of SES rather than another. Three points emerge. First, whilst similar rankings in the two the SES measures will result in similar inequalities, this is a sufficient condition not a necessary one. What matters is whether rank differences are correlated with health - if they are not, the measured degree of inequality will be the same. Second, the statistical importance of choosing one SES measure rather than another can be assessed simply by estimating an artificial regression. Third, in the 19 countries examined here, it seems for the most part to make little difference to the measured degree of socioeconomic inequalities in malnutrition among under-five children whether one measures SES by consumption or by an asset-based wealth index.

10.1002/hec.805.abstractZh: 本文探讨了选择不同的社会经济地位衡量指标对衡量健康领域的社会经济不平等的影响。研究发现三点：首先，尽管两种衡量方式得出的排名相似，但这种情况是充分条件而非必要条件。关键在于排名差异是否与健康状况相关——如果无关，那么衡量出的不平等程度将是相同的。其次，通过估算一个人为的回归模型，可以简单评估选择不同社会经济地位衡量指标所带来的统计差异。第三，在本文研究的19个国家中，无论是通过消费指标还是基于资产的财富指数来衡量社会经济地位，对五岁以下儿童营养不良的社会经济不平等程度的影响似乎并不大。

abstract.text: The partial concentration index (PCI) is commonly used as a measure of income related inequality in health after removing the effects of standardising variables such as age and gender which affect health, are correlated with income, but not amenable to policy. Both direct and indirect standardisation have been used to remove the effects of standardising variables. The paper shows that with individual level data direct standardisation is possible using the coefficients from a linear regression of health on income and the standardising variables and yields a consistent estimate of the PCI. Indirect standardisation estimates the effects of the standardising variables on health from a health regression which excludes income. The coefficients on the standardising variables include some of the effects of income on health if income is correlated with the standardising variables. Using these coefficients to remove the effects of the standardising variables also removes some of the effect of income on health and leads to an inconsistent estimate of the PCI. Indirect standardisation underestimates the PCI irrespective of the signs of the correlations of standardising variables and income with each other and with health. An adaptation of the PCI when the marginal effect of income on health depends on the standardising variables is also proposed.

10.1002/hec.813.abstractZh: 部分集中指数（PCI）常被用作衡量与收入相关的健康不平等的指标，该指标在去除年龄和性别等标准化变量的影响后进行计算。这些标准化变量会影响健康，且与健康收入相关，但无法通过政策进行调整。直接标准化和间接标准化两种方法都被用来消除这些标准化变量的影响。本文表明，使用线性回归得出的健康与收入及标准化变量之间的系数，可以直接进行标准化处理，从而得到一致的PCI估计值。而间接标准化则通过排除收入因素的健康回归模型来估算标准化变量对健康的影响。如果收入与标准化变量存在相关性，那么标准化变量系数中也会包含部分收入对健康的影响。然而，使用这些系数来消除标准化变量的影响时，也会部分消除收入对健康的影响，从而导致PCI估计值的不一致性。无论标准化变量与收入之间以及它们与健康之间的关系具有何种符号，间接标准化都会低估PCI的值。本文还提出了一种针对这种情况的PCI调整方法，即根据收入对健康的影响程度来选择合适的标准化变量。

abstract.text: This paper investigates on the existence of physician-induced demand (PID) for French physicians. The test is carried out for GPs and specialists, using a representative sample of 4500 French self-employed physicians over the 1979-1993 period. These physicians receive a fee-for-services (FFS) payment and fees are controlled. The panel structure of our data allows us to take into account unobserved heterogeneity related to the characteristics of physicians and their patients. We use generalized method of moments (GMM) estimators in order to obtain consistent and efficient estimates. We show that physicians experience a decline of the number of consultations when they face an increase in the physician:population ratio. However this decrease is very slight. In addition, physicians counterbalance the fall in the number of consultations by an increase in the volume of care delivered in each encounter. Econometric results give a strong support for the existence of PID in the French system for ambulatory care.

10.1002/hec.823.abstractZh: 本文探讨了法国医生中医生诱导需求的存在性。研究针对普通医生和专科医生进行，样本为1979年至1993年间4500名法国自由职业医生的代表性样本。这些医生接受服务收费，且收费受到严格控制。我们的数据采用面板结构，能够考虑与医生及其患者特征相关的未观测异质性。我们使用广义矩估计方法获得一致且有效的估计结果。研究表明，当医生与患者的比例增加时，咨询次数会下降，但这种下降非常轻微。此外，医生通过增加每次就诊的医疗服务量来抵消咨询次数的减少。计量经济学结果强烈支持法国门诊护理系统中医生诱导需求的存在性。

abstract.text: Many health-care systems allocate funding according to measures of need. The utilisation approach for measuring need rests on the assumptions that use of health care is determined by demand and supply and that need is an important element of demand. By estimating utilisation models which allow for supply it is possible to isolate the socio-economic and health characteristics which affect demand. A subset of these variables can then be identified by a combination of judgement and further analysis as needs variables to inform funding allocations. We estimate utilisation models using newly assembled data on admissions to acute hospitals, measures of supply, morbidity and socio-economic characteristics for 8414 small geographical areas in England. We make a number of methodological innovations including deriving additional measures of specific morbidities at small area level from individual level survey data. We compare models with different specifications for the effect of waiting times and provider characteristics, with total, planned and unplanned hospital admissions, and estimated at small area (ward) and primary care organisation (general practice) level. After allowing for waiting times, distance, capacity and the availability of private health care, measures of mortality, self-reported morbidity, low education and low income increase the use of health care. We find evidence of horizontal inequity with respect to ethnicity and employment and suggest a method for reducing its effects when deriving a needs-based allocation formula.

10.1002/hec.830.abstractZh: 许多医疗保健系统根据需求指标来分配资金。衡量需求的利用方法基于这样的假设：医疗保健的使用由需求和供应决定，而需求是需求的一个重要组成部分。通过估算能够考虑供应的利用模型，可以分离出影响需求的社会经济和健康特征。然后，可以通过判断和进一步分析，确定其中一部分变量作为需求变量，以指导资金分配。我们使用新收集的数据，包括英格兰8414个小型地理区域的急性医院入院情况、供应指标、发病率和社会经济特征，来估算利用模型。我们在方法论上进行了多项创新，包括从个体层面调查数据中推导出小区域特定疾病的额外指标。我们比较了不同模型对等待时间和医疗服务提供者特征的影响，以及小区域（病房）和初级保健组织（全科医学）层面的总住院人次、计划内和计划外住院人次。在考虑等待时间、距离、容量以及私人医疗保健的可用性之后，死亡率、自我报告的发病率、低教育水平和低收入等因素会增加医疗保健的使用。我们发现，在种族和就业方面存在横向不平等现象，并提出了一种方法来减少这种影响，以便在制定基于需求的分配公式时考虑这些因素。

abstract.text: Shortage of nurses is a problem in several countries. It is an unsettled question whether increasing wages constitute a viable policy for extracting more labour supply from nurses. In this paper we use a unique matched panel data set of Norwegian nurses covering the period 1993-1998 to estimate wage elasticities. The data set includes detailed information on 19,638 individuals over 6 years totalling 69,122 observations. The estimated wage elasticity after controlling for individual heterogeneity, sample selection and instrumenting for possible endogeneity is 0.21. Individual and institutional features are statistically significant and important for working hours. Contractual arrangements as represented by shift work are also important for hours of work, and omitting information about this common phenomenon will underestimate the wage effect.

10.1002/hec.836.abstractZh: 护士短缺是多个国家面临的问题。增加工资是否是一种可行的政策，以吸引更多护士加入劳动力市场，这一直存在争议。在本文中，我们使用了1993年至1998年间挪威护士的独有匹配面板数据集来估计工资弹性。该数据集包含了19,638名个体在6年期间的详细信息，共计69,122个观测值。在控制个体异质性、样本选择以及可能的内生性问题后，估计出的工资弹性为0.21。个体特征和制度因素对工作时间有统计学意义且非常重要。以轮班工作为代表的合同安排也对工作时间有重要影响，忽略这一常见现象将低估工资效应。

abstract.text: This paper estimates a fully structural unitary household model of employment and health insurance decisions for dual wage-earner families with children in the United States, using data from the 1987 National Medical Expenditure Survey. Families choose hours of work and the breakdown of compensation between cash wages and health insurance benefits for each wage earner in order to maximize expected utility under uncertain need for medical care. Heterogeneous demand for the employer-sponsored health insurance is thus generated directly from variations in health status and earning potential. The paper concludes by discussing the benefits of using structural models for simulating welfare effects of insurance reform relative to the costly assumptions that must be imposed for identification.

10.1002/hec.837.abstractZh: 本文利用1987年国民医疗支出调查的数据，对美国有子女的双收入家庭在就业和医疗保险决策方面的结构完整单一家庭模型进行了估计。家庭选择工作小时数以及每位收入者的现金工资与医疗保险福利之间的分配比例，以在不确定医疗需求的情况下最大化预期效用。因此，对雇主赞助的医疗保险的不同需求直接源于健康状况和收入潜力的差异。文章最后讨论了使用结构模型来模拟保险改革对福利影响的优势，相比为识别问题而必须做出的昂贵假设，这种方法更为高效。

abstract.text: When ill the individual faces the options of seeking health care, using self-medication or doing nothing. In an economic perspective, an individual's propensity to utilise health care is determined by the costs of utilisation and the perceived benefits of health care. The propensity to utilise health care may hence be expected to vary between individuals. In this paper we attempt on the one hand to determine what factors influence sick individuals' propensity to seek health care at a health facility or use self-medication (or do nothing), and on the other hand attempt to determine the factors that influence the magnitude of their expenditures for health care, in particular what other factors than just health status influence utilisation. For the empirical analysis, data, covering 9700 individuals, from the 1998 Living Conditions Monitoring Survey (LCMS) is used. We use a Multinomial Logit selection model to estimate the equation, which allows us to analyse health-care utilisation through two separate processes, the decision to seek care and the magnitude of expenditures incurred. In general, we find that the individuals are influenced by income, insurance, type of illness and access variables such as distance and owning a vehicle.

10.1002/hec.839.abstractZh: 当个体生病时，他们面临寻求医疗护理、自行用药或无所作为的选择。从经济学的角度来看，个体利用医疗护理的倾向取决于利用医疗护理的成本以及对其感知到的益处。因此，个体利用医疗护理的倾向可能会有所不同。在本文中，我们试图一方面确定哪些因素会影响生病个体在医疗机构寻求医疗护理或自行用药（或无所作为）的倾向，另一方面则试图确定影响医疗护理支出规模的因素，特别是除了健康状况之外，还有哪些其他因素会影响医疗护理的利用。在实证分析中，我们使用了1998年生活状况监测调查中的9700名个体的数据。我们采用多项逻辑回归模型来估计方程，从而可以通过两个独立的过程来分析医疗护理的利用：寻求护理的决策和产生的支出规模。总体而言，我们发现个体受到收入、保险、疾病类型以及诸如距离和是否拥有车辆等获取条件的因素的影响。

abstract.text: A pervasive phenomenon in developing countries is that self-prescribed medications are purchased from drug vendors without professional supervision. In this article we develop a model of self-medicating behavior of a utility-maximizing consumer who balances the benefits and risks of self-medication. The empirical investigation focuses on the role of income and health insurance on the use of self-medication. Our data are from the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Survey of Vietnam, 1997-1998. The results show that self-medication is an inferior good at high income levels and a normal good at low income levels, and it shows a strong and robust negative insurance effect.

10.1002/hec.841.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，一个普遍的现象是，人们在没有专业监督的情况下，从药品贩售商那里购买自制药剂。本文建立了一个模型，用于描述一个效用最大化的消费者的自我用药行为，该模型考虑了自我用药的利弊。实证研究重点关注收入和健康保险对自我用药行为的影响。我们的数据来自世界银行1997-1998年对越南的生活水平测量调查。研究结果表明，在高收入水平下，自我用药是一种劣等商品；而在低收入水平下，则是一种正常商品。此外，研究还发现，健康保险对自我用药行为具有强烈的负向影响。

abstract.text: We investigate whether pairwise hospital consolidation leads to cost savings. We use a unified empirical methodology to assess both systems and mergers. Our comparison group for each consolidation consists of 10 'pseudo-mergers' chosen based on propensity scores. Cost function estimates reveal that consolidation into systems does not generate savings, even after 4 years. Mergers in which hospitals consolidate financial reporting and licenses generate savings of approximately 14%: 2, 3, and 4 years after merger. The system consolidation and merger results are very robust to changes in the specification and the sample.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.05.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了医院之间的合并是否能够带来成本节约。我们采用统一的实证方法来评估系统合并和医院合并的效果。对于每次合并，我们的对照组由10个基于倾向评分选择的“伪合并”组成。成本函数估计显示，即使经过4年后，系统合并也并未带来成本节约。而那些通过合并使医院在财务报告和许可方面实现整合的合并，在合并后2年、3年和4年分别实现了约14%的成本节约。系统合并和合并的结果对于规范和样本的变化表现出很强的稳健性。

abstract.text: Although the 1996 welfare reform legislation limited the eligibility of immigrant households to receive assistance, many states chose to protect their immigrant populations by offering state-funded aid to these groups. I exploit these changes in eligibility rules to examine the link between the welfare cutbacks and health insurance coverage in the immigrant population. The data reveal that the cutbacks in the Medicaid program did not reduce health insurance coverage rates among targeted immigrants. The immigrants responded by increasing their labor supply, thereby raising the probability of being covered by employer-sponsored health insurance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.05.002.abstractZh: 尽管1996年的福利改革立法限制了移民家庭获得援助的资格，但许多州仍选择通过提供州政府资助的援助来保护这些群体的利益。我利用这些资格规则的变化，来研究福利削减与移民人口健康保险覆盖率之间的关系。数据显示，医疗补助计划的削减并没有降低目标移民群体的健康保险覆盖率。移民们通过增加劳动力供应来应对这一情况，从而提高了他们获得雇主赞助健康保险的可能性。

abstract.text: We explore the causes of the dramatic rise in employee contributions to health insurance over the past two decades. In 1982, 44% of those who were covered by their employer-provided health insurance had their costs fully financed by their employer, but by 1998 this had fallen to 28%. We discuss the theory of why employers might shift premiums to their employees, and empirically model the role of four factors suggested by the theory. We find that there was a large impact of falling tax rates, rising eligibility for insurance through the Medicaid system, rising medical costs, and increased managed care penetration. Overall, this set of factors can explain more than one-half of the rise in employee premiums over the 1982-1996 period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.06.001.abstractZh: 我们探讨了过去二十年员工为健康保险支付的费用急剧上升的原因。1982年，有44%的雇员通过雇主提供的健康保险获得全额费用报销，但到1998年这一比例下降到了28%。我们讨论了雇主可能将保险费转嫁给员工的理论依据，并通过实证分析研究了该理论所提出的四个因素的作用。研究发现，税率下降、通过医疗体系获得保险资格的人数增加、医疗费用上升以及管理式医疗的普及程度提高，这些因素对员工保险费上升产生了较大影响。总体而言，这些因素可以解释1982年至1996年间员工保险费上升幅度的一半以上。

abstract.text: Economic models of patient decision-making emphasize the costs of getting medical attention and the improved physical health that results from it. This note builds a model of patient decision-making when fears or anxiety about the future-captured as beliefs about next period's state of health-also enter the patient's utility function. Anxiety can lead the patient to avoid doctor's visits or other easily available information about her health. However, this avoidance cannot take any form: she will never avoid the doctor with small problems, and under regularity conditions she will never go to a bad doctor to limit the information received.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.06.002.abstractZh: 患者决策的经济模型强调获得医疗服务的成本以及由此带来的身体健康改善。本文构建了一个患者决策模型，其中对未来的恐惧或焦虑——被视作对下一时期健康状况的信念——也会进入患者的效用函数中。焦虑可能导致患者避免就医或获取其他关于自身健康的简单信息。然而，这种回避行为不能采取任何形式：对于小问题，患者绝不会避免就医；在常规条件下，患者也不会为了限制所获取的信息而选择去糟糕的医生那里就诊。

abstract.text: Recent analyses suggest that cigarette excise taxes lower prenatal smoking. It is unclear, however, whether the association between taxes and prenatal smoking represents a decline among women of reproductive age or a particular response by pregnant women. We address this question directly with an analysis of quit and relapse behavior during and after pregnancy. We find that the price elasticity of prenatal quitting and postpartum relapse is close to one in absolute value. We conclude that direct financial incentives to stop smoking during and after pregnancy should be considered.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.06.003.abstractZh: 最近的研究表明，香烟消费税可以降低孕妇的吸烟行为。然而，消费税与孕妇吸烟行为之间的关联，究竟是反映了育龄妇女吸烟行为的减少，还是孕妇对吸烟的特别反应，目前尚不清楚。我们通过分析孕期及产后戒烟和复吸行为来直接探讨这个问题。研究发现，孕期戒烟和产后复吸的行为价格弹性几乎接近1。因此，应考虑在孕期及产后提供直接的财政激励措施来鼓励戒烟。

abstract.text: We study whether welfare reform adversely affected the health insurance coverage of low-educated single mothers and their children. Specifically, we investigate whether changes in the welfare caseload during the 1990s were associated with changes in Medicaid participation, private insurance coverage, and the number of uninsured among single mothers and their children. Estimates suggest that between 1996 and 1999, the 42% decrease in the welfare caseload was associated with the following changes in insurance coverage among low-educated, single mothers: a 7-9% decrease in Medicaid coverage; an increase in employer-sponsored, private insurance coverage of 6%; and a 2-9% increase in the proportion uninsured. Among children of low-educated, single mothers, effects were somewhat smaller. Since welfare policy was responsible for only part (e.g. one-third) of the decline in the caseload, welfare reform per se had significantly smaller effects on the health insurance status of low-income families. However, we found limited evidence that changes in the caseload due to state and federal welfare policy had fewer adverse consequences on insurance status than changes in the caseload due to other factors. This implies even smaller effects of welfare reform.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.06.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了福利改革是否对低教育水平单身母亲及其子女的医疗保险覆盖产生了不利影响。具体来说，我们调查了20世纪90年代福利案件数量的变化是否与医疗补助的参与率、私人保险覆盖率的变动以及单身母亲及其子女的无保险人数变化有关。估计结果显示，在1996年至1999年间，福利案件数量减少了42%，这一变化导致低教育水平单身母亲的保险覆盖率出现了以下变化：医疗补助覆盖率减少了7-9%；雇主提供的私人保险覆盖率增加了6%；无保险人数比例增加了2-9%。对于低教育水平单身母亲的子女来说，这些影响相对较小。由于福利政策仅导致了案件数量下降的一部分（例如三分之一），因此福利改革本身对低收入家庭的医疗保险状况的影响相对较小。然而，我们发现，由于州和联邦福利政策导致的案件数量变化对保险状况的负面影响，比其他因素导致的案件数量变化要小得多。这表明福利改革的影响更为微小。

abstract.text: In the federal Medicare program, contracting health maintenance organizations (HMOs) are paid on a capitated basis. There has long been concern that an "adverse selection" of risks remain in the traditional fee-for-service (FFS) sector, since beneficiaries with low costs may leave the FFS sector and join the HMOs. The distortion associated with this form of selection is that health plans may design their mix of health care services in order to effectuate favorable selection. This paper scrutinizes patterns of HMO membership and costs by service in the FFS sector for evidence consistent with the hypothesis that HMOs engage in service-level product distortion. We develop a multi-service model of choice between FFS and HMOs and show that if the HMO sector is underproviding (overproviding) a service relative to the FFS sector, we should observe a positive (negative) correlation between the HMO market share and average costs of those remaining in the FFS sector. We estimate the correlation between the HMO market share and the average FFS costs for different health care services using Medicare data for 1996. We find evidence indicating that there exists significant service-level selection by HMOs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.06.005.abstractZh: 在联邦Medicare计划中，签约的医疗保健组织（HMOs）是按总包费的方式获得报酬的。长期以来，人们一直担心在传统的按服务收费（FFS）领域仍然存在“逆向选择”的风险，因为成本较低的受益人可能会离开FFS领域，转而加入HMOs。这种选择方式带来的扭曲是，健康计划可能会设计其医疗服务组合，以实现有利的选择。本文通过分析FFS领域的HMO会员资格和服务成本，寻找与假设一致的证据，即HMOs存在服务水平的产品扭曲行为。我们建立了一个多服务模型，研究在FFS和HMOs之间的选择，并发现如果HMO领域提供的某项服务相对于FFS领域而言不足或过剩，那么HMO市场的份额与留在FFS领域的人的平均成本之间应该存在正相关或负相关关系。我们使用1996年的Medicare数据，估计了HMO市场份额与不同医疗服务平均成本之间的相关性。我们发现有证据表明，HMOs确实存在显著的服务水平选择行为。

abstract.text: As policymakers consider expanding insurance coverage for the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV+) population, it is useful to ask whether insurance has any effect on health outcomes, and, if so, whether public insurance is as efficacious as private insurance in preventing premature death. Using data from a nationally representative cohort of HIV-infected persons receiving regular medical care, we estimate the impact of different types of insurance on mortality in this population. Our main findings are that (1) ignoring observed and unobserved health status misleads one to conclude that insurance may not be protective for HIV patients, (2) after accounting for observed and unobserved heterogeneity, insurance does protect against premature death, and (3) private insurance is more effective than public insurance. The better performance of private insurance can be explained in part by more restrictive Medicaid prescription drug policies that limit access to highly efficacious treatment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2003.07.001.abstractZh: 当政策制定者考虑扩大针对人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV+）感染者的保险覆盖范围时，有必要探讨保险是否对健康结果有任何影响，如果有的话，公共保险在预防过早死亡方面是否比私人保险更有效。我们利用一个具有全国代表性的HIV感染者队列的数据，该队列接受定期医疗护理，来估算不同类型保险对该人群死亡率的影响。我们的主要发现是：(1)忽略观察到的和未观察到的健康状况会误导人们认为保险可能对HIV患者没有保护作用；(2)在考虑了观察到的和未观察到的异质性后，保险确实能预防过早死亡；(3)私人保险比公共保险更有效。私人保险表现更好的部分原因可能是其医疗补助处方药物政策更为严格，这限制了获得高效治疗的机会。

abstract.text: Numerous reports have documented a volume-outcome relationship for complex medical and surgical care, although many such studies are compromised by the use of discharge abstract data, inadequate risk adjustment, and problematic statistical methodology. Because of the volume-outcome association, and because valid outcome measurements are unavailable for many procedures, volume-based referral strategies have been advocated as an alternative approach to health-care quality improvement. This is most appropriate for procedures with the greatest outcome variability between low-volume and high-volume providers, such as esophagectomy and pancreatectomy, and for particularly high-risk subgroups of patients. Whenever possible, risk-adjusted outcome data should supplement or supplant volume standards, and continuous quality improvement programs should seek to emulate the processes of high-volume, high-quality providers. The Leapfrog Group has established a minimum volume requirement of 500 procedures for coronary artery bypass grafting. In view of the questionable basis for this recommendation, we suggest that it be reevaluated.

10.1016/s0003-4975(02)04308-4.abstractZh: 许多研究报告记录了复杂医疗和外科护理中的手术量与结果之间的关系，但许多此类研究受到出院摘要数据使用、风险调整不足以及统计方法问题的影响而存在局限性。由于存在手术量与结果之间的关联，且许多手术的有效结果数据难以获取，因此基于手术量的转诊策略被作为改善医疗质量的替代方法而受到推崇。这一策略尤其适用于那些在低手术量和高手术量医疗机构之间结果差异较大的手术，如食管切除术和胰腺切除术，以及高风险患者群体。在可能的情况下，经过风险调整后的结果数据应补充或替代基于手术量的标准，而持续的质量改进计划应努力模仿高手术量、高质量医疗机构的工作流程。Leapfrog集团为冠状动脉旁路移植术设定了最低手术量要求为500例。鉴于这一建议的基础存在疑问，我们建议重新评估这一标准。

abstract.text: Background Many trials have been done to compare primary percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) with thrombolytic therapy for acute ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (AMI). Our aim was to look at the combined results of these trials and to ascertain which reperfusion therapy is most effective. Methods We did a search of published work and identified 23 trials, which together randomly assigned 7739 thrombolytic-eligible patients with ST-segment elevation AMI to primary PTCA (n=3872) or thrombolytic therapy (n=3867). Streptokinase was used in eight trials (n=1837), and fibrin-specific agents in 15 (n=5902). Most patients who received thrombolytic therapy (76%, n=2939) received a fibrin-specific agent. Stents were used in 12 trials, and platelet glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors were used in eight. We identified short-term and long-term clinical outcomes of death, non-fatal reinfarction, and stroke, and did subgroup analyses to assess the effect of type of thrombolytic agent used and the strategy of emergent hospital transfer for primary PTCA. All analyses were done with and without inclusion of the SHOCK trial data. Findings Primary PTCA was better than thrombolytic therapy at reducing overall short-term death (7% [n=270] vs 9% [360]; p=0.0002), death excluding the SHOCK trial data (5% [199] vs 7% [276]; p=0.0003), non-fatal reinfarction (3% [80] vs 7% [222]; p<0.0001), stroke (1% [30] vs 2% [64]; p=0.0004), and the combined endpoint of death, non-fatal reinfarction, and stroke (8% [253] vs 14% [442]; p<0.0001). The results seen with primary PTCA remained better than those seen with thrombolytic therapy during long-term follow-up, and were independent of both the type of thrombolytic agent used, and whether or not the patient was transferred for primary PTCA. Interpretation Primary PTCA is more effective than thrombolytic therapy for the treatment of ST-segment elevation AMI.

10.1016/s0140-6736(03)12113-7.abstractZh:
背景  
许多试验旨在比较经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术与溶栓疗法在急性ST段抬高型心肌梗死中的疗效。我们的研究旨在综合这些试验的结果，以确定哪种再灌注疗法最为有效。  

方法  
我们对已发表的研究进行了检索，共识别出23项试验。这些试验将7739名符合溶栓条件的ST段抬高型心肌梗死患者随机分配至经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术组（n=3872）或溶栓治疗组（n=3867）。其中8项试验使用了链激酶（n=1837），15项试验使用了纤维蛋白特异性药物（n=5902）。大多数接受溶栓治疗的患者（76%，n=2939）使用了纤维蛋白特异性药物。12项试验使用了支架，8项试验使用了血小板糖蛋白IIb/IIIa抑制剂。我们评估了短期和长期临床结果，包括死亡、非致命性再梗死和中风的发生率，并进行了亚组分析，以评估所用溶栓药物的类型以及经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术紧急转诊策略的影响。所有分析均考虑了SHOCK试验的数据，也考虑了未考虑该数据的情况。  

结果  
与溶栓疗法相比，经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术在减少短期死亡（7% [n=270] vs 9% [360]; p=0.0002）、死亡（不包括SHOCK试验数据，5% [199] vs 7% [276]; p=0.0003）、非致命性再梗死（3% [80] vs 7% [222]; p<0.0001）、中风（1% [30] vs 2% [64]; p=0.0004）以及死亡、非致命性再梗死和中风的综合终点（8% [253] vs 14% [442]; p<0.0001）方面表现更好。在长期随访中，经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术的结果仍然优于溶栓疗法，且这种优势与所用溶栓药物的类型以及患者是否进行了经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术的转诊无关。解读：对于ST段抬高型心肌梗死的治疗，介入治疗比溶栓疗法更为有效。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the internal validity of using the McMaster 'Health Utility Index Mark III' (HUI) to scale the responses on the typical self-assessed health (SAH) question, "how do you rate your health status in general?" It compares alternative procedures to impose cardinality on the ordinal responses. These include OLS, ordered probit and interval regression approaches. The cardinal measures of health are used to compute and to decompose concentration indices for income-related inequality in health. These results are validated by comparison with the individual variation in the 'benchmark' HUI responses obtained from the Canadian 'National Population Health Survey 1994-1995'. The interval regression approach, which exploits a mapping from the empirical distribution function (EDF) of HUI into SAH, outperforms the other approaches. In addition, we show how the method can be extended to allow for differences in SAH thresholds across different groups of people and to measuring and decomposing 'pure' health inequality.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00080-2.abstractZh: 本文评估了使用McMaster的“健康效用指数Mark III”（HUI）来量化典型自我评估健康状况问题“您的总体健康状况如何？”的内部有效性。文章比较了多种为序数回答施加基数化的方法，包括OLS、有序probit和区间回归方法。利用这些基数化健康指标，可以计算并分解与收入相关的健康不平等浓度指数。通过与加拿大“1994-1995年全国人口健康调查”中获得的“基准”HUI回答的个体变异进行比较，验证了这些结果。区间回归方法通过将从HUI的经验分布函数映射到健康状况评估中，表现出比其他方法更优的性能。此外，本文还展示了该方法如何扩展以允许不同人群在健康状况评估阈值上的差异，并用于衡量和分解“纯粹”的健康不平等。

abstract.text: Issue The role of prices charged to patients as a policy instrument for altering waiting times. Method A game theoretic model is used to examine the determinants of waiting times. Results Under certain circumstances an increase in the price charged to patients at some institutions will lower the waiting times at all institutions. Conclusions The results provide a set of policy implications and testable predictions that arise under a certain set of assumptions. Alternative assumptions as well as the policy implications and testable predictions associated with them are also examined.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00081-4.abstractZh: 研究问题：向患者收取的费用作为改变等待时间的政策工具的作用。研究方法：采用博弈论模型来研究等待时间的决定因素。研究结果：在某些情况下，某些机构向患者收取的费用增加会降低所有机构的等待时间。结论：研究结果提供了一组政策含义和可验证的预测，这些预测是在特定假设下得出的。同时，也探讨了其他假设以及与之相关的政策含义和可验证的预测。

abstract.text: The importance of non-profit institutions in the health care sector has generated a vast empirical literature examining quality differences between non-profit and for-profit nursing homes. Recent theoretical work has emphasized that much of this empirical literature is flawed in that previous studies rely solely on dummy variables to capture the effects of ownership rather than accounting for the share of non-profit nursing homes in the market. This analysis considers whether competitive spillovers from non-profits lead to higher quality in for-profit nursing homes. Using instrumental variables to account for the potential endogeneity of non-profit market share, this study finds that an increase in non-profit market share improves for-profit and overall nursing home quality. These findings are consistent with the hypothesis that non-profits serve as a quality signal for uninformed nursing home consumers.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00093-0.abstractZh: 非营利机构在医疗保健领域的重要性催生了大量实证研究，这些研究探讨了非营利与营利性养老院之间的质量差异。最近的理论工作指出，这些实证研究存在缺陷，因为先前的研究仅依赖虚拟变量来捕捉所有权的效应，而未能考虑非营利养老院在市场上的占比。本研究探讨了非营利机构的竞争溢出效应是否会导致营利性养老院的质量提升。通过使用工具变量来消除非营利市场份额的潜在内生性，研究发现非营利市场份额的增加能够提升营利性养老院的整体质量。这些发现与“非营利机构为不知情的养老院消费者传递质量信号”的假设一致。

abstract.text: Why do indemnity insurance plans cost substantially more per capita--77% more in our study--than HMOs? We answer this question using data from a large organization's insurance pool, covering 215,000 lives. We decompose cost differences for eight major medical conditions into four sources: demographics, incidence within demographic groups, treatment intensity, and prices per service. Greater incidence of disease in the indemnity plan (both from demographics themselves and within demographic groups) and higher prices each explain nearly 50% of the difference. Contrary to conventional wisdom, indemnity plans do not have greater treatment intensity.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00094-2.abstractZh: 为什么赔偿保险计划的人均成本要高出许多——在我们的研究中高出77%——相比之下，健康维护组织则不然？我们通过一个大型组织的保险数据来回答这个问题，这些数据涵盖了215,000人的生命保障。我们将八种主要医疗状况的成本差异分解为四个因素：人口统计特征、各人口统计群体内的发病率、治疗强度以及每项服务的价格。赔偿计划中的疾病发病率较高（无论是由于人口统计特征本身还是各人口统计群体内的因素），以及较高的价格，几乎解释了成本差异的50%。与普遍观点相反，赔偿计划并没有更高的治疗强度。

abstract.text: Disparities in health can result from the clinical encounter between a doctor and a patient. This paper studies three possible mechanisms: prejudice of doctors in the form of being less willing to interact with members of minority groups, clinical uncertainty associated with doctors' differential interpretation of symptoms from minority patients or from doctor's distinct priors across races, and stereotypes doctors hold about health-related behavior of minority patients. Within a unified conceptual framework, we show how all three can lead to disparities in health and health services use. We also show that the effect of social policy depends critically on the underlying cause of disparities.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00098-x.abstractZh: 健康方面的差异可能源于医生与患者之间的临床互动。本文研究了三种可能的机制：医生对少数群体成员的偏见，导致医生不愿与这些群体成员互动；医生对少数群体患者症状的差异化解读所带来的临床不确定性；以及医生对少数群体患者健康相关行为的固有刻板印象。在一个统一的概念框架内，我们展示了这三种机制如何共同导致健康差异以及健康服务使用的差异。我们还指出，社会政策的效果在很大程度上取决于这些差异的根本原因。

abstract.text: This study estimates the impact of the price of alcoholic beverages on latent dimensions of current alcohol dependence and abuse. A three-part econometric model is used to estimate the impact of price on three latent dimensions (factors). For heavier drinking, the estimated price elasticity is -1.325 (P = 0.027); for physical and other consequences of drinking, -1.895 (P = 0.003); for increased salience of drinking, -0.411 (P = 0.339). For a single latent factor characterized simply as dependence/abuse, estimated price elasticity is -1.487 (P = 0.012). These results suggest that higher prices for alcohol reduce important dimensions of current alcohol dependence and abuse.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00099-1.abstractZh: 本研究估计了酒精饮料价格对当前酒精依赖和滥用三个潜在维度的影响。采用一个三部分的计量经济模型来估计价格对这三个潜在维度的影响。对于饮酒量较大的情况，估计出的价格弹性为-1.325（P=0.027）；对于饮酒导致的身体及其他后果，弹性为-1.895（P=0.003）；对于饮酒的显著性增加，弹性为-0.411（P=0.339）。对于仅被简单定义为依赖/滥用的单一潜在因素，估计出的价格弹性为-1.487（P=0.012）。这些结果表明，较高的酒精价格会降低当前酒精依赖和滥用的几个重要维度。

abstract.text: In Belgium, income-related inequality in ill-health among the 65- is present, but reduces significantly as soon as one restricts the analysis to the 65+. The main goal of this paper is to check whether these findings (based on current income) are robust to the income concept used. The analysis is repeated using estimates of permanent income. Measured inequality among the 65+ remains very limited, suggesting that the observed findings are not heavily dependent upon the income concept. Finally, I suggest an explanation for the observed difference in inequality between the 65- and the 65+. I argue that this difference is likely to be correlated with differences across income groups of (1) sample attrition; and (2) mortality.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00100-5.abstractZh: 在比利时，65岁及以上人群中与收入相关的健康不平等现象确实存在，但一旦将分析范围限制在65岁以上人群，这种不平等显著减少。本文的主要目标是验证这些基于当前收入得出的发现，在采用不同的收入概念时是否仍然具有稳健性。分析再次使用永久收入的估计值进行。65岁以上人群之间的不平等程度仍然非常有限，这表明观察到的发现并不严重依赖于收入概念。最后，我提出了一种解释65岁及以下与65岁以上人群之间不平等差异的原因。我认为，这种差异可能与以下两个因素有关：（1）样本流失；（2）死亡率差异。

abstract.text: Using regression techniques this paper estimates the level of income related health inequality in GB in 1992 and 1998. Inequality is decomposed to investigate which socio-demographic factors are important contributors to health differences. The paper includes a range of measured and subjective income variables to control for absolute income. A relative deprivation measure is included to test the impact of income inequality on health inequality. It is found that subjective financial status is a major determinant of ill-health and makes a major contribution to income related inequalities in health. Relative deprivation is an important contributor for women but not for men.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00101-7.abstractZh: 本文采用回归技术，估算了1992年和1998年英国与收入相关的健康不平等程度。通过分解不平等现象，研究哪些社会人口因素对健康差异有重要影响。文中包含了多种可测量的和主观的收入变量，以控制绝对收入的影响。同时，文中还引入了相对剥夺指标，以检验收入不平等对健康不平等的影响。研究发现，主观财务状况是健康不良的主要决定因素，并对与收入相关的健康不平等起着重要作用。相对剥夺对女性而言是重要的影响因素，但对男性则不然。

abstract.text: This is a model of endogenous sick leave in the presence of endemic infectious diseases. The prevalence rate elasticity with respect to sick leave is unity, when workers are paid their marginal product, and firms profit maximise. Full information contracts yield a compensating higher wage to the sick than to the healthy workers. Sick leave pay is greater than the healthy working wage. The contracted sick leave period falls with: the external disease transmission, the productivity of the ill, the discomfort when ill on sick leave and reductions in the work discomfort of the ill. Full insurance breaks down under asymmetric information, where implicit contract firms may offer more sick leave than profit maximising firms with the same payment schedule.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00102-9.abstractZh: 这是一个在地方性传染病存在的情况下，内生性病假模型的案例。当工人获得其边际产品，且企业利润最大化时，病假的患病率弹性为1。完全信息契约要求对病假员工支付的补偿工资高于健康员工。病假的薪酬高于健康员工的工资。随着外部疾病传播、病人的生产力下降、病假期间的身体不适以及病人工作不适的减少，契约规定的病假期限会缩短。在信息不对称的情况下，完全保险机制会失效，因为隐性契约可能允许提供比利润最大化企业更多的病假，而支付标准相同。

abstract.text: A dynamic model of risky behavior in the midst of an epidemic is discussed. The key result is that pessimistic expectations over the future of the epidemic induce more current risky behavior. Numerical simulation of equilibrium epidemics shows that this effect can accelerate spread of the disease in an epidemic's early stages and that the effect of policy interventions, such as preventative vaccines, may depend on whether the intervention was anticipated.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00103-0.abstractZh: 本文讨论了一种在疫情期间的风险行为的动态模型。主要结论是，对疫情未来的悲观预期会促使人们采取更多冒险行为。数值模拟显示，这种效应可以在疫情初期加速疾病的传播，而政策干预措施（如预防性疫苗）的效果则可能取决于这些干预措施是否被提前预见。

abstract.text: The Australian hospital system is characterized by the co-existence of private hospitals, where individuals pay for services and public hospitals, where services are free to all but delivered after a waiting time. The decision to purchase insurance for private hospital treatment depends on the trade-off between the price of treatment, waiting time, and the insurance premium. Clearly, the potential for adverse selection and moral hazard exists. When the endogeneity of the insurance decision is accounted for, the extent of moral hazard can substantially increase the expected length of a hospital stay by a factor of up to 3.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00104-2.abstractZh: 澳大利亚的医院系统以私立医院和公立医院并存为特征。私立医院需要患者自行支付服务费用，而公立医院则对所有患者免费提供服务，但需经过等待时间后才能获得服务。是否购买私立医院治疗的保险取决于治疗费用、等待时间以及保险保费之间的权衡。显然，存在逆向选择和道德风险的可能性。当考虑到保险决策的内生性时，道德风险的程度可能会使预期的住院时间增加多达3倍。

abstract.text: This study provides estimates of practice variation for primary physician services in Norway. Nearly all previous studies on practice variation have encompassed mainly specialist and hospital services. Thus we provide evidence for treatment variation for a health care sector where information about treatment variation is relatively scarce. Our analyses were carried out on a large set of data from individual physician practices. We estimated the extent of practice variation according to type of diagnosis and type of treatment option. The main finding is that variation in clinical practice between physicians is an important determinant of expenditure for primary physician services. Depending on the type of diagnosis, physician-specific effects explained 47-66% of the variation in expenditure for laboratory tests, 59-66% of the variation in expenditure for consultations lasting over 20min and 49-61% of the variation in expenditure for specific procedures. The age and gender of the patients explained only about 1% of the variation in expenditure. This finding supports the results from previous studies, which have shown that patients' age and gender are inadequate when used as risk adjusters. We also identified physicians who moved their practice from one municipality to another, i.e. they changed their patient population completely. Our results showed that those physicians who moved did not change practice style after they moved, i.e. that physician's style of practice is stabile. This indicates that practice style reflects a deeply rooted behaviour with respect to how to practice medicine.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00105-4.abstractZh: 本研究提供了挪威初级医生服务实践变异的估计结果。几乎所有关于实践变异的研究主要涵盖了专科和医院服务。因此，我们为这一医疗领域提供了关于治疗变异的证据，因为关于治疗变异的信息相对匮乏。我们的分析基于大量个体医生诊所的数据，根据诊断类型和治疗方案类型来估计实践变异的程度。主要发现是，医生之间的临床实践差异是初级医生服务支出的重要决定因素。根据诊断类型的不同，医生特有的效应解释了实验室检测支出的47-66%，超过20分钟咨询支出的59-66%，以及特定程序的支出变化的49-61%。患者的年龄和性别仅解释了约1%的支出变化。这一发现支持了先前研究的结果，这些研究表明，患者年龄和性别作为风险调整因素并不充分。我们还发现了一些医生将诊所从一个市镇迁移到另一个市镇，即他们完全改变了患者群体。我们的结果显示，这些迁移后的医生并未改变其实践风格，即医生的实践风格是稳定的。这表明，实践风格反映了关于如何行医的根深蒂固的行为特征。

abstract.text: Reform proposals of health care systems in several countries have advocated variations of a risk adjustment/capitation system. These proposals face a serious objection: incentives to risk selection are prevalent in the system. By now, considerable literature has been devoted to finding ways of mitigating, if not eliminating, this problem, while at the same time preserving incentives to efficiency. We contribute to this debate presenting a transfer system that, under some circumstances, attains both provider efficiency and no risk selection. The transfer system extends typical linear payment systems. It can be interpreted as a fixed transfer in the beginning of the period plus an ex-post fund at the end of the period. The novelty rests in the way contributions to this fund are defined.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00119-4.abstractZh: 一些国家的医疗保健系统改革提案提倡采用风险调整/按服务收费制度的变体。但这些提案面临一个严重的障碍：系统中普遍存在选择风险的动机。目前，已有大量文献致力于寻找方法来缓解这一问题，甚至消除这种动机，同时保留效率激励。我们在此提出一种转移制度，在某些情况下，既能实现提供者的效率，又能避免风险选择。该转移制度扩展了典型的线性支付制度，可以解释为在期初进行固定转移，在期末进行事后资金分配。其创新之处在于对这笔资金的定义方式。

abstract.text: In order to calculate quality adjusted life years (QALYs) from time trade-off (TTO) responses, individual preferences are required to satisfy the constant proportional time trade-off (CPTTO) assumption. Respondents who use a simple proportional heuristic may appear to satisfy CPTTO but will in fact generate preference reversals for states that are associated with a maximal endurable time (MET). Using data from 91 respondents, the study reported here examines the extent to which valuations satisfy the CPTTO assumption and the extent to which they might be generated by the proportional heuristic. The results suggest that respondents are using a proportional heuristic that casts doubt on the validity of using the TTO method to calculate QALYs for health states that are associated with MET preferences.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00120-0.abstractZh: 为了从时间权衡响应中计算质量调整生命年（QALYs），需要个体偏好满足恒定比例时间权衡（CPTTO）假设。使用简单比例启发式的受访者可能看似满足CPTTO假设，但实际上会为与最大可忍受时间相关的状态产生偏好逆转。本研究基于91名受访者的数据，探讨了受访者的评估在多大程度上满足CPTTO假设，以及这些评估是否可能由比例启发式产生。研究结果表明，受访者使用的比例启发式方法使得使用时间权衡方法计算与MET偏好相关的健康状态的QALYs的有效性受到质疑。

abstract.text: We study the existence of self-selection and moral hazard in the Chilean health insurance industry. Dependent workers must purchase health insurance either from one public or several private insurance providers. For them, we analyze the relationship between health care services utilization and the choice of either private or public insurance. In the case of independent workers, where there is no mandate, we analyze the relationship between utilization and the decision to voluntarily purchase health insurance. The results show self-selection against insurance companies for independent workers, and against public insurance for dependent workers. Moral hazard is negligible in the case of hospitalization, but for medical visits, it is quantitatively important.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00121-2.abstractZh: 我们研究了智利健康保险行业中自我选择和道德风险的存在情况。依赖工人必须从一家公共保险公司或多家私人保险公司中购买健康保险。对于他们来说，我们分析了医疗服务利用与选择私人或公共保险之间的关系。对于独立工人来说，由于不存在强制要求，我们分析了利用医疗服务与自愿购买健康保险决策之间的关系。研究结果表明，对于独立工人而言，存在针对保险公司的自我选择现象；而对于依赖工人而言，则存在针对公共保险的道德风险。在住院情况下，道德风险可以忽略不计，但在医疗就诊方面，道德风险具有显著的量化重要性。

abstract.text: This paper re-examines the stationarity of national health care expenditures and GDP in a panel setting utilizing data from 20 OECD countries over the period from 1960 to 1997. Previous research in this area has recognized the drawback of not allowing for structural breaks in their unit root tests and noted that their empirical results may not be robust. We advance the literature by utilizing a recently developed panel LM unit root test that allows for heterogeneous level shifts. In contrast to previous analyses that did not consider breaks, our results reject the unit root null hypothesis for both series.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00122-4.abstractZh: 本文重新检验了20个经合组织国家从1960年到1997年期间国民医疗保健支出与GDP的平稳性。以往的研究在单位根检验中未能考虑结构突变，导致实证结果可能不够稳健。我们采用了一种新开发的面板LM单位根检验方法，该方法能够考虑不同水平的突变。与以往未考虑结构突变的分析相比，我们的结果否定了两个序列都存在单位根的原假设。

abstract.text: This study explores global inequality in health status and decomposes it into within- and between-country inequality. We rely on standardized height as our health indicator since it avoids the measurement pitfalls of more traditional measures of health such as morbidity, mortality, and life expectancy. It also avoids measurement problems associated with using monetary variables such as income or expenditure across time or place to compare welfare. Our calculation of world height inequality indicates that, in contrast with similar research on income inequality, within-country variation is the source of most inequality, rather than the differences between countries.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00123-6.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了全球健康状况的不平等现象，并将其分解为国内差异与国家间差异。我们选用标准化身高作为健康指标，因为这一指标避免了传统健康测量方法（如发病率、死亡率和预期寿命）所存在的测量缺陷。同时，它还能避免使用收入或支出等货币变量来比较不同时期或地区的福利状况所带来的测量问题。我们的全球身高不平等计算结果显示，与关于收入不平等的类似研究不同，国内差异才是大部分不平等的根源，而非国家间的差异。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of financial pressure on hospital quality, using health outcomes after treatment for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) as quality indicators. The financial pressure variables are: fiscal pressure from the Prospective Payment System (PPS) for inpatient care, and changes in health maintenance organization (HMO) penetration at the county level. The study shows that both types of financial pressures adversely affect short-term health outcomes, but do not affect patient survival beyond 1 year after patients' hospital admissions. Furthermore, the impact of HMO penetration appears to differ from that of Medicare payment changes for certain hospitals because HMO penetration encourages price competition.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00124-8.abstractZh: 本文探讨了财务压力对医院质量的影响，以急性心肌梗死治疗后的健康结果为质量指标。财务压力因素包括：来自前瞻性支付系统对住院治疗的财政压力，以及县级地区健康维护组织渗透率的变化。研究表明，这两种财务压力都会对短期健康结果产生不利影响，但并不会影响患者出院后一年的生存状况。此外，对于某些医院而言，健康维护组织渗透率的影响与医疗保险支付变化的影响有所不同，因为健康维护组织渗透率会促进价格竞争。

abstract.text: A puzzling feature of many medical innovations is that they simultaneously appear to reduce unit costs and increase total costs. We consider this phenomenon by examining the diffusion of percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA)--a treatment for coronary artery disease--over the past two decades. We find that growth in the use of PTCA led to higher total costs despite its lower unit cost. Over the two decades following PTCA's introduction, however, we find that the magnitude of this increase was reduced by between 10 and 20% due to the substitution of PTCA for CABG. In addition, the increased use of PTCA appears to be a productivity improvement. PTCAs that substitute for CABG cost less and have the same or better outcomes, while PTCAs that replace medical management appear to improve health by enough to justify the cost.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00125-x.abstractZh: 许多医学创新的一个令人困惑的特点是，它们似乎同时降低了单位成本，却增加了总成本。我们通过研究过去二十年经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术（PTCA）的普及情况来探讨这一现象。我们发现，尽管PTCA的单位成本较低，但其使用量的增加导致了总成本的上升。然而，在PTCA引入后的二十年里，由于PTCA被冠状动脉旁路移植术所替代，这种成本增加的程度减少了10%到20%。此外，PTCA的广泛使用似乎也带来了生产力的提升。替代冠状动脉旁路移植术的PTCA成本更低，且效果相同或更好，而替代传统医疗管理的PTCA则能够改善健康状况，其成本增加是值得的。

abstract.text: The research and development costs of 68 randomly selected new drugs were obtained from a survey of 10 pharmaceutical firms. These data were used to estimate the average pre-tax cost of new drug development. The costs of compounds abandoned during testing were linked to the costs of compounds that obtained marketing approval. The estimated average out-of-pocket cost per new drug is 403 million US dollars (2000 dollars). Capitalizing out-of-pocket costs to the point of marketing approval at a real discount rate of 11% yields a total pre-approval cost estimate of 802 million US dollars (2000 dollars). When compared to the results of an earlier study with a similar methodology, total capitalized costs were shown to have increased at an annual rate of 7.4% above general price inflation.

10.1016/s0167-6296(02)00126-1.abstractZh: 通过对10家制药公司的调查，获得了68种新药的研发成本数据。这些数据被用来估算新药开发的平均税前成本。在测试过程中被放弃的化合物的成本与获得市场批准的化合物的成本有关。估计每种新药的平均自付成本约为4.03亿美元（2000年汇率）。以11%的实际折现率将自付成本资本化至市场批准阶段，总的批准前成本估计为8.02亿美元（2000年汇率）。与采用类似方法的前一项研究的结果相比，总的资本化成本以每年7.4%的速度增长，高于一般的价格通胀率。

abstract.text: A framework is developed to analyse the impact of the distribution of income on individual health and health inequality, with individual health modelled as a function of income and the distribution of income. It is demonstrated that the impact of income inequality can generate non-concave health production functions resulting in a non-concave health production possibility frontier. In this context, the impact of different health policies are considered and it is argued that if the distribution of income affects individual health, any policy aimed at equalising health, which does not account for income inequality, will lead to unequal distributions of health. This is an important development given current UK government attention to reducing health inequality.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00003-1.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个分析框架，用以研究收入分配对个人健康及健康不平等的影响。将个人健康视为收入与收入分配的函数进行建模。研究表明，收入不平等的影响可能导致健康生产函数呈现非凹形，进而使健康生产可能性边界也呈现非凹形。在此背景下，本文还探讨了不同健康政策的影响。文章指出，如果收入分配确实影响个人健康，那么任何旨在实现健康平等的政策，如果未能考虑收入不平等问题，将导致健康资源的分配不均。鉴于英国政府当前对减少健康不平等问题的重视，这一研究具有重要的现实意义。

abstract.text: In this note we test if unemployment has an effect on mortality using a large individual level data set of nearly 30,000 individuals in Sweden aged 20-64 years followed-up for 10-17 years. We follow individuals over time that are initially in the same health state, but differ with respect to whether they are employed or unemployed (controlling also for a number of individual characteristics that may affect the depreciation of health over time). Unemployment significantly increases the risk of being dead at the end of follow-up by nearly 50% (from 5.36 to 7.83%). In an analysis of cause-specific mortality, we find that unemployment significantly increases the risk of suicides and the risk of dying from "other diseases" (all diseases except cancer and cardiovascular), but has no significant effect on cancer mortality, cardiovascular mortality or deaths due to "other external causes" (motor vehicle accidents, accidents and homicides).

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00004-3.abstractZh: 在这篇论文中，我们使用瑞典约30,000名20-64岁个体的大规模个人级数据，对失业对死亡率的影响进行了研究。这些个体在随访期间最初处于相同的健康状况，但区别在于他们是否就业或失业（同时考虑了可能影响健康随时间恶化的多种个人特征）。结果显示，失业使在随访结束时死亡的风险显著增加，接近50%（从5.36%上升到7.83%）。在分析特定原因的死亡率时，我们发现失业显著增加了自杀的风险以及因“其他疾病”（除癌症和心血管疾病外的所有疾病）死亡的风险，但对癌症死亡率、心血管疾病死亡率或因“其他外部原因”（如机动车事故、意外事故和凶杀案）导致的死亡没有显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper uses a unique dataset on the inhabitants of Amsterdam, to study the dynamics of the consumption of cannabis and cocaine. People are most likely to start using that drugs at ages 18-20 and 20-25. An analysis of the starting rates shows some evidence of cannabis being a "stepping-stone" for cocaine. However, the fact that some individuals use both cannabis and cocaine has to do mostly with correlation through (unobserved) personal characteristics and not with cannabis causing the use of cocaine.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00005-5.abstractZh: 本文利用关于阿姆斯特丹居民的独特数据集，研究大麻和可卡因消费的动态变化。人们开始使用这些药物的年龄通常在18-20岁和20-25岁之间。对起始使用率的分析表明，大麻可能是大麻成为可卡因使用“垫脚石”的媒介。然而，一些个体同时使用大麻和可卡因，这主要与个人特征的关联性有关，而非大麻导致了可卡因的使用。

abstract.text: Willingness-to-pay (WTP) is being used increasingly in health technology assessment, although a number of methodological issues remain unresolved. Using data obtained from a randomised questionnaire survey, we investigated the metrical properties of two WTP formats, the open-ended question versus the payment scale, in the context of screening for colorectal cancer. Approximately, 2800 responses were analysed. Household income, attitudes toward health promotion and personal risk perceptions were the principal determinants of the nature and value of response. In comparison with the open-ended format, the payment scale achieved a higher completion rate and generated higher valuations. We believe that a framing effect is the most plausible explanation for these differences in performance. In contrast to previous findings, we do not find subjects' perceptions of the resource cost of interventions to be a convincing explanation for either their WTP values or inconsistencies between values and preferences. Although a proportion of respondents protested at the notion of valuation, the majority offer positive valuations, although typically of a lower value that non-protesters.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00006-7.abstractZh: 支付意愿（WTP）在健康技术评估中的应用日益增多，尽管仍存在一些方法学上的问题尚未解决。我们通过一项随机问卷调查获得的数据，研究了两种支付意愿评估方式在结直肠癌筛查中的表现差异：开放式问题与支付量表。约2800份回应被分析。家庭收入、对健康促进的态度以及个人风险感知是影响回应性质和价值的主要因素。与开放式问题相比，支付量表达到了更高的完成率，并产生了更高的评估值。我们认为，框架效应是解释这些差异的最合理解释。与以往的研究结果不同，我们发现受试者对干预措施资源成本的认知并不能很好地解释他们的支付意愿值或价值与偏好之间的不一致性。尽管部分受访者对评估概念表示反对，但大多数受访者都给出了积极的评估，尽管其评估值通常低于那些没有提出异议的受访者。

abstract.text: We consider an economy where most of the health care is publicly provided, and where there is waiting time for several types of treatments. Private health care without waiting time is an option for the patients in the public health queue. We show that although patients with low waiting costs will choose public treatment, they may be better off with waiting time than without. The reason is that waiting time induces patients with high waiting costs to choose private treatment, thus reducing the cost of public health care that everyone pays for. Even if higher quality (i.e. zero waiting time) can be achieved at no cost, the self-selection induced redistribution may imply that it is socially optimal to provide health care publicly and at an inferior quality level. We give a detailed discussion of the circumstances in which it is optimal to have waiting time for public health treatment. Moreover, we study the interaction between this quality decision and the optimal tax/subsidy on private health care.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00007-9.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个大多数医疗服务由公共部门提供的经济体，其中多种治疗需要等待时间。对于处于公共医疗等待队列中的患者来说，无需等待时间的私人医疗服务是一个选择。我们发现，尽管等待成本较低的患者会选择公共医疗服务，但等待时间的存在反而可能使他们受益。原因在于，等待时间会促使那些等待成本较高的患者选择私人医疗服务，从而降低全体民众需要支付的公共医疗成本。即使无需成本就能实现更高质量的医疗服务（即零等待时间），由于自我选择导致的资源重新分配，公共医疗服务以较低质量提供可能才是最优选择。我们详细讨论了在何种情况下，为公共医疗治疗设置等待时间是最优的。此外，我们还研究了这一服务质量决策与私人医疗服务最优税收/补贴之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: This paper compares the role of general practitioners in determining access to specialists in two types of health care systems: gate-keeping systems, where a general practitioner (GP) referral is compulsory to visit a specialist, and non-gate-keeping systems, where this referral is optional. We model the dependence between the GP's diagnosis effort and her referral behaviour, and identify the optimal contracts that induce the best behaviour from a public insurer's point of view, where there is asymmetry of information between the insurer and the GP regarding diagnosis effort and referral decisions. We show that gate keeping is superior wherever GP's incentives matter.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00008-0.abstractZh: 本文比较了全科医生在两种医疗体系中决定患者能否就诊专科医生的作用：一种是强制转诊制度，即患者必须由全科医生转诊才能就诊专科医生；另一种是自愿转诊制度，患者可以选择是否进行转诊。我们建立了全科医生诊断努力与其转诊行为之间的依赖关系模型，并确定了从公共保险公司的角度来看最优的契约安排，以促使保险公司在全科医生对诊断努力和转诊决策的信息不对称情况下，做出最佳决策。研究表明，在全科医生的激励因素起重要作用的情况下，强制转诊制度更为优越。

abstract.text: This paper seeks to determine whether a causal relationship exists between maternal employment and childhood weight problems. We use matched mother-child data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) and employ econometric techniques to control for observable and unobservable differences across individuals and families that may influence both children's weight and their mothers' work patterns. Our results indicate that a child is more likely to be overweight if his/her mother worked more hours per week over the child's life. Analyses by subgroups show that it is higher socioeconomic status mothers whose work intensity is particularly deleterious for their children's overweight status.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00022-5.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨母亲就业与儿童体重问题之间是否存在因果关系。我们采用了来自全国青年纵向调查的数据，并运用计量经济学方法，以控制个体和家庭之间可观测及不可观测的差异，这些差异可能会影响儿童的体重以及母亲的就业模式。研究结果表明，如果一个孩子的母亲在孩子的成长过程中每周工作时间更长，那么这个孩子超重的可能性就会增加。按子群体进行分析后发现，社会经济地位较高的母亲，其工作强度对子女的超重状况尤为不利。

abstract.text: This article reports a study that tests whether the internal consistency of the standard gamble can be improved upon by incorporating loss weighting and probability transformation parameters in the standard gamble valuation procedure. Five alternatives to the standard EU formulation are considered: (1) probability transformation within an EU framework; and, within a prospect theory framework, (2) loss weighting and full probability transformation, (3) no loss weighting and full probability transformation, (4) loss weighting and no probability transformation, and (5) loss weighting and partial probability transformation.
