Of the five alternatives, only the prospect theory formulation with loss weighting and no probability transformation offers an improvement in internal consistency over the standard EU valuation procedure.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00023-7.abstractZh: 本文报道了一项研究，旨在探讨是否可以通过在标准赌博估值过程中引入损失权重和概率转换参数，来提高标准赌博的内部一致性。研究考虑了标准欧盟公式的五种替代方案：(1)在欧盟框架内进行概率转换；以及在前景理论框架内进行的损失权重处理和完全概率转换；(2)不进行损失权重处理但进行完全概率转换；(3)不进行损失权重处理但进行完全概率转换；(4)进行损失权重处理但不进行概率转换；(5)进行损失权重处理但进行部分概率转换。在这五种替代方案中，只有结合损失权重和概率转换的前景理论公式能够比标准欧盟估值方法在内部一致性上有所改进。

abstract.text: The paper contributes to the use of social choice and welfare theory in health economics by developing and applying the integration of claims framework to health-care rationing. Related to Sen's critique of neo-classical welfare economics, the integration of claims framework recognises three primitive sources of claim: consequences, deontology and procedures. A taxonomy is presented with the aid of which it is shown that social welfare functions reflecting these claims individually or together, can be specified. Some of the resulting social choice rules can be regarded as generalisations of health-maximisation and all have normative justifications, though the justifications may not be universally acceptable. The paper shows how non-linear programming can be used to operationalise such choice rules and illustrates their differential impacts on the optimal provision of health-care. Following discussion of relations to the capabilities framework and the context in which rationing occurs, the paper concludes that the integration of claims provides a viable framework for modelling health-care rationing that is technically rigorous, general and tractable, as well as being consistent with relevant moral considerations and citizen preferences.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00024-9.abstractZh: 本文通过开发并应用索赔框架的整合方法，为健康经济学中社会选择与福利理论的应用做出了贡献。与森对新古典福利经济学的批判相关，索赔框架将索赔分为三个基本来源：后果、义务论和程序。文中还提出了一种分类体系，通过该系统可以明确如何分别或综合地指定反映这些索赔的社会福利函数。部分由此产生的社会选择规则可以被视为健康最大化的一般化形式，并且都具有规范性的依据，尽管这些依据可能并不具有普遍的可接受性。文章还展示了如何利用非线性规划来操作化这些选择规则，并说明了它们对优化医疗服务供给的不同影响。在讨论了与能力框架以及医疗服务分配情境之间的关系后，本文得出结论：索赔框架为医疗服务分配建模提供了一个可行的框架，该框架在技术上严谨、具有通用性且易于处理，同时与相关的道德考量及公民偏好相一致。

abstract.text: This paper estimates treatment effects for back pain patients using observational data from a low-key social insurance reform in Norway. Using a latent variable model, we estimate the average treatment effect (ATE), the average effect of treatment on the treated (TT), and the distribution of treatment effects for multidisciplinary outpatient treatment at three different locations. To estimate these treatment effects, we use a discrete-choice model with unobservables generated by a factor structure model. Distance to the nearest hospital (in kilometres) is used as an instrument in estimating the different treatment effects. We find a positive effect of treatment of around 6 percentage points on the probability of leaving the sickness benefits scheme after allowing for selection effects and full heterogeneity in treatment effects. We also find that there are sound arguments for expanding the multidisciplinary outpatient programme for treating back pain patients.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00025-0.abstractZh: 本文利用挪威一项低调的社会保险改革中的观察数据，估计了背痛患者的治疗效果。通过潜在变量模型，我们估算了平均治疗效果（ATE）、治疗对受治疗者的平均影响（TT），以及三个不同地点多学科门诊治疗的效果分布。为了估算这些治疗效果，我们使用了一个由因子结构模型生成的不可观测变量的离散选择模型。在估算不同治疗效果时，以距离最近医院的距离（以公里为单位）作为工具变量。研究发现，在考虑选择效应和治疗效果的完全异质性后，治疗对离开疾病福利计划的概率有约6个百分点的正面影响。此外，我们还发现，有充分的理由扩大多学科门诊计划，以治疗背痛患者。

abstract.text: Doctors and patients generally share a common interest in maximizing the quality of care. Purchasers of health care on the other hand, desire cost-effective levels of quality. We consider the purchaser's problem of implementing supply-side cost sharing when patients and doctors are asymmetrically informed and can collude to advance their own joint interests in maximal quality. Such collusion can be interpreted as the sort of informal side-payments that are observed in transitional and developing economies. It may also be interpreted as a "formal" (but unregulated) case of physician balance billing. We show that both collusion-proof schemes and collusion-inducing schemes can implement cost-effective care. A number of policy implications are discussed. In particular, more permissive advertising of referred services (such as pharmaceuticals) and more informed patients will increase the cost of implementing collusion-proof mechanisms. If patients have a high willingness to pay or are informed, then allowing collusion may be preferred.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00026-2.abstractZh: 医生和患者通常都致力于提升护理质量。而医疗保健的购买者则希望获得具有成本效益的优质服务。我们考虑了购买者在患者和医生信息不对称且可能合谋以追求最大质量利益时的成本分担问题。这种合谋可以被视为在转型和发展中经济体中观察到的非正式支付行为，也可以被理解为一种“正式”但缺乏监管的医生平衡计费行为。我们证明了，无论是防止合谋的方案还是诱发合谋的方案，都能实现具有成本效益的医疗服务。文中还讨论了若干政策含义，特别是，对推荐服务（如药品）的更宽松广告宣传以及更知情的患者会增加实施防止合谋机制的成本。如果患者愿意支付较高的费用或了解相关信息，那么允许合谋可能是更合适的选择。

abstract.text: This study uses microdata from the 1972-1981 National Health Interview Surveys (NHIS) to examine how health status and medical care utilization fluctuate with state macroeconomic conditions. Personal characteristics, location fixed-effects, general time effects and (usually) state-specific time trends are controlled for. The major finding is that there is a counter-cyclical variation in physical health that is especially pronounced for individuals of prime-working age, employed persons, and males. The negative health effects of economic expansions persist or accumulate over time, are larger for acute than chronic ailments, and occur despite a protective effect of income and a possible increase in the use of medical care. Finally, there is some suggestion that mental health may be procyclical, in sharp contrast to physical well-being.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00041-9.abstractZh: 本研究利用1972-1981年国民健康访谈调查的数据，考察了健康状况和医疗利用如何随各州的宏观经济状况波动。研究中控制了个人特征、地理位置固定效应、一般时间效应以及通常的州特定时间趋势。主要发现是，身体健康状况存在反周期性变化，这种变化在壮年人群、就业者和男性中尤为明显。经济扩张带来的负面健康影响会持续或累积，且对急性疾病的负面影响大于慢性疾病，尽管收入具有保护作用，且医疗利用可能有所增加。最后，有迹象表明心理健康可能呈现顺周期性，这与身体健康状况的反周期性形成鲜明对比。

abstract.text: Using data from two sources, the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS), I analyze the relationship between health status and the likelihood of engaging in medical screening and other preventive behavior. The results show that individuals who are in poorer health are more likely to get flu shots and cholesterol checks, but less likely to have mammograms, pap smears, breast examinations and prostate checks. There is some evidence that suggests that psychological factors such as fear and anxiety may be important reasons why sicker people are less likely to get cancer screens.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00042-0.abstractZh: 通过结合健康与退休研究（HRS）和医疗支出面板调查（MEPS）的两组数据，我分析了健康状况与进行医疗筛查及其他预防行为之间的关联。研究结果表明，健康状况较差的人更有可能接种流感疫苗和进行胆固醇检查，但更不可能接受乳房X光检查、宫颈涂片检查、乳腺检查和前列腺检查。有一些证据表明，恐惧和焦虑等心理因素可能是健康状况较差的人较少接受癌症筛查的重要原因。

abstract.text: Traditional cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) assumes that program costs and benefits scale linearly with investment-an unrealistic assumption for epidemic control programs. This paper combines epidemic modeling with optimization techniques to determine the optimal allocation of a limited resource for epidemic control among multiple noninteracting populations. We show that the optimal resource allocation depends on many factors including the size of each population, the state of the epidemic in each population before resources are allocated (e.g. infection prevalence and incidence), the length of the time horizon, and prevention program characteristics. We establish conditions that characterize the optimal solution in certain cases.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00043-2.abstractZh: 传统的成本效益分析假设项目成本和收益与投入呈线性关系，但这对于流行病控制项目来说是不现实的假设。本文将流行病建模与优化技术相结合，以确定在多个不相互作用的群体中，有限资源在流行病控制中的最优分配方案。我们指出，最优资源分配取决于多种因素，包括每个群体的规模、在资源分配前该群体中流行病的情况（如感染率和发病率）、时间范围的长度以及预防项目的特性。我们建立了在某些情况下描述最优解的条件。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the costs borne by both male and female carers in terms of their forgone formal employment opportunities. Traditionally, informal care was supplied by women but nowadays women are not only more likely to work, but also likely to be significant contributors to family finances. For women, this implies that the size of any forgone earnings cost of informal care is increasing. At the same time, population ageing is making for increasing numbers requiring care. From a policy perspective it is therefore helpful to consider a less traditional but nevertheless important source of informal care, men. We find that both male and female carers bear indirect costs in that they are less likely to be in paid work than otherwise similar non-carers and when they are in paid work they earn significantly less. However, we find that the motivation for lower employment participation is not the same for men as it is for women.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00044-4.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了男性与女性照顾者在放弃正式就业机会方面所承担的成本。传统上，非正式照顾工作由女性承担，但如今女性不仅更有可能工作，而且更有可能成为家庭财务的重要贡献者。对于女性来说，这意味着因非正式照顾而放弃的收入成本正在增加。同时，人口老龄化导致需要照顾的人数量不断增加。因此，从政策角度来看，考虑一个不太传统但同样重要的非正式照顾来源——男性，是有帮助的。我们发现，无论是男性还是女性照顾者都承担着间接成本，因为他们从事有偿工作的可能性低于其他类似的非照顾者，而且即使从事有偿工作，他们的收入也明显较低。然而，我们发现，男性与女性在较低的就业参与度方面的动机并不相同。

abstract.text: Medical decision analyses typically focus on one disease, that is, on one source of risk. In many medical decisions multiple sources of risk co-exist, however. This paper analyzes the effect of such comorbidities on treatment decisions. The effect of comorbidities on treatment decisions depends primarily on the way in which the patient's attitude to health status risks varies with duration. In the QALY model comorbidities do not affect treatment decisions. This property of the QALY model can be used as a diagnostic test of its descriptive and prescriptive validity.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00045-6.abstractZh: 医学决策分析通常聚焦于一种疾病，即一种风险来源。然而，在许多医学决策中，多种风险来源同时存在。本文分析了这些并存疾病对治疗决策的影响。并存疾病对治疗决策的影响主要取决于患者对健康状况风险的态度随时间的变化。在质量调整生命年模型中，并存疾病并不会影响治疗决策。QALY模型的这一特性可以作为其描述性和规范性有效性的诊断工具。

abstract.text: This paper tests the internal consistency of time trade-off utilities. We find significant violations of consistency in the direction predicted by loss aversion. The violations disappear for higher gauge durations. We show that loss aversion can also explain that for short gauge durations time trade-off utilities exceed standard gamble utilities. Our results suggest that time trade-off measurements that use relatively short gauge durations, like the widely used EuroQol algorithm, are affected by loss aversion and lead to utilities that are too high.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00046-8.abstractZh: 本文测试了时间权衡效用的内部一致性。我们发现，与损失厌恶理论预测的方向相反，存在显著的一致性违反现象。对于较长的持续时间，这些违反现象会消失。我们还发现，损失厌恶理论也可以解释为什么在较短的持续时间下，时间权衡效用会超过标准赌博效用。我们的结果表明，使用相对较短持续时间的权衡测量方法，如广泛使用的EuroQol算法，会受到损失厌恶的影响，从而导致过高的效用值。

abstract.text: This study exploits a natural experiment in Belgium to estimate the effect of copayment increases on the demand for physician services. It shows how a differences-in-differences (DD) estimator of the price effects can be decomposed into effects induced by the common average proportional price increase (income effects) and by the change in relative prices (substitution effects). The price elasticity of a uniform proportional price increase is relatively small (-0.13 for men and -0.03 for women). Substitution effects are large, especially for women, but imprecisely estimated. Despite the substantial price increases, the efficiency gain of the reform, if any, is modest.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00047-x.abstractZh: 本研究利用比利时的一项自然实验来估计共同支付额增加对医生服务需求的影响。研究展示了如何通过差异差异估计方法将价格效应分解为由共同的平均比例价格上涨引起的效应（收入效应）以及相对价格变化引起的效应（替代效应）。统一比例价格上涨的价格弹性相对较小，男性为-0.13，女性为-0.03。替代效应较大，尤其是对女性而言，但估计精度不高。尽管价格有所上涨，但改革带来的效率提升，如果有的话，也是有限的。

abstract.text: This paper considers the production responses to demand uncertainty within the hospital sector. It is noted that such responses have an impact on hospital cost structures. An empirical model is specified. Estimation is undertaken on a sample of UK hospitals over the period 1993-1995, differentiating between hospital output which arises from uncertain demand (emergency treatment) and output considered to be predictable (elective treatment). The model estimates that the cost of an elective admission is approximately 45% of the cost of an emergency admission. Demand uncertainty imposes a direct cost equivalent to around 5% of the total cost of emergency admission.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00048-1.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医院行业对需求不确定性的生产响应。研究表明，这种响应会对医院的成本结构产生影响。文中提出了一个实证模型，并对1993至1995年期间英国部分医院的数据进行了估计。模型区分了由需求不确定性导致的医院产出（如紧急治疗）和被认为可预测的医院产出（如选择性治疗）。模型估计，选择性住院的费用大约相当于紧急住院费用的45%。需求不确定性带来的直接成本约占总紧急住院费用的5%。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the optimal structure of a regulated health care industry in a model in which the regulator cannot enforce what hospitals do (unverifiable quality of health) or does not know what hospitals know (incomplete information about production costs) or both. We show that if quality is unverifiable the choice between monopoly and duopoly does not change with respect to the verifiable case but, if there are fixed costs (assumed to be quality dependent) and the monopoly is the optimal market structure, the quality level of the operative hospital decreases. Asymmetry of information introduces informational rents that can be reduced by increasing the most efficient hospital's market share. A monopoly is chosen more often.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00049-3.abstractZh: 本文分析了一个受监管的医疗行业的最优结构，该模型中的监管机构无法强制医院执行某些标准（如不可验证的质量），或者不了解医院所掌握的信息（如生产成本的详细信息），或者两者兼而有之。我们指出，如果质量不可验证，垄断与双头垄断之间的选择与可验证情况下的选择并无区别；但如果存在固定成本（假定与质量相关），并且垄断是最优的市场结构，那么运营医院的品质水平将会下降。信息不对称会导致信息租金的产生，通过增加效率最高的医院的市场份额，可以减少这种信息租金。在这种情况下，垄断形式会被更频繁地选择。

abstract.text: Since the 1998 Master Settlement Agreement (MSA) between states and the tobacco industry, states have unprecedented resources for programs to reduce tobacco use. Decisions concerning the use of these funds will, in part, be based on the experiences of states with existing programs. We examine the experiences of several states that have adopted comprehensive tobacco control programs. We also report estimates from econometric analyses of the impact of tobacco control expenditures on aggregate tobacco use in all states and in selected states with comprehensive programs for the period from 1981 through 2000. Our analyses clearly show that increases in funding for state tobacco control programs reduce tobacco use.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00057-2.abstractZh: 自1998年各州与烟草行业达成《主协议》以来，各州获得了前所未有的资源来实施减少烟草使用的计划。关于如何使用这些资金的决策，部分将基于各州现有计划的经验。我们研究了几个采纳了全面烟草控制计划的州的经验。我们还报告了计量经济分析的结果，这些分析研究了1981年至2000年期间，烟草控制支出对所有州以及部分实施全面计划的州的总体烟草使用情况的影响。我们的分析清楚地表明，增加州级烟草控制计划的资金能够减少烟草使用。

abstract.text: A central parameter for evaluating tax policies is the price elasticity of demand for cigarettes. But in many countries this parameter is difficult to estimate reliably due to widespread smuggling, which significantly biases estimates using legal sales data. An excellent example is Canada, where widespread smuggling in the early 1990s, in response to large tax increases, biases upwards the response of legal cigarette sales to price. We surmount this problem through two approaches: excluding the provinces and years where smuggling was greatest; and using household level expenditure data on smoking. These two approaches yield a tightly estimated elasticity in the range of -0.45 to -0.47. We also show that the sensitivity of smoking to price is much larger among lower income Canadians. In the context of recent behavioral models of smoking, whereby higher taxes reduce unwanted smoking among price sensitive populations, this finding suggests that cigarette taxes may not be as regressive as previously suggested. Finally, we show that price increases on cigarettes do not increase, and may actually decrease, consumption of alcohol; as a result, smuggling of cigarettes may have raised consumption of alcohol as well.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00058-4.abstractZh: 评估税收政策的一个核心参数是香烟需求的价格弹性。但在许多国家，由于广泛的走私行为，这一参数难以可靠地估算，这显著影响了使用合法销售数据得出的估计结果。加拿大就是一个很好的例子，在20世纪90年代初，由于税收大幅上涨，广泛的走私行为导致合法香烟销售对价格的反应出现上升。我们通过两种方法解决了这个问题：排除走私最严重的省份和年份；以及使用家庭层面的吸烟支出数据。这两种方法得出的价格弹性估计值在-0.45到-0.47之间。我们还发现，低收入加拿大人在对价格敏感的情况下，吸烟的敏感性要更高。在最近的行为模型研究中，较高的税收可以减少对价格敏感人群的不必要吸烟行为，这一发现表明，香烟税可能并不像之前认为的那样具有递减效应。最后，我们发现香烟价格的上涨并不会增加酒精消费，反而可能会减少酒精消费；因此，香烟的走私行为可能也增加了酒精消费。

abstract.text: The causal links between health and economic resources have long concerned social scientists. We use four waves of data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) to analyze the impact of wealth upon an individual's health status. The difficulty in approaching this task that has bedeviled previous studies is that wealth may be endogenous; a priori, it is just as likely that changes in health affect wealth as vice versa. We argue that inheritance is a suitable instrument for the change in wealth, and implement a straightforward instrumental variables strategy to deal with this problem. Our results suggest that the causal relationship running from wealth to health may not be as strong as first appears. In the data, wealth exerts a positive and statistically significant effect on health status, but it is very small in magnitude. Instrumental variables estimation leaves the point estimate approximately the same, but renders it insignificantly different from zero. And even when the point estimate is increased by twice its standard error (S.E.), the quantitative effect is small. We conclude that the wealth-health connection is not driven by short run changes in wealth.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00059-6.abstractZh: 健康与经济资源之间的因果关系长期以来一直困扰着社会科学家。我们利用收入动态面板研究（PSID）的四波数据来分析财富对个人健康状况的影响。以往研究在探讨这一问题时遇到的困难在于，财富可能是内生变量；从先验来看，健康状况的变化与财富的变化同样可能发生。我们认为，继承是一种合适的工具变量，并采用直接工具变量策略来解决这个问题。我们的研究结果表明，从财富到健康的因果关系可能并不像最初认为的那样强烈。在数据中，财富对健康状况有积极且统计上显著的影响，但其影响幅度非常小。工具变量估计的结果显示，点估计值大致相同，但其与零的差异并不显著。即使将点估计值增加其标准误差的两倍，其量化效应仍然很小。我们得出结论，财富与健康的联系并非由财富的短期变化所驱动。

abstract.text: We measure the effect of urban hospital closure on the operating efficiency of the remaining hospitals in the local market. Closure of a hospital other than the least efficient can be detrimental to social welfare because treatment costs will be higher at surviving hospitals. The results show that hospital closure has led to an evolutionary increase in efficiency in urban markets. The hospitals that closed were less efficient at baseline, and after closure their competitors realized lower costs per adjusted admission through an increase in inpatient admissions and emergency room visits. Overall, we estimate that costs per adjusted admission declined by 2-4% for all patients and about 6-8% for patients who would have been treated at the closed hospital.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00060-2.abstractZh: 我们研究了城市医院关闭对当地市场剩余医院运营效率的影响。除了效率最低的医院外，其他医院的关闭可能会对社会福利产生负面影响，因为生存下来的医院的治疗成本将会上升。研究结果表明，医院关闭确实促进了城市市场的效率提升。那些关闭的医院在初始阶段效率较低，但在关闭后，其竞争对手通过增加住院人数和急诊就诊量，实现了每调整一次入院次数的成本降低。总体而言，我们估计所有患者的每调整一次入院次数的成本下降了2-4%，而对于原本会在关闭医院接受治疗的患者，这一比例约为6-8%。

abstract.text: This paper considers the impact of the introduction of laws requiring parental involvement in a minor's decision to abort a pregnancy. State-level data over the 1985-1996 period are used to examine abortion, birth, and pregnancy outcomes, while microdata from the 1988 and 1995 National Surveys of Family Growth (NSFG) are utilized to examine sexual activity and contraception. Quasi-experimental methods are employed that examine whether minors' fertility outcomes were affected in those locations that introduced these laws following their introduction and occurred for minors but not other women. I find that parental involvement laws resulted in fewer abortions for minors resulting from fewer pregnancies; there is no statistically significant impact on births. The reduction in pregnancy seems to be attributable to increased use of contraception rather than a reduction in sexual activity.

10.1016/s0167-6296(03)00063-8.abstractZh: 本文探讨了要求父母参与未成年人堕胎决策的法律实施所带来的影响。研究使用了1985至1996年间的州级数据来考察堕胎、出生和妊娠结果，同时利用1988年和1995年家庭成长全国调查中的微观数据来研究性行为和避孕措施情况。采用准实验方法，分析在引入这些法律后，这些法律是否对未成年人而非其他女性的生育结果产生了影响。研究发现，父母参与法律的实施导致未成年人因妊娠次数减少而堕胎次数减少；但对出生数量的影响并不显著。妊娠次数的减少似乎是由于避孕措施的增多，而非性行为的减少所致。

abstract.text: This book describes the new generation of discrete choice methods, focusing on the many advances that are made possible by simulation. Researchers use these statistical methods to examine the choices that consumers, households, firms, and other agents make. Each of the major models is covered: logit, generalized extreme value, or GEV (including nested and cross-nested logits), probit, and mixed logit, plus a variety of specifications that build on these basics. Simulation-assisted estimation procedures are investigated and compared, including maximum simulated likelihood, method of simulated moments, and method of simulated scores. Procedures for drawing from densities are described, including variance reduction techniques such as anithetics and Halton draws. Recent advances in Bayesian procedures are explored, including the use of the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm and its variant Gibbs sampling. No other book incorporates all these fields, which have arisen in the past 20 years. The procedures are applicable in many fields, including energy, transportation, environmental studies, health, labor, and marketing.

10.1017/cbo9780511753930.abstractZh: 本书介绍了新一代离散选择方法，重点介绍了通过模拟实现的诸多进展。研究人员使用这些统计方法来研究消费者、家庭、企业及其他主体所做出的选择。书中涵盖了所有主要模型：逻辑模型、广义极值模型（包括嵌套和交叉嵌套逻辑模型）、概率逻辑模型以及混合逻辑模型，同时还介绍了基于这些基础的各种扩展方法。书中还探讨了模拟辅助估计方法，包括最大模拟似然法、模拟矩法以及模拟得分法。此外，还描述了从密度分布中提取数据的程序，包括方差减少技术，如反熵法和Halton抽样法。书中还探讨了贝叶斯程序的最新进展，包括使用Metropolis-Hastings算法及其变体Gibbs抽样法。没有其他书籍能够涵盖过去20年中出现的所有这些领域。这些程序适用于许多领域，包括能源、交通、环境研究、健康、劳动和市场营销等。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: For the treatment of myocardial infarction with ST-segment elevation, primary angioplasty is considered superior to fibrinolysis for patients who are admitted to hospitals with angioplasty facilities. Whether this benefit is maintained for patients who require transportation from a community hospital to a center where invasive treatment is available is uncertain. METHODS: We randomly assigned 1572 patients with acute myocardial infarction to treatment with angioplasty or accelerated treatment with intravenous alteplase; 1129 patients were enrolled at 24 referral hospitals and 443 patients at 5 invasive-treatment centers. The primary study end point was a composite of death, clinical evidence of reinfarction, or disabling stroke at 30 days. RESULTS: Among patients who underwent randomization at referral hospitals, the primary end point was reached in 8.5 percent of the patients in the angioplasty group, as compared with 14.2 percent of those in the fibrinolysis group (P=0.002). The results were similar among patients who were enrolled at invasive-treatment centers: 6.7 percent of the patients in the angioplasty group reached the primary end point, as compared with 12.3 percent in the fibrinolysis group (P=0.05). Among all patients, the better outcome after angioplasty was driven primarily by a reduction in the rate of reinfarction (1.6 percent in the angioplasty group vs. 6.3 percent in the fibrinolysis group, P<0.001); no significant differences were observed in the rate of death (6.6 percent vs. 7.8 percent, P=0.35) or the rate of stroke (1.1 percent vs. 2.0 percent, P=0.15). Ninety-six percent of patients were transferred from referral hospitals to an invasive-treatment center within two hours. CONCLUSIONS: A strategy for reperfusion involving the transfer of patients to an invasive-treatment center for primary angioplasty is superior to on-site fibrinolysis, provided that the transfer takes two hours or less.

10.1056/nejmoa025142.abstractZh:
背景：对于采用ST段抬高型心肌梗死的治疗，如果患者是在具备血管成形术设施的医院入院的，则优先选择血管成形术而非纤维蛋白溶解疗法。但对于需要从社区医院转运到具备介入治疗的中心的患者来说，这种优势是否仍然存在尚不确定。  
方法：我们将1572名急性心肌梗死患者随机分配为接受血管成形术治疗或接受加速静脉溶栓治疗；其中1129名患者来自24家转诊医院，443名患者来自5个介入治疗中心。主要研究终点为30天内死亡、再梗死或严重中风的综合指标。  
结果：在转诊医院接受随机分配的患者中，血管成形术组有8.5%的患者达到了主要终点，而纤维蛋白溶解组则有14.2%的患者达到了该终点（P=0.002）。在介入治疗中心接受治疗的患者中，血管成形术组有6.7%的患者达到了主要终点，而纤维蛋白溶解组则有12.3%的患者达到了该终点（P=0.05）。在所有患者中，血管成形术治疗后的较好结果主要归因于再梗死率的降低（血管成形术组为1.6%，纤维蛋白溶解组为6.3%，P<0.001）；死亡率和中风发生率没有显著差异（分别为6.6%和7.8%，P=0.35）。96%的患者在两小时内从转诊医院转运到了介入治疗中心。结论：将患者转至介入治疗中心进行初级血管成形术的再灌注策略，在转移时间不超过两小时的情况下，优于现场纤维蛋白溶解疗法。

abstract.text: I apply features of the economics of conflict and spatial competition in developing a model of the emergence of land ownership in hunter-gatherer societies. Tenure regimes are the result of interactions between those seeking to defend claims to land and those seeking to infringe on those claims. The model highlights the dependence of land ownership on ecological parameters, such as resource density and predictability, and allows for situational ownership, in which the nature of ownership changes as realized ecological conditions change. The paper concludes with a comparative assessment of tenure across a representative sample of hunter-gatherer peoples.

10.1086/344800.abstractZh: 我运用冲突经济学和空间竞争经济学的相关理论，发展了一个关于狩猎采集社会土地所有权形成的模型。土地占有制度是由那些试图捍卫土地权利的人与那些试图侵犯这些权利的人之间的互动所决定的。该模型强调了土地所有权对生态参数的依赖性，例如资源密度和可预测性，并允许存在情境性所有权，即随着实现的环境条件的变化，所有权的性质也会发生变化。文章最后对代表性狩猎采集民族的占有制度进行了比较评估。

abstract.text: While English auctions are the most common in practice, their rules typically lack sufficient structure to yield a tractable theoretical model without significant abstractions. Rather than relying on one stylized model to provide an exact interpretation of the data, we explore an incomplete model based on two simple assumptions: bidders neither bid more than their valuations nor let an opponent win at a price they would be willing to beat. Focusing on the symmetric independent private values paradigm, we show that this limited structure enables construction of informative bounds on the distribution function characterizing bidder demand, on the optimal reserve price, and on the effects of observable covariates on bidder valuations. If the standard theoretical model happens to be the true model, our bounds collapse to the true features of interest. In contrast, when the true data‐generating process deviates in seemingly small ways from that implied by equilibrium in the standard theoretical model, existing methods can yield misleading results that need not even lie within our bounds. We report results from Monte Carlo experiments illustrating the performance of our approach and comparing it to others. We apply our approach to U.S. Forest Service timber auctions to evaluate reserve price policy.

10.1086/344801.abstractZh: 虽然英语拍卖在实践中最为常见，但其规则通常缺乏足够的结构性，无法构建出无需大量抽象概念就能处理的理论模型。我们并非依赖某一标准化模型来精确解释数据，而是基于两个简单假设，探索一个不完整的模型：投标者不会出价超过其估值，也不会让对手以他们愿意接受的价格中标。以对称独立私人价值范式为基础，我们证明这种有限的结构能够构建出关于投标者需求分布函数、最优保留价格以及可观测协变量对投标者估值影响的 informative bounds。如果标准理论模型恰好是真实模型，那么我们的界限将收敛到真实特征。相反，当真实数据生成过程与标准理论模型所假设的均衡状态存在细微偏差时，现有方法可能会得出误导性结果，而这些结果甚至可能不在我们的界限之内。我们通过蒙特卡洛实验报告了我们的方法性能，并将其与其他方法进行了比较。我们将我们的方法应用于美国森林服务局的木材拍卖，以评估保留价格政策。

abstract.text: A central statement of the theory of natural trading partners is that preferential trading with regional trading partners is less likely to be trade diverting and therefore geographically proximate partners are to be considered "natural" partners for preferential arrangements. This paper examines this question empirically. The analytical framework involves a general equilibrium model of preferential trade and an econometric model with tight links to this theory. This framework is used to implement tests of the natural trading partners hypothesis using U.S. trade data for the years 196495: Welfare changes that would result from preferential tariff reductions by the United States against various trading partners are first estimated, and correlations with bilateral "distance" measures (with and without controls for income levels) are then examined. Since the argument for "natural" trading partners is based on the greater likelihood of geographically proximate countries to be more significant trading partners, correlations between the welfare change estimates and bilateral trade volume are examined as well. Both geographic proximity and trade volume are found to have no effect. Thus this paper is unable to find any support for the natural trading partners theory in U.S. data.

10.1086/344802.abstractZh: 自然贸易伙伴理论的核心观点是，与区域贸易伙伴进行优惠贸易不太可能导致贸易转移，因此地理位置相近的伙伴应被视为“自然”的优惠安排对象。本文通过实证方法对这一观点进行了检验。分析框架包括一个关于优惠贸易的一般均衡模型，以及一个与该理论紧密相关的计量经济模型。利用1964至1949年的美国贸易数据，本文对“自然贸易伙伴”假设进行了检验：首先估算了美国对各类贸易伙伴实施优惠关税所带来的福利变化，然后考察了与双边“距离”指标相关的相关性（包括不考虑收入水平的控制情况）。由于“自然”贸易伙伴的假设基于地理位置相近的国家更有可能成为重要贸易伙伴这一逻辑，因此还考察了福利变化估计值与双边贸易量之间的相关性。结果发现，地理邻近性和贸易量对这一假设都没有影响。因此，本文未能在美国数据中发现任何支持“自然贸易伙伴”理论的证据。

abstract.text: We analyze a banking system in which the class of feasible deposit contracts, or mechanisms, is broad. The mechanisms must satisfy a sequential service constraint, but partial or full suspension of convertibility is allowed. Consumers must be willing to deposit, ex ante. We show, by examples, that under the so-called "optimal contract," the postdeposit game can have a run equilibrium. Given a propensity to run, triggered by sunspots, the optimal contract for the full predeposit game can be consistent with runs that occur with positive probability. Thus the Diamond-Dybvig framework can explain bank runs as emerging in equilibrium under the optimal deposit contract.

10.1086/344803.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个银行系统，其中可行的存款合同或机制种类繁多。这些机制必须满足顺序服务约束，但允许部分或完全暂停货币兑换。消费者必须愿意在事前进行存款。我们通过实例表明，在所谓的“最优合同”下，存款后的博弈可以存在持续均衡。鉴于由太阳黑子引发的持续倾向，全额预存款游戏的最优合同可以与以正概率发生的持续行为相一致。因此，Diamond-Dybvig框架可以解释在最优存款合同下银行持续现象的出现。

abstract.text: In public discussions of policy, evidence that import-competing sectors earn low or falling incomes is often used to argue for protection. This paper rationalizes the apparent effectiveness of this argument in both direct and indirect democracies. In direct democracies, a small degree of voter altruism leads to protection in the specific factors model when the import-competing sector earns little. Similarly, voter altruism creates an incentive in representative democracies for self-interested parties to present evidence to legislators on the income of import-competing factors. This leads to a theory in which campaign contributions buy access to legislators rather than buy votes.

10.1086/344804.abstractZh: 在政策讨论中，常常引用进口竞争行业收入低或下降的证据来主张保护政策。本文旨在解释这一论点在直接民主和间接民主中的有效性。在直接民主中，选民的某种程度的利他主义使得在进口竞争行业收入较低的情况下，相关政策得以实施。同样，在代议制民主中，选民的利他主义促使自私的政党向立法者提供关于进口竞争行业收入的数据。这导致了一个理论，即竞选捐款可以换取与立法者的接触机会，而非直接获得选票。

abstract.text: The striking growth in the trade share of output is one of the most important developments in the world economy since World War II. Two features of this growth present challenges to the standard trade models. First, the growth is generally thought to have been generated by falling tariff barriers worldwide. But tariff barriers have decreased by only about 11 percentage points since the early 1960s; the standard models cannot explain the growth of trade without assuming counterfactually large elasticities of substitution between goods. Second, tariff declines were much larger prior to the mid 1980s than after, and yet, trade growth was smaller in the earlier period than in the later period. The standard models have difficulty generating this nonlinear feature. This paper develops a two-country dynamic Ricardian trade model that offers a resolution of these two puzzles. The key idea embedded in this model is vertical specialization, which occurs when countries specialize only in particular stages of a good's production sequence. The model generates a nonlinear trade response to tariff reductions and can explain over 50 percent of the growth of trade. Finally, the model has important implications for the gains from trade.

10.1086/344805.abstractZh: 贸易产出份额的显著增长是第二次世界大战以来世界经济中最重要的发展之一。这一增长的两个特点给标准贸易模型带来了挑战。首先，人们普遍认为这种增长是由全球关税壁垒的下降所推动的。但实际上，自20世纪60年代初以来，关税壁垒仅下降了约11个百分点；标准模型无法在不假设商品之间替代弹性较大的情况下解释贸易的增长。其次，在20世纪80年代中期之前，关税的下降幅度远大于之后，然而，贸易增长在前者时期反而小于后者时期。标准模型难以解释这一非线性特征。本文提出了一个双国动态李嘉图贸易模型，该模型为这两个难题提供了解决方案。该模型的核心思想是垂直专业化，即各国仅在商品生产序列的特定阶段进行专业化生产。该模型能够产生对关税降低的非线性贸易反应，并可以解释超过50%的贸易增长。最后，该模型对贸易带来的收益具有重要意义。

abstract.text: In contrast to most dowry-oriented societies in which payments have declined with modernization, those in India have undergone significant inflation over the last five decades. This paper explains the difference between these two experiences by focusing on the role played by caste. The theoretical model contrasts caste- and non-caste-based societies: in the former, there exists an inherited component to status (caste) that is independent of wealth, and in the latter, wealth is the primary determinant of status. Modernization is assumed to involve two components: increasing average wealth and increasing wealth dispersion within status (or caste) groups. The paper shows that, in caste-based societies, the increases in wealth dispersion that accompany modernization necessarily lead to increases in dowry payments, whereas in non-caste-based societies, increased dispersion has no real effect on dowry payments and increasing average wealth causes the payments to decline.

10.1086/367679.abstractZh: 与大多数随着现代化进程而减少嫁妆支付的社会相比，印度的社会在过去五十年中经历了显著的通货膨胀。本文通过关注种姓的作用，解释了这两种社会经历之间的差异。理论模型对比了基于种姓和非基于种姓的社会：在前者中，地位（种姓）具有独立于财富继承的成分；而在后者中，财富是地位的主要决定因素。假设现代化包含两个要素：平均财富的增加以及地位（或种姓）内部财富分布的扩大。研究表明，在基于种姓的社会中，现代化带来的财富分布扩大必然导致嫁妆支付的增加；而非基于种姓的社会中，财富分布的扩大对嫁妆支付几乎没有实际影响，平均财富的增加反而会导致嫁妆支付减少。

abstract.text: We analyze a mutual fire insurance mechanism used in Andorra, which is called La Crema in the local language. This mechanism relies on households' announced property values to determine how much a household is reimbursed in the case of a fire and how payments are apportioned among other households. The only Pareto-efficient allocation reachable through the mechanism requires that all households honestly report the true value of their property. However, such honest reporting is not an equilibrium except in the extreme case in which the property values are identical for all households. Nevertheless, as the size of the society becomes large, the benefits from deviating from truthful reporting vanish, and all the nondegenerate equilibria of the mechanism are nearly truthful and approximately Pareto efficient.

10.1086/367680.abstractZh: 我们分析了安道尔使用的一种相互火灾保险机制，当地语言称之为“La Crema”。该机制依赖于家庭公布的财产价值，以确定在发生火灾时家庭可获得的赔偿金额，以及赔偿金额如何在其他家庭之间分配。通过该机制所能达到的唯一帕累托有效分配要求所有家庭都诚实地报告其财产的真实价值。然而，除非所有家庭的财产价值完全相同，否则这种诚实报告并不构成均衡状态。尽管如此，随着社会规模扩大，偏离真实报告所带来的好处逐渐消失，该机制的所有非退化均衡状态几乎都是诚实的，并且近似帕累托有效。

abstract.text: This paper presents a spatial econometric method for characterizing productivity comovement across sectors of the U.S. economy. Input-output relations provide an economic distance measure that is used to characterize interactions between sectors, as well as conduct estimation and inference. We construct two different economic distance measures. One metric implies that two sectors are close to one another if they use inputs of other industrial sectors in nearly the same proportion, and the other metric implies that sectors are close if their outputs are used by the same sectors. Our model holds that covariance in productivity growth across sectors is a function of economic distance. We find that (1) positive cross-sector covariance of productivity growth generates a substantial fraction of the variance in aggregate productivity, (2) cross-sector productivity covariance tends to be greatest between sectors with similar input relations, and (3) there are constant to modest increasing returns to scale. We test and reject the hypothesis that these correlations are due to a common shock.

10.1086/367681.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种空间计量经济方法，用于描述美国经济各部门的生产率变动情况。投入产出关系提供了一种经济距离度量方法，可用于描述各部门之间的互动关系，并进行估计和推断。我们构建了两种不同的经济距离度量方法。一种指标表明，如果两个部门使用其他工业部门的投入比例几乎相同，则这两个部门彼此接近；另一种指标则表明，如果某个部门的产出被相同数量的部门使用，则该部门与这些部门接近。我们的模型表明，各部门之间生产率增长的协方差是经济距离的函数。我们发现：(1) 部门间生产率增长的积极协方差产生了总体生产率变异的很大一部分；(2) 部门间生产率协方差在投入关系相似的部门之间最为显著；(3) 存在恒定到适度递增的规模报酬效应。我们测试并拒绝了这些相关性是由共同冲击引起的假设。

abstract.text: The classical model of balance of payments crises implicitly assumes that the central bank sits passively as international reserves dwindle. In practice, however, central banks typically defend pegs aggressively by raising short-term interest rates. This paper analyzes the feasibility and optimality of raising interest rates to delay a potential BOP crisis. Interest rate policy works through two distinct channels. By raising demand for domestic, interest-bearing liquid assets, higher interest rates tend to delay the crisis. Higher interest rates, however, increase public debt service and imply higher future inflation, which tends to bring forward the crisis. We show that, under certain conditions, it is feasible to delay the crisis, but raising interest rates beyond a certain point may actually hasten the crisis. A similar nonmonotonic relationship emerges between welfare and the increase in interest rates. It is thus optimal to engage in some active interest rate defense but only up to a certain point. In fact, there is a whole range of interest rate increases for which it is feasible to delay the crisis but not optimal to do so.

10.1086/367682.abstractZh: 传统的国际收支危机模型隐含地假设，当国际储备减少时，中央银行会被动地坐视不理。然而，在实践中，中央银行通常会通过提高短期利率来积极防御。本文分析了提高利率以延缓潜在国际收支危机的可行性和最优性。利率政策通过两个不同的渠道发挥作用：通过提高对国内有息流动资产的需求，较高的利率可以延缓危机的发生；然而，较高的利率会增加公共债务支出，并导致未来通货膨胀加剧，这往往会进一步推迟危机的到来。我们表明，在某些条件下，延缓危机是可行的，但超过某个限度的利率上升实际上可能会加速危机的到来。福利与利率上升之间也呈现出类似的非单调关系。因此，采取某种积极的利率防御措施是最优的，但只能达到一定的限度。事实上，存在一系列利率上升的情况，在这些情况下，延缓危机是可行的，但并非最优选择。

abstract.text: Recent equity carve-outs in U.S. technology stocks appear to violate a basic premise of financial theory: identical assets have identical prices. In our 19982000 sample, holders of a share of company A are expected to receive x shares of company B, but the price of A is less than x times the price of B. A prominent example involves 3Com and Palm. Arbitrage does not eliminate this blatant mispricing due to short-sale constraints, so that B is overpriced but expensive or impossible to sell short. Evidence from options prices shows that shorting costs are extremely high, eliminating exploitable arbitrage opportunities.

10.1086/367683.abstractZh: 美国科技股最近出现的股权分割现象似乎违反了金融理论的一个基本前提：相同的资产应该有相同的价格。在我们的1998-2000年样本数据中，公司A的持股者预计将获得x股公司B的股票，但A的股价却低于B股价的x倍。一个典型的例子是3Com和Palm的情况。套利并不能消除由于卖空限制导致的这种明显的价格扭曲，因此B股被高估了，或者很难被卖空。期权价格的证据表明，卖空的成本非常高，从而消除了可利用的套利机会。

abstract.text: We present a model in which the microstructure of trade in a commodity or asset is endogenously determined. Producers and consumers of a commodity (or buyers and sellers of an asset) who wish to trade can choose between two competing types of intermediaries: "middlemen" (dealer/brokers) and "market makers" (specialists). Market makers post publicly observable bid and ask prices, whereas the prices quoted by different middlemen are private information that can be obtained only through a costly search process. We consider an initial equilibrium with which there are no market makers but there is free entry of middlemen with heterogeneous transactions costs. We characterize conditions under which entry of a single market maker can be profitable even though it is common knowledge that all surviving middlemen will undercut the market maker's publicly posted bid and ask prices in the postentry equilibrium. The market maker's entry induces the surviving middlemen to reduce their bid-ask spreads, and as a result, all producers and consumers who choose to participate in the market enjoy a strict increase in their expected gains from trade. When there is free entry into market making and search and transactions costs tend to zero, bid-ask spreads of all market makers and middlemen are forced to zero, and a fully efficient Walrasian equilibrium outcome emerges.

10.1086/367684.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中商品或资产的交易微观结构是由内生因素决定的。希望进行交易的商品生产者与消费者（或资产买卖者）可以在两种竞争类型的中介中进行选择：“中间商”（经销商/经纪人）和“市场制造者”（专家）。市场制造者会公开发布买卖价格，而不同中间商提供的价格则是私人信息，只能通过昂贵的搜索过程才能获得。我们考虑了一个初始均衡状态，在这种状态下没有市场制造者，但中间商可以自由进入市场，且交易成本各不相同。我们分析了在何种条件下，即使所有幸存的中间商都会在均衡状态下压低市场制造者公开发布的买卖价格，单个市场制造者的进入仍然能够获利。市场制造者的进入促使幸存的中间商降低买卖价差，因此，所有选择参与市场的生产者与消费者都能获得更大的预期收益。当市场制造者的进入自由以及搜索和交易成本趋于零时，所有市场制造者和中间商的买卖价差都会被迫降至零，从而形成一个完全有效的瓦尔拉斯均衡结果。

abstract.text: I develop a factor content of trade prediction for the Heckscher-Ohlin-Vanek model (HOV) that relates bilateral differences in country endowments to bilateral differences in factor contents. The results are striking. In comparisons of North-South factor contents or factor contents of countries with very different endowments (e.g., with very different capital-labor ratios), there is clear support for an HOV sign prediction. Thus countries with dissimilar endowment ratios also have very different factor content of trade differences as predicted by the HOV model.

10.1086/374179.abstractZh: 我为Heckscher-Ohlin-Vanek模型开发了一种贸易预测因子内容模型，该模型将双边国家禀赋差异与双边因子内容差异联系起来。研究结果非常显著。在比较南北地区因子内容或禀赋差异极大的国家之间的因子内容时，该模型能够清晰地支持Heckscher-Ohlin-Vanek模型的预测。因此，禀赋比例不同的国家之间的贸易差异在因子内容上也存在显著差异，这与Heckscher-Ohlin-Vanek模型的预测一致。

abstract.text: Health care report cards—public disclosure of patient health outcomes at the level of the individual physician or hospital or both—may address important informational asymmetries in markets for health care, but they may also give doctors and hospitals incentives to decline to treat more difficult, severely ill patients. Whether report cards are good for patients and for society depends on whether their financial and health benefits outweigh their costs in terms of the quantity, quality, and appropriateness of medical treatment that they induce. Using national data on Medicare patients at risk for cardiac surgery, we find that cardiac surgery report cards in New York and Pennsylvania led both to selection behavior by providers and to improved matching of patients with hospitals. On net, this led to higher levels of resource use and to worse health outcomes, particularly for sicker patients. We conclude that, at least in the short run, these report cards decreased patient and social welfare.

10.1086/374180.abstractZh: 医疗报告卡——在个体医生或医院层面公开患者健康结果——可以解决医疗市场中的重要信息不对称问题，但也可能促使医生和医院拒绝治疗病情更为严重的患者。这些报告卡对病人和社会是否有益，取决于它们在促进医疗服务的数量、质量和适当性方面所带来的经济和健康利益是否超过其成本。利用关于面临心脏手术风险的医疗保险患者的全国数据，我们发现纽约和宾夕法尼亚州的心脏手术报告卡既导致了医疗服务提供者的选择性行为，也改善了患者与医院的匹配。然而，总体而言，这导致了更高的资源使用率，以及更糟糕的健康结果，尤其是对于病情更为严重的患者而言。我们得出结论，至少在短期内，这些报告卡降低了患者和社会的福利。

abstract.text: Among the most important changes brought about by the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 are time limits, which provide consumers with an incentive to conserve their welfare benefits for future use. Among forward-looking, expected-utility-maximizing consumers who face liquidity constraints and earnings uncertainty, economic theory predicts that the incentive to conserve should be strongest among families with the youngest children. We test this prediction using data from Florida's Family Transition Program, a randomized welfare reform experiment. Our estimates generally exhibit the predicted age dependence, which suggests that time limits affect welfare use before they become binding. Our estimates indicate that, in the absence of other reforms that increased welfare use, FTP's time limit would have reduced welfare receipt by 16 percent.

10.1086/374181.abstractZh: 1996年《个人责任与工作机会协调法案》带来的最重要变化之一是时间限制，这为消费者提供了将福利津贴保存起来以备将来使用的激励。对于面临流动性限制和收入不确定性的预期效用最大化型消费者来说，经济理论预测，拥有最年幼孩子的家庭应该是最有保存福利津贴的动机的群体。我们通过佛罗里达州家庭过渡计划的数据来验证这一预测，该计划是一项随机化的福利改革实验。我们的估计结果总体上符合预期的年龄依赖性，这表明时间限制在变得具有约束力之前就已经开始影响福利的使用。我们的估计表明，如果没有其他增加福利使用的改革措施，佛罗里达州家庭过渡计划中的时间限制将使福利领取量减少16%。

abstract.text: This paper identifies and evaluates rationales for team participation and for the effects of team composition on productivity using novel data from a garment plant that shifted from individual piece rate to group piece rate production over three years. The adoption of teams at the plant improved worker productivity by 14 percent on average. Productivity improvement was greatest for the earliest teams and diminished as more workers engaged in team production, providing support for the view that teams utilize collaborative skills, which are less valuable in individual production. High-productivity workers tended to join teams first, despite a loss in earnings in many cases, suggesting nonpecuniary benefits associated with teamwork. Finally, more heterogeneous teams were more productive, with average ability held constant, which is consistent with explanations emphasizing mutual team learning and intrateam bargaining.

10.1086/374182.abstractZh: 本文通过分析一家服装工厂在三年内从个体计件制转向小组计件制的生产变革，利用新颖的数据来识别并评估团队参与的理由以及团队构成对生产效率的影响。该工厂采用团队生产模式后，工人的生产效率平均提高了14%。最初采用团队生产模式的工人，其生产效率提升最为显著；而随着更多工人参与团队生产，这种提升逐渐减弱，这支持了团队能够运用协作技能的观点，而个体生产模式下，协作技能的价值相对较低。高生产效率的工人往往首先加入团队，尽管在许多情况下收入有所减少，这表明团队合作还带来了非经济性的好处。最后，在能力保持不变的情况下，异质性更强的团队生产效率更高，这与强调团队间相互学习以及团队内部协商的解释相一致。

abstract.text: The theory of involuntary international transfers (war indemnities) has been constructed on the assumption that the donor and recipient are completely indifferent to each other's well-being. The assumption is hard to justify since usually the transfers closely follow periods during which the countries have been dropping bombs on each other. In the present paper, we rework the theory on the more plausible assumption that the well-being of each country is negatively influenced by the well-being of the other country. It is shown that, contrary to the conventional theory, the donor might benefit at the expense of the recipient, even when local Walrasian stability is imposed.

10.1086/374183.abstractZh: 非自愿国际转移（如战争赔款）的理论建立在这样一种假设之上，即捐助方和接收方对彼此的福祉完全漠不关心。这一假设难以成立，因为通常情况下，这些转移发生在各国相互投掷炸弹的时期。在本文中，我们基于一个更合理的假设重新构建了这一理论，即每个国家的福祉都会受到另一个国家福祉的负面影响。研究表明，与传统理论相反，即使在当地遵循瓦尔拉斯稳定条件下，捐助方也可能以牺牲接收方的利益为代价而获益。

abstract.text: This study investigates whether marketwide liquidity is a state variable important for asset pricing. We find that expected stock returns are related cross-sectionally to the sensitivities of returns to fluctuations in aggregate liquidity. Our monthly liquidity measure, an average of individual-stock measures estimated with daily data, relies on the principle that order flow induces greater return reversals when liquidity is lower. From 1966 through 1999, the average return on stocks with high sensitivities to liquidity exceeds that for stocks with low sensitivities by 7.5 percent annually, adjusted for exposures to the market return as well as size, value, and momentum factors. Furthermore, a liquidity risk factor accounts for half of the profits to a momentum strategy over the same 34-year period.

10.1086/374184.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了市场整体流动性是否是影响资产定价的重要状态变量。我们发现，预期股票回报与回报对整体流动性波动的敏感性之间存在交叉截面关系。我们使用的月度流动性指标，是基于每日数据估算的个股流动性指标的平均值，其依据的是：当流动性较低时，订单流会导致更大的回报反转。从1966年到1999年，对流动性敏感度较高的股票的平均回报每年比敏感性较低的股票高出7.5%，这一差异在考虑市场回报以及规模、价值和动量因素后仍然成立。此外，在这34年期间，流动性风险因素解释了动量策略获得收益的一半。

abstract.text: When parents are more educated, their children tend to receive more schooling as well. Does this occur because parental ability is passed on genetically or because more educated parents provide a better environment for children to flourish? Using an intergenerational sample of families, we estimate on the basis of a comparison of biological and adopted children that about 5560 percent of the parental ability is genetically transmitted.

10.1086/374185.abstractZh: 当父母受教育程度较高时，他们的孩子往往也能接受更多的教育。这种现象是因为父母的能力是通过遗传传递的，还是因为受过更多教育的父母能够为孩子提供更好的成长环境？通过对比亲生子女和养子女的数据，我们发现大约56%到60%的父母能力是通过遗传传递的。

abstract.text: We investigate the creation and evolution of conventions of behavior in "intergenerational games" or games in which a sequence of nonoverlapping "generations" of players play a stage game for a finite number of periods and are then replaced by other agents who continue the game in their role for an identical length of time. Players in generation t can offer advice to their successors in generation t + 1. What we find is that word-of-mouth social learning (in the form of advice from laboratory "parents" to laboratory "children") can be a strong force in the creation of social conventions.

10.1086/374187.abstractZh: 我们研究了在“代际游戏”中行为惯例的创造与演变。在这种游戏中，一系列不重叠的“代”的玩家会进行一系列有限期的游戏，之后由其他代理人接替他们的角色继续游戏，且持续的时间相同。第t代的玩家可以向第t+1代的继承人提供建议。我们发现，口头社会学习（以实验室中的“父母”向“孩子”提供建议的形式）可以成为创造社会惯例的强大力量。

abstract.text: We show that under typical conditions the simple "excess-burden triangle" formula substantially underestimates the excess burden of commodity taxes, in some cases by a factor of 10 or more. This formula performs poorly because it ignores general equilibrium interactionsmost important, interactions between the taxed commodity and the labor market. Many prior studies have shown that general equilibrium interactions affect excess burden but have not appreciated the bias associated with ignoring these interactions or the quantitative importance of this bias. We derive an implementable alternative to the simple formula. This alternative formula captures interactions that the simple formula omits; as a result it is both unbiased and usually more accurate.

10.1086/375378.abstractZh: 我们指出，在典型条件下，简单的“超额负担三角形”公式严重低估了商品税的超额负担，在某些情况下，低估幅度可达10倍或更多。该公式表现不佳，因为它忽略了一般均衡中的相互作用——尤其是被征税商品与劳动力市场之间的相互作用。许多先前的研究表明，一般均衡中的相互作用会影响超额负担，但人们并未充分认识到忽略这些相互作用所带来的偏差，以及这种偏差的定量重要性。我们提出了一种可实施的替代公式。该替代公式能够捕捉到简单公式所忽略的相互作用，因此既无偏差，通常也更准确。

abstract.text: We construct a dynamic general equilibrium production economy to explicitly link expected stock returns to firm characteristics such as firm size and the book-to-market ratio. Stock returns in the model are completely characterized by a conditional capital asset pricing model (CAPM). Size and book-to-market are correlated with the true conditional market beta and therefore appear to predict stock returns. The cross-sectional relations between firm characteristics and returns can subsist even after one controls for typical empirical estimates of beta. These findings suggest that the empirical success of size and book-to-market can be consistent with a single-factor conditional CAPM model.

10.1086/375379.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个动态一般均衡生产经济模型，以明确将预期股票回报与公司特征（如公司规模和市场市值比率）联系起来。该模型中的股票回报完全由条件资本资产定价模型来刻画。公司规模和市场市值比率与真实的条件市场贝塔值相关，因此似乎能够预测股票回报。即使控制了典型的贝塔值估计值后，公司特征与回报之间的横截面关系仍然存在。这些发现表明，公司规模和市场市值比率在实证上的成功可以与单因素条件CAPM模型相一致。

abstract.text: When consumers share similar preferences, additional consumers will bring forth products that confer positive "preference externalities" on others. However, if distinct groups of consumers have substantially different preferences, the groups bring forth products with more appeal to themselves and less appeal to others. We document that in their capacity as daily newspaper consumers, blacks and whites are more likely to buy daily newspapers in markets with larger black and white populations, respectively. Similar results hold for Hispanics and non-Hispanics, but not by education, income, or age. We provide evidence that product positioning underlies our results.

10.1086/375380.abstractZh: 当消费者具有相似的偏好时，额外的消费者会带来对其他人具有积极“偏好外部性”的产品。然而，如果不同群体的消费者具有显著不同的偏好，这些群体会推出更吸引自己的产品，而对他人的吸引力则较低。我们的研究指出，作为日报消费者的黑人比白人更有可能在黑人人口较多的市场中购买日报。对于西班牙裔和非西班牙裔群体来说，情况也类似，但这一差异并不受教育水平、收入或年龄的影响。我们的研究还表明，产品的定位是解释这些结果的重要因素。

abstract.text: We analyze five education finance systems: local, state, foundation, power equalizing with recapture (PER), and power equalizing without recapture (PEN). In a calibrated model, we find that finance systems have large effects on educational resources and equity. The trade-off between equity and resources, however, is not monotone. Ranking systems by expected utility, we find that PER consistently ranks highest, though it provides fewer resources to education than the foundation and PEN systems and is less equitable than a state system. We prove that for an important subset of preferences, PER will win in majority voting comparisons with the other systems.

10.1086/375381.abstractZh: 我们分析了五种教育融资体系：地方融资体系、州融资体系、基金会融资体系、带有回收机制的平等化融资体系（PER）以及不带回收机制的平等化融资体系（PEN）。在校准后的模型中，我们发现这些融资体系对教育资源与公平性的影响很大。然而，公平性与资源之间的权衡并非单调的。通过期望效用对体系进行排名，我们发现PER体系始终处于最高排名，尽管它提供的教育资源少于基金会和PEN体系，且公平性也低于州融资体系。我们证明，对于一部分重要的偏好类型，PER体系在多数投票对比中将会胜出。

abstract.text: We show that a theory of earnings and wealth inequality, based on the optimal choices of ex ante identical households that face uninsured idiosyncratic shocks to their endowments of efficiency labor units, accounts for the U.S. earnings and wealth inequality almost exactly.

10.1086/375382.abstractZh: 我们证明，一种关于收入与财富不平等的理论，基于面临未保险的特殊冲击的同一家庭在事前的最优选择，能够几乎完全解释美国的收入与财富不平等现象。

abstract.text: In the United States, more than two-thirds of decedents with multichild families divide their estates exactly equally among their children. In contrast, gifts given before death are usually unequal. These findings challenge the validity of existing theories regarding the determination of intergenerational transfers. In this paper, we develop a theory that accounts for this puzzle based on the notion that the division of bequests provides a signal about a parent's altruistic preferences. The theory can also explain the norm of unigeniture, which prevails in other societies.

10.1086/375383.abstractZh: 在美国，拥有多个孩子的家庭中的超过三分之二的逝者会将遗产完全平均分配给他们的子女。相比之下，去世前所给予的礼物通常是不平等的。这些发现挑战了关于代际转移决定的现有理论的有效性。在本文中，我们基于遗产分配能够反映父母利他偏好这一概念，提出了一个理论来解释这一谜题。该理论还可以解释其他社会中普遍存在的单子女继承制现象。

abstract.text: We consider a simple model of competition under moral hazard with constant return technologies. We consider preferences that are not separable in effort: marginal utility of income is assumed to increase with leisure, especially for high income levels. We show that, in this context, Bertrand competition may result in positive equilibrium profit. This result holds for purely idiosyncratic shocks when only deterministic contracts are considered and extends to unrestricted contract spaces in the presence of aggregate uncertainty. Finally, these findings have important consequences on the definition of an equilibrium. We show that, in this context, a Walrasian general equilibrium à la Prescott-Townsend may fail to exist: any "equilibrium" must involve rationing.

10.1086/375384.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个在道德风险下的简单竞争模型，其中收益技术为恒定收益。我们考虑的偏好在努力方面是不可分割的：收入的边际效用被认为会随着闲暇时间的增加而增加，尤其是在高收入水平下。我们表明，在这种情况下，伯特兰竞争可能导致正的均衡利润。这一结果在仅考虑确定性合同的情况下成立，并且当存在总体不确定性时，该结果也适用于不受限制的合同空间。最后，这些发现对均衡的定义有重要影响。我们表明，在这种情况下，按照Prescott-Townsend方法定义的瓦尔拉斯一般均衡可能不存在：任何“均衡”都必须涉及配给。

abstract.text: Much of our understanding of corporations builds on the idea that managers, when they are not closely monitored, will pursue goals that are not in shareholders' interests. But what goals would managers pursue? This paper uses variation in corporate governance generated by state adoption of antitakeover laws to empirically map out managerial preferences. We use plant-level data and exploit a unique feature of corporate law that allows us to deal with possible biases associated with the timing of the laws. We find that when managers are insulated from takeovers, worker wages (especially those of white-collar workers) rise. The destruction of old plants falls, but the creation of new plants also falls. Finally, overall productivity and profitability decline in response to these laws. Our results suggest that active empire building may not be the norm and that managers may instead prefer to enjoy the quiet life.

10.1086/376950.abstractZh: 我们对企业的理解很大程度上基于这样一个观点：当管理者不受严格监督时，他们会追求不符合股东利益的目标。但管理者究竟会追求什么目标呢？本文通过研究国家实施反垄断法所导致的企业治理变化，实证分析了管理者的偏好。我们利用了工厂层面的数据，并利用了企业法律中一个独特的特点，从而能够克服与法律实施时机相关的潜在偏差。研究发现，当管理者免受收购影响时，工人工资（尤其是白领工人的工资）会上升。旧工厂的拆除减少，而新工厂的建造也减少了。最后，整体生产力和盈利能力因这些法律而下降。我们的研究结果表明，积极进行企业扩张可能并非常态，管理者可能更倾向于享受平静的生活。

abstract.text: We analyze a simple stochastic environment in which policy makers can be threatened by "nasty" interest groups. In the absence of these groups, the policy maker's desire for reelection guarantees that good policies are implemented for every realization of the shock. When pressure groups can harass the policy maker, good policies will be chosen for only a subset of states of nature. Hence, honest and able leaders might implement bad policies, and needed reforms could be delayed. In order to make good policies more likely, the public will want to increase the cost of exerting pressure for "nasty groups" and provide rents to those in power. This last result can be used to explain the existence of political parties. They play a role resembling that of the supervisor in the literature on collusion in hierarchical agency. A rational public may also choose to ignore negative media reports on a politician's personal life and, in general, elect "strong" political leaders. The prevalence of coercive methods of influence helps explain why countries may get to be governed by "inept politicians."

10.1086/376951.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个简单的随机环境，在这种环境中，政策制定者可能会受到“不良”利益集团的威胁。如果没有这些集团，政策制定者希望连任的意愿将确保无论发生何种冲击，都会实施良好的政策。然而，当压力集团能够骚扰政策制定者时，良好的政策只会在部分自然状态下被选择。因此，诚实且有能力的总统可能会实施不良政策，而必要的改革可能会被推迟。为了使良好的政策更有可能实现，公众会希望增加对“不良集团”施加压力的成本，并为当权者提供利益。这一结果可以用来解释政党的存在。它们在类似文献中描述的层级代理中的监督者角色中发挥作用。理性的公众也可能选择忽略关于政治家个人生活的负面媒体报道，并总体上选举“强势”的政治领袖。强制性的影响手段的普遍存在有助于解释为什么国家可能会由“无能的政治家”来治理。

abstract.text: Real estate agents typically charge a 6 percent commission, regardless of the price of the house sold. As a consequence, the commission fee from selling a house will differ dramatically across cities depending on the average price of housing, although the effort necessary to match buyers and sellers may not be that different. We use a simple economic model to show that if barriers to entry are low, the entry of real estate agents in cities with high housing prices is socially inefficient. Consistent with our model, we find that when the average price of land in a city increases, (1) the fraction of real estate brokers in a city increases, (2) the productivity of an average real estate agent (houses sold per hour worked) falls, and (3) the real wage of a typical real estate agent remains unchanged. We cannot completely rule out the alternative explanation that these results reflect unmeasured differences in the quality of broker services. However, we present evidence that as the average price of housing in a city increases, there is only a small increase in the amount of time a buyer spends searching for a house, and the average time a house for sale stays on the market falls.

10.1086/376953.abstractZh: 房地产经纪人通常会收取6%的佣金，无论出售的房子价格如何。因此，不同城市出售房屋所收取的佣金会存在显著差异，这取决于房屋的平均价格，尽管匹配买家和卖家所需的努力可能并没有太大差别。我们使用一个简单的经济模型来表明，如果进入市场的壁垒较低，那么在房价较高的城市引入房地产经纪人会显得社会效率低下。与我们的模型一致，我们发现当城市土地的平均价格上升时，(1)城市中的房地产经纪人比例增加，(2)普通房地产经纪人的工作效率下降（即每小时售出的房屋数量减少），(3)普通房地产经纪人的实际工资保持不变。我们无法完全排除这些结果反映了经纪服务质量差异这一替代解释的可能性。然而，我们有证据表明，随着城市房屋平均价格的上升，买家寻找房屋的时间只会增加一点点，而待售房屋在市场上停留的平均时间则会减少。

abstract.text: This paper describes the equilibrium of a discrete-time exchange economy in which consumers with arbitrary subjective discount factors and homothetic period utility functions follow linear Markov consumption and portfolio strategies. Explicit expressions are given for state prices and consumption-wealth ratios. We provide an analytically convenient continuous-time approximation and show how subjective rates of time preference affect risk-free rates but not instantaneous risk-return trade-offs. Hyperbolic discount factors can be a source of return volatility, but they cannot be used to address asset pricing puzzles related to high-frequency Sharpe ratios.

10.1086/376954.abstractZh: 本文描述了一种离散时间交换经济中的均衡状态。在这种经济中，消费者具有任意的主观折现因子和同质时期效用函数，并遵循线性马尔可夫消费和投资组合策略。文中给出了状态价格和消费-财富比率的显式表达式。我们提供了一种分析上更为方便的连续时间近似方法，并展示了主观时间偏好率如何影响无风险利率，但不会影响瞬时风险回报权衡。双曲折现因子可能是回报波动性的来源，但它们不能用于解决与高频夏普比率相关的资产定价难题。

abstract.text: This paper uses data from income tax returns (191598), wage tax returns (191998), and inheritance tax returns (190294) in order to compute homogeneous, yearly estimates of income, wage, and wealth inequality for twentieth-century France. The main conclusion is that the decline in income inequality that took place during the first half of the century was mostly accidental. In France, and possibly in a number of other countries as well, wage inequality has been extremely stable in the long run, and the secular decline in income inequality is for the most part a capital income phenomenon. Holders of large fortunes were badly hurt by major shocks during the 191445 period, and they were never able to fully recover from these shocks, probably because of the dynamic effects of progressive taxation on capital accumulation and pretax income inequality.

10.1086/376955.abstractZh: 本文利用所得税申报表（191598份）、工资税申报表（191998份）和遗产税申报表（190294份）的数据，计算20世纪法国收入、工资和财富不平等的年度估计值。主要结论是，本世纪上半期收入不平等的下降主要是偶然现象。在法国，以及可能其他一些国家，工资不平等在长期内保持极为稳定，收入不平等的下降在很大程度上是资本收入现象所致。在1914至1945年期间，拥有巨额财富的人受到了重大冲击的严重影响，并且他们从未完全从这些冲击中恢复过来，这可能是由于累进税制对资本积累和税前收入不平等的动态影响所致。

abstract.text: Bureaucracies tend to be used when consumers cannot be trusted to choose outcomes efficiently. But a primary means of bureaucratic oversight is consumer complaints. But this can give bureaucrats an incentive to inefficiently accede to consumer demands to avoid a complaint. I show that when this incentive is important, bureaucracies (efficiently) respond by (i) ignoring legitimate consumer complaints, (ii) monitoring more in situations in which it is not needed, (iii) delaying decision making "too long," and (iv) biasing oversight against consumers. I also show that bureaucracies are used only when consumers cannot be trusted. As a result, observed bureaucracies are always inefficient.

10.1086/376956.abstractZh: 官僚机构往往在消费者无法被信任以有效选择结果时被使用。但官僚监督的主要手段是消费者投诉。然而，这可能会促使官僚机构以低效的方式满足消费者需求，以避免引发投诉。我指出，当这种动机较为重要时，官僚机构会采取以下措施来应对：(i) 忽视合法的消费者投诉；(ii) 在不需要的情况下进行过度监控；(iii) 延迟决策“太久”；(iv) 使监督偏向消费者一方。我还指出，官僚机构只有在消费者不可信时才被使用。因此，实际存在的官僚机构总是效率较低的。

abstract.text: Complete financial markets transform the political choice between candidates with different redistribution policies. If redistribution policies do not affect aggregate wealth, then financial trade implies that wealth considerations have no effect on voting and so do not affect who wins. However, an election in which one candidate would redistribute results in redistribution, and redistribution is the same whether or not he wins. Furthermore, he proposes, and if elected carries out, more redistribution than he prefers. If redistribution policies do affect aggregate wealth, then everybody expects more wealth if the candidate with the higher aggregate-wealth policy wins.

10.1086/377086.abstractZh: 完整的金融市场会改变候选人之间关于再分配政策的政治选择。如果再分配政策不影响总体财富，那么金融交易意味着财富因素对投票没有影响，因此也不会影响胜者。然而，如果有一个候选人会重新分配选举结果，而无论他是否获胜，再分配的方式都是相同的，那么情况就会有所不同。此外，他提议，如果当选并实施政策，将会进行比他个人更积极的再分配。如果再分配政策确实会影响总体财富，那么如果拥有更高总体财富政策的候选人获胜，所有人都会期望获得更多的财富。

abstract.text: Recent empirical work on financial crises documents that crises tend to occur when macroeconomic fundamentals are weak; but even after conditioning on an exhaustive list of fundamentals, a sizable random component to crises and associated capital flows remains. We develop a model of herd behavior consistent with these observations. Informational frictions together with standard debt default problems lead to volatile capital flows resembling hot money and financial crises. We show that repaying debt during difficult times identifies a government as financially resilient, enhances its reputation, and stabilizes capital flows. Bailing out governments deprives resilient countries of the opportunity to differentiate themselves from the nonresilient.

10.1086/378525.abstractZh: 近期关于金融危机的实证研究表明，危机往往发生在宏观经济基础薄弱的情况下；但即使考虑到一系列基本经济因素，危机及其相关的资本流动仍具有相当大的随机性。我们建立了一个与这些观察结果一致的群体行为模型。信息摩擦以及标准的债务违约问题导致资本流动变得不稳定，类似于热钱流动和金融危机。我们指出，在困难时期偿还债务能够提升政府的财务韧性，增强其声誉，并稳定资本流动。救助政府则会使有韧性的国家失去与无韧性的国家区分开来的机会。

abstract.text: In this paper, we find that the age-adjusted elasticity of child wealth with respect to parental wealth is 0.37 before the transfer of bequests. Lifetime income and asset ownership jointly explain nearly two-thirds of the wealth elasticity. Education, past parental transfers, and expected future bequests account for little of the remaining elasticity. Survey measures of risk correlate strongly between parents and children. However, they explain little of the intergenerational similarity in the propensity to own different assets, suggesting that children's savings propensities are determined by mimicking their parents' behavior, or the inheritance of preferences not related to risk tolerance. Our results imply that while parents do pass on human capital and saving propensities to their children, the level of intergenerational fluidity is much greater than that suggested by recent accounts in the popular press.

10.1086/378526.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们发现，在遗产转移之前，儿童财富对父母财富的年龄调整弹性为0.37。终身收入和资产所有权共同解释了近三分之二的财富弹性。教育、父母过去的转移行为以及预期的未来遗产转移对剩余弹性贡献甚微。调查得出的风险指标在父母与子女之间表现出强烈的关联性。然而，这些指标并不能很好地解释代际间持有不同资产倾向的相似性，这表明儿童的储蓄倾向是通过模仿父母的行为，或是继承与风险承受能力无关的偏好来决定的。我们的研究结果表明，虽然父母确实将人力资本和储蓄倾向传递给了子女，但代际流动性程度远大于近期大众媒体报道所暗示的。

abstract.text: The model concerns a searcher making multiple searches from the same distribution of payoffs. The searcher does not know the distribution, does not attempt to infer it from cumulating information, and does not attempt to compute an optimal stopping rule. Instead the searcher follows thoroughly elementary adaptive rules. Nonetheless, the searcher converges to optimal stopping.

10.1086/378527.abstractZh: 该模型涉及一个搜索者从相同的收益分布中进行多次搜索。搜索者并不了解该分布，也不试图从累积的信息中推断出来，更不试图计算最优停止规则。相反，搜索者遵循非常基本的自适应规则。尽管如此，搜索者最终会收敛到最优停止策略。

abstract.text: Consider a world of traders separated in geographic, economic, or social space. Honest trade offers larger gains for more distant traders, but frequencies of meetings, and information flows about cheating, have local bias. Honesty is self-enforcing only between pairs of sufficiently close neighbors. Global honesty prevails only in a sufficiently small world. The extent of self-enforcing honesty is likely to decrease when the world expands beyond this size. Costly external enforcement is useful only if the world is sufficiently large, and its net payoff need not be larger than that of a self-governing small community. Intermediate-size worlds fare worst.

10.1086/378528.abstractZh: 设想一个由地理、经济或社会因素分隔的交易者世界。诚实的交易能够为距离较远的交易者带来更大的收益，但会议的频率以及关于欺诈的信息流动会存在局部偏差。诚实行为只有在足够近的邻居之间才会自我维持。全球范围内的诚实行为只有在足够小的世界中才会普遍存在。当世界规模扩大超过这个限度时，自我维持的诚实行为的程度可能会降低。只有在世界足够大的情况下，昂贵的外部强制手段才具有实际意义，而且其净收益不必高于一个自我管理的小型社区。中等规模的世界则处于更糟糕的境地。

abstract.text: Because estate tax liability usually depends on how long one lives, it implicitly provides annuity income. In the absence of annuity markets, lump-sum estate taxation may be used to achieve the first-best solution for individuals with a sufficiently strong bequest motive. Calculations of the annuity embedded in the U.S. estate tax show that people with $10 million of assets may be effectively receiving more than $100,000 a year financed at actuarially fair rates by their tax payments. According to my calibrations, the insurance effect reduces the marginal cost of funds (MCF) for the estate tax by as much as 30 percent, and the resulting MCF is within the range of estimates for the MCF for the income tax.

10.1086/378529.abstractZh: 由于遗产税的负担通常取决于一个人的寿命，因此它隐含着提供年金收入的功能。在没有年金市场的情况下，一次性遗产税可以用来为那些具有强烈遗赠动机的人提供最优解决方案。对美国遗产税中嵌入的年金进行计算后发现，拥有1000万美元资产的人实际上可以通过纳税获得每年超过10万美元的年金收入，且这些收入的获取方式符合精算公平原则。根据我的计算，保险效应可以将遗产税的边际成本降低多达30%，而由此产生的边际成本与所得税的边际成本大致相当。

abstract.text: The entry-level market for American gastroenterologists was organized by a centralized clearinghouse from 1986 to 1996. Before, and since, it has been conducted via a decentralized market in which appointment dates have unraveled to well over a year before the start of employment. We find that, both before and after the years in which the centralized clearinghouse was used, gastroenterologists are less mobile and more likely to be employed at the same hospital in which they were internal medicine residents than when the clearinghouse was in use. This suggests that the clearinghouse not only coordinates the timing of appointments but also increases the scope of the market, compared to a decentralized market with early appointments.

10.1086/378530.abstractZh: 在1986年至1996年间，美国胃肠病学家的基础市场是由一个集中式清算所组织的。在此之前及之后，市场都是通过分散式市场进行的，在这种市场中，预约日期往往要提前一年多才确定。我们发现，无论是在使用集中式清算所之前还是之后，胃肠病学家在同样医院担任内科住院医师期间，其流动性较低，且更有可能在同一家医院工作。这表明，集中式清算所不仅协调了预约时间，还扩大了市场的范围，相比之下，分散式市场的预约时间则更早。

abstract.text: Motivated by the behavior of asset prices, trading volume, and price volatility during episodes of asset price bubbles, we present a continuous-time equilibrium model in which overconfidence generates disagreements among agents regarding asset fundamentals. With short-sale constraints, an asset buyer acquires an option to sell the asset to other agents when those agents have more optimistic beliefs. As in a paper by Harrison and Kreps, agents pay prices that exceed their own valuation of future dividends because they believe that in the future they will find a buyer willing to pay even more. This causes a significant bubble component in asset prices even when small differences of beliefs are sufficient to generate a trade. In equilibrium, bubbles are accompanied by large trading volume and high price volatility. Our analysis shows that while Tobin's tax can substantially reduce speculative trading when transaction costs are small, it has only a limited impact on the size of the bubble or on price volatility.

10.1086/378531.abstractZh: 本文基于资产价格、交易量和价格波动在资产价格泡沫期间的行为，提出了一个连续时间均衡模型。在该模型中，过度自信会导致代理人之间对资产基本面的分歧。在卖空限制下，资产买家拥有向其他代理人出售资产的期权，前提是这些代理人持有更乐观的信念。正如Harrison和Kreps在论文中所提出的，代理人支付的价格高于他们对未来股息的估值，因为他们相信未来会找到愿意支付更高价格的买家。这导致即使信念差异很小也能引发资产价格的显著泡沫现象。在均衡状态下，泡沫伴随着巨大的交易量和高波动性。我们的分析表明，虽然托宾税可以在交易成本较低时大幅减少投机性交易，但它对泡沫规模或价格波动的影响有限。

abstract.text: With minimal sleight of hand, it is possible to transform the recent growth experience of the People's Republic of China from the extraordinary into the mundane. Systematic understatement of inflation by enterprises accounts for 2.5 percent growth per year in the nonagricultural economy during the first two decades of the reform period (197898). The usual suspects (i.e., rising participation rates, improvements in educational attainment, and the transfer of labor out of agriculture) account for most of the remainder. The productivity performance of the nonagricultural economy during the reform period is respectable but not outstanding. To the degree that the reforms have improved efficiency, these gains may lie principally in agriculture.

10.1086/378532.abstractZh: 通过最少的修饰，可以将中华人民共和国近期的经济增长经历从非凡转变为平常。企业在改革初期（1978-1988年）对通货膨胀的系统性低估，使得非农业经济每年增长2.5%。其余的增长主要得益于通常提到的因素，如参与率的上升、教育水平的提高以及劳动力从农业领域的转移。改革期间非农业经济的生产力表现虽然值得肯定，但并未达到卓越的水平。如果改革确实提高了效率，那么这些提升可能主要发生在农业领域。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study an important paradox of Deaton and Paxson (1998): Using the Barten model of economies of scale, Deaton and Paxson predict food share should increase as household size rises at the same per capita expenditure, while their empirical evidence shows the opposite. This paradox has important implications in measuring poverty and inequality. Consistent with predictions of the Barten model, we show food share in food and a more public good(housing) increases with family size, and the elasticity of the share of food with respect to family size is larger for poorer households. Therefore, the Deaton-Paxson Paradox cannot simply be due to an incorrect theoretical model. We provide evidence that food preparation time may be important in understanding this puzzle.

10.1086/378534.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了Deaton和Paxson（1998）提出的一个重要悖论：根据Barten的规模经济模型，Deaton和Paxson预测，在相同的人均支出条件下，家庭规模增加会导致食品份额上升，而实际数据却显示出相反的结果。这一悖论在衡量贫困和不平等方面具有重要意义。与Barten模型的预测一致，我们发现食品份额在食品领域以及更公共性的住房领域会随着家庭规模的增加而上升，而且对于较贫困的家庭来说，食品份额对家庭规模的弹性更大。因此，Deaton-Paxson悖论并不仅仅是由于理论模型的错误所致。我们有证据表明，食品准备时间可能在理解这一谜题中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Gan and Vernon’s comment does not resolve the puzzle that we orig-inally posed. Their description of the puzzle is unclear, so we start by restating it. The essence of the matter is this. Imagine two households, one of which is larger than the other, for example, containing the same age and sex composition of people, but with twice as many of everyone. Imagine too that both households have the same level of per capita total house-hold expenditure so that, in the example, the household with twice as many people spends twice as much in total. If there are economies of scale, the second household is better off. While it is possible for it to maintain exactly the same expenditure pattern as the smaller household, with everyone having the same of everything, it can also rearrange its purchases to take advantage of the differential economies of scale in different goods. Because food is a normal good, we would expect the larger household to spend more per capita on food. This is especially so in poor countries, where there are few substitutes for food, so that there is limited opportunity for substituting away from food toward goods with greater economies of scale. The evidence contradicts this prediction. We looked at household survey data from the United States,

10.1086/378535.abstractZh: 甘和弗农的评论并没有解决我们最初提出的难题。他们对这一难题的描述并不清晰，因此我们首先重新陈述这个问题。问题的核心在于：想象有两个家庭，其中一个家庭比另一个家庭更大，例如，这两个家庭的人口年龄和性别构成相同，但前者的人口数量是后者的两倍。同时，假设这两个家庭的人均总家庭支出相同，那么在例子中，人口更多的那个家庭的总支出也是后者的两倍。如果存在规模经济，那么人口更多的那个家庭就会处于更有利的位置。虽然它有可能保持与较小家庭相同的支出模式，即每个人都能获得相同的资源，但它也可以重新安排购买计划，以利用不同商品之间的规模经济差异。由于食物是一种正常商品，我们预计人口更多的家庭在食物上的人均支出会更高。特别是在贫穷国家，食物的替代品很少，因此从食物转向具有更大规模经济性的商品的机会有限。然而，实际证据与这一预测不符。我们研究了来自美国的家庭调查数据。

abstract.text: Can we rely on the public service ethos to deliver high quality public services? Are professionals such as doctors and teachers really public‐spirited altruists—knights—or self‐interested egoists—knaves? And how should the recipients of those services, patients, parents, and pupils, be treated? As passive recipients—pawns—or as active consumers—queens? This book offers answers to these questions. It argues that the original welfare state was designed on the assumptions that those who worked within it were basically altruists or knights and that the beneficiaries were passive recipients or pawns. In consequence, services were often of low quality, delivered in a patronising fashion and inequitable in outcome. However, services designed on an opposite set of assumptions—that public service professionals are knaves and that users should be queens—also face problems: exploitation by unscrupulous professionals, and overuse by demanding consumers, especially middle class ones. The book draws on evidence from Britain and abroad to show that, in fact, public policies designed on the basis that professionals are a mixture of knight and knave and recipients a mixture of pawn and queen deliver better quality and greater equity than policies based on more simplistic assumptions about motivation and agency. In particular, contrary to popular mythology, the book shows that policies that offer choice and competition within public services such as education and health care can deliver both excellence and equity. And policies aimed at building up individual assets and wealth ownership can empower the poor and powerless more effectively than those aimed simply at bolstering their current income.

10.1093/0199266999.001.0001.abstractZh: 我们能否依靠公共服务精神来提供高质量的公共服务？像医生和教师这样的专业人士真的是无私的“骑士”——真正的公共精神主义者，还是自私的“恶棍”——只关心自己利益的人？那么，这些服务的接受者——患者、家长和学生——应该被当作被动的“棋子”，还是积极的“消费者”？这本书为这些问题提供了答案。它认为，最初的福利国家是基于这样的假设设计的：在该体系内工作的人基本上是无私的“骑士”，而受益者则是被动的“棋子”。因此，服务的质量往往较低，提供方式带有居高临下的态度，结果也不公平。然而，基于相反假设的服务设计——即认为公共服务专业人士是“恶棍”，而用户应该是“女王”——也面临问题：不道德的专业人士可能会剥削用户，而要求苛刻的消费者，尤其是中产阶级消费者，则可能会过度使用服务。本书通过英国及其他国家的案例表明，实际上，基于“专业人士是骑士与恶棍的混合体，接受者是棋子和女王的混合体”这样的假设制定的公共政策，比基于更简单的动机和能动性假设制定的政策，能够提供更高质量和更公平的服务。特别是，与普遍的观点相反，本书表明，在教育和医疗保健等公共服务领域提供选择和竞争的政策，既能实现卓越，又能实现公平。此外，旨在增加个人资产和财富所有权的政策，比单纯提高当前收入的政策更能有效地帮助贫困和弱势群体。

abstract.text: This paper discusses a theoretical framework to study the issues of competition and incentives without relying on the standard profit‐oriented ‘market’ model in the context of the debates about public‐service reform in the UK. It uses the idea that the production of public services coheres around a mission, and discusses how decentralized service provision can raise productivity by matching motivated workers to their preferred missions. Our focus on competition and incentives cuts across traditional debates about public versus private ownership and allows for the possibility of involving private non‐profit organizations. We also address concerns about the consequences of allowing more flexibility in mission design and competition on inequality.

10.1093/oxrep/19.2.235.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一个理论框架，用于研究竞争与激励问题，而不依赖于标准的以利润为导向的“市场”模型，该模型通常用于英国公共服务改革相关的讨论。文章提出，公共服务的提供围绕一个使命展开，并探讨了通过让有动力的劳动者与他们偏好的使命相匹配，如何实现服务提供的效率提升。我们关注竞争与激励问题，这跨越了关于公共与私有产权传统的争论，并考虑了引入私人非营利组织的可能性。此外，文章还探讨了在使命设计和竞争方面增加灵活性所带来的不平等问题。

abstract.text: This paper shows that supervision with soft information is valuable whenever supervisors and supervisees collude under asymmetric information and proceeds then to derive an Equivalence Principle between organizational forms of supervisory and productive activities. We consider an organization with an agent privately informed on his productivity and a risk averse supervisor getting signals on the agent's type. In a centralized organization, the principal can communicate and contract with both the supervisor and the agent. However, these two agents can collude against the principal. In a decentralized organization, the principal only communicates and contracts with the supervisor who in turn sub-contracts with the agent. We show that the two organizations achieve the same outcome. We discuss this equivalence and provide various comparative statics results to assess the efficiency of supervisory structures.

10.1111/1467-937x.000244.abstractZh: 本文指出，在信息不对称的情况下，通过软信息进行的监督具有价值。我们探讨了一种组织形式，其中代理人对其生产力有私人信息，而监督者则通过信号获取代理人的类型信息。在集中式组织中，委托人可以与监督者和代理人进行沟通和合作。然而，这两个代理人可能会合谋对抗委托人。在分散式组织中，委托人仅与监督者进行沟通和合作，而监督者则进一步与代理人进行分包合作。我们证明了这两种组织能够实现相同的结果。我们讨论了这种等价性，并提供了各种比较静态结果来评估监督结构的效率。

abstract.text: Venture capital financing is characterized by extensive use of convertible securities and stage financing. In a model where a venture capitalist provides staged financing for a project, we illustrate an advantage of convertible debt (or warrants) over a mixture of debt and equity. Essentially, when the venture capitalist retains the option to abandon the project, the entrepreneur has an incentive to engage in window dressing and bias positively the short-term performance of the project, reducing the probability that it will be liquidated. An appropriately designed convertible security prevents such behaviour because window dressing also increases the probability that the venture capitalist will exercise the conversion option becoming the owner of a substantial fraction of the project's equity.

10.1111/1467-937x.00235.abstractZh: 风险投资融资的特点在于广泛使用可转换证券和分阶段融资。在一个风险投资家为项目提供分阶段融资的模型中，我们说明了可转换债务（或权证）相对于债务和股权混合融资的优势。本质上，当风险投资家保留放弃项目的选择权时，企业家有动机进行表面上的改进，从而积极提升项目的短期表现，降低项目被清算的概率。设计得当的可转换证券可以防止这种行为，因为表面上的改进还会增加风险投资家行使转换选择权、成为项目股权主要持有者的可能性。

abstract.text: Sample selection models provide an important way of accounting for economic decisions that combine discrete and continuous choices and of correcting for nonrandom sampling. Nonparametric estimators for these models are developed in this paper. These can be used for estimating shapes and important economic quantities, as in standard nonparametric regression. Endogeneity of regressors of interest is allowed for. Series estimators for these models are developed, which are useful for imposing additivity restrictions that arise from selection corrections. Convergence rates and asymptotic normality results are derived. An application to returns to schooling among Australian young females is given.

10.1111/1467-937x.00236.abstractZh: 样本选择模型为解释结合离散和连续选择的经济决策提供了重要方法，并有助于纠正非随机抽样问题。本文开发了这些模型的非参数估计器，可用于估计形状和重要的经济量，类似于标准非参数回归方法。模型允许感兴趣的回归变量存在内生性。文中还开发了适用于施加选择校正所产生加性限制的一系列估计器。推导出了收敛速率和渐近正态性结果。最后，文章以澳大利亚年轻女性受教育程度回报为例进行了应用分析。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the interactions between growth and the contracting environment in production.
