With incompleteness in contracting, viable production relationships between firms and workers, and therefore the profitability of industries, depend on the rates of innovation and growth. The speed at which new innovations arrive in turn depends on the profitability of production, for the usual reasons examined in the endogenous growth literature. We show that these interactions can have important implications which are consistent with observed phenomena in both the micro and macro environments. In particular, we demonstrate that a technological shock (increasing productivity of research) can, through this interaction, lead to a productivity slowdown and a shift in labour market contracts away from firms providing implicit guarantees of lifetime employment and towards shorter-term “contractor” type arrangements. We show the consistency of an increase in the proportion of the labour force under short-term employment, increased relative returns of workers in high-productivity sectors, and increased income inequality, with a productivity slowdown of finite duration.

10.1111/1467-937x.00237.abstractZh: 本文分析了增长与收缩性环境之间的相互作用。在收缩性不完全的情况下，企业与工人之间可行的生产关系以及产业的盈利能力，取决于创新与增长的速率。新创新的出现速度则取决于生产的盈利能力，这一规律与内生增长理论中的常见观点一致。我们指出，这些相互作用可能产生重要影响，这些影响与微观和宏观环境中的现象是一致的。具体而言，我们证明，技术冲击（提高研究生产力）可以通过这种相互作用导致生产力下降，并使劳动力市场合约从提供终身雇佣的安排转向更短期的“承包商”型安排。我们展示了劳动力中短期就业比例的增加、高生产力领域工人相对收益的提高以及收入不平等的增加，与有限持续时间的生产力下降之间存在一致性。

abstract.text: We study informal insurance within communities, explicitly recognizing the possibility that subgroups of individuals may destabilize insurance arrangements among the larger group. We therefore consider self-enforcing risk-sharing agreements that are robust not only to single-person deviations but also to potential deviations by subgroups. However, such deviations must be credible, in the sense that the subgroup must pass exactly the same test that we apply to the entire group; it must itself employ some self-enforcing risk-sharing agreement. We observe that the stability of subgroups is inimical to the stability of the group as a whole. Two surprising consequences of this analysis are that stable groups have (uniformly) bounded size, a result in sharp contrast to the individual-deviation problem, and that the degree of risk-sharing in a community is generally non-monotonic in the level of uncertainty or need for insurance in the community.

10.1111/1467-937x.00238.abstractZh: 我们研究了社区内的非正式保险现象，明确认识到个体子群体可能会破坏整个群体的保险安排。因此，我们考虑了能够自我维持的风险分担协议，这些协议不仅对单个个体的偏差具有鲁棒性，而且对子群体的潜在偏差也同样具有鲁棒性。然而，这种偏差必须是可信的，即子群体必须完全通过我们应用于整个群体的相同测试；子群体本身也必须采用某种自我维持的风险分担协议。我们发现，子群体的稳定性对整个群体的稳定性是有害的。这一分析的两个令人惊讶的结果是：稳定的群体具有（均匀）有限的大小，这与个体偏差问题形成了鲜明对比；此外，社区中的风险分担程度通常随着社区中的不确定性或保险需求的增加而呈现非单调变化。

abstract.text: This paper studies federal auctions for wildcat leases on the Outer Continental Shelf from 1954 to 1970. These are leases where bidders privately acquire (at some cost) noisy, but equally informative, signals about the amount of oil and gas that may be present. We develop tests of rational and equilibrium bidding in a common values model that are implemented using data on bids and ex post values. We also use data on tract location and ex post values to test the comparative static prediction that bidders may bid less aggressively in common value auctions when they expect more competition. We find that bidders are aware of the “winner's curse” and their bidding is largely consistent with equilibrium.

10.1111/1467-937x.00239.abstractZh: 本文研究了1954年至1970年间外大陆架上的联邦拍卖机制，用于租赁相关资产。这些租赁中，投标者会私下获取（尽管需要付出一定成本）关于潜在石油和天然气储量的信息。我们基于共同价值模型，对理性投标和均衡投标行为进行了测试，并使用了投标数据和事后价值数据来进行验证。同时，我们还利用地块位置数据及事后价值数据，检验了相对静态预测结果：当预期竞争加剧时，投标者可能会降低投标积极性。研究发现，投标者意识到“赢家诅咒”现象，其投标行为在很大程度上符合均衡状态。

abstract.text: A bivariate simultaneous discrete response model which is a stochastic representation of equilibria in a two-person discrete game is studied. The presence of multiple equilibria in the underlying discrete game maps into a region for the exogenous variables where the model predicts a nonunique outcome. This is an example of an incomplete econometric structure. Economists using this model have made simplifying assumptions to avoid multiplicity. I make a distinction between incoherent models and incomplete models, and then analyse the model in the presence of multiple equilibria, showing that the model contains enough information to identify the parameters of interest and to obtain a well defined semiparametric estimator. I also show that the latter is consistent and √n normal. Moreover, by exploiting the presence of multiplicity, one is able to obtain a more efficient estimator than the existing methods.

10.1111/1467-937x.00240.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种双变量同时离散响应模型，该模型是对两人离散博弈中均衡的随机表示。在底层离散博弈中存在多个均衡时，模型预测的外生变量会映射到一个区域，此时模型预测的结果并非唯一。这是一个不完备计量经济结构的例子。使用该模型的经济学家们做出了简化假设以避免均衡的多样性。我区分了不连贯模型和不完备模型，并分析了存在多个均衡情况下的模型，表明该模型包含足够的信息来识别感兴趣的参数，并获得一个定义明确的半参数估计量。我还证明了后者具有一致性，并且呈√n正态分布。此外，通过利用均衡的多样性，可以获得比现有方法更高效的估计量。

abstract.text: During the 1980's, all Japanese automobile producers opened assembly plants in North America. Industry analysts and previous research claim that these transplants are more productive than incumbent plants and that they produce with a substantially different production process. I compare the production processes by estimating a model that allows for heterogeneity in technology and productivity, both of which are intrinsically unobservable. The model is estimated on a panel of assembly plants, controlling for capacity utilization and price effects. The results indicate that the more recent technology uses capital more intensively and it has a higher elasticity of substitution between labour and capital. Hicks-neutral productivity growth is estimated to be lower, while capital-biased (labour-saving) productivity growth is higher for the new technology. Using the estimation results, I decompose industry-wide productivity growth and find plant-level changes in lean plants to be the most important contributor. Plant-level productivity growth is further decomposed to reveal the importance of capital-biased productivity growth, increases in the capital-labour ratio, and returns to scale.

10.1111/1467-937x.00241.abstractZh: 在20世纪80年代，所有日本汽车制造商都在北美开设了组装工厂。行业分析师和先前的研究表明，这些新设立的工厂比现有工厂更具生产效率，其生产流程也大有不同。我通过建立一个模型来比较这些生产流程，该模型能够考虑技术和生产力的异质性，而这两者本质上都是难以观测的。该模型基于一系列组装工厂的数据进行估计，同时控制了产能利用率和价格因素。研究结果表明，采用较新技术的工厂更密集地使用资本，并且劳动与资本之间的替代弹性更高。估计出的希克斯中性生产率增长较低，而基于资本偏向的生产率增长则更高。利用这些估计结果，我分解了整个行业的生产率增长，发现精益工厂层面的变化是最重要的贡献因素。进一步分解工厂层面的生产率增长，可以发现基于资本偏向的生产率增长、资本-劳动比率的上升以及规模效益的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model to analyse how skill premia differ over time and across countries, and uses this model to study the impact of international trade on wage inequality. Skill premia are determined by technology, the relative supply of skills, and trade. Technology is itself endogenous, and responds to profit incentives. An increase in the relative supply of skills, holding technology constant, reduces the skill premium. But an increase in the supply of skills over time also induces a change in technology, increasing the demand for skills. The most important result of the paper is that increased international trade induces skill-biased technical change. As a result, trade opening can cause a rise in inequality both in the U.S. and the less developed countries, and thanks to the induced skill-biased technical change, this can happen without a rise in the relative prices of skill-intensive goods in the U.S., which is the usual intervening mechanism in the standard trade models.

10.1111/1467-937x.00242.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，用于分析技能溢价随时间以及在不同国家之间的差异，并利用该模型研究国际贸易对工资不平等的影响。技能溢价由技术、技能的相对供应以及贸易状况决定。技术本身是内生性的，会响应利润激励。在技术保持不变的情况下，技能相对供应的增加会降低技能溢价。但随着时间的推移，技能供应的增加也会促使技术发生变化，从而增加对技能的需求。本文最重要的结论是，国际贸易的增加会引发技能偏向的技术变革。因此，贸易开放可能导致美国和欠发达国家的不平等加剧，而由于这种技能偏向的技术变革，这种情况的发生可能不会伴随着美国技能密集型商品相对价格的上升，而这在标准的贸易模型中通常是干预机制。

abstract.text: We consider the impact of reputation on the survival of a monopolist selling single units in discrete time periods, whose quality is learned slowly. If the seller learns her own quality at the same rate as customers, a sufficiently bad run of luck could induce her to stop selling. When she knows her quality, a good seller never stops selling though at low reputations a bad seller does with some probability. Furthermore, a seller with positive, though imperfect, information sells for the same number of periods whether her information is private or public. We further consider the robustness of the central result when the seller's opportunities for strategic behaviour are limited.

10.1111/1467-937x.00243.abstractZh: 我们考虑了声誉对垄断者生存的影响，这些垄断者在离散的时间段内销售单一单位的产品，其质量需要时间来了解。如果卖家了解自身质量的速度与顾客相同，那么一次糟糕的运气就可能导致她停止销售。当她了解自身质量时，优秀的卖家永远不会停止销售，尽管在声誉较低的情况下，有概率会出现糟糕的卖家。此外，即使信息不完全，拥有积极信息的卖家在无论信息是私密还是公开的情况下，都能以相同数量的时期进行销售。我们进一步考虑了当卖家的战略行为机会有限时，中心结果的稳健性。

abstract.text: We compare the characteristics of real-world financial contracts to their counterparts in financial contracting theory. We do so by studying the actual contracts between venture capitalists (VCs) and entrepreneurs. The distinguishing characteristic of VC financings is that they allow VCs to separately allocate cash flow rights, board rights, voting rights, liquidation rights, and other control rights. We describe and measure these rights. We then interpret our results in relation to existing financial contracting theories. We also describe the interrelation and the evolution across financing rounds of the different rights.

10.1111/1467-937x.00245.abstractZh: 我们将现实世界中的金融合约的特点与金融契约理论中的对应概念进行比较。我们通过研究风险投资家与企业家之间的实际合约来实现这一目的。风险投资的特点在于，它允许风险投资家分别分配现金流权、董事会表决权、投票权、清算权以及其他控制权。我们对这些权利进行了描述和测量。然后，我们将研究结果与现有的金融契约理论相结合进行解释。此外，我们还描述了不同权利在融资轮次之间的相互关系和演变情况。

abstract.text: We add to the methods for conditioning out serially correlated unobserved shocks to the production technology. We build on ideas first developed in Olley and Pakes (1996). They show how to use investment to control for correlation between input levels and the unobserved firm-specific productivity process. We show that intermediate inputs (those inputs which are typically subtracted out in a value-added production function) can also solve this simultaneity problem. We discuss some theoretical benefits of extending the proxy choice set in this direction and our empirical results suggest these benefits can be important.

10.1111/1467-937x.00246.abstractZh: 我们增加了一种方法来排除对生产技术产生的序列相关未观测冲击的影响。这一方法基于Olley和Pakes在1996年提出的理论。他们展示了如何利用投资来控制输入水平与未观测的 firm-specific 生产率过程之间的相关性。我们发现，中间投入（即在增加值生产函数中通常被减去的投入）也可以解决这种同时性问题。我们讨论了朝这个方向扩展代理选择集的一些理论优势，而我们的实证结果表明这些优势可能非常重要。

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic general equilibrium asset pricing model with heterogeneous agents and asymmetric information. We show how agents' different methods of gathering information affect their chances of survival in the market depending upon the nature of the information and the level of noise in the economy.

10.1111/1467-937x.00247.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个具有异质代理人和不对称信息的动态一般均衡资产定价模型。我们展示了代理人获取信息的不同方式如何影响他们在市场中的生存机会，这取决于信息的性质以及经济中的噪声水平。

abstract.text: When human capital accumulation generates pecuniary externalities across professions, and capital markets are imperfect, persistent inequality in utility and consumption is inevitable in any steady state. This is true irrespective of the degree of divisibility in investments. However, divisibility (or fineness of occupational structure) has implications for both the multiplicity and Pareto-efficiency of steady states. Indivisibilities generate a continuum of inefficient and efficient steady states with varying per capita income. On the other hand, perfect divisibility typically implies the existence of a unique steady state distribution which is Pareto-efficient.

10.1111/1467-937x.00248.abstractZh: 当人力资本积累在多个职业领域产生经济外部性，且资本市场存在缺陷时，任何稳定状态下效用和消费的持续不平等都是不可避免的。这一点与投资的可分割性无关。然而，可分割性（或职业结构的精细程度）对稳定状态的多样性和帕累托效率都有影响。不可分割性会导致一系列效率不同且人均收入也不同的稳定状态。另一方面，完全的可分割性通常意味着存在一个唯一的、具有帕累托效率的稳定状态分布。

abstract.text: The implications of the Minimax theorem are tested using natural data. The tests use a unique data set from penalty kicks in professional soccer games. In this natural setting experts play a one-shot two-person zero-sum game. The results of the tests are remarkably consistent with equilibrium play in every respect: (i) winning probabilities are statistically identical across strategies for players; (ii) players' choices are serially independent. The tests have substantial power to distinguish equilibrium play from disequilibrium alternatives. These results represent the first time that both implications of von Neumann's Minimax theorem are supported under natural conditions.

10.1111/1467-937x.00249.abstractZh: 通过自然数据对极小极大定理的推论进行了验证。测试使用了专业足球比赛点球这一独特数据集。在这种自然环境中，专家们进行的是一次性的两人零和博弈。测试结果与均衡博弈在各个方面都高度一致：(i) 不同策略下玩家的获胜概率在统计上完全相同；(ii) 玩家的选择是序列独立的。这些测试具有强大的能力，能够区分均衡博弈与非均衡博弈。这些结果首次在自然条件下支持了冯·诺伊曼极小极大定理的两个推论。

abstract.text: We consider a market in which an expert must exert costly but unobservable effort to identify the service that meets the consumer's need. In our model, experts offer competing contracts and the consumer may gather multiple opinions. We explore the incentives that a competitive sampling of prices and opinions provides for experts to exert effort and find that there is a tension between price competition and the equilibrium effort. In particular, the equilibrium fails to realize the second best welfare optimum. An intervention, that limits price competition via price control, increases welfare.

10.1111/1467-937x.00250.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个市场，在这个市场中，专家需要付出昂贵但难以观察到的努力来识别能够满足消费者需求的服务。在我们的模型中，专家提供相互竞争的合同，而消费者可以收集多种意见。我们探讨了竞争性价格采集和意见收集对专家努力付出的激励作用，发现价格竞争与均衡努力之间存在矛盾。具体而言，均衡未能实现第二优的福利状态。通过价格管制来限制价格竞争的做法，能够提升福利水平。

abstract.text: This paper examines the profitability of three types of integration in a cooperative game solved by a random-order value (e.g. the Shapley value). Collusion between players i and j is a contract merging their resources in the hands of one of them, say i. This contract can be represented as a combination of exclusion, which lets i exclude j's resource but not use it himself, and inclusion, which lets i use j's resource but not exclude j from it. This representation yields a third-difference condition on the characteristic function that determines the profitability of collusion, generalizing existing results for specific games. Namely, collusion is profitable [unprofitable] when the complementarity of the colluding players is reduced [increased] by other players.

10.1111/1467-937x.00251.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在由随机顺序值（例如沙普利值）解决的合作博弈中，三种类型整合的盈利能力。玩家i和j之间的勾结是一种合同，将他们的资源合并到其中一位玩家的手中，比如i。这种合同可以表示为排除与包含两种组合：排除意味着i可以排除j的资源，但不能使用它；包含则意味着i可以使用j的资源，但不能排除j在其中的地位。这种表示方式得出了一个关于特征函数的第三差条件，该条件决定了勾结的盈利能力，从而推广了针对特定博弈的现有结果。具体来说，当勾结玩家的互补性被其他玩家减少或增加时，勾结就是有利可图的[无利可图的]。

abstract.text: We characterize competitive equilibria with perfect foresight in a deterministic, three-period pure-exchange overlapping generations economy with perfect information and no commitment to loan contracts. Commitment is replaced by an enforcement mechanism that excludes defaulters from asset markets for one period. For hump-shaped endowment profiles, young individuals face endogenous debt constraints that ration current consumption. Changes in current and future yields affect these constraints, inducing an additional income effect on rationed household demand that makes current and future consumption complements. This mechanism can lead to multiple steady states, persistent indeterminacy and regime switching. We show that sensitivity to shocks and complex dynamic behaviour are consistent with endogenous debt limits but not with exogenous liquidity constraints.

10.1111/1467-937x.00252.abstractZh: 我们描述了在确定性、三期纯交换重叠世代经济中，具有完美预见性的竞争均衡。该经济具有完美信息，且不存在贷款合同的承诺。承诺被一种执行机制所取代，该机制将违约者排除在资产市场之外，为期一个时期。对于驼峰形禀赋配置，年轻个体面临内生性债务约束，这些约束限制了当前的消费。当前和未来收益的变化会影响这些约束，从而进一步影响家庭需求的分配，使得当前和未来的消费成为互补品。这种机制可能导致多个稳定状态、持续的不确定性以及制度转换。我们表明，对冲击的敏感性和复杂的动态行为与内生性债务限制一致，但与外生的流动性约束并不一致。

abstract.text: A central tenet of economics is that individuals respond to incentives. For psychologists and sociologists, in contrast, rewards and punishments are often counterproductive, because they undermine “intrinsic motivation”. We reconcile these two views, showing how performance incentives offered by an informed principal (manager, teacher, parent) can adversely impact an agent's (worker, child) perception of the task, or of his own abilities. Incentives are then only weak reinforcers in the short run, and negative reinforcers in the long run. We also study the effects of empowerment, help and excuses on motivation, as well as situations of ego bashing reflecting a battle for dominance within a relationship.

10.1111/1467-937x.00253.abstractZh: 经济学的核心观点是，个体会对激励作出反应。而对于心理学家和社会学家来说，奖励和惩罚往往会产生反效果，因为它们会削弱“内在动机”。我们试图调和这两种观点，指出由知情主体（如管理者、教师、家长）提供的绩效激励可能会负面影响个体（工人、儿童）对任务的认知或自身能力的评价。因此，激励在短期内只是较弱的强化因素，在长期内则成为负面强化因素。我们还研究了授权、帮助和借口对动机的影响，以及反映关系内竞争地位的自我贬低现象。

abstract.text: This paper analyses labour force participation and precautionary savings in the presence of risks of being fired or failing to secure a job offer when out of the labour market. We use a finite horizon framework with two employment states and a stage utility function which is CARA in consumption but non-separable in leisure. The results are that there is precautionary labour force participation: employment risk lowers the reservation wage; generally it also reduces consumption. However due to the non-separability assumption, precautionary savings, as usually defined, may not be positive. We characterize the reservation wage and contrast the results with those in which the stage utility is additive in leisure and consumption. We extend the analysis to study the effects of cyclical variation in employment risk, of stochastic future wage rates, and of adding a third employment state of search.

10.1111/1467-937x.00254.abstractZh: 本文分析了在失业时面临被解雇或无法获得工作机会的风险情况下，劳动力的参与程度以及预防性储蓄行为。我们采用有限时间框架，包含两个就业状态，并采用阶段效用函数，该函数在消费方面符合CARA模型，但在休闲方面不可分离。研究结果表明，预防性劳动力参与存在：就业风险会降低保留工资；通常也会减少消费。然而，由于不可分离性假设的存在，通常定义的预防性储蓄可能并不为正。我们进一步描述了保留工资，并将其结果与阶段效用在休闲和消费方面可加性的结果进行了对比。我们还扩展了分析范围，研究了就业风险的周期性变化、未来工资的随机性变化，以及增加第三个就业状态——搜索状态的影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of an unfunded social security system on the distribution of altruistic transfers in a framework where savings are due to both life cycle and random altruistic motivations. We show that the effect of social security on the distribution of these transfers depends crucially on the strength of the bequest motive in explaining savings behaviour. We measure this strength by the expected weight that individuals attach to the utility of future generations. On the one hand, if the bequest motive is strong, then an increase in the social security tax raises the bequests left by altruistic parents. On the other hand, when the importance of altruism in motivating savings is sufficiently low, the increase in the social security tax could result in a reduction of the bequests left by altruistic parents under some conditions on the attitude of individuals toward risk and on the relative returns associated with private saving and social security. Some implications concerning the transitional effects of introducing an unfunded social security scheme are also discussed.

10.1111/1467-937x.00255.abstractZh: 本文研究了无资金保障的社会保障制度对利他性转移分配的影响，研究框架中储蓄行为是由生命周期和随机利他动机共同驱动的。我们指出，社会保障对这类转移分配的影响在很大程度上取决于“遗赠动机”在解释储蓄行为中的重要性。我们通过个体对未来世代利益的预期重视程度来衡量这一重要性。一方面，如果遗赠动机较强，那么提高社会保障税会促使利他性父母留下的遗赠额增加。另一方面，当利他主义在激励储蓄方面的重要性较低时，在某些关于个体风险态度以及私人储蓄与社会保障相关回报的条件下，提高社会保障税可能会导致利他性父母留下的遗赠额减少。本文还讨论了引入无资金保障社会保障制度的过渡效应所带来的一些启示。

abstract.text: We consider an environment in which agents' skills are private information and follow arbitrary stochastic processes. We prove that it is typically Pareto optimal for an individual's marginal benefit of investing in capital to exceed his marginal cost of doing so. This wedge is consistent with a positive tax on capital income. We also prove that it is Pareto optimal for the marginal rate of substitution between any two consumption goods to equal the marginal rate of transformation. This lack of a wedge is consistent with uniform taxation of consumption goods within a period.

10.1111/1467-937x.00256.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个环境，其中代理人的技能是私人信息，并且遵循任意的随机过程。我们证明，对于个人而言，投资资本的边际收益通常要高于其边际成本，这种收益与资本收益的税收是相容的。我们还证明，任意两种消费商品之间的边际替代率等于边际转换率时，是帕累托最优的。没有这种收益与税收的不相容性，意味着消费商品在一段时间内可以实行统一征税。

abstract.text: For a nonexcludable public good with benefit and cost functions independent of the number of participants, this paper studies second-best allocations under Bayesian interim incentive compatibility and interim individual rationality. As the number of participants becomes large, second-best provision levels converge in distribution to first-best levels if the latter are bounded. Second-best provision levels become large in absolute terms but small relative to first-best levels if benefit and cost functions are isoelastic. In contrast, for an excludable public good, the ratio of second-best to first-best levels is bounded away from zero.

10.1111/1467-937x.00257.abstractZh: 对于一种不可排除的公共物品，其收益和成本函数与参与者的数量无关，本文研究了在贝叶斯中期激励兼容性和中期个体理性约束下的次优分配问题。当参与者数量增加时，如果次优供给水平是有界的，那么次优供给水平会收敛到最优供给水平。如果收益和成本函数是等弹性函数，那么次优供给水平在绝对值上会较大，但相对于最优供给水平来说则较小。相比之下，对于可排除的公共物品，次优水平与最优水平的比率接近于零。

abstract.text: This paper asks whether statistical discrimination is a market failure. I consider the problem for a utilitarian social planner who operates in an environment that can generate statistical discrimination as an equilibrium phenomenon. It is found that there are potential efficiency gains from discrimination in terms of reduced “mismatch” between workers and jobs. Whether the solution to the planning problem involves discrimination depends on the trade-off between the informational gains of specialization and the losses in terms of increased investment costs.

10.1111/1467-937x.00258.abstractZh: 本文探讨了统计歧视是否是一种市场失灵。我将这一问题视为一个功利主义社会规划者在能够产生统计歧视的环境中运作时的均衡现象。研究发现，从减少工人与职位之间的“不匹配”角度来看，歧视确实可能带来效率提升。而规划问题的解决方案是否涉及歧视，则取决于专业化所带来的信息收益与增加的投资成本之间的权衡。

abstract.text: We explore entry into a foreign market with uncertain demand growth. A multinational can serve the foreign demand by two modes, or by a combination thereof: it can export its products, or it can create productive capacity via foreign direct investment (FDI). The advantage of FDI is that it allows for lower marginal cost than exporting does. The disadvantage is that FDI is irreversible and, hence, entails the risk of creating under-utilized capacity in the case that the market turns out to be small. The presence of demand uncertainty and irreversibility gives rise to an interior solution, where the multinational, under certain conditions, both exports its products and does FDI.

10.1111/1467-937x.00259.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在需求增长不确定的情况下进入外国市场的策略。跨国企业可以通过两种模式或两者的组合来满足外国市场的需求：一种是出口产品，另一种是通过外国直接投资来创造生产能力。外国直接投资的优势在于其边际成本低于出口方式。然而，其缺点在于投资是不可逆转的，因此如果市场规模较小，可能会导致生产能力被闲置。由于需求的不确定性以及投资的可逆性问题，存在一种内部解决方案：在特定条件下，跨国企业可以同时出口产品和进行外国直接投资。

abstract.text: This paper looks at the incentives of individual members of a monetary policy committee to gain a reputation for inflationary toughness. I show a policy maker can have more or less incentive to build a reputation when part of a group. But, group policy making leads to higher expected social welfare. Not publishing individuals’ votes, raises the temptation to inflate and lowers expected social welfare. If the culture or rules of a central bank puts more weight on senior policy makers, the incentive to build a reputation is greater, but expected social welfare may be higher or lower.

10.1111/1467-937x.00260.abstractZh: 本文探讨了货币政策委员会成员个体为获得“通胀强硬”声誉而采取的激励措施。研究表明，当成员属于一个团体时，他们建立声誉的动机会有所不同。然而，团体决策往往能带来更高的预期社会福利。如果不公开个人的投票意见，就会增加通胀的诱惑，从而降低预期社会福利。如果中央银行的文化或规则更重视资深决策者的意见，那么建立声誉的动机就会更强，但预期社会福利可能会更高或更低。

abstract.text: We propose a model of organizational decision making, in which information processing is decentralized. Our model incorporates two features of many actual organizations: aggregation entails a loss of useful information, and the decision problems of different agents interact. We assume that an organization forms a portfolio of risky assets, following a hierarchical procedure. Agents' decision rules and the organization's hierarchical structure are derived endogenously. Typically, in the optimal hierarchical structure, all agents have one subordinate, and returns to ability are at least as high at the bottom as at the top. However, these results can be reversed in the presence of returns to specialization.

10.1111/1467-937x.00261.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个组织决策模型，其中信息处理是分散式的。我们的模型包含了许多实际组织的两个特点：聚合会导致有用信息的丢失，以及不同代理的决策问题会相互影响。我们假设一个组织按照分层程序形成一系列风险资产组合。代理的决策规则以及组织的分层结构都是内生性产生的。通常，在最优的分层结构中，所有代理都只有一个下属，而能力回报在底层至少与顶层一样高。然而，在存在专业化回报的情况下，这些结果可能会颠倒。

abstract.text: In this paper, we derive principles of optimal cyclical monetary policy in an economy without capital, with a cash-in-advance restriction on household transactions, and monopolistic firms that set prices one period in advance. The only distortionary policy instruments are the nominal interest rate and the money supply. In this environment it is feasible to undo both the cash-in-advance and price setting restrictions, but not the distortion due to monopolistic competition. We show that it is optimal to follow the Friedman rule, and thus offset the cash-in-advance restriction. We also find that, in general, it is not optimal to undo the price setting restriction, so that a simple criterion of eliminating gaps is not optimal. Sticky prices provide the planner with tools to improve upon a distorted flexible price allocation.

10.1111/1467-937x.00263.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们推导了在没有资本的经济体中，在存在家庭交易预付现金限制以及垄断企业提前设定价格的情况下，最优周期性货币政策的原理。唯一的扭曲性政策工具是名义利率和货币供应量。在这种环境下，取消预付现金和价格设定限制是可行的，但无法消除由于垄断竞争造成的扭曲。我们表明，遵循弗里德曼规则是最优的，从而可以抵消预付现金的限制。我们还发现，一般来说，取消价格设定限制并不是最优的，因此，简单的消除价格差异的标准并不具有最优性。粘性价格为决策者提供了改善扭曲的灵活价格分配的工具。

abstract.text: Why is inflation persistently high in some periods and low in others? The reason may be the absence of commitment in monetary policy. In a standard model, absence of commitment leads to multiple equilibria, or expectation traps, even without trigger strategies. In these traps, expectations of high or low inflation lead the public to take defensive actions, which then make accommodating those expectations the optimal monetary policy. Under commitment, the equilibrium is unique and the inflation rate is low on average. This analysis suggests that institutions which promote commitment can prevent high inflation episodes from recurring.

10.1111/1467-937x.00264.abstractZh: 为什么在某些时期通货膨胀会持续较高，而在其他时期则较低？原因可能是货币政策缺乏承诺性。在标准的模型中，缺乏承诺性会导致多重均衡或预期陷阱，即使没有触发策略也是如此。在这些陷阱中，对高或低通货膨胀的预期会促使公众采取防御性行动，从而使得适应这些预期成为最优的货币政策。在承诺性条件下，均衡是唯一的，通货膨胀率平均而言较低。这一分析表明，能够促进承诺性的制度可以防止高通货膨胀现象再次发生。

abstract.text: This paper studies the theoretical conditions under which price stability is the optimal policy in a two-country open-economy model with imperfect competition and price stickiness. Special conditions on the levels of country-specific distortionary taxation and the intratemporal and intertemporal elasticities of substitution need to be satisfied. These restrictions apply to both cooperative and non-cooperative settings. Importantly, we show that cooperative and non-cooperative solutions do not coincide despite market completeness and producer currency pricing. We study the conditions under which quadratic approximations of single countries' welfare can be correctly evaluated by relying only on log-linear approximations of the equilibrium conditions.

10.1111/1467-937x.00265.abstractZh: 本文研究在存在不完全竞争和价格粘性的双国开放经济模型中，价格稳定作为最优政策的条件。需要满足国家特定扭曲性税收水平以及替代弹性在时际和跨时际上的特定条件。这些限制适用于合作与非合作两种情形。重要的是，我们指出，尽管市场是完备的且生产者采用同一货币定价，合作与非合作解决方案并不一致。我们研究了仅依靠均衡条件的对数线性近似来正确评估单个国家福利的二次近似条件。

abstract.text: This paper develops a welfare-based model of monetary policy in an open economy. We examine the optimal monetary policy under commitment, focusing on the nature of price adjustment in determining policy. We investigate the implications of these policies for exchange-rate flexibility. The traditional approach maintains that exchange-rate flexibility is desirable in the presence of real country-specific shocks that require adjustment in relative prices. However, in the light of empirical evidence on nominal price response to exchange-rate changes—specifically, that there appears to be a large degree of local-currency pricing (LCP) in industrialized countries—the expenditure-switching role played by nominal exchange rates may be exaggerated in the traditional literature. In the presence of LCP, we find that the optimal monetary policy leads to a fixed exchange rate, even in the presence of country-specific shocks. This is true whether monetary policy is chosen cooperatively or non-cooperatively among countries.

10.1111/1467-937x.00266.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个基于福利的开放经济货币政策模型。我们研究了在承诺约束下的最优货币政策，重点关注价格调整在政策制定中的决定性作用。我们还探讨了这些政策对汇率灵活性影响的研究结果。传统观点认为，在存在需要调整相对价格的特定国家冲击时，汇率灵活性是可取的。然而，根据关于名义价格对汇率变动反应的实证证据——特别是工业化国家中普遍存在本地货币定价现象——传统文献中对于名义汇率在支出转换中的作用描述可能过于夸张。在存在本地货币定价的情况下，我们发现即使存在特定国家冲击，最优货币政策仍会导致固定汇率。这一点无论各国之间的货币政策是合作选择还是非合作选择都是如此。

abstract.text: We study the optimal monetary policy in a two-country open-economy model under two monetary arrangements: (a) multiple currencies controlled by independent policy makers; (b) common currencies with a centralized policy maker. Our findings suggest that: (i) monetary policy competition leads to higher long-term inflation and interest rates with large welfare losses; (ii) the inflation bias and the consequent losses are larger when countries are unable to commit to future policies; (iii) the welfare losses from higher long-term inflation dominates the welfare costs of losing the ability to react optimally to shocks.

10.1111/1467-937x.00267.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个双国开放经济模型下，在两种货币安排下的最优货币政策：(a)由独立政策制定者控制的多种货币；(b)由中央政策制定者管理的共同货币。我们的研究发现表明：(i)货币政策竞争会导致长期通胀和利率上升，同时带来巨大的福利损失；(ii)当各国无法对未来政策做出承诺时，通胀偏差及其导致的损失会更大；(iii)长期通胀上升带来的福利损失，超过了因无法最优应对冲击而造成的损失。

abstract.text: A fundamentals based monetary policy rule, which would be the optimal monetary policy without commitment when private agents have perfectly rational expectations, is unstable if in fact these agents follow standard adaptive learning rules. This problem can be overcome if private expectations are observed and suitably incorporated into the policy maker's optimal rule. These strong results extend to the case in which there is simultaneous learning by the policy maker and the private agents. Our findings show the importance of conditioning policy appropriately, not just on fundamentals, but also directly on observed household and firm expectations.

10.1111/1467-937x.00268.abstractZh: 一种基于基本面的货币政策规则，在私人主体具有完全理性预期的情况下，如果没有承诺约束，该规则是最优的货币政策。然而，如果这些私人主体遵循标准的适应性学习规则，这种规则就会变得不稳定。这个问题可以通过观察私人主体的预期，并将其适当地纳入政策制定者的最优规则中来解决。这些强有力的研究结果也适用于政策制定者和私人主体同时进行学习的情况。我们的研究结果表明，适当的政策条件设置非常重要，不仅基于基本面，还直接基于观察到的家庭和企业的预期。

abstract.text: Optimal monetary policy maximizes the welfare of a representative agent, given frictions in the economic environment. Constructing a model with two sets of frictions—costly price adjustment by imperfectly competitive firms and costly exchange of wealth for goods—we find optimal monetary policy is governed by two familiar principles. First, the average level of the nominal interest rate should be sufficiently low, as suggested by Milton Friedman, that there should be deflation on average. Yet, the Keynesian frictions imply that the optimal nominal interest rate is positive. Second, as various shocks occur to the real and monetary sectors, the price level should be largely stabilized, as suggested by Irving Fisher, albeit around a deflationary trend path. Since expected inflation is roughly constant through time, the nominal interest rate must therefore vary with the Fisherian determinants of the real interest rate. Although the monetary authority has substantial leverage over real activity in our model economy, it chooses real allocations that closely resemble those which would occur if prices were flexible. In our benchmark model, there is some tendency for the monetary authority to smooth nominal and real interest rates.

10.1111/1467-937x.00269.abstractZh: 最优货币政策旨在在经济环境中的摩擦条件下最大化代表性代理人的福利。通过构建一个包含两组摩擦的模型——不完美竞争企业进行代价高昂的价格调整，以及财富兑换商品的高成本——我们发现最优货币政策受两个常见原则的支配。首先，正如米尔顿·弗里德曼所提出的，名义利率的平均水平应足够低，以实现平均通缩。然而，凯恩斯主义摩擦表明，最优名义利率应该是正的。其次，当实际和货币领域受到各种冲击时，价格水平应大致保持稳定，正如欧文·费雪所建议的，尽管这种稳定是在通缩趋势的框架内实现的。由于预期通胀在一段时间内大致保持不变，因此名义利率必须随着费雪式实际利率的决定因素而变化。尽管在我们的模型经济中，货币当局对实际经济活动有相当大的影响力，但它选择的实际分配方式与价格具有灵活性时的情况非常相似。在我们的基准模型中，货币当局有某种倾向去平滑名义利率和实际利率。

abstract.text: This paper considers the desirability of the observed tendency of central banks to adjust interest rates only gradually in response to changes in economic conditions. It shows, in the context of a simple model of optimizing private-sector behaviour, that assignment of an interest-rate smoothing objective to the central bank may be desirable, even when reduction of the magnitude of interest-rate changes is not a social objective in itself. This is because a response of policy to “irrelevant” lagged variables may be desirable owing to the way it steers private-sector expectations of future policy.

10.1111/1467-937x.00270.abstractZh: 本文探讨了中央银行在应对经济条件变化时仅逐步调整利率的倾向是否可取。在一个简单的优化私营部门行为的模型中，即使降低利率变动的幅度本身并非社会目标，将利率平滑目标分配给中央银行仍可能是可取的。这是因为，政策对“无关”的滞后变量的响应可能是可取的，因为这种方式能够引导私营部门对未来政策的预期。

abstract.text: We study adaptive learning in a monetary overlapping generations model with sticky prices and monopolistic competition for the case where learning agents observe current endogenous variables. Observability of current variables is essential for informational consistency of the learning setup with the model setup but generates multiple temporary equilibria when prices are flexible and prevents a straightforward construction of the learning dynamics. Sticky prices overcome this problem by avoiding simultaneity between prices and price expectations. Adaptive learning then robustly selects the determinate (monetary) steady state independent from the degree of imperfect competition. The indeterminate (non-monetary) steady state and non-stationary equilibria are never stable. Stability in a deterministic version of the model may differ because perfect foresight equilibria can be the limit of restricted perceptions equilibria of the stochastic economy with vanishing noise and thereby inherit different stability properties. This discontinuity at the zero variance of shocks suggests one should analyse learning in stochastic models.

10.1111/1467-937x.00271.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有粘性价格和垄断竞争的货币重叠世代模型中的自适应学习现象，该模型假设学习代理能够观测到当前的内生变量。当前变量的可观测性对于学习设置与模型设置的资讯一致性至关重要，但当价格具有灵活性时，这会产生多个临时均衡，并阻碍学习动态的直接构建。粘性价格通过避免价格和价格预期之间的同时性来克服这一问题。自适应学习能够稳健地选择与不完全竞争程度无关的确定性（货币）稳态。非确定性（非货币）稳态和非静态均衡则永远不稳定。确定性模型中的稳定性可能会有所不同，因为完美预见均衡可能是随机经济中噪声消失时限制性感知均衡的极限，从而继承不同的稳定性特性。这种在冲击方差为零时的不连续性表明，应该分析随机模型中的学习现象。

abstract.text: Monetary policy analyses usually assume an atomistic private sector, thereby ignoring potential interactions between policy and wage-setting decisions. Yet, non-atomistic wage setters are a key feature of several industrialized economies. We study the economic consequence of non-atomistic agents and show that this qualifies previous results on the effects and desirability of a conservative central banker. In particular, the central bank aversion to inflation may have a permanent effect on structural employment, while no such effect emerges with atomistic agents.

10.1111/1467-937x.t01-1-00263.abstractZh: 货币政策分析通常假设一个原子化的私人部门，从而忽略了政策与工资设定决策之间的潜在互动。然而，非原子化的工资设定者是几个工业化经济体的重要特征。我们研究了非原子化代理人的经济后果，并表明这验证了之前关于保守型中央银行行长的影响和可行性的研究结果。特别是，中央银行对通货膨胀的厌恶可能对结构性就业产生永久性影响，而原子化代理人则不会出现这样的效应。

abstract.text: A predictor is asked to rank eventualities according to their plausibility, based on past cases. We assume that she can form a ranking given any memory that consists of repetitions of past cases. Mild consistency requirements on these rankings imply that they have a numerical representation via a matrix assigning numbers to eventualitycase pairs, as follows. A memory is identified with a vector, counting the number of repetitions of each case. Multiplication of the matrix by a memory vector yields a numerical representation of the ordinal plausibility ranking given that memory. Interpreting this result for the ranking of theories or hypotheses, rather than of specific eventualities, it is shown that one may ascribe to the predictor subjective conditional probabilities of cases given theories, such that her rankings of theories agree with their likelihood functions. 1 Introduction It is well known that inductive inference is not logically valid. As David Hume (1748) put it, "... The co...

10.1111/1468-0262.00388.abstractZh: 要求预测者根据过去案例的相似性对各种可能性进行排序。我们假设，只要提供过去案例的重复信息，预测者就能形成这样的排序。对这些排序施加轻微的一致性要求意味着，可以通过一个矩阵将排序结果数值化，该矩阵将数字分配给各种可能性-案例对。一个记忆被表示为一个向量，该向量记录了每个案例的重复次数。将矩阵与一个记忆向量相乘，就可以得到给定该记忆下的可能性排序的数值表示。如果将这一结果应用于理论或假设的排序，而不是具体的可能性，那么就可以为预测者赋予给定理论情况下案例的主观条件概率，从而使其对理论的排序与这些理论的可能性函数一致。1 引言众所周知，归纳推理在逻辑上并不有效。正如大卫·休谟在1748年所说，“……

abstract.text: In this paper we estimate a bargaining model of government formation in parliamentary democracies. We use the estimated structural model to conduct constitutional experiments aimed at evaluating the impact of institutional features of the political environment on the duration of the government formation process, the type of coalitions that form, and their relative stability.

10.1111/1468-0262.00389.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们构建了一个关于议会民主制下政府形成过程的讨价还价模型。我们利用该结构模型进行宪法实验，旨在评估政治环境的制度特征对政府形成过程的持续时间、形成的联盟类型以及它们的相对稳定性的影响。

abstract.text: Methods are proposed for testing stochastic dominance of any pre–specified order, with primary interest in the distributions of income. We consider consistent tests, that are similar to Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests, of the complete set of restrictions that relate to the various forms of stochastic dominance. For such tests, in the case of tests for stochastic dominance beyond first order, we propose and justify a variety of approaches to inference based on simulation and the bootstrap. We compare these approaches to one another and to alternative approaches based on multiple comparisons in the context of a Monte Carlo experiment and an empirical example.

10.1111/1468-0262.00390.abstractZh: 本文提出了用于测试任何预设顺序下的随机优势的方法，主要关注收入分布的问题。我们考虑了与Kolmogorov–Smirnov检验类似的一致性检验方法，用于检验与各种随机优势形式相关的全部限制条件。对于超过一阶的随机优势检验，我们提出了基于模拟和自助法的多种推断方法，并对此进行了论证。我们通过蒙特卡洛实验和一个实证案例，对这些方法进行了比较，并与其他基于多重比较的方法进行了对比。

abstract.text: Public information in financial markets often arrives through the disclosures of interested parties who have a material interest in the reactions of the market to the new information. When the strategic interaction between the sender and the receiver is formalized as a disclosure game with verifiable reports, equilibrium prices can be given a simple characterization in terms of the concatenation of binomial pricing trees. There are a number of empirical implications. The theory predicts that the return variance following a poor disclosed outcome is higher than it would have been if the disclosed outcome were good. Also, when investors are risk averse, this leads to negative serial correlation of asset returns. Other points of contact with the empirical literature are discussed.

10.1111/1468-0262.00391.abstractZh: 金融市场中的公共信息往往通过那些对市场价格反应有重大兴趣的当事人的披露而获得。当发送者与接收者之间的战略互动被形式化为一个具有可验证报告的披露游戏时，均衡价格可以用二项式定价树的串联来简单描述。这一理论有一些实证意义。该理论预测，如果披露的结果不佳，随后的回报方差会比披露结果良好时更高。此外，当投资者厌恶风险时，这会导致资产回报的负序列相关性。文中还讨论了与实证文献的其他联系点。

abstract.text: This paper develops an inferential theory for factor models of large dimensions. The principal components estimator is considered because it is easy to compute and is asymptotically equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator (if normality is assumed). We derive the rate of convergence and the limiting distributions of the estimated factors, factor loadings, and common components. The theory is developed within the framework of large cross sections ("N") and a large time dimension ("T"), to which classical factor analysis does not apply.We show that the estimated common components are asymptotically normal with a convergence rate equal to the minimum of the square roots of "N" and "T". The estimated factors and their loadings are generally normal, although not always so. The convergence rate of the estimated factors and factor loadings can be faster than that of the estimated common components. These results are obtained under general conditions that allow for correlations and heteroskedasticities in both dimensions. Stronger results are obtained when the idiosyncratic errors are serially uncorrelated and homoskedastic. A necessary and sufficient condition for consistency is derived for large "N" but fixed "T".

10.1111/1468-0262.00392.abstractZh: 本文发展了一种适用于大维度因子模型的推断理论。主要考虑使用主成分估计方法，因为该方法计算简单，并且在假设正态性的情况下，与最大似然估计具有渐近等价性。我们推导了估计因子、因子载荷以及共同成分的收敛速率和极限分布。该理论是在大样本量（“N”）和长时间维度（“T”）的框架下发展的，而传统的因子分析并不适用于这种情况。我们证明，估计的共同成分在渐近意义上呈正态分布，其收敛速率等于“N”和“T”的平方根的最小值。估计的因子及其载荷通常呈正态分布，但并非总是如此。估计的因子和因子载荷的收敛速率可能比估计的共同成分更快。这些结果是在允许两个维度上存在相关性和异方差性的一般条件下获得的。当特异性误差是序列不相关且同方差时，可以获得更强的结果。对于较大的“N”但固定的“T”，我们推导出了一致性的必要充分条件。

abstract.text: We present a model in which an asset bubble can persist despite the presence of rational arbitrageurs. The resilience of the bubble stems from the inability of arbitrageurs to temporarily coordinate their selling strategies. This synchronization problem together with the individual incentive to time the market results in the persistence of bubbles over a substantial period. Since the derived trading equilibrium is unique, our model rationalizes the existence of bubbles in a strong sense. The model also provides a natural setting in which news events, by enabling synchronization, can have a disproportionate impact relative to their intrinsic informational content.

10.1111/1468-0262.00393.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，在该模型中，尽管存在理性的套利者，资产泡沫仍可能持续存在。泡沫的持久性源于套利者无法暂时协调他们的卖出策略。这种同步性问题，加上个体对市场时机的追求，使得泡沫能够在相当长的时间内持续存在。由于推导出的交易均衡是唯一的，我们的模型从某种意义上解释了泡沫的存在。该模型还提供了一个自然的环境，在这个环境中，新闻事件通过促进同步化，能够产生与其内在信息内容相比更为显著的影响。

abstract.text: We propose a functional estimation procedure for homogeneous stochastic differential equations based on a discrete sample of observations and with minimal requirements on the data generating process. We show how to identify the drift and diffusion function in situations where one or the other function is considered a nuisance parameter. The asymptotic behavior of the estimators is examined as the observation frequency increases and as the time span lengthens. We prove almost sure consistency and weak convergence to mixtures of normal laws, where the mixing variates depend on the chronological local time of the underlying diffusion process, that is the random time spent by the process in the vicinity of a generic spatial point. The estimation method and asymptotic results apply to both stationary and nonstationary recurrent processes.

10.1111/1468-0262.00395.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于离散观测样本的同质随机微分方程的功能性估计方法，该方法对数据生成过程的要求极低。我们展示了如何在某个函数被视为麻烦参数的情况下，识别漂移函数和扩散函数。随着观测频率的增加和时间跨度的延长，估计量的渐近行为得到了研究。我们证明了估计量几乎必然满足一致性，并且弱收敛于正态分布的混合分布，其中混合变量取决于潜在扩散过程在某一特定空间点附近的随机时间。该估计方法和渐近结果适用于平稳和非平稳的复发过程。

abstract.text: ARCH and GARCH models directly address the dependency of conditional second moments, and have proved particularly valuable in modelling processes where a relatively large degree of fluctuation is present. These include financial time series, which can be particularly heavy tailed. However, little is known about properties of ARCH or GARCH models in the heavy–tailed setting, and no methods are available for approximating the distributions of parameter estimators there. In this paper we show that, for heavy–tailed errors, the asymptotic distributions of quasi–maximum likelihood parameter estimators in ARCH and GARCH models are nonnormal, and are particularly difficult to estimate directly using standard parametric methods. Standard bootstrap methods also fail to produce consistent estimators. To overcome these problems we develop percentile–t, subsample bootstrap approximations to estimator distributions. Studentizing is employed to approximate scale, and the subsample bootstrap is used to estimate shape. The good performance of this approach is demonstrated both theoretically and numerically.

10.1111/1468-0262.00396.abstractZh: ARCH和GARCH模型直接针对条件二阶矩的依赖性，在模拟具有较大波动性的过程时表现出显著的价值。这些过程包括金融时间序列，其波动特性往往较为严重。然而，对于ARCH或GARCH模型在严重波动环境下的特性，目前了解甚少，也没有方法可以用来近似参数估计量的分布。本文证明了，在严重波动的误差情况下，ARCH和GARCH模型中准最大似然参数估计量的渐近分布是非正态的，直接使用标准参数方法进行估计非常困难。标准自助法也无法产生一致估计量。为了克服这些问题，我们开发了基于百分位t分布和子样本自助法的估计量近似方法。通过学生化处理来近似尺度，而子样本自助法则用于估计形状。这种方法在理论和数值上均表现出良好的性能。

abstract.text: The paper proposes a new and normative approach for adjusting households' incomes in order to account for the heterogeneity of needs across income recipients when measuring inequality and welfare. We derive the implications for the structure of.-the adjustment method of two conditions concerned with the way the ranking of situations is modified by a change in the reference household type,and by more equally distributed living standards across households. Our results suggest that concern for greater equality in living standards, conflicts With the basic welfarist principle of symmetrical treatment of individuals that is at the core of the standard equivalence scale approach.

10.1111/1468-0262.00397.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的规范性方法，用于调整家庭收入，以在衡量不平等和福利时考虑到不同收入接收者需求的差异性。我们推导了两种条件对调整方法结构的影响——这些条件涉及参考家庭类型的变化以及家庭间生活水平更加均衡所带来的情况排序的修改。我们的研究结果表明，追求更高的生活水平平等性与标准等价尺度方法的核心原则——即个体之间的对称处理原则——存在冲突。

abstract.text: Recent theoretical advances have brought income and wealth distributions back into a prominent position in growth and development theories, and as determinants of specific socio-economic outcomes, such as health or levels of violence. Empirical investigation of the importance of these relationships, however, has been held back by the lack of sufficiently detailed high quality data on distributions. Household surveys that include reasonable measures of income or consumption can be used to calculate distributional measures but at low levels of aggregation these samples are rarely representative or of sufficient size to yield statistically reliable estimates. At the same time, census (or other large sample) data of sufficient size to allow disaggregation either have no information about income or consumption, or measure these variables poorly. This note outlines a statistical procedure to combine these types of data to take advantage of the detail in household sample surveys and the co...

10.1111/1468-0262.00399.abstractZh: 近期的理论进展使收入和财富分配重新成为增长与发展理论中的重要议题，同时也是决定特定社会经济结果（如健康或暴力程度）的关键因素。然而，由于缺乏足够详细且高质量的数据来研究这些关系的实际重要性，相关实证研究一直受到阻碍。包含合理收入或消费指标的住户调查可用于计算分配指标，但在低层次汇总时，这些样本往往缺乏代表性，且规模不足以得出统计上可靠的估计结果。同时，规模足够大的普查（或其他大规模样本）数据，要么无法提供有关收入或消费的信息，要么对这些变量的测量不够准确。本文概述了一种统计方法，可以结合这两种类型的数据，从而充分利用住户调查中的详细信息以及普查数据中的相关信息。

abstract.text: IN A SIMPLE DEBT CONTRACT the investor seizes all of a firm's assets when the project return is below some threshold and receives a constant payment when the return is higher. Krasa and Villamil (2000) show that simple debt contracts that are optimal (ie., give the investor the highest payoff) among the class of deterministic contracts in the costly state verification model, and that satisfy technical conditions (Al), (A2), and a reservation utility constraint, are optimal in a more general costly enforcement model even when stochastic monitoring is possible.2 The italicized segment of this statement was not made explicit in Theorem 1 in Krasa and Villamil (2000). As Sharma points out, this restriction is necessary for the result to hold. Sharma also points out that assumption (A2) had a typographical error. Assumption (A2) in Krasa and Villamil (2000) should have appeared

10.1111/1468-0262.00404.abstractZh: 在简单的债务合同中，当项目收益低于某个阈值时，投资者可以占有公司的全部资产；而当收益较高时，投资者则获得固定的报酬。Krasa和Villamil（2000）指出，在成本较高的状态验证模型中，这类简单的债务合同属于最优合同（即能给投资者带来最高的收益），并且只要满足技术条件（Al）、（A2）以及保留效用约束，即使在可能进行随机监控的更一般的成本较高的执行模型中，这些合同仍然是最优的。不过，Krasa和Villamil在2000年的论文中并未明确说明这一斜体部分的内容。正如Sharma所指出的，这一限制是结论成立所必需的。Sharma还指出，假设（A2）存在印刷错误。在Krasa和Villamil的2000年论文中，假设（A2）应该被正确地呈现出来。

abstract.text: We study the results of elections of Fellows of the Econometric Society. We aremotivated largely by the question of whether these elections are “fair,” where our deﬁni-tion of fairness is that votes are based solely on the quality of the candidates. If so, thenconditional on quality other characteristics of the candidates (such as geographic locationor subspecialty) should not inﬂuence the probability of election. We ﬁnd that, conditionalon a number of measures of the quality of the candidates, other characteristics do sig-niﬁcantly predict election. For example, an Australian econometrician is less likely to beelected than a North America-based economic theorist. This is true whether or not wecontrol for quality measures.One might object that even fully informed individuals may differ in their assessment ofquality, and that neither the voters nor the authors of this study are fully informed aboutcandidates’ quality. This is true in any study of the impact of ascriptive characteristics onoutcomes. We discuss various interpretations of our ﬁndings in the conclusion, but readersmust draw their own conclusions about what the results imply about the roles of qualityand fairness in this electoral process.1 the electoral institutionMost members of the economics profession consider election as a Fellow as an honor.It recognizes prior professional achievements (within what are the more technical areasof economics). There are roughly 500 living Fellows. Names are placed on the ballot inone of two ways: (i) by the Nominating Committee of the Society, or (ii) by petition ofat least three members (who need not be but usually are current Fellows). The ballotcontains the candidate’s name and current afﬁliation; a list of at most six publications; ashort statement of the candidate’s contribution to economics; and an indication of whetherthe nomination was by Committee or by endorsers and, if the latter (from 1990 through2000), the names of all the endorsers. The ballot deadline is April 30.The electorate, dues-paying current Fellows, receive the ballot in early autumn alongwith the nomination form for each candidate, mark their ballots, and return them tothe Society’s ofﬁce. Results are announced in December. Names on the ballot are inalphabetical order, with a different starting point in each annual election. Voters checkthe names of individuals whom they wish to be elected. A candidate is elected who isapproved on at least 30 percent of the ballots returned. (Typically about half the eligibleFellows cast votes.) Losing candidates can be nominated in later years by either of thetwo methods, but the process must be undertaken de novo.

10.1111/1468-0262.00406.abstractZh: 我们研究了计量经济学会会士选举的结果。我们的研究主要受到这样一个问题的驱动：这些选举是否“公平”，我们的公平定义是投票仅基于候选人的质量。如果确实如此，那么在其他候选人特征（如地理位置或子专业领域）不影响选举概率的条件下，候选人的质量应该是一个重要的因素。我们发现，在考虑了候选人质量的多个指标后，其他特征确实显著影响选举结果。例如，一位澳大利亚计量经济学家当选的可能性低于一位来自北美的经济理论家。无论我们是否控制了质量指标，这一结论都是成立的。有人可能会反对，认为即使是完全了解情况的个人，在评估质量时也可能存在差异，而无论是选民还是本研究作者，对候选人的质量都并非完全了解。在任何研究属性特征对结果影响的研究中，这种情况都是存在的。我们在结论中讨论了各种对我们发现结果的解释，但读者必须自行判断这些结果对于质量和公平在这一选举过程中所起的作用意味着什么。1 选举制度大多数经济学专业人士将当选会士视为一种荣誉。这一荣誉认可了候选人在经济学技术领域的先前成就。目前大约有500位在世会士。候选人的名字通过两种方式被列入投票名单：(i) 由学会提名委员会提名，或(ii) 由至少三名成员（这些成员不必是但通常是现任会士）的请愿提名。选票上包含候选人的姓名及其所属组织；最多六篇出版物的列表；候选人对经济学的贡献的简短说明；以及表明提名是由委员会还是由支持者进行的指示。如果是由支持者提名（从1990年到2000年），则还需列出所有支持者的姓名。选票提交截止日期为4月30日。缴纳会费的现任会员在初秋时分会收到选票以及每位候选人的提名表格，他们标记选票后将其交回学会办公室。结果将于12月公布。选票上的名字按字母顺序排列，每年选举的起始点不同。选民可以勾选他们希望当选的人的名字。获得至少30%选票支持的候选人将被当选。（通常约有半数符合条件的会员参与投票。）落选的候选人可以在以后的年份通过这两种方式之一再次被提名，但这一过程必须重新进行。

abstract.text: I consider transactions involving asymmetric prisoners’ dilemmas between pairs of players randomly selected from two large populations. Games are played repeatedly, but information about cheating is not adequate to sustain cooperation, and there is no official legal system of contract enforcement. I examine how profit–maximizing private intermediation can supply the information and enforcement. I obtain conditions under which private governance can improve upon no governance, and examine why it fails to achieve social optimality.

10.1111/1468-0262.00415.abstractZh: 我研究的是从两个大群体中随机选取的玩家之间进行的涉及不对称囚徒困境的交易。这些游戏会反复进行，但关于作弊的信息不足以维持合作，而且也没有正式的法律合同执行体系。我探讨了如何由追求利润的私人中介来提供信息和执行规则。我找到了在没有任何治理的情况下，私人治理能够改善状况的条件，并分析了为什么私人治理无法达到社会最优状态。

abstract.text: Is the stock market boom a result of the baby boom? This paper develops an overlapping generations model in which a baby boom is modeled as a high realization of a random birth rate, and the price of capital is determined endogenously by a convex cost of adjustment. A baby boom increases national saving and investment and thus causes an increase in the price of capital. The price of capital is mean–reverting so the initial increase in the price of capital is followed by a decrease. Social Security can potentially affect national saving and investment, though in the long run, it does not affect the price of capital.

10.1111/1468-0262.00417.abstractZh: 股市的繁荣是婴儿潮的结果吗？本文提出了一个重叠世代模型，将婴儿潮建模为随机出生率的高实现值，而资本价格则由凸调整成本内生决定。婴儿潮会增加国民的储蓄和投资，从而导致资本价格上升。资本价格具有均值回归特性，因此资本价格的初始上升之后会随之下降。社会保障可能会影响国民的储蓄和投资，但从长期来看，它并不会影响资本价格。

abstract.text: This paper provides a general framework for integration of high-frequency intraday data into the measurement, modeling, and forecasting of daily and lower frequency volatility and return distributions. Most procedures for modeling and forecasting financial asset return volatilities, correlations, and distributions rely on restrictive and complicated parametric multivariate ARCH or stochastic volatility models, which often perform poorly at intraday frequencies. Use of realized volatility constructed from high-frequency intraday returns, in contrast, permits the use of traditional time series procedures for modeling and forecasting. Building on the theory of continuous-time arbitrage-free price processes and the theory of quadratic variation, we formally develop the links between the conditional covariance matrix and the concept of realized volatility. Next, using continuously recorded observations for the Deutschemark / Dollar and Yen / Dollar spot exchange rates covering more than a decade, we find that forecasts from a simple long-memory Gaussian vector autoregression for the logarithmic daily realized volatilities perform admirably compared to popular daily ARCH and related models. Moreover, the vector autoregressive volatility forecast, coupled with a parametric lognormal-normal mixture distribution implied by the theoretically and empirically grounded assumption of normally distributed standardized returns, gives rise to well-calibrated density forecasts of future returns, and correspondingly accurate quantile estimates. Our results hold promise for practical modeling and forecasting of the large covariance matrices relevant in asset pricing, asset allocation and financial risk management applications.

10.1111/1468-0262.00418.abstractZh: 本文提供了一个将高频日内数据整合到日常及低频波动性和回报分布测量、建模与预测中的通用框架。大多数用于建模和预测金融资产回报波动性、相关性和分布的方法依赖于限制性强且复杂的参数化多变量ARCH或随机波动性模型，这些模型在日内频率下的表现往往不佳。相比之下，使用基于高频日内回报构建的实现波动性模型，允许使用传统的时间序列方法进行建模和预测。基于连续时间无套利价格过程理论和二次变差理论，我们正式建立了条件协方差矩阵与实现波动性概念之间的联系。接下来，利用涵盖十多年时间的德国马克/美元和日元/美元即期汇率的连续记录数据，我们发现，对于对数日实现波动性的简单长记忆高斯向量自回归模型，其预测效果优于流行的日常ARCH及相关模型。此外，向量自回归波动性预测，结合由理论和实证都支持的正态分布标准化回报假设所暗示的参数化对数正态-正态混合分布，能够产生高度校准的密度预测未来回报，并相应地获得精确的分位数估计。我们的研究结果对于实际建模和预测在资产定价、资产配置和金融风险管理应用中相关的巨大协方差矩阵具有潜在价值。

abstract.text: This paper characterizes empirically achievable limits for time series econometric modeling and forecasting. The approach involves the concept of minimal information loss in time series regression and the paper shows how to derive bounds that delimit the proximity of empirical measures to the true probability measure (the DGP) in models that are of econometric interest. The approach utilizes joint probability measures over the combined space of parameters and observables and the results apply for models with stationary, integrated, and cointegrated data. A theorem due to Rissanen is extended so that it applies directly to probabilities about the relative likelihood (rather than averages), a new way of proving results of the Rissanen type is demonstrated, and the Rissanen theory is extended to nonstationary time series with unit roots, near unit roots, and cointegration of unknown order. The corresponding bound for the minimal information loss in empirical work is shown not to be a constant, in general, but to be proportional to the logarithm of the determinant of the (possibility stochastic) Fisher–information matrix. In fact, the bound that determines proximity to the DGP is generally path dependent, and it depends specifically on the type as well as the number of regressors. For practical purposes, the proximity bound has the asymptotic form (K/2)log n, where K is a new dimensionality factor that depends on the nature of the data as well as the number of parameters in the model. When ‘good’ model selection principles are employed in modeling time series data, we are able to show that our proximity bound quantifies empirical limits even in situations where the models may be incorrectly specified. One of the main implications of the new result is that time trends are more costly than stochastic trends, which are more costly in turn than stationary regressors in achieving proximity to the true density. Thus, in a very real sense and quantifiable manner, the DGP is more elusive when there is nonstationarity in the data. The implications for prediction are explored and a second proximity theorem is given, which provides a bound that measures how close feasible predictors can come to the optimal predictor. Again, the bound has the asymptotic form (K/2)log n, showing that forecasting trends is fundamentally more difficult than forecasting stationary time series, even when the correct form of the model for the trends is known.

10.1111/1468-0262.00419.abstractZh: 本文通过实证方法，描述了时间序列计量经济建模与预测中可实现的极限。该方法涉及时间序列回归中最小信息损失的概念，并展示了如何推导出将实证度量与真实概率度量（DGP）之间的接近程度进行限定的界限。该方法利用了参数和观测值联合概率度量，其结果适用于具有平稳性、积分性和共整合性的数据模型。Rissanen提出的定理被扩展应用，直接适用于关于相对可能性（而非平均值）的概率计算；同时，展示了一种证明Rissanen类型结果的新方法；此外，Rissanen理论还被扩展应用于具有单位根、接近单位根以及未知阶数共整合的非平稳时间序列。文中指出，实证工作中最小信息损失的界限通常不是常数，而是与（可能性随机的）Fisher信息矩阵行列式的对数成正比。实际上，决定与DGP接近程度的界限通常是路径依赖的，并且具体取决于回归变量的类型和数量。从实际角度来看，接近程度的界限具有渐近形式(K/2)log n，其中K是一个新的维度因子，取决于数据的性质以及模型中参数的数量。当在建模时间序列数据时采用“良好”的模型选择原则时，我们能够证明，即使模型可能被错误指定，我们的接近程度界限也能量化实证极限。新结果的主要意义之一在于，时间趋势的估计成本高于随机趋势，而随机趋势的估计成本又高于平稳回归量，后者能够更接近真实密度。因此，从实际和可量化的角度来看，当数据存在非平稳性时，确定最优预测模型变得更加困难。本文还探讨了这一结论对预测的影响，并提出了第二个接近性定理，该定理提供了一个界限，用于衡量可行预测模型与最优预测模型之间的接近程度。该界限具有渐近形式(K/2)log n，表明即使已知趋势模型的准确形式，预测趋势也远比预测平稳时间序列更为困难。

abstract.text: In this paper, we propose a simple bias–reduced log–periodogram regression estimator, ^dr, of the long–memory parameter, d, that eliminates the first– and higher–order biases of the Geweke and Porter–Hudak (1983) (GPH) estimator. The bias–reduced estimator is the same as the GPH estimator except that one includes frequencies to the power 2k for k=1,…,r, for some positive integer r, as additional regressors in the pseudo–regression model that yields the GPH estimator. The reduction in bias is obtained using assumptions on the spectrum only in a neighborhood of the zero frequency. Following the work of Robinson (1995b) and Hurvich, Deo, and Brodsky (1998), we establish the asymptotic bias, variance, and mean–squared error (MSE) of ^dr, determine the asymptotic MSE optimal choice of the number of frequencies, m, to include in the regression, and establish the asymptotic normality of ^dr. These results show that the bias of ^dr goes to zero at a faster rate than that of the GPH estimator when the normalized spectrum at zero is sufficiently smooth, but that its variance only is increased by a multiplicative constant. We show that the bias–reduced estimator ^dr attains the optimal rate of convergence for a class of spectral densities that includes those that are smooth of order s≥1 at zero when r≥(s−2)/2 and m is chosen appropriately. For s>2, the GPH estimator does not attain this rate. The proof uses results of Giraitis, Robinson, and Samarov (1997). We specify a data–dependent plug–in method for selecting the number of frequencies m to minimize asymptotic MSE for a given value of r. Some Monte Carlo simulation results for stationary Gaussian ARFIMA (1, d, 1) and (2, d, 0) models show that the bias–reduced estimators perform well relative to the standard log–periodogram regression estimator.

10.1111/1468-0262.00420.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种简单的偏差降低对数周期图回归估计量^dr，用于估计长记忆参数d。该估计量消除了Geweke和Porter-Hudak（1983）估计量中的一阶及更高阶偏差。偏差降低估计量与GPH估计量相同，只是后者在伪回归模型中增加了频率为2k的频率作为额外回归变量，其中k=1,…,r，r为某个正整数。偏差的降低是通过对零频率附近的频谱进行假设来获得的。借鉴Robinson（1995b）和Hurvich、Deo、Brodsky（1998）的工作，我们确定了^dr的渐近偏差、方差和均方误差（MSE），确定了在回归中应包括的频率数量m的渐近MSE最优选择，并证明了^dr的渐近正态性。这些结果表明，当零频率处的归一化频谱足够平滑时，^dr的偏差下降速度比GPH估计量更快，但其方差仅增加了一个乘法常数。我们证明，当r≥(s−2)/2且m选择得当的情况下，偏差降低估计量^dr在包括零频率处平滑度至少为s≥1的一类谱密度上达到了最优的收敛速率。对于s>2的情况，GPH估计量无法达到这一速率。该证明利用了Giraitis、Robinson和Samarov（1997）的研究成果。我们提出了一种依赖于数据的插入方法，用于选择频率数量m以最小化给定r值下的渐近MSE。一些针对平稳高斯ARFIMA（1, d, 1）和（2, d, 0）模型的蒙特卡洛模拟结果表明，偏差降低估计量相对于标准对数周期图回归估计量表现良好。

abstract.text: This note proposes a necessary and sufficient condition on a utility function to guarantee that it generates a demand function satisfying the law of demand. This condition can be interpreted in terms of an agent's attitude towards lotteries in commodity space. As an application, we show that when an agent has an expected utility function, her demand for securities satisfies the law of demand if her coefficient of relative risk aversion does not vary by more than 4.

10.1111/1468-0262.00421.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于效用函数的必要且充分条件，以确保其生成的需求函数满足需求定律。这一条件可以从代理人的态度角度来理解，即他们对商品空间中彩票的态度。作为应用示例，我们展示了当代理人具有预期效用函数时，如果其相对风险厌恶系数变化不超过4，那么她对证券的需求将满足需求定律。

abstract.text: We develop a model of monetary exchange where, as in the random matching literature, agents trade bilaterally and not through centralized markets. Rather than assuming they match exogenously and at random, however, we determine who meets whom as part of the equilibrium. We show how to formalize this process of directed matching in dynamic models with double coincidence problems, and present several examples and applications that illustrate how the approach can be used in monetary theory. Some of our results are similar to those in the random matching literature; others differ significantly.

10.1111/1468-0262.00424.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个货币交换模型，其中，与随机匹配文献类似，参与者进行双边交易，而非通过集中市场进行交易。然而，我们并不假设这些匹配是外生且随机发生的，而是将谁与谁相遇作为均衡的一部分来加以确定。我们展示了如何在具有双重匹配问题的动态模型中形式化这种定向匹配过程，并提供了几个示例和应用，以说明这种方法如何应用于货币理论。我们的一些结果与随机匹配文献中的结果相似；而另一些则存在显著差异。

abstract.text: The paper studies bilateral contracting between one principal and N agents when each agent's utility depends on the principal's unobservable contracts with other agents. We show that allowing deviations to menu contracts from which the principal chooses bounds equilibrium outcomes in a wide class of bilateral contracting games without imposing ad hoc restrictions on the agents' beliefs. This bound yields, for example, competitive convergence as N →∞ in environments in which an appropriately-defined notion of competitive equilibrium exists. We also examine the additional restrictions arising in two common bilateral contracting games: the “offer game” in which the principal makes simultaneous offers to the agents, and the “bidding game” in which the agents make simultaneous offers to the principal.

10.1111/1468-0262.00425.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个主体与多个代理人之间的双边契约关系，其中每个代理人的效用取决于主体与其他代理人之间的不可观测契约。我们证明了允许菜单契约存在偏差，而主体从中选择均衡结果，可以在广泛的双边契约游戏中实现，同时不对代理人的信念施加特殊限制。例如，当N趋向于无穷大时，这种边界均衡可以带来竞争收敛性，前提是存在适当定义的竞争均衡概念。我们还研究了两种常见的双边契约游戏中出现的额外限制：一种是“报价游戏”，其中主体向代理人同时提出报价；另一种是“竞标游戏”，其中代理人向主体同时提出报价。

abstract.text: In sequential bargaining models without outside options, each player's bargaining power is ultimately determined by which player will make an offer and when. This paper analyzes a sequential bargaining model in which players may hold different beliefs about which player will make an offer and when. Excessive optimism about making offers in the future can cause delays in agreement. The main result states that, despite this, if players will remain sufficiently optimistic for a sufficiently long future, then in equilibrium they will agree immediately. This result is also extended to other canonical models of optimism.

10.1111/1468-0262.00426.abstractZh: 在缺乏外部选择的顺序谈判模型中，每个参与者的谈判能力最终取决于哪个参与者会提出报价以及何时提出。本文分析了一个顺序谈判模型，在该模型中，参与者可能对谁会提出报价以及何时提出报价持有不同的信念。对未来提出报价的过度乐观可能会导致协议延迟。主要结论是，尽管存在这种情况，但如果参与者在未来足够长的时间内保持足够的乐观态度，那么他们在均衡状态下会立即达成协议。这一结果也适用于其他典型的乐观模型。

abstract.text: A nonparametric, residual-based block bootstrap procedure is proposed in the context of testing for integrated (unit root) time series. The resampling procedure is based on weak assumptions on the dependence structure of the stationary process driving the random walk and successfully generates unit root integrated pseudo-series retaining the important characteristics of the data. It is more general than previous bootstrap approaches to the unit root problem in that it allows for a very wide class of weakly dependent processes and it is not based on any parametric assumption on the process generating the data. As a consequence the procedure can accurately capture the distribution of many unit root test statistics proposed in the literature. Large sample theory is developed and the asymptotic validity of the block bootstrap-based unit root testing is shown via a bootstrap functional limit theorem. Applications to some particular test statistics of the unit root hypothesis, i.e., least squares and Dickey-Fuller type statistics are given. The power properties of our procedure are investigated and compared to those of alternative bootstrap approaches to carry out the unit root test. Some simulations examine the finite sample performance of our procedure.

10.1111/1468-0262.00427.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种非参数、基于残差的块自助法，用于检验具有单位根的时间序列。该重采样方法基于对驱动随机游走的平稳过程的依赖结构的弱假设，能够成功生成保留数据重要特征的具有单位根的伪序列。与以往针对单位根问题的自助法相比，该方法具有更大的通用性，因为它可以处理多种弱依赖过程，并且不依赖于生成数据的过程的任何参数假设。因此，该方法能够准确捕捉文献中提出的许多单位根检验统计量的分布。文中还发展了大样本理论，并通过自助法功能极限定理证明了基于块自助法的单位根检验的渐近有效性。最后，本文对单位根假设的一些特定检验统计量，如最小二乘法和Dickey-Fuller型统计量进行了应用分析。同时，还研究了我们方法的功效特性，并将其与采用其他自助法进行单位根检验的方法进行了比较。部分模拟实验检验了我们方法在有限样本下的性能。

abstract.text: Many refinements of Nash equilibrium yield solution correspondences that do not have closed graph in the space of payoffs or information. This has significance for implementation theory, especially under complete information. If a planner is concerned that all equilibria of his mechanism yield a desired outcome, and entertains the possibility that players may have even the slightest uncertainty about payoffs, then the planner should insist on a solution concept with closed graph. We show that this requirement entails substantial restrictions on the set of implementable social choice rules. In particular, when preferences are strict (or more generally, hedonic), while almost any social choice function can be implemented in undominated Nash equilibrium, only monotonic social choice functions can be implemented in the closure of the undominated Nash correspondence.

10.1111/1468-0262.00428.abstractZh: 许多纳什均衡的改进所得到的解决方案在收益或信息空间中并不具有封闭图结构。这一点对于实施理论具有重要意义，尤其是在完全信息的情况下。如果一个规划者希望其机制的所有均衡都能产生期望的结果，并且考虑到玩家可能对收益存在哪怕是最微小的不确定性，那么规划者应该坚持使用具有封闭图的解决方案概念。我们表明，这一要求对可实施的社会选择规则集施加了实质性的限制。特别是，当偏好是严格的（或更一般地说，是享乐主义的）时，虽然几乎任何社会选择函数都可以在未被占用的纳什均衡中实现，但只有单调的社会选择函数才能在被占用的纳什对应关系的闭包中实现。

abstract.text: This paper provides deterministic approximation results for stochastic processes that arise when finite populations recurrently play finite games. The deterministic approximation is defined in continuous time as a system of ordinary differential equations of the type studied in evolutionary game theory. We establish precise connections between the long-run behavior of the stochastic process, for large populations, and its deterministic approximation. In particular, we show that if the deterministic solution through the initial state of the stochastic process at some point in time enters a basin of attraction, then the stochastic process will enter any given neighborhood of that attractor within a finite and deterministic time with a probability that exponentially approaches one as the population size goes to infinity. The process will remain in this neighborhood for a random time that almost surely exceeds an exponential function of the population size. During this time interval, the process spends almost all time at a certain subset of the attractor, its so-called Birkhoff center. We sharpen this result in the special case of ergodic processes.

10.1111/1468-0262.00429.abstractZh: 本文为有限人口反复参与有限博弈时出现的随机过程提供了确定性近似结果。在连续时间中，确定性近似被定义为一种常微分方程系统，这类方程在进化博弈论中有所研究。我们建立了随机过程在长期行为与其确定性近似之间的精确联系。特别地，我们证明了：如果随机过程在某个时间点通过初始状态进入一个吸引子，那么该随机过程将在有限且确定的时间内进入该吸引子的任何邻域，且随着人口规模的无限增大，其概率将呈指数级趋近于1。该过程将始终处于该邻域中，且停留时间几乎肯定大于人口规模的指数函数。在这段时间内，该过程几乎始终位于吸引子的某个子集上，即所谓的Birkhoff中心。我们在遍历过程的特殊情况下对这一结果进行了进一步细化。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the linear regression model y = xb+e with a conditional median assumption Med( e | z)=0 where z is a vector of instruments. Added complication arises due to the censoring of the outcome y. We treat the censored model as a model with interval-observed outcome thus obtaining interval restrictions on conditional median regressions. This allows us to use the framework introduced by Manski and Tamer (2000) to analyze the information contained in these inequality restrictions. We first show identification of the parameter b in the absence of censoring and introduce a consistent estimator based on the minimum distance method. We then give conditions for global identification of b in the model above with censored y and endogenous x. We provide a consistent estimator that is based on a modified minimum distance method.

10.1111/1468-0262.00430.abstractZh: 本文分析了线性回归模型 y = xb+e，并假设条件中位数 Med( e | z)=0，其中 z 是工具变量向量。由于结果 y 受到截尾处理，情况变得更加复杂。我们将截尾模型视为具有区间观测结果的模型，从而对条件中位数回归获得区间限制。这使我们能够利用 Manski 和 Tamer (2000) 提出的框架来分析这些不等式限制所包含的信息。我们首先展示了在不存在截尾处理的情况下参数 b 的识别方法，并提出了一种基于最小距离方法的一致估计量。然后，我们给出了在存在截尾 y 和内生 x 的模型中对 b 进行全局识别的条件。我们提供了一种基于改进的最小距离方法的一致估计量。

abstract.text: A popular way to account for unobserved heterogeneity is to assume that the data are drawn from a finite mixture distribution. A barrier to using finite mixture models is that parameters that could previously be estimated in stages must now be estimated jointly: using mixture distributions destroys any additive separability of the log-likelihood function. We show, however, that an extension of the EM algorithm reintroduces additive separability, thus allowing one to estimate parameters sequentially during each maximization step. In establishing this result, we develop a broad class of estimators for mixture models. Returning to the likelihood problem, we show that, relative to full information maximum likelihood, our sequential estimator can generate large computational savings with little loss of efficiency.

10.1111/1468-0262.00431.abstractZh: 解释未观测到的异质性时，一种常见的方法是假设数据来自一个有限的混合分布。使用有限混合模型的障碍在于，那些可以分阶段估计的参数现在必须联合估计：使用混合分布会破坏对数似然函数的可加性。然而，我们证明，通过扩展EM算法可以重新引入可加性，从而在每个最大化步骤中依次估计参数。在证明这一结果时，我们开发了一类适用于混合模型的估计器。回到似然问题，我们表明，与全信息最大似然法相比，我们的序贯估计方法可以在保持效率不降低的情况下大幅节省计算资源。

abstract.text: We introduce a game of complete information with multiple principals and multiple common agents. Each agent makes a decision that can affect the payoffs of all principals. Each principal offers monetary transfers to each agent conditional on the action taken by the agent. We characterize pure-strategy equilibria and we provide conditions—in terms of game balancedness—for the existence of an equilibrium with an efficient outcome. Games played through agents display a type of strategic inefficiency that is absent when either there is a unique principal or there is a unique agent.

10.1111/1468-0262.00437.abstractZh: 我们引入了一个具有多个主体和多个共同代理人的完全信息博弈。每个代理人做出的决策会影响所有主体的收益。每个主体根据代理人的行动提供货币转移。我们描述了纯策略均衡，并提供了关于存在具有有效结果的均衡的条件——从博弈平衡的角度来看。通过代理人进行的博弈表现出一种战略上的低效率，这种低效率在存在唯一主体或唯一代理人时是不存在的。

abstract.text: This paper develops a general method for constructing exactly similar tests based on the conditional distribution of nonpivotal statistics in a simultaneous equations model with normal errors and known reduced-form covariance matrix. These tests are shown to be similar under weak-instrument asymptotics when the reduced-form covariance matrix is estimated and the errors are non-normal. The conditional test based on the likelihood ratio statistic is particularly simple and has good power properties. Like the score test, it is optimal under the usual local-to-null asymptotics, but it has better power when identification is weak.

10.1111/1468-0262.00438.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种通用方法，用于构建基于非枢轴统计量条件分布的正态检验，这些检验适用于具有正态误差且已知简化形式协方差矩阵的同时方程模型。当简化形式协方差矩阵被估计且误差非正态分布时，这些检验在弱仪器渐近条件下被证明是相似的。基于似然比统计量的条件检验尤为简单，并且具有良好的功效特性。与得分检验类似，它在通常的局部到零渐近条件下是最优的，但在识别较弱的情况下，其功效更高。

abstract.text: The block bootstrap is the best known bootstrap method for time-series data when the analyst does not have a parametric model that reduces the data generation process to simple random sampling. However, the errors made by the block bootstrap converge to zero only slightly faster than those made by first-order asymptotic approximations. This paper describes a bootstrap procedure for data that are generated by a Markov process or a process that can be approximated by a Markov process with sufficient accuracy. The procedure is based on estimating the Markov transition density nonparametrically. Bootstrap samples are obtained by sampling the process implied by the estimated transition density. Conditions are given under which the errors made by the Markov bootstrap converge to zero more rapidly than those made by the block bootstrap.

10.1111/1468-0262.00439.abstractZh: 块自助法是在分析师没有能够将数据生成过程简化为简单随机抽样的参数模型时，用于时间序列数据的最著名的自助法。然而，块自助法产生的误差收敛到零的速度仅比一阶渐近近似产生的误差快一点点。本文描述了一种适用于由马尔可夫过程生成的数据或能够以足够精度近似为马尔可夫过程的数据的自助法。该过程基于非参数估计马尔可夫转移密度的方法。通过抽取由估计的转移密度所暗示的过程的样本来获得自助样本。文中给出了一些条件，在这些条件下，马尔可夫自助法产生的误差收敛到零的速度比块自助法快。

abstract.text: In this paper we focus on strategic voting behavior when both an election and a signaling motivation affect voters' behavior. We analyze a model of elections with two candidates competing on a one-dimensional policy space. Voters are privately and imperfectly informed about a common shock affecting the electorate's preferences. Candidates are assumed to choose policy in response to information gleaned from election results and according to exogenous factors that may lead to polarization in candidates' policy choices. We analyze a subset of symmetric equilibria in which strategies are symmetric to candidates' names and private signals (CSS equilibria). We show that signaling and election motivations pull voters to vote in different directions. We provide conditions that show the relation between the amount of information aggregated in the election and the motivation that influences voting behavior the most. Finally, we show that when candidates are responsive and polarized, all CSS equilibria are inefficient in the limit.

10.1111/1468-0262.00440.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于在选举和信号传递动机共同影响选民行为时的战略投票行为。我们分析了一个包含两个候选人竞争一维政策空间的选举模型。选民对影响选民偏好的共同冲击信息了解有限且不完全。假设候选人根据选举结果获得的信息以及可能导致候选人政策选择两极分化的外部因素来制定政策。我们分析了对称均衡的一个子集，其中策略与候选人的名字和私人信号对称（CSS均衡）。我们表明，信号传递和选举动机会促使选民朝不同的方向投票。我们提出了条件，以说明选举中汇总的信息量与影响投票行为的最强动机之间的关系。最后，我们表明，当候选人对选民的反应敏感且政策选择存在两极分化时，所有CSS均衡在极限情况下都是低效的。

abstract.text: In this paper we derive the asymptotic properties of within groups (WG), GMM, and LIML estimators for an autoregressive model with random effects when both T and N tend to infinity. GMM and LIML are consistent and asymptotically equivalent to the WG estimator. When T/N→ 0 the fixed T results for GMM and LIML remain valid, but WG, although consistent, has an asymptotic bias in its asymptotic distribution. When T/N tends to a positive constant, the WG, GMM, and LIML estimators exhibit negative asymptotic biases of order 1/T, 1/N, and 1/(2N−T), respectively. In addition, the crude GMM estimator that neglects the autocorrelation in first differenced errors is inconsistent as T/N→c>0, despite being consistent for fixed T. Finally, we discuss the properties of a random effects pseudo MLE with unrestricted initial conditions when both T and N tend to infinity.

10.1111/1468-0262.00441.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们推导了在T和N都趋于无穷大时，具有随机效应的自回归模型的组内估计（WG）、广义最小二乘法估计以及LIML估计的渐近性质。广义最小二乘法估计和LIML估计与WG估计一致，并且在渐近意义上等价。当T/N→0时，广义最小二乘法估计和LIML估计的固定T结果仍然有效，但WG估计虽然一致，其渐近分布存在渐近偏差。当T/N趋于一个正常数时，WG估计、广义最小二乘法估计和LIML估计分别表现出1/T、1/N和1/(2N−T)阶的负渐近偏差。此外，当T/N→c>0时，忽略首次差分误差自相关的粗糙广义最小二乘法估计是不一致的，尽管它在固定T时是一致的。最后，我们讨论了在T和N都趋于无穷大时，具有不受限制初始条件的随机效应伪最大似然估计的性质。

abstract.text: We are interested in estimating the average effect of a binary treatment on a scalar outcome. If assignment to the treatment is exogenous or unconfounded, that is, independent of the potential outcomes given covariates, biases associated with simple treatment-control average comparisons can be removed by adjusting for differences in the covariates. Rosenbaum and Rubin (1983) show that adjusting solely for differences between treated and control units in the propensity score removes all biases associated with differences in covariates. Although adjusting for differences in the propensity score removes all the bias, this can come at the expense of efficiency, as shown by Hahn (1998), Heckman, Ichimura, and Todd (1998), and Robins, Mark, and Newey (1992). We show that weighting by the inverse of a nonparametric estimate of the propensity score, rather than the true propensity score, leads to an efficient estimate of the average treatment effect. We provide intuition for this result by showing that this estimator can be interpreted as an empirical likelihood estimator that efficiently incorporates the information about the propensity score.

10.1111/1468-0262.00442.abstractZh: 我们感兴趣的是估计二元处理对标量结果的平均效应。如果分配到处理组是外生的或无混杂的，即独立于给定协变量的潜在结果，那么通过调整协变量的差异，就可以消除与简单处理-对照平均比较相关的偏差。Rosenbaum和Rubin（1983）指出，仅通过调整处理组和对照组在倾向得分上的差异，就可以消除与协变量差异相关的所有偏差。尽管调整倾向得分的差异可以消除所有偏差，但这可能会牺牲效率，正如Hahn（1998）、Heckman、Ichimura和Todd（1998）以及Robins、Mark和Newey（1992）所展示的那样。我们指出，通过使用权重等于非参数估计的倾向得分的倒数，而不是真实的倾向得分，可以得到平均处理效应的有效估计。我们通过展示这种估计量可以被解释为一种经验似然估计量，从而有效地整合了关于倾向得分的信息，为这一结果提供了直观的解释。

abstract.text: An isotone pure strategy equilibrium exists in any game of incomplete information in which (1) each player i's action set is a finite sublattice of multi-dimensional Euclidean space, (2) types are multidimensional and atomless, and each player's interim expected payoff function satisfies two "non-primitive conditions" whenever others adopt isotone pure strategies: (3) single-crossing in own action and type and (4) quasisupermodularity in own action. Similarly, given that (134) and (2') types are multi-dimensional (with atoms) an isotone mixed strategy equilibrium exists. Conditions (34) are satisfied in supermodular and log-supermodular games given affiliated types, and in games with independent types in which each player's ex post payoff satisfies (a) supermodularity in own action and (b) non-decreasing differences in own action and type. These results also extend to games with a continuum action space when each player's ex post payoff is also continuous in his and others' actions.

10.1111/1468-0262.00443.abstractZh: 在任何不完全信息博弈中，只要满足以下条件，就存在等时纯策略均衡：(1) 每个玩家的行动集是多维欧几里得空间的有限子格；(2) 类型具有多维且无原子，且当其他玩家采用等时纯策略时，每个玩家的临时期望收益函数满足两个“非原始条件”：(3) 在自身行动和类型上进行单次交叉；(4) 在自身行动上具备准超模性。同样，鉴于条件(134)和(2')，类型具有多维性（包含原子），则存在等时混合策略均衡。在具有关联类型的超模和对数超模博弈中，以及那些类型独立但每个玩家的事后收益满足以下条件时，条件(34)也得到满足：(a) 在自身行动上具有超模性；(b) 自身行动和类型的差异是非递减的。这些结果也适用于行动空间为连续型博弈的情况，此时每个玩家的事后收益在其自身和其他玩家的行动上也是连续的。

abstract.text: This paper develops new econometric methods to infer hospital quality in a model with discrete dependent variables and nonrandom selection.
