Mortality rates in patient discharge records are widely used to infer hospital quality. However, hospital admission is not random and some hospitals may attract patients with greater unobserved severity of illness than others. In this situation the assumption of random admission leads to spurious inference about hospital quality. This study controls for hospital selection using a model in which distance between the patient's residence and alternative hospitals are key exogenous variables. Bayesian inference in this model is feasible using a Markov chain Monte Carlo posterior simulator, and attaches posterior probabilities to quality comparisons between individual hospitals and groups of hospitals. The study uses data on 74,848 Medicare patients admitted to 114 hospitals in Los Angeles County from 1989 through 1992 with a diagnosis of pneumonia. It finds the smallest and largest hospitals to be of the highest quality. There is strong evidence of dependence between the unobserved severity of illness and the assignment of patients to hospitals, whereby patients with a high unobserved severity of illness are disproportionately admitted to high quality hospitals. Consequently a conventional probit model leads to inferences about quality that are markedly different from those in this study's selection model.

10.1111/1468-0262.00444.abstractZh: 本文提出了新的计量经济方法，用于推断具有离散因变量和非随机选择的医院质量。患者出院记录中的死亡率被广泛用于推断医院质量。然而，医院收治并非随机，某些医院可能会吸引那些病情更为严重的患者。在这种情况下，假设医院收治是随机的会导致对医院质量的错误推断。本研究通过使用一个模型来控制医院选择，该模型中患者居住地与不同医院之间的距离是关键的外生变量。利用马尔科夫链蒙特卡洛后验模拟器，可以在该模型中实现贝叶斯推断，并为单个医院与医院群体之间的质量比较赋予后验概率。本研究使用了1989年至1992年间在洛杉矶县114家医院收治的74,848名医疗保险患者的数据，这些患者均被诊断为肺炎。研究发现，规模最小和最大的医院质量最高。有强有力的证据表明，未观察到的病情严重程度与患者被分配到哪些医院之间存在依赖性，即病情严重的患者更倾向于被分配到质量较高的医院。因此，传统的Probit模型得出的质量推断结果与本研究中的选择模型得出的结果明显不同。

abstract.text: I characterize the implications of the common prior assumption for finite orders of beliefs about beliefs at a state and show that in finite models, the only such implications are those stemming from the weaker assumption of a common support. More precisely, given any finite N and any finite partitions model where priors have the same support, there is another finite partitions model with common priors that has the same nth order beliefs and knowledge for all n≤N.

10.1111/1468-0262.00446.abstractZh: 我阐述了常见先验假设对有限阶信念的影响，并表明在有限模型中，这些影响仅源于较弱的“共同支持”假设。更具体地说，给定任意有限阶N和任意具有相同支持的先验的有限划分模型，存在另一个具有共同先验的有限划分模型，该模型在所有n≤N的情况下具有相同的第n阶信念和知识。

abstract.text: The paper analyzes the impact of the initial observation on the problem of testing for unit roots. To this end, we derive a family of optimal tests that maximize a weighted average power criterion with respect to the initial observation. We then investigate the relationship of this optimal family to unit root tests in an asymptotic framework. We find that many popular unit root tests are closely related to specific members of the optimal family, but the corresponding members employ very different weightings for the initial observation. The popular Dickey-Fuller tests, for instance, are closely related to optimal tests which put a large weight on extreme deviations of the initial observation from the deterministic component, whereas other popular tests put more weight on moderate deviations. At the same time, the power of the various unit root tests varies dramatically with the initial observation. This paper therefore helps to explain the results of comparative power studies of unit root tests, and allows a much deeper understanding of the merits of particular tests in specific circumstances.

10.1111/1468-0262.00447.abstractZh: 本文分析了初始观测对单位根检验问题的影响。为此，我们推导了一族最优检验方法，这些方法在考虑初始观测因素的情况下，最大化加权平均功效准则。随后，我们在渐近框架下研究了这一最优检验族与单位根检验之间的关系。我们发现，许多流行的单位根检验与最优检验族中的特定成员密切相关，但这些成员对初始观测的权重却大相径庭。例如，流行的Dickey-Fuller检验与那些对初始观测与确定性成分偏差较大的最优检验密切相关，而其他流行的检验则更重视中等程度的偏差。同时，各种单位根检验的功效随着初始观测的变化而呈现出显著的差异。因此，本文有助于解释单位根检验功效比较研究的结果，并有助于更深入地理解特定情况下特定检验的优势。

abstract.text: We consider the problem of constructing a portfolio of finitely many assets whose returns are described by a discrete joint distribution.We propose mean-risk models that are solvable by linear programming and generate portfolios whose returns are nondominated in the sense of second-order stochastic dominance. Next, we develop a specialized parametric method for recovering the entire mean-risk efficient frontiers of these models and we illustrate its operation on a large data set involving thousands of assets and realizations.

10.1111/1468-0262.00448.abstractZh: 我们考虑构建一组有限数量资产的投资组合问题，这些资产的回报由离散的联合分布描述。我们提出了可以通过线性规划求解的均值-风险模型，并且这些模型生成的投资组合在二阶随机优势意义上是非支配的。接下来，我们开发了一种专门的参数化方法，用于恢复这些模型的全部均值-风险有效前沿，并展示了该方法在包含数千种资产和具体实现的大型数据集上的应用效果。

abstract.text: In certain auction, search, and related models, the boundary of the support of the observed data depends on some of the parameters of interest. For such nonregular models, standard asymptotic distribution theory does not apply. Previous work has focused on characterizing the nonstandard limiting distributions of particular estimators in these models. In contrast, we study the problem of constructing efficient point estimators. We show that the maximum likelihood estimator is generally inefficient, but that the Bayes estimator is efficient according to the local asymptotic minmax criterion for conventional loss functions. We provide intuition for this result using Le Cam's limits of experiments framework.

10.1111/1468-0262.00451.abstractZh: 在某些拍卖、搜索及相关模型中，观测数据的支持域取决于某些感兴趣的参数。对于这类非规则模型，标准的渐近分布理论并不适用。以往的研究主要集中在描述这些模型中特定估计量的非标准极限分布。相比之下，我们研究构建高效点估计量的问题。我们表明，最大似然估计量通常效率不高，但根据局部渐近最小最大准则，贝叶斯估计量是高效的，该准则适用于传统的损失函数。我们使用Le Cam的实验极限框架为这一结果提供了直观的解释。

abstract.text: We present estimators for nonparametric functions that are nonadditive in unobservable random terms. The distributions of the unobservable random terms are assumed to be unknown. We show that when a nonadditive, nonparametric function is strictly monotone in an unobservable random term, and it satisfies some other properties that may be implied by economic theory, such as homogeneity of degree one or separability, the function and the distribution of the unobservable random term are identified. We also present convenient normalizations, to use when the properties of the function, other than strict monotonicity in the unobservable random term, are unknown. The estimators for the nonparametric function and for the distribution of the unobservable random term are shown to be consistent and asymptotically normal. We extend the results to functions that depend on a multivariate random term. The results of a limited simulation study are presented.

10.1111/1468-0262.00452.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种针对非参数函数的估计方法，这类函数在不可观测的随机变量上不具有加性性质。假设这些不可观测的随机变量的分布是未知的。我们证明了，当一个非参数函数在一个不可观测的随机变量上严格单调，并且满足一些由经济理论所暗示的其他性质（如一次齐次性或可分性）时，该函数与不可观测随机变量的分布是可以确定的。我们还提出了一些方便的规范化方法，以便在函数的其他性质未知的情况下使用。对于非参数函数以及不可观测随机变量的分布的估计方法，我们证明了其一致性且渐近正态性。我们将这些结果扩展到依赖于多元随机变量的函数上。最后，我们展示了一个有限的模拟研究的结果。

abstract.text: In this study we consider a labor market matching model where firms post wage-tenure contracts and workers, both employed and unemployed, search for new job opportunities. Given workers are risk averse, we establish there is a unique equilibrium in the environment considered. Although firms in the market make different offers in equilibrium, all post a wage-tenure contract that implies a worker's wage increases smoothly with tenure at the firm. As firms make different offers, there is job turnover, as employed workers move jobs as the opportunity arises. This implies the increase in a worker's wage can be due to job-to-job movements as well as wage-tenure effects. Further, there is a nondegenerate equilibrium distribution of initial wage offers that is differentiable on its support except for a mass point at the lowest initial wage. We also show that relevant characteristics of the equilibrium can be written as explicit functions of preferences and the other market parameters.

10.1111/1468-0262.00453.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了一个劳动力市场匹配模型，其中企业发布工资与任期合同，而工人无论就业还是失业，都会寻找新的工作机会。鉴于工人具有风险厌恶特性，我们证明了所考虑的环境中存在一个唯一均衡。尽管企业在均衡状态下会提出不同的报价，但所有企业都会发布一种工资与任期合同，这意味着工人的工资会随着在企业的任期而平稳增长。由于企业提出不同的报价，因此会出现工作流动现象，即就业工人会在机会出现时更换工作。这意味着工人工资的增加可能是由于工作之间的流动以及工资与任期的效应共同作用的结果。此外，存在一个非退化的初始工资报价均衡分布，该分布在其支撑集上是可微分的，除了最低初始工资处有一个质量点。我们还表明，均衡的相关特征可以表示为偏好和其他市场参数的显式函数。

abstract.text: Weak nonparametric restrictions are developed, sufficient to identify the values of derivatives of structural functions in which latent random variables are nonseparable. These derivatives can exhibit stochastic variation. In a microeconometric context this allows the impact of a policy intervention, as measured by the value of a structural derivative, to vary across people who are identical as measured by covariates. When the restrictions are satisfied quantiles of the distribution of a policy impact across people can be identified. The identification restrictions are local in the sense that they are specific to the values of the covariates and the specific quantiles of latent variables at which identification is sought. The conditions do not include the commonly required independence of latent variables and covariates. They include local versions of the classical rank and order conditions and local quantile insensitivity conditions. Values of structural derivatives are identified by functionals of quantile regression functions and can be estimated using the same functionals applied to estimated quantile regression functions.

10.1111/1468-0262.00454.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种弱非参数约束方法，该方法足以识别结构函数导数的取值，其中潜在随机变量是不可分离的。这些导数可能表现出随机变化。在微观计量经济学背景下，这种方法允许政策干预的影响可以通过结构导数的取值来衡量，而该影响在不同个体之间会有所不同，这种差异可以通过协变量来衡量。当这些约束得到满足时，可以识别出政策影响在不同个体之间的分布分位数。这些识别约束是局部的，因为它们仅针对协变量的取值以及寻求识别的特定潜在变量分位数而言。这些条件并不包括通常要求的潜在变量和协变量的独立性。它们包含了经典秩和条件以及局部分位数不敏感条件的局部版本。结构导数的取值可以通过分位数回归函数的泛函来识别，并且可以通过对估计的分位数回归函数应用相同的泛函来估计。

abstract.text: This paper proposes an estimation method for a repeated auction game under the presence of capacity contraints. The estimation strategy is computationally simple as it does not require solving for the equilibrium of the game. It uses a two stage approach. In the first stage the distribution of bids conditional on state variables is estimated using data on bids, bidder characteristics and contract characteristics. In the second stage, an expression of the expected sum of future profits based on the distribution of bids is obtained, and costs are inferred based on the first order condition of optimal bids. We apply the estimation method to repeated highway construction procurement auctions in the state of California between May 1996 and May 1999. In this market, previously won uncompleted contracts reduce the probability of winning further contracts. We quantify the effect of intertemporal constraints on bidders' costs and on bids. Due to the intertemporal effect and also to bidder asymmetry, the auction can be inefficient. Based on the estimates of costs, we quantify efficiency losses.

10.1111/1468-0262.00455.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种在容量限制存在的情况下对重复拍卖游戏进行估计的方法。该估计方法在计算上较为简单，因为无需求解游戏的均衡状态。该方法采用两阶段策略：第一阶段，利用关于出价、投标者特征和合同特征的数据来估计在状态变量条件下的出价分布；第二阶段，根据出价分布得到未来利润期望值的表达式，并根据最优出价的一阶条件推断出成本。我们将该方法应用于1996年5月至1999年5月期间加利福尼亚州进行的重复公路建设采购拍卖。在该市场中，之前已中标但未完成的合同会降低中标概率。我们量化了时间约束对投标者成本和出价的影响。由于时间约束以及投标者之间的信息不对称，拍卖可能会效率低下。基于成本估计结果，我们量化了效率损失。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the specification and identification of causal multivariate duration models. We focus on the case in which one duration concerns the point in time a treatment is initiated and we are interested in the effect of this treatment on some outcome duration. We define “no anticipation of treatment” and relate it to a common assumption in biostatistics. We show that (i) no anticipation and (ii) randomized treatment assignment can be imposed without restricting the observational data. We impose (i) but not (ii) and prove identification of models that impose some structure. We allow for dependent unobserved heterogeneity and we do not exploit exclusion restrictions on covariates. We provide results for both single-spell and multiple-spell data. The timing of events conveys useful information on the treatment effect.

10.1111/1468-0262.00456.abstractZh: 本文分析了因果多变量持续时间模型的规格化和识别问题。我们重点关注一种持续时间，它涉及到治疗开始的时间点，我们感兴趣的是这种治疗对某些结果持续时间的影响。我们定义了“不预期治疗”的概念，并将其与生物统计学中的一个常见假设联系起来。我们证明了：(i) 不预期治疗的情况以及(ii) 随机化的治疗分配可以在不限制观察数据的情况下实施。我们仅实施(i)而不实施(ii)，并证明了对于施加了某种结构的模型，可以实现识别。我们允许存在依赖性的未观测异质性，并且没有利用对协变量的排除限制。我们为单周期和多周期数据提供了结果。事件的时间点传递了有关治疗效果的有用信息。

abstract.text: We study the problem of the existence and uniqueness of solutions to the Bellman equation in the presence of unbounded returns. We introduce a new approach based both on consideration of a metric on the space of all continuous functions over the state space, and on the application of some metric fixed point theorems. With appropriate conditions we prove uniqueness of solutions with respect to the whole space of continuous functions. Furthermore, the paper provides new sufficient conditions for the existence of solutions that can be applied to fairly general models. It is also proven that the fixed point coincides with the value function and that it can be approached by successive iterations of the Bellman operator.

10.1111/1468-0262.00457.abstractZh: 我们研究了在无限回报条件下，Bellman方程解的存在性和唯一性问题。我们提出了一种新的方法，该方法既考虑了状态空间上所有连续函数空间上的度量，又应用了某些不动点定理。在适当的条件下，我们证明了关于整个连续函数空间的解的唯一性。此外，本文还提出了一些新的充分条件，用于证明解的存在性，这些条件可以应用于相当一般的模型。同时，我们还证明了不动点与价值函数相等，并且可以通过Bellman算子的连续迭代来逼近它。

abstract.text: It has been known that, in aggregating infinite utility streams, there does not exist any social welfare function, which satisfies the axioms of Pareto, intergenerational equity, and continuity. We show that the impossibility result persists even without imposing the continuity axiom, and in frameworks allowing for more general domains of utilities than those used in the existing literature.

10.1111/1468-0262.00458.abstractZh: 已知，在将无限效用流聚合时，不存在满足帕累托效率、代际公平和连续性公理的社会福利函数。我们证明，即使不施加连续性公理，这种不可能性仍然成立，而且这种结论适用于允许比现有文献中使用的效用域更为广泛的框架。

abstract.text: In econometrics there are many occasions where knowledge of the structural relationship among dependent variables is required to answer questions of interest. This paper gives identification and estimation results for nonparametric conditional moment restrictions. We characterize identification of structural functions as completeness of certain conditional distributions, and give sufficient identification conditions for exponential families and discrete variables. We also give a consistent, nonparametric estimator of the structural function. The estimator is nonparametric two-stage least squares based on series approximation, which overcomes an ill-posed inverse problem by placing bounds on integrals of higher-order derivatives.

10.1111/1468-0262.00459.abstractZh: 在计量经济学中，很多时候需要了解因变量之间的结构关系来回答相关问题。本文给出了非参数条件矩约束的识别与估计结果。我们将结构函数的识别描述为某些条件分布的完备性，并为指数族和离散变量提供了充分的识别条件。我们还提出了一种一致的、非参数结构函数估计器。该估计器基于序列近似的非参数两阶段最小二乘法，通过限制高阶导数积分的值来解决逆问题的不适定性问题。

abstract.text: This paper presents new identification conditions for the mixed proportional hazard model. In particular, the baseline hazard is assumed to be bounded away from 0 and ∞ near t = 0. These conditions ensure that the information matrix is nonsingular. The paper also presents an estimator for the mixed proportional hazard model that converges at rate N −1/2.

10.1111/1468-0262.00460.abstractZh: 本文提出了混合比例风险模型的新识别条件。具体而言，基线风险被假设在t=0附近远离0和∞的范围内。这些条件确保了信息矩阵是非奇异的。本文还提出了一种混合比例风险模型的估计量，其收敛速度为N−1/2。

abstract.text: We provide easy to verify sufficient conditions for the consistency and asymptotic normality of a class of semiparametric optimization estimators where the criterion function does not obey standard smoothness conditions and simultaneously depends on some nonparametric estimators that can themselves depend on the parameters to be estimated. Our results extend existing theories such as those of Pakes and Pollard (1989), Andrews (1994a), and Newey (1994). We also show that bootstrap provides asymptotically correct confidence regions for the finite dimensional parameters. We apply our results to two examples: a ‘hit rate’ and a partially linear median regression with some endogenous regressors.

10.1111/1468-0262.00461.abstractZh: 我们提出了一组半参数优化估计量的一致性和渐近正态性的易于验证的充分条件，其中标准函数不遵循标准的平滑性条件，并且同时依赖于一些本身可能依赖于待估计参数的非参数估计量。我们的结果扩展了现有理论，如Pakes和Pollard（1989年）、Andrews（1994a年）以及Newey（1994年）的研究。我们还证明了自举法能够为有限维参数提供渐近正确的置信区间。我们将我们的结果应用于两个例子：一个“命中率”以及一个包含一些内生回归量的部分线性中位数回归问题。

abstract.text: With cheap talk, more can be achieved by long conversations than by a single message—even when one side is strictly better informed than the other. (“Cheap talk” means plain conversation—unmediated, nonbinding, and payoff-irrelevant.) This work characterizes the equilibrium payoffs for all two-person games in which one side is better informed than the other and cheap talk is permitted.

10.1111/1468-0262.00465.abstractZh: 通过廉价交谈，通过长时间的对话可以达成比单一信息更多的成果——即使一方的信息比另一方更为详尽。这里的“廉价交谈”指的是未经中介、无约束且无关利益的普通对话。本研究描述了所有这种两方博弈的均衡结果，其中一方的信息比另一方更为详尽，并且允许使用廉价交谈。

abstract.text: This paper considers tests for structural instability of short duration, such as at the end of the sample. The key feature of the testing problem is that the number, m, of observations in the period of potential change is relatively small—possibly as small as one. The well-known F test of Chow (1960) for this problem only applies in a linear regression model with normally distributed iid errors and strictly exogenous regressors, even when the total number of observations, n+m, is large. We generalize the F test to cover regression models with much more general error processes, regressors that are not strictly exogenous, and estimation by instrumental variables as well as least squares. In addition, we extend the F test to nonlinear models estimated by generalized method of moments and maximum likelihood. Asymptotic critical values that are valid as n→∞ with m fixed are provided using a subsampling-like method. The results apply quite generally to processes that are strictly stationary and ergodic under the null hypothesis of no structural instability.

10.1111/1468-0262.00466.abstractZh: 本文探讨了短期限结构不稳定性的检验问题，例如在样本结束时的情形。该检验问题的关键特征是，潜在变化期间观测值的数量m相对较小——可能仅为1个。著名的Chow（1960）F检验仅适用于具有正态分布的独立同分布误差和严格外生回归变量的线性回归模型，即使观测总数n+m较大时也是如此。我们推广了F检验，以涵盖具有更一般误差过程、非严格外生回归变量以及通过工具变量进行估计或最小二乘法估计的回归模型。此外，我们将F检验扩展到通过广义矩估计和最大似然法估计的非线性模型。使用一种类似子样本的方法，我们提供了在m固定时，随着n趋于无穷大而有效的渐近临界值。这些结果普遍适用于在零假设下严格平稳且遍历的过程。

abstract.text: This Paper builds a dynamic industry model with heterogeneous firms that explains why international trade induces reallocations of resources among firms in an industry. The Paper shows how the exposure to trade will induce only the more productive firms to enter the export market (while some less productive firms continue to produce only for the domestic market) and will simultaneously force the least productive firms to exit. It then shows how further increases in the industry’s exposure to trade lead to additional inter-firm reallocations towards more productive firms. These phenomena have been empirically documented but cannot be explained by current general equilibrium trade models, because they rely on a representative firm framework. The Paper also shows how the aggregate industry productivity growth generated by the reallocations contributes to a welfare gain, thus highlighting a benefit from trade that has not been examined theoretically before. The Paper adapts Hopenhayn’s (1992a) dynamic industry model to monopolistic competition in a general equilibrium setting. In so doing, the Paper provides an extension of Krugman’s (1980) trade model that incorporates firm level productivity differences. Firms with different productivity levels coexist in an industry because each firm faces initial uncertainty concerning its productivity before making an irreversible investment to enter the industry. Entry into the export market is also costly, but the firm’s decision to export occurs after it gains knowledge of its productivity.

10.1111/1468-0262.00467.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个具有异质企业的动态行业模型，解释了为什么国际贸易会导致行业内企业之间的资源重新分配。文章指出，贸易的参与只会促使那些生产效率更高的企业进入出口市场（而一些生产效率较低的企业则继续为国内市场生产），同时迫使那些生产效率最低的企业退出市场。进一步增加行业对贸易的参与度，会导致更多的企业重新分配到生产效率更高的企业手中。这些现象已有实证记录，但无法用当前的一般均衡贸易模型来解释，因为这些模型依赖于代表性企业的框架。文章还表明，通过这种重新分配产生的行业整体生产率增长，有助于提升福利水平，从而揭示了贸易带来的一种理论尚未被充分探讨的益处。本文将霍彭海因（1992a）的动态行业模型应用于垄断竞争的一般均衡环境，从而扩展了克鲁格曼（1980）的贸易模型，使其包含企业层面的生产率差异。由于每个企业在进入行业之前都面临初始的不确定性，因此不同生产率水平的企业会在同一行业中共存。进入出口市场的成本较高，但企业在了解自身生产率后才会做出出口决策。

abstract.text: Cointegrated bivariate nonstationary time series are considered in a fractional context, without allowance for deterministic trends. Both the observable series and the cointegrating error can be fractional processes. The familiar situation in which the respective integration orders are 1 and 0 is nested, but these values have typically been assumed known. We allow one or more of them to be unknown real values, in which case Robinson and Marinucci (2001, 2003) have justified least squares estimates of the cointegrating vector, as well as narrow-band frequency-domain estimates, which may be less biased. While consistent, these estimates do not always have optimal convergence rates, and they have nonstandard limit distributional behavior. We consider estimates formulated in the frequency domain, that consequently allow for a wide variety of (parametric) autocorrelation in the short memory input series, as well as time-domain estimates based on autoregressive transformation. Both can be interpreted as approximating generalized least squares and Gaussian maximum likelihood estimates. The estimates share the same limiting distribution, having mixed normal asymptotics (yielding Wald test statistics with χ2 null limit distributions), irrespective of whether the integration orders are known or unknown, subject in the latter case to their estimation with adequate rates of convergence. The parameters describing the short memory stationary input series are √n-consistently estimable, but the assumptions imposed on these series are much more general than ones of autoregressive moving average type. A Monte Carlo study of finite-sample performance is included.

10.1111/1468-0262.00468.abstractZh: 在分数背景下，我们考虑了非平稳的双变量时间序列，而不考虑确定性趋势。可观测序列和协整误差都可以是分数过程。在常见的情形中，各个积分阶数分别为1和0，这种关系是嵌套的，但通常这些值是被假定为已知的。我们允许其中一个或多个未知实数值，在这种情况下，Robinson和Marinucci（2001, 2003）证明了最小二乘估计协整向量的方法，以及窄带频域估计方法，这些方法可能具有较小的偏差。虽然这些估计方法是一致的，但它们并不总是具有最优的收敛速率，并且它们具有非标准的极限分布行为。我们考虑了在频域中制定的估计方法，因此允许在短记忆输入序列中存在多种（参数化）自相关现象，以及基于自回归变换的时域估计。这两种估计方法都可以被解释为近似广义最小二乘和高斯最大似然估计。这些估计方法具有相同的极限分布，具有混合正态渐近性（产生具有χ2零假设极限分布的Wald检验统计量），无论积分阶数是已知还是未知的，在后一种情况下，只要估计的收敛速率足够快即可。描述短记忆平稳输入序列的参数可以√n一致地估计，但这些序列所受到的假设比自回归移动平均类型的假设更为普遍。文中还包括了对有限样本性能进行的蒙特卡洛研究。

abstract.text: We consider an infinite-horizon exchange economy with incomplete markets and collateral constraints. As in the two-period model of Geanakoplos and Zame (2002), households can default on their liabilities at any time, and financial securities are only traded if the promises associated with these securities are backed by collateral. We examine an economy with a single perishable consumption good, where the only collateral available consists of productive assets. In this model, competitive equilibria always exist and we show that, under the assumption that all exogenous variables follow a Markov chain, there also exist stationary equilibria. These equilibria can be characterized by a mapping from the exogenous shock and the current distribution of financial wealth to prices and portfolio choices. We develop an algorithm to approximate this mapping numerically and discuss ways to implement the algorithm in practice. A computational example demonstrates the performance of the algorithm and shows some quantitative features of equilibria in a model with collateral and default.

10.1111/1468-0262.00469.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个具有不完全市场和抵押约束的无限期交换经济。如同Geanakoplos和Zame在2002年的两期模型中所述，家庭可以在任何时间违约，而金融证券只有在与这些证券相关的承诺得到抵押支持时才会被交易。我们研究了一个仅包含一个易逝消费品的 economy，其中唯一的抵押品由生产性资产构成。在这个模型中，竞争均衡总是存在的，并且我们证明了，在假设所有外生变量遵循马尔可夫链的前提下，也存在稳定均衡。这些均衡可以通过一个映射来表征，该映射将外生冲击与当前金融财富分布映射到价格和投资组合选择上。我们开发了一种算法来数值近似这个映射，并讨论了在实践中实施该算法的方法。一个计算示例展示了该算法的性能，并揭示了在包含抵押和违约的模型中均衡的一些定量特征。

abstract.text: (iii) the estimator for the asymptotic covariance of the 0 estimator is consistent and easy to compute; and (iv) the optimally weighted minimum distance estimator of 0 attains the semiparametric efficiency bound. We illustrate our results with two examples: a partially linear regression with an endogenous nonparametric part, and a partially additive IV regression with a link function.

10.1111/1468-0262.00470.abstractZh: (iii) 0估计量的渐近协方差估计量具有一致性且易于计算；以及(iv) 最优加权最小距离估计量能够达到半参数效率界限。我们通过两个例子来说明我们的结果：一个是包含内生非参数部分的偏线性回归，另一个是带有链接函数的偏加性IV回归。

abstract.text: We consider the bootstrap unit root tests based on finite order autoregressive integrated models driven by iid innovations, with or without deterministic time trends. A general methodology is developed to approximate asymptotic distributions for the models driven by integrated time series, and used to obtain asymptotic expansions for the Dickey–Fuller unit root tests. The second-order terms in their expansions are of stochastic orders Op(n−1/4) and Op(n−1/2), and involve functionals of Brownian motions and normal random variates. The asymptotic expansions for the bootstrap tests are also derived and compared with those of the Dickey–Fuller tests. We show in particular that the bootstrap offers asymptotic refinements for the Dickey–Fuller tests, i.e., it corrects their second-order errors. More precisely, it is shown that the critical values obtained by the bootstrap resampling are correct up to the second-order terms, and the errors in rejection probabilities are of order o(n−1/2) if the tests are based upon the bootstrap critical values. Through simulations, we investigate how effective is the bootstrap correction in small samples.

10.1111/1468-0262.00471.abstractZh: 我们考虑了基于有限阶自回归积分模型的自助法单位根检验，这些模型由独立同分布的创新驱动，可能存在或不存在确定性时间趋势。我们开发了一种通用方法，用于近似由积分时间序列驱动的模型的渐近分布，并用于获得Dickey-Fuller单位根检验的渐近展开式。这些展开式中的二阶项具有随机阶Op(n−1/4)和Op(n−1/2)，涉及布朗运动函数与正态随机变量。我们还推导了自助法检验的渐近展开式，并将其与Dickey-Fuller检验的渐近展开式进行了比较。我们特别指出，自助法为Dickey-Fuller检验提供了渐近的改进，即它纠正了这些检验的二阶误差。更确切地说，通过自助法重采样获得的临界值在二阶项上是正确的，如果检验基于自助法获得的临界值，则拒绝概率的误差为o(n−1/2)阶。通过模拟实验，我们研究了自助法修正在小样本中的有效性。

abstract.text: We provide a behavioral foundation to the notion of 'mixture' of acts, which is used to great advantage in the decision setting introduced by Anscombe and Aumann (1963). Our construction allows one to formulate mixture-space axioms even in a fully subjective setting, without assuming the existence of randomizing devices. This simplifies the task of developing axiomatic models which only use behavioral data. Moreover, it is immune from the difficulty that agents may 'distort' the probabilities associated with randomizing devices. For illustration, we present simple subjective axiomatizations of some models of choice under uncertainty, including the maxmin expected utility model of Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989), and Bewley's model of choice with incomplete preferences (1986).

10.1111/1468-0262.00472.abstractZh: 我们为“行为混合”这一概念提供了行为基础，这一概念在Anscombe和Aumann于1963年提出的决策环境中得到了广泛应用。我们的构建方式允许即使在完全主观的环境中也能制定混合空间公理，而无需假设随机化设备的存在。这简化了仅使用行为数据来开发公理模型的任务。此外，这种方法还避免了代理人可能“扭曲”与随机化设备相关的概率这一难题。为了说明这一点，我们展示了一些在不确定性下的选择模型的简单主观公理化，包括Gilboa和Schmeidler在1989年提出的maxmin期望效用模型，以及Bewley在不完全偏好下的选择模型（1986年）。

abstract.text: High–frequency financial data are not only discretely sampled in time but the time separating successive observations is often random. We analyze the consequences of this dual feature of the data when estimating a continuous–time model. In particular, we measure the additional effects of the randomness of the sampling intervals over and beyond those due to the discreteness of the data. We also examine the effect of simply ignoring the sampling randomness. We find that in many situations the randomness of the sampling has a larger impact than the discreteness of the data.

10.1111/1468-0262.t01-1-00416.abstractZh: 高频金融数据不仅在时间上呈离散采样，而且连续观测值之间的时间间隔往往也是随机的。我们分析了这种数据特性在估计连续时间模型时的后果。具体来说，我们研究了采样间隔的随机性对模型的影响，这些影响超出了数据离散性的影响范围。我们还探讨了简单忽略采样随机性的影响。研究发现，在许多情况下，采样随机性的影响比数据离散性的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: We analyse productivity growth in UK manufacturing 1980‐92 using the newly available ARD panel of establishments drawn from the Census of Production. We examine the contribution to productivity growth of ‘internal’ restructuring (such as new technology and organisational change among survivors) and ‘external’ restructuring (exit, entry and market share change). We find that (a) ‘external restructuring’ accounts for 50% of establishment labour productivity growth and 80–90% of establishment TFP growth; (b) much of the external restructuring effect comes from multi‐establishment firms closing down poorly‐performing plants and opening high‐performing new ones, and (c) external competition is an important determinant of internal restructuring.

10.1111/1468-0297.t01-1-00145.abstractZh: 我们分析了1980至1992年间英国制造业的生产力增长情况，使用了从生产普查中获得的新的ARD企业面板数据。我们研究了“内部”重组（如幸存企业的新技术和组织变革）和“外部”重组（企业的退出、进入以及市场份额的变化）对生产力增长的贡献。研究发现：(a) “外部重组”占企业劳动生产率增长的50%，以及企业全要素生产率增长的80-90%；(b) 外部重组的效应主要来自于多企业联合关闭表现不佳的工厂，并开设表现良好的新工厂；(c) 外部竞争是内部重组的重要决定因素。

abstract.text: This paper uses unique data from the state of Connecticut to examine discounting patterns in the state's hospital industry for the years following deregulation (1995‐1998). The data provide a rare opportunity to study payer‐level differences in negotiated discounts for hospital services. In addition to presenting descriptive evidence on how discounts vary across payers, payer types and hospital types, this study uses matched revenue data to analyze and empirically estimate the economic determinants of discount magnitudes. Payer size appears to affect bargaining power, but the economic significance of the effect is small. Much larger than the effect of payer size is the influence of payers' abilities to ‘move market share’ by channeling patients to hospitals with which favorable discounts have been negotiated.

10.1111/j.0022-1821.2003.00211.x.abstractZh: 本文利用康涅狄格州独有的数据，研究了放松管制后（1995-1998年）该州医院行业的折扣模式。这些数据为研究不同支付方在医院服务方面协商折扣的差异提供了难得的机会。除了描述性分析不同支付方、支付类型以及医院类型之间折扣差异的情况外，本研究还利用匹配的收入数据来分析和实证估计影响折扣幅度的经济因素。支付方的规模似乎会影响其议价能力，但这一影响的经济意义较小。相比之下，支付方通过引导患者与已协商到有利折扣的医院合作，以争取市场份额的能力的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To estimate the effects of competition for both Medicare and HMO patients on the quality decisions of hospitals in Southern California. DATA SOURCE: Secondary discharge data from the Office of Statewide Health Planning and Development for the State of California for the period 1989-1993. STUDY DESIGN: Outcome variables are the risk-adjusted hospital mortality rates for pneumonia (estimated by the authors) and acute myocardial infarction (AMI) (reported by the state of California). Measures of competition are constructed for each hospital and payer type. The competition measures are formulated to mitigate the possibility of endogeneity bias. The relationships between risk-adjusted mortality and the different competition measures are estimated using ordinary least squares. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: The study finds that an increase in the degree of competition for health maintenance organization (HMO) patients is associated with a decrease in risk-adjusted hospital mortality rates. Conversely, an increase in competition for Medicare enrollees is associated with an increase in risk-adjusted mortality rates for hospitals. CONCLUSIONS: In conjunction with previous research, the estimates indicate that increasing competition for HMO patients appears to reduce prices and save lives and hence appears to improve welfare. However, increases in competition for Medicare appear to reduce quality and may reduce welfare. Increasing competition has little net effect on hospital quality in our sample.

10.1111/j.1475-6773.2003.00185.x.abstractZh:
目的：评估竞争对南加州医疗保险和健康维护组织患者的影响，以及这些竞争对医院质量决策的影响。  
数据来源：1989-1993年期间，加州全州健康规划与发展办公室提供的次级出院数据。  
研究设计：研究变量包括肺炎（由作者估算）和急性心肌梗死（由加州政府报告）的风险调整医院死亡率。针对每家医院和每种支付方类型，分别构建了竞争指标。这些竞争指标旨在减少内生性偏差的可能性。使用普通最小二乘法估计风险调整死亡率与不同竞争指标之间的关系。  
主要发现：研究表明，增加健康维护组织患者的竞争程度与降低风险调整医院死亡率相关。相反，增加医疗保险参保者的竞争程度则与医院风险调整死亡率上升相关。  
结论：与先前的研究一致，这些估计结果表明，增加健康维护组织患者的竞争似乎能够降低价格并挽救生命，从而改善福利。然而，增加医疗保险的竞争似乎会降低医院质量，并可能降低福利。在我们的样本中，竞争的增加对医院质量几乎没有净影响。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Studies that are the basis of recommended volume thresholds for CABG surgery are outdated and not reflective of recent advances in the field. This study examines both hospital and surgeon volume-mortality relations for CABG surgery through the use of a population-based clinical data set. METHODS AND RESULTS: Data from New York's clinical CABG surgery registry from 1997 to 1999 (total number of procedures, 57 150) were used to examine the individual and combined impact of annual hospital volume and annual surgeon volume on in-hospital mortality rates after adjusting for differences in severity of illness. Significantly lower risk-adjusted mortality rates occurred above all annual hospital volume thresholds between 200 and 800 and above all surgeon volume thresholds between 50 and 200. The number needed to treat (NNT) at higher-volume providers to avoid a death was minimized for a hospital threshold volume of 100 (NNT=50) and a surgeon threshold volume of 50 (NNT=118). The risk-adjusted mortality rate (RAMR) for patients undergoing surgery performed by surgeons with volumes of > or =125 in hospitals with volumes of > or =600 was 1.89%. The RAMR was significantly higher (2.67%) for patients undergoing surgery performed by surgeons with volumes of <125 in hospitals with volumes of <600. CONCLUSIONS: Higher-volume surgeons and hospitals continue to have lower risk-adjusted mortality rates, and patients undergoing surgery performed by higher-volume surgeons in higher-volume hospitals have the lowest mortality rates.

10.1161/01.cir.0000084551.52010.3b.abstractZh:
背景：用于确定冠状动脉旁路移植手术推荐手术量的研究已经过时，无法反映该领域的最新进展。本研究通过基于人群的临床数据集，探讨了冠状动脉旁路移植手术的医院手术量与外科医生手术量对院内死亡率的影响。

方法与结果：本研究使用了纽约1997至1999年的临床冠状动脉旁路移植手术登记数据（总手术数为57,150例），通过调整疾病严重程度差异，分析了年度医院手术量和年度外科医生手术量对院内死亡率的单独和联合影响。结果显示，在年度医院手术量超过200至800例之间，以及年度外科医生手术量超过50至200例之间时，风险调整后的死亡率显著较低。在较高手术量的医疗机构中，避免死亡所需的治疗人数（NNT）最低，医院手术量达到100例时为50人，外科医生手术量达到50例时为118人。在手术量超过125例且医院手术量超过600例的医疗机构中，由高手术量外科医生执行的手术患者的风险调整后死亡率仅为1.89%。而在手术量低于125例且医院手术量低于600例的医疗机构中，这一比例显著升高至2.67%。

结论：高手术量的外科医生和医院仍然具有较低的风险调整后死亡率，而在高手术量医院中，由高手术量外科医生执行的手术患者的死亡率最低。

abstract.text: Measured by the ratio of trade to output, the period 1870–1913 marked the birth of the first era of trade globalization and the period 1914–1939 its death. What caused the boom and bust? We use an augmented gravity model to examine the gold standard, tariffs, and transport costs as determinants of trade. Until 1913 the rise of the gold standard and the fall in transport costs were the main trade-creating forces. As of 1929 the reversal was driven by higher transport costs. In the 1930s the final collapse of the gold standard drove trade volumes even lower.

10.1162/003355303321675419.abstractZh: 从贸易与产出的比例来看，1870年至1913年标志着贸易全球化的第一个时代，而1914年至1939年则标志着这一时代的终结。是什么导致了这种繁荣与崩溃？我们运用扩展的引力模型来研究金本位制、关税以及运输成本作为贸易的决定因素。直到1913年，金本位制的确立和运输成本的下降是创造贸易的主要动力。而到了1929年，贸易量的下降则是由更高的运输成本所驱动的。在1930年代，金本位制的最终崩溃进一步降低了贸易量。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of an increase in product quality information to consumers on firms' choices of product quality. In 1998 Los Angeles County introduced hygiene quality grade cards to be displayed in restaurant windows. We show that the grade cards cause (i) restaurant health inspection scores to increase, (ii) consumer demand to become sensitive to changes in restaurants' hygiene quality, and (iii) the number of foodborne illness hospitalizations to decrease. We also provide evidence that this improvement in health outcomes is not fully explained by consumers substituting from poor hygiene restaurants to good hygiene restaurants. These results imply that the grade cards cause restaurants to make hygiene quality improvements.

10.1162/003355303321675428.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了向消费者提供更多产品质量信息对企业产品质量选择的影响。1998年，洛杉矶县在餐馆窗户上引入了卫生质量等级牌。我们发现，这些等级牌导致：(i) 餐馆的健康检查评分上升；(ii) 消费者对餐馆卫生质量的变化更加敏感；(iii) 因食源性疾病住院的人数减少。此外，我们的研究还表明，这种健康状况的改善并非完全是由于消费者从卫生条件差的餐馆转向卫生条件好的餐馆所导致的。这些结果意味着，这些等级牌促使餐馆改善了卫生质量。

abstract.text: In cooperation with Lex Mundi member law firms in 109 countries, we measure and describe the exact procedures used by litigants and courts to evict a tenant for non-payment of rent and to collect a bounced check.We use these data to construct an index of procedural formalism of dispute resolution for each country.We find that such formalism is systematically greater in civil than in common law countries.Moreover, procedural formalism is associated with higher expected duration of judicial proceedings, more corruption, less consistency, less honesty, less fairness in judicial decisions, and inferior access to justice.These results suggest that legal transplantation may have led to an inefficiently high level of procedural formalism, particularly in developing countries.

10.1162/003355303321675437.abstractZh: 我们与Lex Mundi的109个成员律师事务所合作，对诉讼当事人和法院在因租户未支付租金而进行的驱逐行动以及处理空头支票时所使用的具体程序进行了测量和描述。我们利用这些数据为每个国家构建了一个关于争议解决程序形式主义的指数。研究发现，在民法国家，程序形式主义普遍高于普通法国家。此外，程序形式主义与司法程序的预期持续时间更长、腐败现象更普遍、决策的一致性更低、诚信度更低、司法决策的不公平性更高以及司法服务的可及性更差有关。这些结果表明，法律移植可能导致程序形式主义水平过高，尤其是在发展中国家。

abstract.text: What motivated men to risk death in the most horrific war in U. S. history when pay was low and irregular and military punishment strategies were weak? In such a situation creating group loyalty by promoting social capital is of paramount importance and in the Civil War was the cement of both armies. We find that individual and company socioeconomic and demographic characteristics, ideology, and morale were important predictors of group loyalty in the Union Army. Company characteristics were more important than ideology or morale. Soldiers in companies that were more homogeneous in ethnicity, occupation, and age were less likely to shirk.

10.1162/003355303321675446.abstractZh: 是什么促使人们在美国历史上最可怕的战争中冒险，即使报酬低且不稳定，军事惩罚手段也薄弱？在这种情况下，通过提升社会资本来建立群体忠诚至关重要，而在内战期间，这种社会资本是两支军队团结的基础。我们发现，个人和单位的 socioeconomic 及人口统计特征、意识形态以及士气都是影响联盟军群体忠诚的重要因素。其中，单位特征比意识形态或士气更为重要。在种族、职业和年龄方面更为同质化的单位中，士兵们更不容易出现逃避责任的行为。

abstract.text: This paper attempts to identify job networks among Mexican migrants in the U. S. labor market. The empirical analysis uses data on migration patterns and labor market outcomes, based on a sample of individuals belonging to multiple origin-communities in Mexico, over a long period of time. Each community's network is measured by the proportion of the sampled individuals who are located at the destination (the United States) in any year. We verify that the same individual is more likely to be employed and to hold a higher paying nonagricultural job when his network is exogenously larger, by including individual fixed effects in the employment and occupation regressions and by using rainfall in the origin-community as an instrument for the size of the network at the destination.

10.1162/003355303321675455.abstractZh: 本文试图识别墨西哥移民在美国劳动力市场中的职业网络。实证分析基于长期对墨西哥多个原籍社区个体迁移模式及劳动力市场结果的数据。每个社区的网络状况通过样本中在目的地（美国）居住的比例来衡量。研究发现，当个体的网络范围较大时，该个体更有可能获得就业，并且从事报酬较高的非农业工作。这一结论是通过在就业和职业回归分析中加入个体固定效应，并利用原籍社区的规模作为衡量目的地网络规模的工具得出的。

abstract.text: Although forests have diminished globally over the past 400 years, forest cover has increased in some areas, including India in the last two decades. Aggregate time-series evidence on forest growth rates and income growth across countries and within India and a newly assembled data set that combines national household survey data, census data, and satellite images of land use in rural India at the village level over a 29-year period are used to explore the hypothesis that increases in the demand for forest products associated with income and population growth lead to forest growth. The evidence is consistent with this hypothesis, which also shows that neither the expansion of agricultural productivity nor rising wages in India increased local forest cover.

10.1162/003355303321675464.abstractZh: 尽管过去400年全球森林面积有所减少，但在某些地区，包括印度，森林覆盖率在过去二十年里有所上升。通过收集各国以及印度国内森林生长率与经济增长的时间序列数据，并结合了国家家庭调查数据、人口普查数据，以及29年间印度农村地区的卫星土地利用图像的新数据集，本研究探讨了随着收入和人口增长而增加的对森林产品需求是否会导致森林增长这一假设。研究结果支持这一假设，同时也表明，无论是农业生产力的提升还是工资的上涨，都没有增加印度的当地森林覆盖率。

abstract.text: Movements in the stock market can have a significant impact on the macroeconomy and are therefore likely to be an important factor in the determination of monetary policy. However, little is known about the magnitude of the Federal Reserve's reaction to the stock market, in part because the simultaneous response of equity prices to interest rates makes it difficult to estimate. This paper uses an identification technique based on the heteroskedasticity of stock market returns to measure the reaction of monetary policy to the stock market. We find a significant policy response, with a 5 percent rise (fall) in the S&P 500 index increasing the likelihood of a 25 basis point tightening (easing) by about a half.

10.1162/003355303321675473.abstractZh: 股市的波动对宏观经济有着显著的影响，因此很可能是决定货币政策的重要因素。然而，关于美联储对股市反应的程度，我们知之甚少，部分原因是股票价格对利率的同步反应使得难以进行估算。本文采用了一种基于股市回报异方差性的识别技术来衡量货币政策对股市的反应。我们发现，货币政策有显著的响应：标准普尔500指数上涨（下跌）5个百分点，会导致货币政策紧缩（宽松）25个基点的可能性增加约一半。

abstract.text: The midcentury GI bills were the largest direct scholarship program for higher education in American history. I use a comparison group created by the sharp cutoff date of the Korean War GI bill to evaluate the effects of the Korean War GI bill on postsecondary educational attainment and access to college by the disadvantaged. I then bound the likely effects of the World War II GI bill based on elasticities estimated for the Korean War GI bill and new estimates using older veterans as a comparison group for younger ones. I find that the combination of the Korean War and WWII GI bills probably increased total postsecondary attainment among all men born between 1921 and 1933 by about 15 to 20 percent, with smaller effects for surrounding cohorts. The impacts of both programs on college attainment were apparently concentrated among veterans from families in the upper half of the distribution of socioeconomic status.

10.1162/003355303321675482.abstractZh: 二十世纪中期的GI法案是美国历史上规模最大的高等教育直接奖学金计划。我以朝鲜战争GI法案的截止日期作为对比基准，来评估朝鲜战争GI法案对弱势群体的高等教育成就和大学入学机会的影响。随后，我基于朝鲜战争GI法案的弹性系数，以及使用老退伍军人作为年轻退伍军人的对比组，进一步估算了第二次世界大战GI法案的可能影响。研究发现，朝鲜战争和第二次世界大战GI法案的结合，可能使1921年至1933年间出生的所有男性的高等教育总成就提高了约15%至20%，而周边群体的影响则较小。这两个计划对大学教育成就的影响，似乎主要集中在社会经济地位处于较高水平家庭的退伍军人身上。

abstract.text: This paper develops a tractable incomplete-markets model of economic growth in which households invest in risk-free physical capital and risky human capital. The paper shows that a reduction in uninsurable idiosyncratic labor income risk decreases physical capital investment, but increases human capital investment, growth, and welfare. A quantitative analysis based on a calibrated version of the model reveals that these effects are substantial and of the same order of magnitude as the effects of distortionary income taxation. The analysis further suggests that government-sponsored severance payments to displaced workers increase growth and welfare even if these payments have to be financed through distortionary income taxation.

10.1162/003355303321675491.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个可行的不完全市场经济增长模型，其中家庭投资于无风险的物质资本和具有风险的人力资本。研究表明，不可保险的特殊劳动收入风险降低会减少物质资本投资，但会增加人力资本投资、经济增长和福利水平。基于该模型校准版本的定量分析显示，这些效应相当显著，其规模与扭曲性所得税的效应相当。分析还表明，即使政府需要借助扭曲性所得税来为失业工人提供补偿，这种补偿措施也能促进经济增长和福利提升。

abstract.text: In this paper we examine the role of social security in an economy populated by overlapping generations of individuals with time-inconsistent preferences who face mortality risk, individual income risk, and borrowing constraints. We find that unfunded social security lowers the capital stock, output, and consumption for consumers with time-consistent or time-inconsistent preferences. However, it may raise or lower welfare depending on the strength of time inconsistency.

10.1162/003355303321675509.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了社会保障在一个由具有时间不一致偏好的重叠世代组成的经济中的角色。这些个体面临死亡风险、个人收入风险以及借贷限制。我们发现，未资助的社会保障会降低具有时间一致性或时间不一致偏好的消费者的资本存量、产出和消费。然而，根据时间不一致性的强度，社会保障可能会提高或降低福利水平。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether and how individual managers affect corporate behavior and performance. We construct a manager-firm matched panel data set which enables us to track the top managers across different firms over time. We find that manager fixed effects matter for a wide range of corporate decisions. A significant extent of the heterogeneity in investment, financial and organizational practices of firms can be explained by the presence of manager fixed effects. We identify specific patterns in managerial decision making that appear to indicate general differences in "style" across managers. Moreover, we show that management style is significantly related to manager fixed effects in performance and that managers with higher performance fixed effects receive higher compensation and are more likely to be found in better governed firms. In a final step, we tie back these findings to observable managerial characteristics. We find that executives from earlier birth cohorts appear on average to be more conservative; on the other hand, managers who hold an MBA degree seem to follow on average more aggressive strategies.

10.1162/003355303322552775.abstractZh: 本文探讨了个体管理者是否以及如何影响企业行为和绩效。我们构建了一个管理者与企业的匹配面板数据集，能够追踪不同时期不同企业的高层管理者。研究发现，管理者固定效应对多种企业决策具有重要影响。企业投资、财务和组织实践中的大量差异可以通过管理者固定效应的存在来解释。我们识别出一些特定的管理决策模式，这些模式似乎表明不同管理者在“风格”上存在差异。此外，我们发现管理风格与管理者固定效应在绩效上的关系显著，那些具有较高绩效固定效应的管理者获得的报酬更高，并且更有可能被分配到管理较好的企业中。最后，我们将这些发现与可观察的管理特征联系起来。研究发现，来自较早出生群体的高管平均而言更为保守；而持有MBA学位的管理者则似乎平均而言采取更为激进的策略。

abstract.text: People exaggerate the degree to which their future tastes will resemble their current tastes. We present evidence from a variety of domains which demonstrates the prevalence of such projection bias, develop a formal model of it, and use this model to demonstrate its importance in economic environments. We show that, when people exhibit habit formation, projection bias leads people to consume too much early in life, and to decide, as time passes, to consume more—and save less—than originally planned. Projection bias can also lead to misguided purchases of durable goods. We discuss a number of additional applications and implications.

10.1162/003355303322552784.abstractZh: 人们往往夸大自己未来喜好与当前喜好的相似程度。我们收集了来自多个领域的证据，证明这种预测偏差普遍存在，并构建了一个正式模型来描述这一现象。该模型表明，当人们形成习惯时，预测偏差会导致他们在生命早期消费过多，随着时间的推移，他们会决定比原计划消费更多、储蓄更少。预测偏差还可能导致对耐用商品的错误购买。我们还讨论了这一偏差的其他应用和影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies whether agents must agglomerate at a single location in a class of models of two-sided interaction. In these models there is an increasing returns effect that favors agglomeration, but also a crowding or market-impact effect that makes agents prefer to be in a market with fewer agents of their own type. We show that such models do not tip in the way the term is commonly used. Instead, they have a broad plateau of equilibria with two active markets, and tipping occurs only when one market is below a critical size threshold. Our assumptions are fairly weak, and are satisfied in Krugman's model of labor market pooling, a heterogeneous-agent version of Pagano's asset market model, and Ellison, Fudenberg, and Möbius' model of competing auctions.

10.1162/003355303322552793.abstractZh: 本文研究在一种双边互动模型中，代理人是否必须在单一地点聚集。在这些模型中，存在一种促进聚集的递增回报效应，但同时也存在一种拥挤效应或市场影响效应，使得代理人更倾向于处于拥有较少同类代理人的市场中。我们指出，这类模型并不会按照通常的术语含义发生 tipping 现象。相反，它们存在一个包含两个活跃市场的广泛均衡区域，而 tipping 现象仅发生在其中一个市场的规模低于一个临界阈值时。我们的假设相当宽松，这些假设在克鲁格曼的劳动力市场集中模型、帕加诺资产市场模型的异质代理人版本，以及埃利森、富登堡和莫比乌斯竞争拍卖模型中都是成立的。

abstract.text: We apply an understanding of what computers do to study how computerization alters job skill demands. We argue that computer capital (1) substitutes for workers in performing cognitive and manual tasks that can be accomplished by following explicit rules; and (2) complements workers in performing nonroutine problem-solving and complex communications tasks. Provided that these tasks are imperfect substitutes, our model implies measurable changes in the composition of job tasks, which we explore using representative data on task input for 1960 to 1998. We find that within industries, occupations, and education groups, computerization is associated with reduced labor input of routine manual and routine cognitive tasks and increased labor input of nonroutine cognitive tasks. Translating task shifts into education demand, the model can explain 60 percent of the estimated relative demand shift favoring college labor during 1970 to 1998. Task changes within nominally identical occupations account for almost half of this impact.

10.1162/003355303322552801.abstractZh: 我们运用对计算机功能的理解来研究计算机化如何改变工作技能的要求。我们认为，计算机资本（1）可以替代工人执行那些可以通过遵循明确规则完成的认知和手动任务；同时（2）可以补充工人执行非例行问题解决和复杂沟通任务的能力。如果这些任务是非完美替代品，我们的模型意味着工作任务的构成会发生可测量的变化。我们使用1960年至1998年的代表性任务数据来探讨这一变化。我们发现，在行业、职业和教育群体内部，计算机化导致常规手动和常规认知任务的劳动投入减少，而非例行认知任务的劳动投入增加。将任务变化转化为教育需求，该模型可以解释1970年至1998年间大学劳动力相对需求增加的60%。在名义上相同的职业中，任务变化几乎占这一影响的半数。

abstract.text: Immigration is not evenly balanced across groups of workers that have the same education but differ in their work experience, and the nature of the supply imbalance changes over time. This paper develops a new approach for estimating the labor market impact of immigration by exploiting this variation in supply shifts across education-experience groups. I assume that similarly educated workers with different levels of experience participate in a national labor market and are not perfect substitutes. The analysis indicates that immigration lowers the wage of competing workers: a 10 percent increase in supply reduces wages by 3 to 4 percent.

10.1162/003355303322552810.abstractZh: 在具有相同教育背景但工作经验不同的工人群体中，移民的影响并不均衡，而且这种供应不平衡的性质会随时间发生变化。本文提出了一种新的方法来估算移民对劳动力市场的影响，该方法利用了不同教育背景和经验水平下的供应变化。我们假设具有相似教育背景但经验水平不同的工人参与全国劳动力市场，并且他们并非完全替代品。分析表明，移民会降低竞争工人的工资：供应增加10%，工资会降低3%到4%。

abstract.text: Roughly one-third of world trade is intrafirm trade. This paper starts by unveiling two systematic patterns in the volume of intrafirm trade. In a panel of industries, the share of intrafirm imports in total U.S. imports is significantly higher, the higher the capital intensity of the exporting industry. In a cross-section of countries U.S. imports is significantly higher, the higher the capital-labor ratio of the exporting country. I then show that these patterns can be rationalized in a theoretical framework that combines a Grossman-Hart-Moore view of the firm with a Helpman-Krugman view of international trade. In particular an incomplete-contracting, property-rights model of the boundaries of the firm, which I then incorporate into a standard trade model with imperfect competition and product differentiation. The model pins down the boundaries of multinational firms as well as the international location of production, and it is shown to predict the patterns of intrafirm trade identified above. Econometric evidence reveals that the model is consistent with other qualitative and quantitative features of the data.

10.1162/003355303322552829.abstractZh: 大约三分之一的世界贸易是企业内部贸易。本文首先揭示了企业内部贸易规模中的两个系统性规律。在一个行业组中，如果出口行业的资本密集度越高，企业进口在总进口中的比例就越高。在各国截面数据中，如果出口国的资本劳动比率越高，企业进口就越高。接着，本文指出这些规律可以在一个理论框架中得到解释，该框架结合了Grossman-Hart-Moore关于企业的观点以及Helpman-Krugman关于国际贸易的观点。特别是，该理论框架采用了一种不完全契约、产权边界的企业模型，并将其纳入一个具有不完全竞争和产品差异性的标准贸易模型。该模型明确了跨国企业的边界以及生产的国际布局，并显示出能够预测上述企业内部贸易的规律。计量经济学证据表明，该模型与其他数据的定性和定量特征是一致的。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of discretionary fiscal policy on output volatility and economic growth. Using data for 91 countries, we isolate three empirical regularities: (1) governments that use fiscal policy aggressively induce significant macroeconomic instability; (2) the volatility of output caused by discretionary fiscal policy lowers economic growth by more than 0.8 percentage points for every percentage point increase in volatility; (3) prudent use of fiscal policy is explained to a large extent by the presence of political constraints and other political and institutional variables. The evidence in the paper supports arguments for constraining discretion by imposing institutional restrictions on governments as a way to reduce output volatility and increase the rate of economic growth.

10.1162/003355303322552838.abstractZh: 本文研究了自由裁量财政政策对产出波动性和经济增长的影响。通过采用91个国家的数据，我们发现了三个实证规律：(1) 积极使用财政政策的政府会导致显著的宏观经济不稳定；(2) 自由裁量财政政策引起的产出波动每增加一个百分点，经济增长就会降低0.8个百分点以上；(3) 财政政策的审慎使用在很大程度上是由政治约束以及其他政治和制度因素所决定的。本文的研究结果支持通过实施制度性限制来约束政府的自由裁量权，以此降低产出波动性和提高经济增长率的论点。

abstract.text: This paper asks how a household should choose between a fixed-rate (FRM) and an adjustable-rate (ARM) mortgage. In an environment with uncertain inflation a nominal FRM has a risky real capital value, whereas an ARM has a stable real capital value but short-term variability in required real payments. Numerical solution of a life-cycle model with borrowing constraints and income risk shows that an ARM is generally attractive, but less so for a risk-averse household with a large mortgage, risky income, high default cost, or low moving probability. An inflation-indexed FRM can improve substantially on standard nominal mortgages.

10.1162/003355303322552847.abstractZh: 本文探讨了家庭在固定利率抵押贷款和可调整利率抵押贷款之间应如何选择。在通胀不确定的环境下，固定利率抵押贷款的真实资本价值具有风险性，而可调整利率抵押贷款虽然真实资本价值稳定，但实际支付金额存在短期波动。通过数值模拟生命周期模型并考虑借款限制和收入风险，结果显示可调整利率抵押贷款通常更具吸引力，但对于风险厌恶型家庭来说，这种抵押贷款的优势则相对减弱，尤其是对于那些背负大额抵押贷款、收入不稳定、违约成本较高或搬家概率较低的家庭而言。与标准固定利率抵押贷款相比，通胀指数挂钩的抵押贷款能带来显著的优势。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of maternal education on birth outcomes using Vital Statistics Natality data for 1970 to 1999. We also assess the importance of four channels through which maternal education may improve birth outcomes: use of prenatal care, smoking, marriage, and fertility. In an effort to account for the endogeneity of educational attainment, we use data about the availability of colleges in the woman's county in her seventeenth year as an instrument for maternal education. We find that higher maternal education improves infant health, as measured by birth weight and gestational age. It also increases the probability that a new mother is married, reduces parity, increases use of prenatal care, and reduces smoking, suggesting that these may be important pathways for the ultimate effect on health. Our results add to the growing body of literature which suggests that estimates of the returns to education which focus only on increases in wages understate the total return.

10.1162/003355303322552856.abstractZh: 我们利用1970至1999年的生命统计出生数据，研究母亲教育水平对出生结果的影响。我们还评估了母亲教育水平可能通过四个途径改善出生结果的潜力：使用产前护理、吸烟、婚姻状况以及生育能力。为了考虑教育水平的内生性，我们使用了女性在十七岁时所在县内大学可用性的数据作为衡量母亲教育水平的工具。研究发现，较高的母亲教育水平能够提升婴儿的健康状况，具体表现为出生体重和妊娠年龄的改善。此外，较高的母亲教育水平还增加了新妈妈结婚的可能性，减少了多胎妊娠的情况，增加了产前护理的使用率，并降低了吸烟率，这些都可能成为影响健康的最终因素。我们的研究结果进一步丰富了相关文献，表明仅关注教育带来的工资增长这一方面的回报估计，实际上低估了教育的整体回报。

abstract.text: Many social scientists presume that the quality of the neighborhood to which children are exposed affects a variety of long-run social outcomes. I examine the effect on long-run labor market outcomes of adults who were assigned, when young, to substantially different public housing projects in Toronto. Administrative data are matched to public housing addresses to track children from the program to when they are more than 30 years old. The main finding is that, while living conditions and exposure to crime differ substantially across projects, neighborhood quality plays little role in determining a youth's eventual earnings, unemployment likelihood, and welfare participation. Living in contrasting housing projects cannot explain large variances in labor market outcomes but family differences, as measured by sibling outcome correlations, account for up to 30 percent of the total variance in the data.

10.1162/003355303322552865.abstractZh: 许多社会科学家认为，儿童所处的社区质量会影响多种长期的社会结果。我研究了在年轻时期被分配到多伦多不同公共住房项目的成年人，其对长期劳动力市场结果的影响。通过行政数据将儿童与公共住房地址进行匹配，以追踪他们从项目开始到30多岁的经历。主要发现是，尽管不同项目的生活条件和犯罪率存在显著差异，但社区质量对年轻人最终的收入、失业概率以及福利参与程度的影响很小。居住在不同类型的住房项目中并不能解释劳动力市场结果的巨大差异，而家庭差异，通过兄弟姐妹之间的关联来衡量，可以解释数据中高达30%的总变异。

abstract.text: This paper presents new homogeneous series on top shares of income and wages from 1913 to 1998 in the United States using individual tax returns data. Top income and wages shares display a U-shaped pattern over the century. Our series suggest that the large shocks that capital owners experienced during the Great Depression and World War II have had a permanent effect on top capital incomes. We argue that steep progressive income and estate taxation may have prevented large fortunes from fully recovering from these shocks. Top wage shares were flat before World War II, dropped precipitously during the war, and did not start to recover before the late 1960s but are now higher than before World War II. As a result, the working rich have replaced the rentiers at the top of the income distribution.

10.1162/00335530360535135.abstractZh: 本文利用个人税务申报数据，呈现了1913年至1998年间美国收入与工资最高份额的新数据系列。这些最高收入与工资份额在整个世纪中呈现出U形变化。我们的数据表明，大萧条和第二次世界大战期间资本所有者所经历的重大冲击对最高资本收入产生了永久性影响。我们认为，严厉的所得税和遗产税政策可能阻碍了巨额财富从这些冲击中完全恢复。二战前，最高工资份额基本保持稳定，战争期间急剧下降，直到20世纪60年代末才开始恢复，但现在又高于二战前的水平。因此，从事经济活动的高收入人群已经取代了收入分配顶端的 Rentier（ Rentier 指依靠租金生活的阶层）。

abstract.text: This study examines individual behavior in two well-functioning marketplaces to investigate whether market experience eliminates the endowment effect. Field evidence from both markets suggests that individual behavior converges to the neoclassical prediction as market experience increases. In an experimental test of whether these observations are due to treatment (market experience) or selection (e.g., static preferences), I find that market experience plays a significant role in eliminating the endowment effect. I also find that these results are robust to institutional change and extend beyond the two marketplaces studied. Overall, this study provides strong evidence that market experience eliminates an important market anomaly.

10.1162/00335530360535144.abstractZh: 本研究考察了两个运作良好的市场中的个体行为，以探讨市场经验是否能够消除禀赋效应。来自两个市场的实地证据表明，随着市场经验的增加，个体行为逐渐趋向于新古典理论的预测。在一项实验测试中，我试图确定这些观察结果是由于处理因素（市场经验）还是选择因素（例如，静态偏好）所致。结果发现，市场经验在消除禀赋效应方面起着重要作用。此外，这些结果在制度变化的情况下依然成立，并且其影响范围超出了所研究的这两个市场。总体而言，这项研究提供了强有力的证据，表明市场经验能够消除一个重要的市场异常现象。

abstract.text: In six experiments we show that initial valuations of familiar products and simple hedonic experiences are strongly inuenced by arbitrary “anchors ” (some-times derived from a person’s social security number). Because subsequent valua-tions are also coherent with respect to salient differences in perceived quality or quantity of these products and experiences, the entire pattern of valuations can easily create an illusion of order, as if it is being generated by stable underlying preferences. The experiments show that this combinationof coherent arbitrariness (1) cannot be interpreted as a rational response to information, (2) does not decrease as a result of experience with a good, (3) is not necessarily reduced by market forces, and (4) is not unique to cash prices. The results imply that demand curves estimated from market data need not reveal true consumer preferences, in any normatively signicant sense of the term. Economic theories of valuation generally assume that prices of commodities and assets are derived from underlying “funda-mental ” values. For example, in nance theory, asset prices are believed to reect the market estimate of the discounted present value of the asset’s payoff stream. In labor theory, the supply of labor is established by the trade-off between the desire for con-sumption and the displeasure of work. Finally, and most impor-tantly for this paper, consumer microeconomics assumes that the demand curves for consumer products—chocolates, CDs, movies, vacations, drugs, etc.—can be ultimately traced to the valuation of pleasures that consumers anticipate receiving from these products. Because it is difcult, as a rule, to measure fundamental values directly, empirical tests of economic theory typically ex-amine whether the effects of changes in circumstances on valua-tions are consistent with theoretical prediction—for example, whether labor supply responds appropriately to a change in the wage rate, whether (compensated) demand curves for commodi-

10.1162/00335530360535153.abstractZh: 在六项实验中，我们发现对熟悉产品和简单享乐体验的初始估值会受到任意“锚点”的强烈影响（这些锚点有时来源于个人的社会安全号码）。由于后续估值也符合这些产品和体验在感知质量或数量上的显著差异，整个估值模式很容易产生一种有序的错觉，仿佛它是由稳定的基本偏好所驱动的。实验表明，这种连贯的任意性：（1）不能解释为对信息的理性反应；（2）不会因使用商品而减少；（3）不一定会因市场力量而减弱；（4）并不仅限于现金价格。这些结果意味着，从市场数据估计出的需求曲线未必能揭示真实的消费者偏好，无论从任何规范意义上讲都是如此。经济学中的估值理论通常假设商品和资产的价格来源于基本的“基本价值”。例如，在金融理论中，资产价格被认为反映了市场对资产收益流的折现现值估计。在劳动理论中，劳动力的供给是由消费欲望与工作不愉快之间的权衡所决定的。最后，对于本文而言最重要的是，消费者微观经济学假设，对消费品——巧克力、CD、电影、度假、药品等——的需求曲线最终可以追溯至消费者对这些产品所期望获得的快乐的估值。因为通常很难直接衡量基本价值，对经济理论的实证检验通常会考察环境变化对价值的影响是否符合理论预测——例如，劳动力供应是否恰当地响应工资率的变化，商品的需求曲线是否得到补偿……

abstract.text: Shareholder rights vary across firms. Using the incidence of 24 governance rules, we construct a “Governance Index” to proxy for the level of shareholder rights at about 1500 large firms during the 1990s. An investment strategy that bought firms in the lowest decile of the index (strongest rights) and sold firms in the highest decile of the index (weakest rights) would have earned abnormal returns of 8.5 percent per year during the sample period. We find that firms with stronger shareholder rights had higher firm value, higher profits, higher sales growth, lower capital expenditures, and made fewer corporate acquisitions.

10.1162/00335530360535162.abstractZh: 不同公司的股东权利存在差异。通过研究24项治理规则的实施情况，我们构建了一个“治理指数”，用以反映1990年代约1500家大型公司的股东权利水平。一种投资策略是购买指数中权利最弱的公司的股票，并出售指数中权利最强的公司的股票。在样本期间，这种投资策略每年可获得8.5%的异常回报。我们发现，股东权利较强的公司，其公司价值更高，利润更高，销售增长更快，资本支出更低，且企业收购次数也较少。

abstract.text: Between 1984 and 2001, the share of nonelderly adults receiving Social Security Disability Insurance income (DI) rose by 60 percent to 5.3 million beneficiaries. Rapid program growth despite improving aggregate health appears to be explained by reduced screening stringency, declining demand for less skilled workers, and an unforeseen increase in the earnings replacement rate. We estimate that the sum of these forces doubled the labor force exit propensity of displaced high school dropouts after 1984, lowering measured U. S. unemployment by one-half a percentage point. Steady state calculations augur a further 40 percent increase in the rate of DI receipt.

10.1162/00335530360535171.abstractZh: 在1984年至2001年间，获得社会保障残疾保险收入的非老年人比例上升了60%，达到530万受益人。尽管整体健康状况有所改善，但该计划的增长速度仍然很快，这似乎可以归因于筛查标准的降低、对低技能工人的需求下降，以及收入替代率的意外增加。我们估计，这些因素共同作用使得1984年后高中辍学者退出劳动力的倾向增加了两倍，从而使美国的实际失业率降低了0.5个百分点。稳态计算表明，残疾保险领取率还有可能进一步上升40%。

abstract.text: This paper uses a unique data set on corruption containing quantitative information on bribe payments of Ugandan firms. The data have two striking features: not all firms report that they need to pay bribes, and there is considerable variation in reported graft across firms facing similar institutions/policies. We propose an explanation for these patterns, based on differences in control rights and bargaining strength across firms. Consistent with the control rights/bargaining hypotheses, we find that the incidence of corruption can be explained by the variation in policies/regulations across industries. How much must bribe-paying firms pay? Combining the quantitative data on corruption with detailed financial information from the surveyed firms, we show that firms' “ability to pay” and firms' “refusal power” can explain a large part of the variation in bribes across graft-reporting firms. These results suggest that public officials act as price (bribe) discriminators, and that prices of public services are partly determined in order to extract bribes.

10.1162/00335530360535180.abstractZh: 本文使用了一种独特的腐败数据集，该数据集包含了乌干达企业贿赂支付的定量信息。这些数据有两个显著特点：并非所有企业都报告需要支付贿赂，而在面临类似制度/政策的企业之间，贿赂行为的报告情况也存在显著差异。我们提出了一种解释这些现象的理论，基于企业之间控制权和议价能力的差异。与控制权/议价假设一致，我们发现腐败的发生可以通过不同行业之间的政策/法规差异来解释。支付贿赂的企业需要支付多少？通过结合腐败的定量数据与受访企业的详细财务信息，我们发现企业的“支付能力”和“拒绝能力”可以解释不同企业之间贿赂金额差异的很大一部分。这些结果表明，公共官员充当了贿赂价格的歧视者，而公共服务的价格在一定程度上也是为了收取贿赂而决定的。

abstract.text: In many countries, banks lend to firms controlled by the bank's owners. We examine the benefits of related lending using a newly assembled data set for Mexico. Related lending is prevalent (20 percent of commercial loans) and takes place on better terms than arm's-length lending (annual interest rates are 4 percentage points lower). Related loans are 33 percent more likely to default and, when they do, have lower recovery rates (30 percent less) than unrelated ones. The evidence for Mexico in the 1990s supports the view that in some important settings related lending is a manifestation of looting.

10.1162/00335530360535199.abstractZh: 在许多国家，银行向由银行所有者控制的公司提供贷款。我们利用新收集到的墨西哥数据，研究了关联贷款的好处。关联贷款非常普遍，占商业贷款的20%，并且其条件比独立贷款更为优惠（年利率低4个百分点）。关联贷款的违约概率高出33%，而且一旦违约，回收率也更低（低30%）。1990年代墨西哥的实证数据支持这样一种观点：在某些重要情况下，关联贷款实际上是掠夺行为的一种表现。

abstract.text: Economists have long emphasized the importance of expectations in determining macroeconomic outcomes. Yet there has been almost no recent effort to model actual empirical expectations data; instead, macroeconomists usually simply assume that expectations are "rational." This paper shows that while empirical household expectations are not rational in the usual sense, expectational dynamics are well captured by a model in which households' views derive from news reports of the views of professional forecasters, which in turn may be rational. The model's estimates imply that people only occasionally pay attention to news reports; this inattention generates "stickyness" in aggregate expectations, with important macroeconomic consequences.

10.1162/00335530360535207.abstractZh: 经济学家长期以来一直强调预期在决定宏观经济结果中的重要性。然而，近期几乎没有人尝试对实际的预期数据进行建模；相反，宏观经济学家通常简单地假设预期是“理性的”。本文表明，虽然家庭的实际预期并不符合通常意义上的理性，但预期动态可以通过一个模型来很好地描述，该模型认为家庭的看法来源于专业预测者的观点报道，而这些观点报道本身可能是理性的。该模型的估计结果表明，人们只是偶尔关注新闻报道；这种不关注导致了总体预期的“粘性”，进而产生了重要的宏观经济后果。

abstract.text: We use data on life insurance contracts to study the properties of long-term contracts in a world where buyers cannot commit to a contract. The data are especially suited to test a theory of dynamic contracting since they include information on the entire profile of future premiums. All the patterns in the data fit the theoretical predictions of a model with symmetric learning and one-sided commitment à la Harris and Holmstom. The lack of commitment by consumers shapes contracts in the way predicted by the theory: all contracts involve front-loading (prepayment) of premiums. Front-loading generates a partial lock-in of consumers; more front-loading is associated with lower lapsation. Moreover, contracts that are more front-loaded have a lower present value of premiums over the period of coverage. This is consistent with the idea that front-loading enhances consumer commitment and that more front-loaded contracts retain better risk pools.

10.1162/00335530360535216.abstractZh: 我们利用人寿保险合同的数据来研究在买家无法承诺履行合同的情况下长期合同的特性。这些数据特别适合用于测试动态契约理论，因为它们包含了未来保费的全部信息。数据中的所有模式都符合具有对称学习能力和单向承诺的模型的理论预测，这一模型类似于Harris和Holmstom提出的模型。消费者的缺乏承诺使得合同按照理论预测的方式形成：所有合同都涉及提前支付保费。提前支付保费会部分锁定消费者的行为；更多的提前支付与更低的违约风险相关。此外，提前支付更多的合同在保险期间内的保费现值更低。这与提前支付能够增强消费者承诺的观点一致，而且提前支付更多的合同能够保留更好的风险池。

abstract.text: Recent immigrants tend to locate in ethnic “enclaves” within metropolitan areas. The economic consequence of living in such enclaves is still an unresolved issue. We use data from an immigrant policy initiative in Sweden, when government authorities distributed refugee immigrants across locales in a way that we argue is exogenous. This policy initiative provides a unique natural experiment, which allows us to estimate the causal effect on labor market outcomes of living in enclaves. We find substantive evidence of sorting across locations. When sorting is taken into account, living in enclaves improves labor market outcomes for less skilled immigrants: the earnings gain associated with a standard deviation increase in ethnic concentration is 13 percent. Furthermore, the quality of the enclave seems to matter. Members of high-income ethnic groups gain more from living in an enclave than members of low-income ethnic groups.

10.1162/00335530360535225.abstractZh: 近期移民往往选择居住在大都市区域内的种族“飞地”中。生活在这样的飞地所带来的经济后果仍然是一个未解决的问题。我们利用了瑞典一项移民政策计划的数据，该计划由政府当局以某种我们认为属于外生因素的方式将难民移民分配到不同的地区。这一政策计划提供了一个独特的自然实验，使我们能够估计生活在飞地中对劳动力市场结果的影响。我们发现，不同地区的移民之间存在明显的分化现象。当考虑到这种分化时，生活在飞地中的低技能移民在劳动力市场表现上有所改善：种族集中度每增加一个标准差，收入增加幅度为13%。此外，飞地本身的质量似乎也起着重要作用。高收入种族群体的成员从生活在飞地中获得的收益比低收入种族群体的成员更多。

abstract.text: We construct a model where the reputational concern of the long-run player to look good in the current period results in the loss of all surplus. This is in contrast to the bulk of the literature on reputations where such considerations mitigate myopic incentive problems. We also show that in models where all parties have long-run objectives, such losses can be avoided.

10.1162/00335530360698423.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中长期参与者在当期保持良好声誉的顾虑会导致所有 surplus 的丧失。这与大多数关于声誉的文献不同，在那些文献中，这样的考虑可以缓解短视的激励问题。我们还表明，在所有参与者都具有长期目标的模型中，这种损失是可以避免的。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a randomized experiment to shed light on the role of information and social interactions in employees' decisions to enroll in a Tax Deferred Account (TDA) retirement plan within a large university. The experiment encouraged a random sample of employees in a subset of departments to attend a benefits information fair organized by the university, by promising a monetary reward for attendance. The experiment multiplied by more than five the attendance rate of these treated individuals (relative to controls), and tripled that of untreated individuals within departments where some individuals were treated. TDA enrollment five and eleven months after the fair was significantly higher in departments where some individuals were treated than in departments where nobody was treated. However, the effect on TDA enrollment is almost as large for individuals in treated departments who did not receive the encouragement as for those who did. We provide three interpretations—differential treatment effects, social network effects, and motivational reward effects—to account for these results.

10.1162/00335530360698432.abstractZh: 本文分析了一项随机实验，旨在探讨信息和社交互动在员工决定加入大型大学内的递延税项退休计划中的作用。实验通过承诺给予金钱奖励，促使部分部门内的随机样本员工参加大学组织的福利信息展。结果显示，接受奖励的员工的参与率比对照组高出五倍以上，而在接受奖励的部门中，未接受奖励的员工的参与率则增加了两倍。实验发现，在那些部分员工接受了奖励的部门中，五个月和十一个月后加入递延税项退休计划的员工数量明显多于未接受奖励的部门。然而，对于接受奖励但未获得奖励的员工来说，递延税项退休计划的参与率与那些获得奖励的员工几乎相同。我们提出了三种解释来解释这些结果：差异性待遇效应、社交网络效应以及激励性奖励效应。

abstract.text: We develop an algorithm for detecting teacher cheating that combines information on unexpected test score fluctuations and suspicious patterns of answers for students in a classroom. Using data from the Chicago public schools, we estimate that serious cases of teacher or administrator cheating on standardized tests occur in a minimum of 4–5 percent of elementary school classrooms annually. The observed frequency of cheating appears to respond strongly to relatively minor changes in incentives. Our results highlight the fact that high-powered incentive systems, especially those with bright line rules, may induce unexpected behavioral distortions such as cheating. Statistical analysis, however, may provide a means of detecting illicit acts, despite the best attempts of perpetrators to keep them clandestine.

10.1162/00335530360698441.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种检测教师作弊的算法，该算法结合了关于学生测试成绩异常波动以及答案中的可疑模式的信息。通过芝加哥公立学校的数据分析，我们估计每年至少有4-5%的小学课堂存在教师或管理人员在标准化考试中作弊的严重情况。作弊的频率似乎对相对较小的激励变化有强烈的反应。我们的研究结果表明，高强度的激励系统，尤其是那些有明确规则的系统，可能会引发诸如作弊这样的意外行为。然而，统计分析可以提供一种检测非法行为的方法，即使作弊者试图将其隐藏起来。

abstract.text: Product and labor market deregulation reduce and redistribute rents, leading economic players to adjust to this new distribution. It typically comes with distribution and dynamic effects. To study these effects, we build a macroeconomic model on two central assumptions: monopolistic competition in the goods market, which determines the size of rents; and bargaining in the labor market, which determines the distribution of rents. Product market regulation determines entry costs and the degree of competition. Labor market regulation determines the bargaining power of workers. We show the effects of deregulation. We then use our results to discuss the political economy of deregulation, and recent macroeconomic evolutions in Europe.

10.1162/00335530360698450.abstractZh: 产品和劳动力市场的解除管制会减少和重新分配租金，促使经济参与者适应这种新的分配格局。这通常伴随着分配和动态效应。为了研究这些效应，我们基于两个核心假设构建了一个宏观经济模型：商品市场的垄断竞争决定了租金的规模；劳动力市场的讨价还价行为决定了租金的分配。产品市场的监管决定了进入成本以及竞争程度。劳动力市场的监管则决定了工人的议价能力。我们展示了解除管制的效应。随后，我们利用这些结果来探讨解除管制的政治经济因素，以及欧洲最近的宏观经济演变。

abstract.text: We propose a boundedly rational model of opinion formation in which individuals are subject to persuasion bias; that is, they fail to account for possible repetition in the information they receive. We show that persuasion bias implies the phenomenon of social influence, whereby one's influence on group opinions depends not only on accuracy, but also on how well-connected one is in the social network that determines communication. Persuasion bias also implies the phenomenon of unidimensional opinions; that is, individuals' opinions over a multidimensional set of issues converge to a single “left-right” spectrum. We explore the implications of our model in several natural settings, including political science and marketing, and we obtain a number of novel empirical implications.

10.1162/00335530360698469.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个有限理性意见形成模型，其中个体受到说服偏差的影响；也就是说，他们无法考虑到所接收信息中可能存在的重复情况。我们证明，说服偏差意味着社会影响现象的存在，即一个人对群体意见的影响不仅取决于信息的准确性，还取决于其在决定沟通的社会网络中的联系程度。说服偏差还意味着单一维度意见现象的存在；也就是说，个体对多维度问题的意见会收敛到单一的“左右”两极。我们在多个自然环境中探讨了该模型的含义，包括政治科学和市场营销领域，并得出了一些新的实证结论。

abstract.text: We use a simple model to outline the conditions under which corporate investment is sensitive to nonfundamental movements in stock prices. The key prediction is that stock prices have a stronger impact on the investment of “equity-dependent” firms—firms that need external equity to finance marginal investments. Using an index of equity dependence based on the work of Kaplan and Zingales, we find support for this hypothesis. In particular, firms that rank in the top quintile of the KZ index have investment that is almost three times as sensitive to stock prices as firms in the bottom quintile.

10.1162/00335530360698478.abstractZh: 我们使用一个简单的模型来概述企业投资对非基本股票价格变动的敏感性的条件。主要预测是，股票价格对“依赖股权”的企业投资的影响更为显著——这类企业需要外部股权来融资边际投资。基于Kaplan和Zingales的研究，我们构建了一个股权依赖指数，并发现这一假设得到了支持。具体而言，在KZ指数中排名前五分之一的企业，其投资对股票价格的敏感度几乎是后五分之一企业的三倍。

abstract.text: Why do similar households end up with very different levels of wealth? We show that differences in the attitudes and skills with which they approach financial planning are a significant factor. We use new and unique survey data to assess these differences and to measure each household's “propensity to plan.” We show that those with a higher such propensity spend more time developing financial plans, and that this shift in planning is associated with increased wealth. These findings are consistent with broad psychological evidence concerning the beneficial impacts of planning on goal pursuit. Those with a high propensity to plan may be better able to control their spending, and thereby achieve their goal of wealth accumulation. We find direct evidence supporting this effortful self-control channel in the very strong relationship we uncover between the propensity to plan and budgeting behavior.

10.1162/00335530360698487.abstractZh: 为什么相似的家庭最终会拥有截然不同的财富水平？我们发现，他们在财务规划方面的态度与技能差异是一个重要因素。我们利用新的、独特的调查数据来评估这些差异，并衡量每个家庭的“规划倾向”。我们发现，那些具有较高规划倾向的家庭会花费更多时间制定财务计划，而这种规划方式的转变与财富的增加相关联。这些发现与关于规划对目标追求有益影响的广泛心理学证据一致。那些具有较高规划倾向的人可能更能控制自己的支出，从而实现财富积累的目标。我们在规划倾向与预算行为之间发现的紧密关系，为这种努力型自我控制机制提供了直接证据。

abstract.text: Even though the provision of equal opportunities for men and women has been a priority in many countries, large gender differences prevail in competitive high-ranking positions. Suggested explanations include discrimination and differences in preferences and human capital. In this paper we present experimental evidence in support of an additional factor: women may be less effective than men in competitive environments, even if they are able to perform similarly in non-competitive environments. In a laboratory experiment we observe, as we increase the competitiveness of the environment, a significant increase in performance for men, but not for women. This results in a significant gender gap in performance in tournaments, while there is no gap when participants are paid according to piece rate. This effect is stronger when women have to compete against men than in single-sex competitive environments: this suggests that women may be able to perform in competitive environments per se.

10.1162/00335530360698496.abstractZh: 尽管为男女提供平等机会已成为许多国家的优先事项，但在竞争性的高级职位上，性别差异仍然显著。可能的解释包括歧视以及偏好和人力资本方面的差异。本文通过实验证据支持另一个因素：即使在非竞争环境中表现相似，女性在竞争环境中的表现可能不如男性。在实验室实验中，我们发现随着环境竞争性的增加，男性的表现显著提高，而女性的表现却没有变化。这导致在比赛中出现了显著的性别表现差距，而当参与者按件计酬时则不存在这种差距。当女性需要与男性竞争时，这种效应更为明显，这表明女性本身可能在竞争环境中能够表现出色。

abstract.text: This paper provides new evidence on the substitutability between private and pension wealth by exploiting the Italian pension reform of 1992. We use a difference-in-difference estimator that exploits the differential effects of the reform on individuals belonging to several year-of-birth cohorts and different occupational groups. We find convincing evidence that saving rates increase as a result of a reduction in pension wealth. By allowing for the possibility that substitutability changes with age, we find that substitutability is particularly high (and precisely estimated) for workers between 35 and 45.

10.1162/00335530360698504.abstractZh: 本文通过研究1992年的意大利养老金改革，为私人财富与养老金财富之间的可替代性提供了新的证据。我们采用了差异-差异估计方法，该方法能够利用改革对不同出生年份的人群以及不同职业群体的影响差异。研究发现，由于养老金财富的减少，储蓄率确实有所上升。考虑到可替代性会随年龄变化，我们发现35至45岁的工人之间的可替代性尤其高（且估计值较为准确）。

abstract.text: The 1981–1982 recession induced substantial variation across sites in air pollution reductions. This is used to estimate the impact of total suspended particulates (TSPs) on infant mortality. We find that a 1-percent reduction in TSPs results in a 0.35 percent decline in the infant mortality rate at the county level, implying that 2500 fewer infants died from 1980–1982 than would have in the absence of the TSPs reductions. Most of these effects are driven by fewer deaths occurring within one month of birth, suggesting that fetal exposure is a potential pathophysiologic mechanism. The analysis also reveals nonlinear effects of TSPs pollution and greater sensitivity of black infant mortality at the county level. Importantly, the estimates are stable across a variety of specifications.

10.1162/00335530360698513.abstractZh: 1981–1982年的经济衰退导致不同地区的空气污染减少情况存在显著差异。我们利用这一差异来估算总悬浮颗粒物对婴儿死亡率的影响。研究发现，总悬浮颗粒物减少1%，在县级层面会导致婴儿死亡率下降0.35%，这意味着1980–1982年间因空气污染导致的婴儿死亡人数比没有空气污染时减少了2500人。这些影响主要源于出生一个月内的死亡人数减少，这表明胎儿暴露于污染中的可能性是一个潜在的病理生理机制。分析还揭示了总悬浮颗粒物污染的非线性影响，以及县级层面黑人群体婴儿死亡率的更高敏感性。重要的是，这些估计结果在不同参数设定下仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: This paper examines the construction of a price index based on an estimated-demand system. In principle the method examined can produce a price index that takes account of the introduction of new products and quality changes in existing products. However, I isolate two key assumptions that have to be made in order to interpret the demand estimates into welfare measures. Using estimates of a brand-level demand system for ready-to-eat cereal, I demonstrate the empirical importance of the assumptions. For the data I use, depending on the interpretation of the demand estimates, a price index can range between a 35% increase over the five years examined to a 2.4% decrease.

10.1162/003465303765299792.abstractZh: 本文探讨了基于估计需求系统构建价格指数的方法。原则上，该方法能够生成考虑到新产品引入和现有产品质量变化的价格指数。然而，为了将需求估计转化为福利指标，需要做出两个关键假设。通过采用即食谷物品牌级需求系统的估计数据，本文证明了这些假设在实证上的重要性。对于所使用的数据，根据需求估计的解释方式，价格指数可能会从五年间增长35%到下降2.4%不等。
