abstract.text: Macroeconomics was born as a distinct field in the 1940s, as a part of the intellectual response to the Great Depression. The term then referred to the body of knowledge and expertise that we hoped would prevent the recurrence of that economic disaster. My thesis in this lecture is that macroeconomics in this original sense has succeeded: Its central problem of depression-prevention has been solved, for all practical purposes, and has in fact been solved for many decades. There remain important gains in welfare from better fiscal policies, but I argue that these are gains from providing people with better incentives to work and to save, not from better fine tuning of spending flows. Taking U.S. performance over the past 50 years as a benchmark, the potential for welfare gains from better long-run, supply side policies exceeds by far the potential from further improvements in short-run demand management. My plan is to review the theory and evidence leading to this conclusion. Section I outlines the general logic of quantitative welfare analysis, in which policy comparisons

10.1257/000282803321455133.abstractZh: 宏观经济学在20世纪40年代作为一个独立的学科诞生，作为对大萧条这一经济灾难的智力回应的一部分。当时，这一术语指的是我们希望能够防止该经济灾难再次发生的一系列知识和专业知识。我在本次讲座中的论点是，宏观经济学在最初的意义上已经取得了成功：其关于防止经济衰退的核心问题，实际上已经得到了解决，并且这种解决已经持续了数十年。尽管通过更好的财政政策还可以进一步改善福利状况，但我认为这些改进主要体现在为人们提供更好的工作动力和储蓄激励上，而不是通过更精细地调整支出流动来实现。以过去50年美国的发展情况作为基准，从更长期的供给侧政策中获得的福利提升潜力，远远超过在短期需求管理上进一步改进所带来的潜力。我的计划是回顾导致这一结论的理论和证据。第一部分概述了定量福利分析的一般逻辑，其中包含了政策比较的内容。

abstract.text: We examine retail and wholesale prices for a large supermarket chain over seven and one-half years. We find that prices fall on average during seasonal demand peaks for a product, largely due to changes in retail margins. Retail margins for specific goods fall during peak demand periods for that good, even if these periods do not coincide with aggregate demand peaks for the retailer. This is consistent with “loss-leader” models of retailer competition. Models stressing cyclical demand elasticities or cyclical firm conduct are less consistent with our findings. Manufacturer behavior plays a limited role in the countercyclicality of prices.

10.1257/000282803321455142.abstractZh: 我们调查了一家大型超市连锁企业的零售和批发价格，时间跨度为七年半。研究发现，在产品的季节性需求高峰期间，价格平均会下降，这主要是由于零售利润的变化所致。对于特定商品而言，即使这些高峰期与零售商的整体需求高峰不一致，其零售利润也会在需求高峰期下降。这一结果与“亏损主导型”零售商竞争模型相符。而强调周期性需求弹性或周期性企业行为的模型则与我们的研究结果不太一致。在价格的反周期性变化中，制造商的行为作用有限。

abstract.text: Using a new data set consisting of six years of real-time exchange-rate quotations, macroeconomic expectations, and macroeconomic realizations, we characterize the conditional means of U.S. dollar spot exchange rates. In particular, we find that announcement surprises produce conditional mean jumps; hence high-frequency exchange-rate dynamics are linked to fundamentals. The details of the linkage are intriguing and include announcement timing and sign effects. The sign effect refers to the fact that the market reacts to news in an asymmetric fashion: bad news has greater impact than good news, which we relate to recent theoretical work on information processing and price discovery.

10.1257/000282803321455151.abstractZh: 我们利用一个包含六年实时汇率报价、宏观经济预期和宏观经济实际结果的新数据集，对美元即期汇率的条件均值进行了分析。研究发现，公告的意外情况会导致汇率条件均值的跳跃；因此，高频汇率动态与基本面因素密切相关。这种关联的细节非常有趣，包括公告的时机和符号效应。符号效应指的是市场对新闻的反应是不对称的：坏消息的影响大于好消息，这与近期关于信息处理和价格发现的理论研究有关。

abstract.text: This paper studies the evolution of sectoral concentration in relation to the level of per capita income. We show that various measures of sectoral concentration follow a U-shaped pattern across a wide variety of data sources: countries first diversify, in the sense that economic activity is spread more equally across sectors, but there exists, relatively late in the development process, a point at which they start specializing again. We discuss this finding in light of existing theories of trade and growth, which generally predict a monotonic relationship between income and diversification.

10.1257/000282803321455160.abstractZh: 本文研究了部门集中度与人均收入水平之间的关系演变。我们发现，不同衡量指标下的部门集中度呈现出U形模式，这一模式在多种数据来源中均得到验证：各国最初会实现活动在各部门之间的更均衡分布，但相对较晚的发展阶段会出现一个节点，此时各部门开始再次专业化。我们结合现有的贸易与增长理论来探讨这一发现，这些理论通常预测收入与部门多样化之间存在单调关系。

abstract.text: This paper provides an analytical characterization of Markov perfect equilibria in a model with repeated voting, where agents vote over distortionary income redistribution. A key result is that the future constituency for redistributive policies depends positively on current redistribution, since this affects both private investments and the future distribution of voters. The model features multiple equilibria. In some equilibria, positive redistribution persists forever. In other equilibria, even a majority of beneficiaries of redistribution vote strategically so as to induce the end of the welfare state next period. Skill-biased technical change makes the survival of the welfare state less likely.

10.1257/000282803321455179.abstractZh: 本文对具有重复投票机制的模型中马尔可夫完美均衡进行了分析性描述。在该模型中，代理人会投票决定是否接受扭曲性的收入再分配政策。一个关键结论是，再分配政策的未来支持程度与当前的再分配政策呈正相关，因为这一政策既会影响私人投资，也会影响选民未来的分布。该模型存在多个均衡状态。在某些均衡状态下，积极的再分配政策会持续存在；而在其他均衡状态下，甚至大多数受益者都会采取策略性投票，以促使福利国家在下个周期结束。基于技能差异的技术变革使得福利国家的存续可能性降低。

abstract.text: This article investigates the economic effects of conflict, using the terrorist conflict in the Basque Country as a case study. We find that, after the outbreak of terrorism in the late 1960's, per capita GDP in the Basque Country declined about 10 percentage points relative to a synthetic control region without terrorism. In addition, we use the 1998–1999 truce as a natural experiment. We find that stocks of firms with a significant part of their business in the Basque Country showed a positive relative performance when truce became credible, and a negative relative performance at the end of the cease-fire.

10.1257/000282803321455188.abstractZh: 本文以巴斯克地区的恐怖冲突为案例研究，探讨了冲突的经济影响。研究发现，自20世纪60年代末恐怖活动爆发以来，巴斯克地区的人均GDP相比没有恐怖活动的对照组下降了约10个百分点。此外，我们将1998-1999年的停火协议视为一个自然实验。研究发现，当停火协议变得可信时，那些在巴斯克地区拥有大量业务的企业的股票表现呈现积极趋势；而在停火协议结束之际，这些企业的股票表现则呈现消极趋势。

abstract.text: Starting from an example of the Allies' decision to feint at Calais and attack Normandy on D-Day, this paper models misrepresentation of intentions to competitors or enemies. Allowing for the possibility of bounded strategic rationality and rational players' responses to it yields a sensible account of lying via costless, noiseless messages. In some leading cases, the model has generically unique pure-strategy sequential equilibria, in which rational players exploit boundedly rational players, but are not themselves fooled. In others, the model has generically essentially unique mixed-strategy sequential equilibria, in which rational players' strategies protect all players from exploitation.

10.1257/000282803321455197.abstractZh: 本文以盟军在诺曼底登陆日选择假意进攻加来而非诺曼底为例，模拟了对竞争对手或敌人的意图误导行为。在考虑有限战略理性以及理性玩家对此的反应后，模型能够合理地解释通过无成本、无噪音的信息进行欺骗的行为。在某些典型情况下，模型存在具有普遍唯一性的纯策略序贯均衡，在这种均衡中，理性玩家会利用有限理性玩家，但自身不会被欺骗。而在其他情况下，模型存在具有普遍唯一性的混合策略序贯均衡，在这种均衡中，理性玩家的策略能够保护所有玩家免受剥削。

abstract.text: The economics of hunting and gathering must have driven the biological evolution of human characteristics, since hunter-gatherer societies prevailed for the two million years of human history. These societies feature huge intergenerational resource flows, suggesting that these resource flows should replace fertility as the key demographic consideration. It is then theoretically expected that life expectancy and brain size would increase simultaneously, as apparently occurred during our evolutionary history. The brain here is considered as a direct form of bodily investment, but also crucially as facilitating further indirect investment by means of learning-by-doing.

10.1257/000282803321455205.abstractZh: 狩猎采集经济无疑推动了人类特征的生物进化，因为在人类历史的两百万年里，狩猎采集社会一直占据主导地位。这些社会具有巨大的代际资源流动，这表明资源流动应该取代生育能力成为关键的人口统计因素。理论上，预期寿命和大脑大小会同时增加，正如在人类的进化历史中确实发生的那样。这里的大脑被视为一种直接的身体投资，但同样重要的是，它通过实践学习的方式促进了进一步的间接投资。

abstract.text: Gravity equations have been widely used to infer trade flow effects of various institutional arrangements. We show that estimated gravity equations do not have a theoretical foundation. This implies both that estimation suffers from omitted variables bias and that comparative statics analysis is unfounded. We develop a method that (i) consistently and efficiently estimates a theoretical gravity equation and (ii) correctly calculates the comparative statics of trade frictions. We apply the method to solve the famous McCallum border puzzle. Applying our method, we find that national borders reduce trade between industrialized countries by moderate amounts of 20–50 percent.

10.1257/000282803321455214.abstractZh: 重力方程已被广泛用于推断各种制度安排对贸易流动的影响。我们发现，所估计的重力方程缺乏理论依据。这意味着这种估计方法存在遗漏变量偏差的问题，同时比较静态分析也是没有根据的。我们开发了一种方法，该方法能够（i）一致且高效地估计理论重力方程，以及（ii）正确计算贸易摩擦的比较静态结果。我们将该方法应用于解决著名的McCallum边界难题。通过应用我们的方法，我们发现国家边界会使工业化国家之间的贸易减少20%到50%。

abstract.text: We study nearly 7,000 retirement accounts during the April 1994–August 1998 period. Several interesting patterns emerge. Most asset allocations are extreme (either 100 percent or zero percent in equities) and there is inertia in asset allocations. Equity allocations are higher for males, married investors, and for investors with higher earnings and more seniority on the job; equity allocations are lower for older investors. There is very limited portfolio reshuffling, in sharp contrast to discount brokerage accounts. Daily changes in equity allocations correlate only weakly with same-day equity returns and do not correlate with future equity returns.

10.1257/000282803321455223.abstractZh: 我们研究了1994年4月至1998年8月期间近7,000个退休账户的数据。研究发现了一些有趣的现象。大多数资产配置都较为极端，要么完全投资于股票，要么完全不投资股票。资产配置在投资者之间也存在惯性现象。男性、已婚投资者以及收入较高、工作年限较长的投资者在股票配置上比例较高；而年龄较大的投资者在股票配置上比例较低。与折扣经纪账户相比，这些账户中的资产重新配置非常有限。股票配置的每日变化与当天的股票回报相关性较弱，且与未来的股票回报也没有相关性。

abstract.text: This paper extends the standard principal–agent model to allow for subjective evaluation. The optimal contract results in more compressed pay relative to the case with verifiable performance measures. Moreover, discrimination against an individual implies lower pay and performance, suggesting that the extent of discrimination as measured after controlling for performance may underestimate the level of true discrimination. Finally, the optimal contract entails the use of bonus pay rather than the threat of dismissal, hence neither “efficiency wages” nor the right to dismiss an employee are necessary ingredients for an optimal incentive contract.

10.1257/000282803321455232.abstractZh: 本文将标准的主客体模型扩展为允许主观评估。最优合同导致相对于可验证绩效指标的案例而言，薪酬更为压缩。此外，对个人的歧视意味着较低的薪酬和绩效，这表明在控制绩效因素后所测量的歧视程度可能会低估真实的歧视程度。最后，最优合同需要使用奖金而非解雇威胁作为激励手段，因此“效率工资”或解雇员工的权利并非最优激励合同所必需的要素。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of lobbying by corporations when investments are irreversible and government cannot commit to tax policies. We show that industries which rely more heavily on sunk capital lobby more vigorously and are generally more successful in obtaining tax breaks. Thus lobbying can mitigate the capital levy problem. Nevertheless, these industries invest less in long-run equilibrium than more flexible ones. We then consider the effects of relaxing legal restrictions on corporate lobbying. When the deadweight costs of lobbying fall, taxes on sunk capital tend to fall, but political contributions may rise, as lobbyists compete more intensively for political favors. On balance, a ban of lobbying may therefore cause investment to rise or fall.

10.1257/000282803321455241.abstractZh: 本文研究了在投资不可逆转且政府无法承诺税收政策的情况下，企业游说行为的影响。我们发现，那些依赖沉没资本的行业会进行更积极的游说，并且在获得税收优惠方面通常更为成功。因此，游说可以缓解资本负担问题。然而，这些行业在长期均衡中的投资水平低于那些更灵活的行业。接下来，我们探讨了放宽企业游说法律限制的影响。当游说的无谓成本降低时，沉没资本的税收往往会下降，但政治捐款可能会上升，因为游说者会更加激烈地竞争政治支持。总体而言，禁止游说可能会导致投资的增加或减少。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the relationship between economic reform and the democratic process to ask the following question: Does the likelihood of adoption of an economic reform increase with an increase in the efficiency benefits from that reform? A priori we might expect that this likelihood should increase monotonically, for two reasons. First, economic reform results in an increase in the size of the national pie. If the government has the ability to make compensatory tax-transfers, an increase in each citizen's income is possible. Second, a larger economic reform results in a greater number of winners. This might also be expected to reinforce the political support for economic reform. So we should expect a reform with greater efficiency benefits to a larger population to have a greater chance of adoption by the government. However, in this paper we show that this intuition is mistaken. In particular, we demonstrate that there exists a certain non-monotonicity between the distribution of winners from economic reform and the probability of its adoption. An increase in the number of winners may lower, rather than increase, the likelihood of adoption of economic reform. In particular, even though reforms that benefit a minority or an overwhelming majority are adopted, reforms that benefit a smaller majority are not adopted.

10.1257/000282803321455269.abstractZh: 本文分析了经济改革与民主进程之间的关系，提出了以下问题：经济改革的效率收益增加时，其被采纳的可能性是否也会增加？从直觉来看，我们可能会认为这种可能性应该呈单调增加，原因有二。首先，经济改革会导致国家财富的增加。如果政府有能力进行补偿性税收转移，那么每个公民的收入都有可能增加。其次，规模更大的经济改革会带来更多的受益者，这也可能增强对经济改革的政治支持。因此，我们认为效率收益更大且惠及更多人的改革，被政府采纳的可能性也会更大。然而，本文表明这种直觉是错误的。具体来说，我们发现经济改革带来的受益者分布与改革被采纳的概率之间存在一定的非单调性。受益者数量的增加可能会降低而不是增加经济改革被采纳的可能性。特别是，即使那些惠及少数人或绝大多数人的改革被采纳了，那些惠及较小多数人的改革却未被采纳。

abstract.text: In a standard New Keynesian model, a myopic central bank concerned with stabilizing inflation and changes in the output gap will implement a policy under discretion that replicates the optimal, timeless perspective, precommitment policy. By stabilizing output gap changes, the central bank imparts inertia into output and inflation that is absent under pure discretion. Even a fully optimizing (i.e., non-myopic) central bank operating in a discretionary policy environment achieves better social outcomes if it focuses on inflation and changes in the output gap than are achieved under inflation targeting.

10.1257/000282803321455278.abstractZh: 在标准的新凯恩斯主义模型中，一个目光短浅的中央银行为了稳定通货膨胀和产出缺口的变化，会实施一种基于自由裁量的政策，这种政策能够复制最优的、不受时间影响的决策。通过稳定产出缺口的变化，中央银行为产出和通货膨胀带来了一种惯性，这种惯性在纯粹的自由裁量政策环境下是不存在的。即使是一个完全优化的（即非目光短浅的）中央银行，在自由裁量政策环境下运作，如果它专注于通货膨胀和产出缺口的变化，也会取得比通货膨胀目标制更好的社会成果。

abstract.text: Does student financial aid increase college attendance, or simply subsidize costs for infra-marginal students? Settling the question empirically is a challenge, because aid is correlated with many characteristics that influence schooling decisions. A shift in financial aid policy that affects some youth but not others can provide an identifying source of variation in aid. In 1982, Congress eliminated the Social Security student benefit program, which at its peak provided grants totaling $3.9 billion a year (amounts are in constant 2000 dollars) to one out of eight college students. I use difference-in-differences analysis to evaluate the effect of this program on schooling outcomes. Using the death of a parent to proxy for Social Security beneficiary status, I find that the college attendance of the affected group dropped by more than a third, and schooling by two-thirds of a year. Offering $1,000 of grant aid increases the probability of attending college by 3.6 percentage points and years of completed schooling by a tenth of a year. Aid eligibility also appears to have a positive impact on school quality.

10.1257/000282803321455287.abstractZh: 学生经济援助是增加了大学入学率，还是仅仅为低收入学生提供了费用补贴？从实证角度解决这一问题是一个挑战，因为经济援助与许多影响教育决策的因素相关。如果经济援助政策的变化只影响某些群体，那么这种差异可以成为衡量援助效果的一个指标。1982年，国会取消了社会保障学生福利计划，该计划在鼎盛时期每年向八分之一的大学生提供总计39亿美元的资金（金额以2000年不变价计算）。我使用差异-差异分析方法来评估该计划对教育成果的影响。通过以父母死亡作为社会保障受益人的替代指标，我发现受影响群体的大学入学率下降了三分之一以上，教育年限减少了三分之二。提供1000美元的助学金可以将上大学的概率提高3.6个百分点，教育年限增加十分之一年。获得经济援助资格似乎也对教育质量有积极影响。

abstract.text: Pianists who achieve high scores in the Queen Elizabeth musical competition are rewarded by subsequent success.This is not surprising in itself, but it is not immediately clear whether this is caused by the score or because those who have high scores are better pianists.Data on eleven consecutive competitions make it possible to distinguish between the two explanations, since an unexpected situation allows us to use an instrumental variable (the randomly assigned order in which musicians appear at the competition), uncorrelated with ability, but correlated with the results of the competition.

10.1257/000282803321455296.abstractZh: 在女王伊丽莎白音乐比赛中取得高分的钢琴家，随后会获得更多的成功。这本身并不奇怪，但尚不清楚这是否是由于分数本身的原因，还是因为那些取得高分的人本身就是更优秀的钢琴家。通过对连续十一次比赛的数据分析，可以区分这两种解释。由于存在一种意外的情况，我们可以使用一个与能力无关，但与比赛结果相关的工具变量（即音乐家在比赛中出现的随机顺序）。

abstract.text: When a firm offers several tariff options to its customers, the possibility arises that they will make an ex post mistake in tariff choice. This occurs since consumers cannot commit to a certain purchase level at the time they subscribe to the service option and, thus, they might find out later that a different choice of tariff could have resulted in a lower payment for their actual level of consumption. This is a common feature of increasingly important subscriptions markets, in which buyers and sellers maintain long-term, nonanonymous relations and where learning induces interesting dynamics. On the one hand, buyers may learn their taste over time, thus making the right choice as times goes by; on the other hand, the seller may design options to identify the “type” of each buyer and, if possible, to extract a higher proportion of their consumer surplus by offering tariff options that are better tailored to the profile of the consumer. This paper focuses on the first type of learning. In turn I document buyer behavior in a subscriptions market using data from a tariff experiment run by South Central Bell (SCB) in Kentucky during the second half of 1986. The most frequently studied case of subscriptions markets is the choice among Optional Calling Plans (OCPs) in the telephone industry. This paper shows that, contrary to the conven-

10.1257/000282803321455304.abstractZh: 当一家公司向客户提供多种资费选项时，客户可能会在资费选择上犯下事后错误。这种情况的发生是因为消费者在订阅服务选项时无法承诺特定的消费水平，因此他们可能会后来发现，选择不同的资费反而能让他们为实际消费水平支付更低的费用。这是日益重要的订阅市场的常见现象，在这个市场中，买卖双方保持着长期的、非匿名的关系，而学习行为则会产生有趣的动态变化。一方面，买家可能会随着时间了解自己的偏好，从而做出正确的选择；另一方面，卖家可能会设计各种选项来识别每个买家的“类型”，并尽可能通过提供更符合消费者特征的资费选项来提取更高的消费者剩余。本文重点关注第一种类型的学习行为。我通过1986年下半年由肯塔基州南中央贝尔公司进行的资费实验数据，来研究订阅市场中的买家行为。订阅市场中最常研究的案例是电话行业中的可选通话计划选择。本文表明，与人们通常认为的相反，这种情况确实会发生。

abstract.text: Real energy prices jumped by 80% from 1973 to 1974.At the same time, the market value of firms plunged by 40%.Is the energy crisis responsible for the dramatic decline in the stock market?Many economists, starting with Baily (1981), have concluded that higher energy prices resulted in the effective scrappage of a substantial fraction of the capital stock.The fall in the stock market reflected the fall in the value of firms' assets, in this view.Because capital is never scrapped in a neoclassical model of capital, I build a model based on the putty-clay specification, where different vintages of capital are imperfect substitutes.I distinguish three factors: capital, energy, and labor.I take the production technology ex ante to be Cobb-Douglas with constant returns to scale, but for capital goods already installed, production possibilities take the Leontief form: there is no substitutability of capital, energy, and labor ex post.I use the model to evaluate the impact of the energy price shock on the securities market in 1974.As a preliminary to the analysis based on the model, I calculate an upper bound on the effect of the energy price shock in a partial equilibrium puttyclay model, holding the real wage fixed.An 80% increase in real energy prices leads to a 10% decline in the market value of installed machines.Even this small effect exceeds what I find in the general equilibrium model.There, the energy price shock causes a decrease in the real wage, sufficient to offset the adverse impact of the increase in the energy cost on the value of capital.An 80% increase in the real energy prices causes the market value to decrease by only 2.2%.The theoretical analysis is supported by the observed decline in the real wage in 1974 of a magnitude comparable to that predicted by the model.Finally, I conduct a cross-industry event study that shows that the energy share of production costs cannot explain the cross-sectional patterns of the decline of stock prices from 1972 to 1974.The theoretical analysis and empirical evidence indicate that a broader set of forces was at work in causing the market downfall in 1974 than those effects of energy prices captured in the putty-clay model that appears to inform the thinking of most economists on this question.

10.1257/000282803321455313.abstractZh: 从1973年到1974年，实际能源价格上升了80%。与此同时，企业的市场价值下降了40%。能源危机是否导致了股票市场的剧烈下跌？许多经济学家，从贝利在1981年的研究开始，认为较高的能源价格导致了大量资本存量的实际报废。从这一观点来看，股票市场的下跌反映了企业资产价值的下降。因为在新古典资本模型中，资本永远不会被报废。我建立了一个基于“油泥-黏土”模型的模型，在这个模型中，不同年代的资本是不完美的替代品。我区分了三个因素：资本、能源和劳动力。我假设生产技术是 Cobb-Douglas 型，具有规模报酬不变，但对于已经安装好的资本品，生产可能性遵循 Leontief 形式：资本、能源和劳动力在事后上不可替代。我使用这个模型来评估1974年能源价格冲击对证券市场的影響。作为基于该模型分析的初步步骤，我在一个部分均衡的“油泥-黏土”模型中计算了能源价格冲击的影响上限，同时固定实际工资。实际能源价格上升80%会导致已安装机器的市场价值下降10%。即使这种微小的效应也超过了我在一般均衡模型中发现的效应。在那里，能源价格冲击导致实际工资的下降，足以抵消能源成本增加对资本价值的不利影响。实际能源价格上升80%仅导致市场价值下降2.2%。理论分析得到了1974年实际工资下降的观测结果的支持，其幅度与模型预测的结果相当。最后，我进行了跨行业事件分析。一项研究表明，生产成本中的能源占比无法解释1972年至1974年间股票价格下降的横向模式。理论分析和实证证据表明，1974年市场崩溃的成因涉及更广泛的力量，这些力量超出了“油泥模型”所捕捉的能源价格影响范围，而该模型似乎为大多数经济学家对这个问题的思考提供了依据。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of seasonal affective disorder (SAD) in the seasonal time-variation of stock market returns. SAD is an extensively documented medical condition whereby the shortness of the days in fall and winter leads to depression for many people. Experimental research in psychology and economics indicates that depression, in turn, causes heightened risk aversion. Building on these links between the length of day, depression, and risk aversion, we provide international evidence that stock market returns vary seasonally with the length of the day, a result we call the SAD effect. Using data from numerous stock exchanges and controlling for well-known market seasonals as well as other environmental factors, stock returns are shown to be significantly related to the amount of daylight through the fall and winter. Patterns at different latitudes and in both hemispheres provide compelling evidence of a link between seasonal depression and seasonal variation in stock returns: Higher latitude markets show more pronounced SAD effects and results in the Southern Hemisphere are six months out of phase, as are the seasons. Overall, the economic magnitude of the SAD effect is large.

10.1257/000282803321455322.abstractZh: 本文探讨了季节性情感障碍（SAD）在股市收益季节性变化中的作用。SAD是一种被广泛记录的医学状况，秋季和冬季白天变短会导致许多人出现抑郁症状。心理学和经济学领域的实验研究表明，抑郁情绪会加剧风险厌恶心理。基于白天长度、抑郁情绪与风险厌恶之间的关联，我们提供了国际层面的证据，证明股市收益会随着白天长度的季节性变化而波动，这一结果被称为SAD效应。通过利用多个股票交易所的数据，并控制已知的市场季节性因素及其他环境因素，我们发现股市收益与秋季和冬季的日照时间存在显著关系。不同纬度和两个半球地区的样本数据均表明，季节性抑郁与股市收益的季节性变化之间存在关联：高纬度地区的市场表现出更为明显的SAD效应，而南半球市场的表现则与其所在地区的季节相差六个月。总体而言，SAD效应的经济影响非常显著。

abstract.text: In this paper we show that the spread of the classical gold standard in the late nineteenth century increased international trade flows. This positive effect was compounded whenever a group of countries formed a monetary union. Applying the gravity model of trade to more than 1,100 country pairs during the 1870-1910 period, we find that two countries on gold would trade 60 percent more with each other than with countries on a different monetary standard. Moreover, a monetary union would more than double bilateral trade flows. Our findings are relevant for current discussions on alternative monetary arrangements for the twenty-first century.

10.1257/000282803321455331.abstractZh: 本文指出，19世纪末古典金本位制的普及促进了国际贸易流量的增加。当一组国家形成货币联盟时，这种积极效应更为显著。通过对1870至1910年间1100多个国家之间的贸易数据应用引力模型分析，我们发现采用金本位制的国家之间贸易额比采用其他货币制度的国家之间高出60%。此外，货币联盟还能使双边贸易流量增加一倍以上。我们的研究结果对于当前关于21世纪替代货币安排的讨论具有参考价值。

abstract.text: This study examines life insurance holdings and financial vulnerabilities among couples approaching retirement age. Two separate concerns motivate our analysis. First, there are reasons to suspect that life insurance coverage may be poorly correlated with underlying financial vulnerabilities. A well-known insurance industry adage holds that life insurance is “sold and not bought.” Alternatively, households may purchase long-term policies relatively early in life, and subsequently fail to adjust coverage appropriately because of inertia and/or other psychological considerations. Second, households that purchase little or no life insurance may leave either or both spouses at risk of serious financial consequences.

10.1257/000282803321455340.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了接近退休年龄的夫妇在人寿保险持有情况与财务脆弱性之间的关系。我们的分析受到两个问题的驱动。首先，有理由怀疑人寿保险覆盖与潜在的财务脆弱性之间可能存在关联不足的情况。保险行业有一句著名的谚语：“人寿保险是出售而非购买。”此外，家庭可能在生命早期就购买长期保险，但由于惯性或其他心理因素，未能及时调整保险覆盖。其次，几乎没有或完全没有购买人寿保险的家庭，可能会让配偶面临严重的财务后果。

abstract.text: A demand for behavioral norms arises when members of a group have individual incentives to take actions that reduce the group's overall welfare (James S. Coleman, 1990). Norms require enforcement with a system of sanctions that penalize deviations from acceptable behavior (George C. Homans, 1961). Formal sanctions include fines or restrictions implemented by a legal system or private individuals that impose costs of money and time on the offender. However, informal sanctions such as peer pressure, gossip, or social ostracism might in some cases also be effective deterrents, and expressions of social acceptance might be effective in encouraging group-oriented behavior (Peter M. Blau, 1964). Indeed, the fact that expressions of approval and disapproval are commonly observed in human interaction suggests that they must influence the behavior of at least some individuals. In recognition of the importance of informal sanctions, economists have integrated phenomena such as peer pressure (Eugene Kandel and Edward P. Lazear, 1992; John M. Barron and Kathy Paulson-Gjerde, 1997), and the avoidance of social disapproval (George A. Akerlof, 1980; Heinz Hollander, 1990; Assar Lindbeck et al., 1999) into theoretical models. Social pressures are thought to be a major factor behind high voter participation (Carol-Jean Uhlaner, 1989; Stephen Knack, 1992) and compliance with the law (Tom R. Tyler, 1990).

10.1257/000282803321455359.abstractZh: 当群体中的成员有动机采取减少群体整体福利的行为时，就会产生对行为规范的需求（James S. Coleman, 1990）。规范需要依靠一套制裁机制来实施，以惩罚偏离可接受行为的行为（George C. Homans, 1961）。正式的制裁包括由法律系统或私人个体实施的罚款或限制措施，这些制裁会给违规者带来金钱和时间上的成本。然而，非正式的制裁，如同伴压力、闲言碎语或社会排斥，在某些情况下也可能起到有效的威慑作用，而社会认可的表达也可能有助于鼓励群体导向的行为（Peter M. Blau, 1964）。事实上，人类互动中常见的认可和反对表达表明，它们至少对某些个体的行为产生了影响。鉴于非正式制裁的重要性，经济学家将诸如同伴压力（Eugene Kandel和Edward P. Lazear, 1992；John M. Barron和Kathy Paulson-Gjerde, 1997）以及避免社会不认可的行为（George A. Akerlof, 1980；Heinz Hollander, 1990；Assar Lindbeck等, 1999）等现象纳入理论模型中。社会压力被认为是高选民参与率（Carol-Jean Uhlaner, 1989；Stephen Knack, 1992）和遵守法律行为的主要因素（Tom R. Tyler, 1990）。

abstract.text: Many households received income tax rebates in 2001 of $300 or $600. These rebates represented advance payments of the tax cut from the new 10 percent tax bracket. Based on a survey of a representative sample of households, this paper finds that only 22 percent of households receiving the rebate would spent it. Instead, they would either save it or use it to pay off debt. This very low rate of spending represents a striking break with past behavior, which would have suggested a much higher rate of spending. The low spending rate implies that the tax rebate provided a very limited stimulus to aggregate demand.

10.1257/000282803321455368.abstractZh: 在2001年，许多家庭获得了300或600美元的所得税退税。这些退税实际上是对新10%税率档次减税的提前支付。根据对代表性家庭样本的调查，本文发现只有22%的接受退税的家庭会将其使用。相反，这些家庭要么将退税存起来，要么用來偿还债务。如此低的支出率与过去的行为形成了显著的反差，过去人们通常会将退税用于消费。较低的支出率意味着退税对总需求的刺激作用非常有限。

abstract.text: A central implication of the life-cycle/permanentincome hypothesis (LC/PIH) is that consumers should not respond to predictable changes in their income. 1 To test this hypothesis, a number of recent papers have exploited natural experiments to identify anticipated income changes. 2 In particular, recent work by Parker (1999) uses the change in after-tax income due to the cap on earnings subject to the Social Security tax, and a related paper by Souleles (1999) examines the response of consumption to income tax refunds. Surprisingly, Parker and Souleles find that even when income is expected to change within the year, expenditure is excessively sensitive to the timing of the income change. While their results can be interpreted as evidence that our canonical model of consumption is inadequate, an alternative explanation is that the anticipated income changes they exploit are small and irregular, and that households will not bother to

10.1257/000282803321455377.abstractZh: 生命周期/永久收入假说的一个核心观点是，消费者不应对其收入的预期变化作出反应。为了验证这一假说，许多近期的研究利用自然实验来识别预期的收入变化。特别是，Parker在1999年的研究利用了因社会保障税而对收入的影响，而Souleles在1999年的研究则探讨了消费对所得税返还的反应。令人惊讶的是，Parker和Souleles发现，即使收入预计会在一年内发生变化，支出对收入变化的时间点也表现出过度敏感。虽然他们的研究结果可以被解释为我们的消费模型不够完善的证据，但另一种解释是，他们所利用的预期收入变化幅度较小且不规则，因此家庭不会去关注这些变化。

abstract.text: This paper examines the response of consumption expenditures to the monthly receipt of Social Security checks. Since the amount and arrival date of these checks are known to the recipients, the basic Life-Cycle/Permanent Income Hypothesis (LCPIH) predicts that consumption should not respond to the receipt of these checks. Using daily diary data from the Consumer Expenditure Survey, this paper finds evidence that both the dollar amount and probability of expenditures increase immediately following the receipt of this check. Most relevant to testing the LCPIH, categories of instantaneous consumption expenditure such as food away from home increase on the check arrival date. The response is found primarily amongst households for whom Social Security is the primary source of income. However, the magnitude of the estimated responses are relatively small and do not suggest that the utility losses are large from this non-smoothing behavior.

10.1257/000282803321455386.abstractZh: 本文研究了消费支出对每月收到社会保障支票的反应。由于领取者知道支票的金额和领取日期，基本的生命周期/永久收入假说预测消费支出不应对此产生反应。通过消费者支出调查中的日常日记数据，本文发现，支票领取后，消费金额和消费概率都会立即增加。对于检验生命周期/永久收入假说而言，尤为重要的是，诸如外出就餐等即时消费支出类别在支票领取当天就会增加。这种反应主要出现在以社会保障为主要收入来源的家庭中。然而，估计出的反应幅度相对较小，并不表明这种非平滑行为会导致巨大的效用损失。

abstract.text: The idea that the happiness of an individual depends upon the consumption of others is widely viewed as an important feature of our shared social existence. Recent research in finance has used this idea, through consumption externalities, to explore asset-pricing anomalies. Consumption externalities potentially break the link between Pareto optimality and competitive equilibria and open the door for beneficial government intervention (e.g., Lars Ljungqvist and Harald Uhlig, 2000). In this paper, we delineate two effects that a consumption externality may have. An increase in aggregate consumption may: (a) raise the marginal utility of individual consumption relative to leisure, and/or (b) lower an individual’s utility level. We refer to (a) as “keeping up with the Joneses” (henceforth, KUJ), following Jordi Gali (1994), and we refer to (b) as jealousy. Jealousy is a distinct concept from KUJ. Under KUJ, an individual derives greater utility from additional own consumption relative to leisure when others consume more. At the same time, higher per capita consumption holding fixed individual consumption can trigger either jealousy, so that individual utility falls, or admiration, so that individual utility rises. In Section I of this paper, we show that jealousy implies that the laissez-faire equilibrium consumption level is greater than the optimal level. Whether preferences exhibit KUJ is not necessary for this main result. Intuitively, in the presence of jealousy, consumption is similar to pollution. Overpollution exists because individuals do not take into account the cost of polluting on others, not because an increase in economywide pollution makes the return to individual polluting higher. Similarly, overconsumption exists because individuals do not take into account the negative effect of own consumption on jealous others. Things go in the opposite direction when individuals are admiring. In Section II, we consider a functional form that encompasses several existing models. We show that jealousy determines the optimal tax to correct overconsumption and that KUJ is mainly important for asset pricing.

10.1257/000282803321455395.abstractZh: 个体幸福感取决于他人消费的观点，被广泛认为是我们共同社会存在的一个重要特征。最近在金融领域的研究利用这一观点，通过消费外部性来探讨资产定价异常现象。消费外部性可能打破帕累托最优与竞争均衡之间的联系，并为政府的有效干预打开大门（例如，Lars Ljungqvist和Harald Uhlig，2000年）。在本文中，我们描述了消费外部性可能产生的两种效应。总体消费的增加可能会：(a) 提高个人消费相对于休闲的边际效用，和/或 (b) 降低个人的效用水平。我们将(a)称为“攀比心理”，参考了Jordi Gali（1994年）的观点；而将(b)称为嫉妒。嫉妒与攀比心理是不同的概念。在攀比心理下，当其他人消费更多时，个人从额外消费中获得的效用会高于休闲。同时，在个人消费固定的情况下，更高的人均消费可能会引发嫉妒，从而导致个人效用下降，或者引发钦佩，从而导致个人效用上升。在本文的第一部分中，我们展示了嫉妒意味着自由放任的均衡消费水平高于最优水平。偏好是否表现出攀比心理并不是这一主要结果所必需的。直观地说，在嫉妒存在的情况下，消费类似于污染。过度污染的存在是因为个人没有考虑到污染对他人的影响，而不是因为经济范围内的污染增加使得个人污染带来的回报更高。同样，过度消费的存在是因为个体没有考虑到自身消费对嫉妒他人的负面影响。当个体在欣赏他人时，情况则相反。在第二部分中，我们考虑了一种能够涵盖现有多个模型的功能性形式。我们表明，嫉妒行为决定了纠正过度消费的最佳税收水平，而KUJ因素对于资产定价尤为重要。

abstract.text: I agree with the point made by Edoh Y. Amiran and Daniel A. Hagen (2003) that there can be a substantial, or even infinite, divergence between the WTA and WTP for a public good even where there is a nonzero elasticity of substitution between market goods and the public good, provided that the indifference curves are asymptotically bounded with respect to market goods in the manner they describe. This is an important point. They are also correct to point out that the elasticity of substitution is a local concept, whereas their asymptotic boundedness condition applies also for discrete changes. My 1991 paper used a local analysis because it was following the structure of the analysis in Robert D. Willig (1976) and Alan Randall and John R. Stoll (1980); I wanted to show that, while Randall and Stoll appeared to extend Willig’s local result on WTA versus WTP from price changes to changes in the quantity of a public good, the relevant elasticity was in fact different and involved the substitution elasticity as well as the income elasticity. I view these points by Amiran and Hagen as not two separate results but essentially the same result: their asymptotic boundedness condition generalizes my zero elasticity of substitution condition to discrete changes. The asymptotic boundedness condition can be expressed as follows: assuming a bivariate utility function u( x, q), and given a reference point ( x*, q*) associated with a reference utility level u* u( x*, q*), there exists some q q* such that, for all q q , there exists no x such that u( x , q) u*. In other words, no amount of x can substitute for the reduction in public good from q* to q q . In the case of a zero elasticity of substitution, q q* but, as Amiran and Hagen show in their Theorem 1, this is unnecessarily restrictive when dealing with a discrete reduction in q. Furthermore, their Theorem 2 can be viewed as a special case of their Theorem 1 in which q 0, which makes q an essential commodity. It is well known in consumer theory that the WTA to avoid the loss of an essential market good is infinite; their Theorem 2 extends this result to the case of an essential nonmarket good. But, as their Theorem 1 shows, essentialness is not necessary for an infinite WTA. The boundedness condition is the key, and this implies a fundamental lack of substitutability between money (market goods) and the public good.

10.1257/000282803321455449.abstractZh: 我同意Edoh Y. Amiran和Daniel A. Hagen在2003年提出的观点，即即使市场商品与公共物品之间存在非零的替代弹性，公共物品的WTA和WTP之间仍可能存在显著甚至无限的差距。这一观点非常重要。他们正确地指出，替代弹性是一个局部概念，而他们的渐近有界条件同样适用于离散变化。我的1991年论文采用了局部分析方法，因为该分析遵循了Robert D. Willig（1976年）和Alan Randall与John R. Stoll（1980年）的分析结构；我想表明，虽然Randall和Stoll似乎将Willig关于WTA与WTP的局部结果从价格变化扩展到了公共物品数量的变化，但实际上相关的弹性是不同的，它涉及到替代弹性以及收入弹性。我认为Amiran和Hagen的这些观点并不是两个独立的结果，而是本质上相同的结果：他们的渐近有界条件将我的零替代弹性条件推广到了离散变化的情况。渐近有界条件可以表述为：假设一个双变量效用函数u(x, q)，并且给定一个与参考效用水平u* u(x*, q*)相关的参考点(x*, q*)，那么存在某个q和q*，使得对于所有q，都不存在x使得u(x, q)大于u*。换句话说，没有任何数量的x能够替代从q*到q的公共物品减少量。在替代弹性为零的情况下，q等于q*，但正如Amiran和Hagen在他们的定理1中所展示的，当处理q的离散减少时，这种限制是不必要的。此外，他们的定理2可以被视为定理1的一个特例，其中q0使得q成为一种必需品。在消费者理论中，众所周知，为了避免失去一种必需品市场商品，最优替代方案是无限的；他们的定理2将这一结果扩展到了一种非市场必需品的情况。但是，正如他们的定理1所展示的，必需品性并不是导致无限最优替代方案的必要条件。有界性条件是关键，这意味着货币（市场商品）与公共物品之间根本不存在可替代性。

abstract.text: I stand here with deeply conflicting emotions. I am honored to be delivering this prestigious lecture. I am profoundly sad that Rudi Dornbusch, who should have delivered the Ely Lecture, died in July last year and that I am here in his place. So I would like to start by talking about Rudi. Rudi was born and grew up in Krefeld, Germany. He was an undergraduate at the University of Geneva and completed his Ph.D. at the University of Chicago in 1971, which is where we met. He was a student of Robert Mundell, and both the subject matter (the development of the Mundell-Fleming model) and the elegance and insights of his early work reflected Mundell’s influence. He taught at the University of Rochester and at the University of Chicago before accepting an offer from MIT in 1975. In 1976, soon after coming to MIT, Rudi wrote his most famous and influential theoretical article, “Expectations and Exchange Rate Dynamics. ” As Ken Rogoff (2002 p. 1) said in his celebratory lecture on the 25th anniversary of its publication, “The ‘overshooting ’ paper... marks the birth of modern international macroeconomics.” From the late 1970’s, Rudi became increasingly interested in policy issues. Within a decade, he had become one of the outstanding

10.1257/000282803321946750.abstractZh: 我站在这里，心情复杂。能够举办这一享有盛誉的讲座，我感到非常荣幸。同时，我也深感悲痛，因为本应担任埃利讲座的鲁迪·多恩布什在去年七月去世，而我却代替他在这里演讲。因此，我想先谈谈鲁迪。鲁迪出生于德国克雷费尔德，并在那里长大。他曾在日内瓦大学攻读本科，并于1971年在芝加哥大学完成博士学位，我们就是在那里相识的。他是罗伯特·蒙代尔的学生，他的研究主题（蒙代尔-弗莱明模型的开发）以及早期工作的优雅和深刻见解都体现了蒙代尔的影响。他在罗切斯特大学和芝加哥大学任教后，于1975年接受了麻省理工学院的邀请。1976年，刚来到麻省理工学院不久，鲁迪撰写了他最著名、最具影响力的理论文章《预期与汇率动态》。正如肯·罗格夫在纪念该文章发表25周年的演讲中所说：“这篇名为《过度反应》的文章……标志着现代国际宏观经济学的诞生。”从20世纪70年代末开始，鲁迪越来越关注政策问题。在十年内，他成为了杰出的经济学家之一。

abstract.text: Capital flows to emerging markets remain highly volatile. This has enormous economic and social costs for developing economies. Most of the proposals to reform the international financial architecture and the IMF in particular are aimed at dealing with the most extreme cases of crises - run-like crises and bankruptcy. While this is good, it leaves unaddressed a significant fraction of the costs associated to capital flow reversals. Many countries experience deep contractions but no open crises, and many of the countries that end up in extreme crises go first through a prolonged period of sharply reduced access to international capital markets. To deal with these situations, the paper proposes a market solution: The creation of hedging and insurance markets against capital flow volatility. The role of the IMF and other IFIs in this context is to facilitate the creation and functioning of these markets, and supervise/advise countries on the management of fiscal, monetary, and liquidity-requirement policies in this mega-insurance context.

10.1257/000282803321946769.abstractZh: 资本流向新兴市场的波动性仍然很高。这对发展中国家经济造成了巨大的经济和社会成本。大多数关于改革国际金融架构以及国际货币基金组织的提议，都是为了解决最极端的情况——如企业破产等危机。虽然这些举措是积极的，但它们未能解决与资本流动逆转相关的重大成本问题。许多国家经历了严重的经济收缩，但并未出现明显的危机；而那些陷入极端危机的国家，往往首先经历了国际资本市场通道大幅受限的漫长时期。为了应对这种情况，本文提出了一种市场解决方案：建立针对资本流动波动性的对冲和保险市场。国际货币基金组织及其他国际金融机构在此过程中的作用是促进这些市场的创建与运作，并对各国在财政、货币和流动性政策方面的管理提供监督与建议。

abstract.text: This paper argues that the prima facie evidence suggests that the World Bank is not particularly effective either in dealing with countries that default or in promoting countries, projects and ideas that are likely to do well. We argue that this is probably related to the fact that the Bank does not make adequate use of scientific evidence in its decision-making and suggest ways to improve matters.

10.1257/000282803321946778.abstractZh: 本文认为，初步证据表明，世界银行在处理违约国家或推动可能取得良好成效的国家、项目和理念方面并不特别有效。我们认为，这可能与世界银行在决策过程中未能充分运用科学证据有关，并提出了改进措施的建议。

abstract.text: A widely held belief, among economists and policymakers alike, is that countries that are linked through international trade will also share business cycle fluctuations. For this reason, countries proceed slowly and carefully to adopt new arrangements (regional trading arrangements, for example) that are designed to increase trade with a particular group of countries. It is therefore surprising that we lack strong empirical evidence that increased trade, by itself, also increases the extent of business-cycle linkages.1 This paper takes a first step on a new line of research that is designed to evaluate the circumstances under which trading relationships between two countries will lead their business cycles to become more synchronized.2 Our starting point is the observation that most countries have several, even many, trading partners, and that the basket of goods traded with one country may be different from the basket traded with another country. Thus, we use a highly disaggregated dataset that includes information on the industrial structure of each country, as well as detailed information on the industry composition of trade. Our dataset includes information on manufacturing goods, which have been the focus of some past studies, but also includes data on non-manufacturing industries.

10.1257/000282803321946796.abstractZh: 经济学家和政策制定者普遍认为，通过国际贸易联系起来的国家也会共享商业周期的波动。因此，各国在采纳新的贸易安排（例如区域贸易安排）时会非常谨慎，这些安排旨在增加与特定国家群体的贸易。然而，令人惊讶的是，我们缺乏强有力的实证证据来证明贸易的增加本身也能增强商业周期的联动性。本文是探索这一新研究方向的第一步，旨在评估两国之间的贸易关系在何种情况下能使它们的商业周期更加同步。我们的出发点是观察到大多数国家都有多个甚至更多的贸易伙伴，而且与一个国家进行的贸易商品组合可能与与另一个国家进行的贸易商品组合不同。因此，我们使用了一个高度细分的数据库，其中包含每个国家的产业结构信息以及贸易行业构成的具体信息。我们的数据库包括制造业商品的信息，这是一些过去研究的重点，同时也包括非制造业行业的数据。

abstract.text: The phenomenon of globalization, which re-fers to the rising trade arid financial integration of the world economy, has gathered steam in recent decades. The grov/th rate of world trade has been greater than that of world output in almost all years since I960, and the cumulative increase in the volume of world trade is almost three times larger than that of world output over this period. A more dramatic element in the process of globalization has been the surge in cross-border capital flows over tlie last two de-cades. Since the eariy 198O's, gross capital flows have jumped from less than 5 percent to approximately 20 percent of GDP for advanced countries. For emerging markets, gross capital flows have increased almost fourfold over the same period and now account for roughly 5 percent of GDP in these economies.' What is the impact of globalization on the synchronization of business cycles across coun-tries? In this paper, we attempt to address this question by systematically examining the im-pact of increased trade and financial integration on intemational business-cycle comovements. In particular, we analyzi ^ the pattems of cor-relations for industrial as well as developing countries within a unified empirical framework. We also examine the effects of different aspects of globalization on output as well as consump-tion comovement across countries.

10.1257/000282803321946804.abstractZh: 全球化现象指的是世界经济在贸易和金融方面的日益紧密融合，这一趋势在近几十年中愈发明显。自1960年以来，世界贸易的增长率几乎始终高于世界产出的增长率，而世界贸易总量的累计增长幅度更是世界产出增长幅度的三倍。在全球化进程中，一个更为显著的现象是跨境资本流动的激增。自1980年代初期以来，先进国家的资本流动总额从不到GDP的5%增加到了约20%。对于新兴市场而言，同一时期资本流动总额几乎增加了四倍，现在这些经济体的资本流动总额约占GDP的5%。那么，全球化对各国商业周期同步性有何影响呢？在本文中，我们试图通过系统分析贸易和金融一体化增强对国际商业周期同步性的影响来解答这个问题。我们特别分析了工业国家和发展中国家之间的相关模式，并采用统一的实证框架来研究全球化不同方面对各国产出和消费同步性的影响。

abstract.text: (May 2003) - In this paper we do two things. First we document that over the last 40 years the U.S. business cycle has become less synchronized with the cycle in the rest of the world. Second we try to explain why this has happened. We use a general-equilibrium model as a tool to discriminate between two alternative explanations: (i) a change in the nature of real shocks, and (ii) an increase in U.S. financial integration with the rest of the world. Our results indicate that financial integration has played the major role in producing the observed changes in international co-movement.

10.1257/000282803321946813.abstractZh: (2003年5月) - 在本文中，我们做了两件事。首先，我们记录了在过去40年里，美国的商业周期与全球其他地区的商业周期同步性降低。其次，我们试图解释这一现象发生的原因。我们使用一般均衡模型来探讨两种可能的解释：(i)实际冲击性质的变化；(ii)美国与全球其他地区的金融整合程度增加。我们的研究结果表明，金融整合在导致国际市场联动性变化中起到了主要作用。

abstract.text: Ever since the Mexican, Asian, and Russian crises of the mid-1990’s, efforts have been underway to find means for more effective prevention and resolution of currency-financial crises. Much has been done with respect to crisis prevention: exchange-rate flexibility is much greater than it was; there is increased transparency and improved oversight of the financial system; and greater attention is paid to unsustainable policy stances. Work continues to strengthen economies’ immunity to crises. However, no matter how much is done, there will inevitably be a crisis or crises. Much has already been learned with respect to crisis resolution, and the international financial community is better equipped to cope with crises than was the case earlier. But, as with prevention, more can be done. One item on the agenda, which should contribute both to prevention and to resolution, is dealing with unsustainable debt burdens of sovereign nations. Two of the hallmarks of most of the 1990’s crises were, first, the importance of private capital flows, and their reversals, in triggering the crises and in intensifying their severity; and second, the involvement of the financial systems in them. The countries afflicted by these crises were ones that had succeeded in raising per capita incomes and rates of economic growth. That success hinged in significant part on their having put in place economic policies that are conducive to economic growth, including a predictable legal framework, respect for property rights, openness to the international economy, and much more. The fact that the policy framework was generally appropriate implied, among other things, that there were relatively high real returns to investment in these economies. That is of course the main reason why private investors were interested in them. At the same time, capital inflows permitted more rapid development than would otherwise be possible. These associations of high real returns, growth, and appropriate policy stances continue. For these reasons, there is typically a strong stake for emerging markets to maintain international creditworthiness, and policymakers go to great lengths to maintain their international reputations and market standings. An efficient private international capital market benefits both developing countries, which are thereby able to invest more than domestic savings at high real rates of return, and investors in high-income countries, who can realize higher real returns and greater portfolio diversification than they could achieve without these investment opportunities. Because countries are sovereign, their high stakes in maintaining creditworthiness are crucial for attracting international capital flows. This is because foreign creditors do not have the rights they do in domestic courts and hence must have other protections against default on the part of borrowers. This is especially true for sovereign borrowers; international lenders to private entities in emerging markets normally have the same protection as is afforded to domestic lenders. For sovereign borrowing, however, the chief protection foreign creditors have is the losses that would accrue to the sovereign debtor (both directly, through the future reduction in access to international credit markets, and through the effects on private economic activity of a sovereign default) in the event of † Discussants: Guillermo Calvo, InterAmerican Development Bank and University of Maryland; Morris Goldstein, Institute for International Economics; Michael Mussa, Institute for International Economics; Ann Harrison, University of California–Berkeley.

10.1257/000282803321946822.abstractZh: 自20世纪90年代中期墨西哥、亚洲和俄罗斯的金融危机以来，人们一直在努力寻找更有效的预防和解决货币金融危机的方法。在危机预防方面已经取得了不少成果：汇率的灵活性比以往大得多；金融系统的透明度和监管也有所改善；对不可持续的政策立场的关注也日益增加。各项工作仍在继续，以增强经济体对危机的抵御能力。然而，无论采取多少措施，危机仍不可避免地会发生。在危机解决方面，我们已经学到了很多，国际金融界应对危机的能力也比以前更强了。但正如预防工作一样，仍有许多工作可以做。一个应该有助于预防和解决危机的议题是处理主权国家不可持续的债务负担。20世纪90年代大多数危机的两个特点是：首先，私人资本流动的重要性以及其逆转在引发危机和加剧危机严重性方面起到了关键作用；其次，金融系统在这些危机中发挥了重要作用。受这些危机影响的国家都是那些成功提高了人均收入和经济增长率的国家。这种成功在很大程度上取决于它们实施了有利于经济增长的经济政策，包括可预测的法律框架、对财产权的尊重、对国际经济的开放态度等等。政策框架通常较为合理，这意味着这些经济体的投资实际回报相对较高。这当然也是私人投资者对这些国家感兴趣的主要原因。同时，资本流入使得发展速度比其他情况下更快。这种高实际回报、增长以及适当政策立场的关联持续存在。因此，新兴市场通常有着维护国际信用度的强烈利益，政策制定者也会竭尽全力维护其国际声誉和市场地位。一个高效的国际私人资本市场对发展中国家和高收入国家的投资者都有好处，发展中国家能够以较高的实际回报率投资超过国内储蓄的资金，而高收入国家的投资者则能够获得更高的实际回报和更大的投资组合多样性。由于各国是主权国家，它们在维护信用度方面的利益对于吸引国际资本流动至关重要。这是因为外国债权人并不像在国内法院那样拥有相同的权利，因此借款人必须得到其他保护以避免违约。这一点对于主权借款人来说尤为明显；对新兴市场私人实体的国际贷款机构通常享有与国内贷款机构相同的保护。然而，对于主权借款人而言，外国债权人主要拥有的保护是，如果借款人违约，主权债务人将遭受损失（包括未来国际信贷市场准入的减少，以及主权违约对私人经济活动的影响）。

abstract.text: Since the early 1980's, patterns of emergingmarket finance have changed significantly. Greater integration of capital markets and a trend toward a greater use of direct lending through bonds has led to relatively decreased use of indirect finance through syndicated bank loans. These changes have produced benefits to investors through opportunities for risk diversification and to emerging-market sovereign borrowers by increasing the investor base. The broadened investor base in bond financing, however, raises problems of coordination and collective action in the event of a sovereign borrower's default and restructuring. Now, three parties are involved in determining the debt markdown required to produce solvency: the debtor, creditors, and the global taxpayer through international financial institutions (IFI's). The complex relationships among the borrowers, creditors, and the global taxpayer have made restructuring obligations a costly and time-consuming exercise, especially with the possibility of holdouts. Both the sovereign borrower and its creditors have an incentive to avoid a restructuring in the hope of financial assistance from the global taxpayer. Sovereign governments may not undertake the politically painful steps involved in beginning a restructuring when there is always the hope that official assistance will be forthcoming. Creditors may not accept a reduction in the value of their claims, also in the hope that official assistance will be forthcoming. Costs of postponed and disorderly restructurings are real and substantial. Delays in restructuring can drain a country's resources and increase the ultimate costs of restoring financial sustainability. Creditors bear a burden as well, because the losses associated with the restructuring are reflected in values of

10.1257/000282803321946831.abstractZh: 自20世纪80年代初以来，新兴市场金融模式发生了显著变化。资本市场的一体化程度提高，直接通过债券进行贷款的趋势日益明显，这导致通过银团银行贷款进行间接融资的使用相对减少。这些变化为投资者带来了风险分散的机会，同时也为新兴市场的主权借款人增加了投资者基础。然而，债券融资中投资者基础的扩大，在主权借款人出现违约和重组时，带来了协调与集体行动的问题。现在，确定产生偿付能力所需的债务减记是由三个当事方共同决定的：债务人、债权人和通过国际金融机构的全球纳税人。借款人、债权人和全球纳税人之间的复杂关系使得重组义务变得成本高昂且耗时，尤其是考虑到存在拒绝参与重组的可能性。主权借款人和其债权人都有动机避免重组，希望获得全球纳税人的财政援助。当总是有希望获得官方援助时，主权政府可能不会采取开始重组所需的政治上的痛苦步骤。债权人也可能不愿意接受其债权价值的减少，同样是因为希望获得官方援助。推迟和混乱的重组所带来的成本是真实且巨大的。重组的延迟会消耗一个国家的资源，并增加恢复财务可持续性的最终成本。债权人也承受着负担，因为与重组相关的损失会反映在债权价值上。

abstract.text: Reform of the mechanisms and procedures through which problems of sovereign debt sustainability are resolved is at the centre of the effort to make the international financial system less crisis prone. The purported difficulty of coordinating creditors holding distinct bond issues provides one basis for choosing among the reform proposals currently on the table. We assess the significance of this difficulty (‘the aggregation problem’) using evidence on the pricing of international bonds. Our evidence suggests that investors do perceive that aggregation has costs. Plausibly, they worry most about difficulties of information sharing and coordination across issues when the debt in question is an obligation of a country with a significant perceived probability of having to restructure.

10.1257/000282803321946840.abstractZh: 改革解决主权债务可持续性问题的机制和程序，是使国际金融体系减少危机风险的核心措施。债权人持有不同债券时难以协调的问题，为当前提出的改革方案提供了依据。我们通过国际债券定价的相关证据来评估这一难题（“聚合问题”）的重要性。我们的证据表明，投资者确实认为聚合存在成本。他们最担心的是在债务涉及一个被认为有巨大重组风险的国家时，信息分享和协调方面的困难。

abstract.text: Economic theory and evidence from a variety of debt markets shed light on current reform proposals concerning emerging market debt.Debt markets, including the U.S. municipal bond market, generally function best when the rights of creditors are protected most effectively.Since current IMF reform proposals significantly emasculate creditor rights, they are likely to have an adverse effect on the flow of new funds to sovereign borrowers.

10.1257/000282803321946859.abstractZh: 各种债务市场的经济理论和实证数据为当前关于新兴市场债务的改革提案提供了启示。包括美国市政债券市场在内的债务市场，在债权人的权利得到最有效保护时，通常运作得最为顺畅。由于当前国际货币基金组织的改革提案严重削弱了债权人的权利，这些改革很可能会对主权借款人的新资金流入产生负面影响。

abstract.text: Three things happen when emerging economies open their stock markets to foreign investors. First, the aggregate dividend yield falls by 240 basis points. Second, the growth rate of the capital stock increases by an average of 1.1 percentage points per year. Third, the growth rate of output per worker rises by 2.3 percentage points per year. Since the cost of capital falls, investment booms, and the growth rate of output per worker increases when countries liberalize the stock market, the increasingly popular view that capital account liberalization brings no real benefits seems untenable.

10.1257/000282803321946868.abstractZh: 当新兴经济体向外国投资者开放其股票市场时，会发生三件事。首先，总体股息收益率下降240个基点。其次，资本存量的增长率平均每年增加1.1个百分点。第三，每工人的产出增长率每年增加2.3个百分点。由于资本成本下降、投资激增以及每工人的产出增长率上升，当国家放开股票市场时，那种认为资本账户自由化不会带来实际好处的观点似乎站不住脚了。

abstract.text: Equity market liberalizations are like IPOs, but they are IPOs of a country's stock market rather than of individual firms. Both are endogenous events whose benefits are limited by poor investor protection, agency costs, and information asymmetries. As for stock prices following an IPO, there are legitimate concerns about the efficiency in the period following the liberalization of the stock market returns of countries that liberalize their equity markets. Equity markets of liberalizing countries experience extremely strong performance immediately after the liberalization, but then go through a period of poor performance. This pattern of stock returns is more dramatic for countries with poorer financial development before the liberalization.

10.1257/000282803321946877.abstractZh: 股权市场自由化类似于首次公开募股，但它是国家股市的首次公开募股，而非个别公司的IPO。两者都是内生性事件，其收益受到投资者保护不足、代理成本以及信息不对称性等因素的限制。对于IPO后股价的表现，人们普遍担忧在股市自由化后的那段时间内效率会受到影响。在自由化国家，股市在自由化后立即表现出极强的表现，但随后会经历一段表现不佳的时期。对于在自由化前金融发展较为落后的国家来说，这种股价走势更为明显。

abstract.text: (May 2003) - This paper reviews recent randomized evaluations of educational programs in developing countries, including programs to increase school participation, to provide educational inputs, and to reform education. It then extracts some lessons for education policy and for the practice and political economy of randomized evaluations.

10.1257/000282803321946886.abstractZh: （2003年5月） - 本文回顾了发展中国家教育项目的最新随机评估结果，这些项目包括提高学校参与度、提供教育支持以及改革教育体系的措施。文章随后总结了一些对教育政策以及随机评估实践与政治经济学具有启示意义的经验。

abstract.text: Development economics has been the beneÞciary of a rich tradition of Þeld research. Within this broad tradition there is a huge variety of methods, from short qualitative studies in which the primary interaction between the researcher and the participants is relatively unstructured conversation to large-scale surveys designed by and perhaps loosely supervised by economists. In this note, however, I focus on one point in this broad space of research methodologies- iterative Þeld research in which the collection of data through surveys is combined with detailed observation and conversation to elicit knowledge about institutions. A highly artiÞcial, but I hope useful typology is provided in Figure 1. Typically, empir-ical work in economics relies on existing data. However, it is becoming more common in development economics to complement existing data with relatively short, often less struc-tured visits to the Þeld site in order to clarify aspects of the data, to better deÞne the economic environment, or to collect limited amounts of complementary data. For example, ICRISAT hosted and provided institutional support for a series of visiting scholars during the collection of the Village Level Surveys. This proved to be a relatively inexpensive mech-anism that generated an important sequence of insights regarding economic institutions India (Rosenzweig (1998 EJ), Pender (1996) are examples of papers emerging from this 1 practice). At the forefront of public service in development economics is that set of academic econo-mists who have combined their time and energy with signiÞcant outside resources to direct and organize the collection of new large-scale datasets. An important recent example is the Indonesian Family Life Survey

10.1257/000282803321946895.abstractZh: 发展经济学受益于丰富的领导研究传统。在这一广泛的研究传统中，存在多种多样的方法，从简短的定性研究到大规模的调查，后者通常由经济学家设计，并可能由他们进行松散的监督。然而，在本文中，我将重点关注这一研究方法领域中的一个方面——迭代领导研究，即通过调查收集数据，并结合详细的观察和对话来获取关于制度的知识。图1提供了一个高度人为化的分类，但我希望它能有所帮助。通常，经济学中的实证研究依赖于现有数据。然而，在发展经济学中，越来越多地采用相对简短、结构较为松散的实地考察来补充现有数据，以便澄清数据的某些方面，更好地描述经济环境，或收集少量补充数据。例如，在收集村级调查数据时，ICRISAT为一系列访问学者提供了场地和支持。这一机制被证明是一种相对低成本的方法，它产生了一系列关于印度经济制度的宝贵见解（Rosenzweig (1998 EJ)，Pender (1996)就是源于这一实践而出现的论文）。在发展经济学领域，有一群学者走在公共服务的前沿，他们投入了大量时间和精力，并利用重要的外部资源来指导和组织新的大规模数据集的收集工作。最近的一个重要例子就是印度尼西亚家庭生活调查。

abstract.text: What is the weak-instruments (WI) problem and what causes it? Universal agreement does not exist on these questions. We define weak instruments by two features: (i) two-stage least squares (2SLS) analysis is badly biased toward the ordinary least-squares (OLS) estimate, and alternative “unbiased” estimators such as limited-information maximum likelihood (LIML) may not solve the problem; and (ii) the standard (first-order) asymptotic distribution does not give an accurate framework for inference. Thus, a researcher may estimate “bad results” and not be aware of the outcome. The cause of WI is often stated to be a low R or F statistic of the reduced-form equation, in the most commonly occurring situation of one right-handside endogenous variable. We find the situation is more complex with an additional factor, the correlation between the stochastic disturbances of the structural equation and the reduced form, that needs to be taken into account. We discuss in this paper a specification test (Hahn and Hausman, 2002a) for WI, a caution against using “no moments” estimators such as LIML in the WI situation, and suggestions for different estimators, an approach to inference of Frank Kleibergen (2002) for WI. We end with a caution of how “small biases” can become “large biases” in the WI situation. We begin with the limited-information structural model under the assumptions of Hausman (1983):

10.1257/000282803321946912.abstractZh: 什么是弱工具变量问题，其成因是什么？关于这些问题，并没有普遍性的共识。我们通过两个特征来定义弱工具变量：(i) 两阶段最小二乘法分析严重偏向于普通最小二乘估计，而一些替代的“无偏”估计方法，如有限信息最大似然法，可能无法解决该问题；(ii) 标准的一阶渐近分布并不能为推断提供准确的框架。因此，研究者可能会得到“糟糕的结果”，却并未意识到这一点。通常认为，弱工具变量问题的成因是简化形式方程的R统计量或F统计量较低，尤其是在一个右侧内生变量存在的情况下。我们发现实际情况更为复杂，还需要考虑另一个因素，即结构方程中的随机扰动与简化形式之间的相关性。本文讨论了针对弱工具变量问题的规范检验方法（Hahn和Hausman，2002a），对使用“无矩”估计方法（如LIML）在弱工具变量情况下的警示，以及针对不同估计方法的建议，还提出了Frank Kleibergen（2002）提出的针对弱工具变量问题的推断方法。最后，我们提醒读者在弱工具变量情况下，“小偏差”可能会变成“大偏差”。本文从Hausman（1983）假设下的有限信息结构模型开始讨论。

abstract.text: In many empirical studies of the effect of social programs researchers assume that, condi-tional on a set of observed covariates, assign-ment to the treatment is exogenous or unconfounded (aka selection on observables). Often this assumption is not realistic, and re-searchers are concerned about the robustness of their results to departures from it. One approach (e.g., Charles Manski, 1990) is to entirely drop the exogeneity assumption and investigate what can be learned about treatment effects without it. With unbounded outcomes, and in the ab-sence of alternative identifying assumptions, there are no restrictions on the set of possible values for average treatment effects. This does

10.1257/000282803321946921.abstractZh: 在许多关于社会项目效果的经验研究中，研究人员假设，在一系列观察到的协变量条件下，分配到某个项目的处理是外生的或不受混杂影响的（即基于可观测变量的选择）。然而，这种假设往往并不现实，研究人员也关注其研究结果在脱离这一假设时的稳健性。一种方法（例如，Charles Manski，1990年）是完全放弃外生性假设，研究在不考虑外生性假设的情况下，关于项目效果能得出哪些结论。在结果不受限制的情况下，且不存在其他识别假设的情况下，对平均项目效果可能取值的限制就不存在了。这确实……

abstract.text: Inference methods that recognize the clustering of individual observations have been available for more than 25 years. Brent Moulton (1990) caught the attention of economists when he demonstrated the serious biases that can result in estimating the effects of aggregate explanatory variables on individual-specific response variables. The source of the downward bias in the usual ordinary least-squares (OLS) standard errors is the presence of an unobserved, state-level effect in the error term. More recently, John Pepper (2002) showed how accounting for multi-level clustering can have dramatic effects on t statistics. While adjusting for clustering is much more common than it was 10 years ago, inference methods robust to cluster correlation are not used routinely across all relevant settings. In this paper, I provide an overview of applications of cluster-sample methods, both to cluster samples and to panel data sets.

10.1257/000282803321946930.abstractZh: 识别个体观测值聚类结构的推断方法已经存在超过25年。Brent Moulton在1990年提出这一理论时，引起了经济学家的注意，他揭示了在估计总体解释变量对个体特定响应变量的影响时可能出现的严重偏差。通常，普通最小二乘法标准误差出现向下偏差的原因在于误差项中存在一个未被观察到的州级效应。最近，John Pepper在2002年指出，考虑多层级聚类结构对t统计量有显著影响。虽然现在对聚类结构的调整比10年前更为普遍，但能够抵御聚类相关性的推断方法并未在所有相关领域中得到常规应用。在本文中，我概述了聚类样本方法的应用情况，包括聚类样本和面板数据集的应用。

abstract.text: The use of modern microeconomics in policy is illustrated by the markets for spectrum, electricity, greenhouse-gas reductions, defense procurement, and Treasury bills. Further examples are antitrust divestiture rules, market-based redistribution, fishery conservation, and privatization. The limits of the use of theory are also discussed, by reference to China's economy-wide reforms. Lessons on the policy use of theory are drawn.

10.1257/000282803321946949.abstractZh: 现代微观经济学在政策中的应用体现在频谱市场、电力市场、温室气体减排、国防采购以及国库券市场等方面。此外，还有反垄断剥离规则、基于市场的再分配、渔业保护以及私有化等例子。文章还讨论了理论应用的局限性，并参考了中国经济领域的改革实例，提出了关于理论在政策应用中的启示。

abstract.text: (May 2003) - Strong and widely accepted evidence shows that the natural rate of unemployment varies over time with substantial amplitude. The frictions in the labor market that account for positive normal levels of unemployment are not simple and mechanical. Instead, as a rich modern body of theory demonstrates, the natural rate of unemployment is an equilibrium in which the volumes of job-seeking by workers and worker-seeking by employers reach a balance controlled by fundamental determinants of the relative prices of the two activities. In recessions, unemployment rises, and job vacancies fall. The natural explanation is an economywide fall in labor demand. But a compelling model that generates a fall in labor demand without a counterfactual fall in productivity has eluded theorists to date. Nonetheless, policymakers have appropriately adopted the view that the natural rate varies over time and is not a simple benchmark for setting monetary instruments.

10.1257/000282803321946958.abstractZh: (2003年5月) - 大量且被广泛接受的证据表明，自然失业率随时间变化，且变化幅度较大。导致正常失业率存在的劳动力市场摩擦并非简单机械的现象。相反，正如丰富的现代理论所表明的，自然失业率是一种均衡状态，在这种状态下，工人求职的数量与雇主招聘的数量达到一种平衡，这种平衡由两种活动相对价格的基本决定因素所控制。在经济衰退期间，失业率上升，职位空缺减少。自然失业率下降的原因在于整个经济领域的劳动力需求减少。然而，一个能够在不导致生产率下降的情况下产生劳动力需求下降的令人信服的模型至今仍未被理论家们提出。尽管如此，政策制定者已经正确地认识到自然失业率随时间变化，并不是一个用于设定货币政策的简单基准。

abstract.text: (May 2003) - Inviting political scientists to tell economists how they could do better work is an act of disciplinary generosity. The reality is that contemporary political science is a net importer of ideas and methods from other disciplines, and from none more than economics. Indeed, some of the most exciting research in political science in the past 40 years has involved the incorporation of ideas from economics. We have neither the space nor the mandate to summarize that research here, but refer interested readers to Gary J. Miller's (1997) extensive review. Our aim here is to offertwo modest case studies of specific instances of overlap between the interests and research efforts of economists and political scientists. Our first case study focuses on describing and explaining participation in the workforce, the polity, and many other social activities and organizations. Our second case study focuses on the impact of political processes and institutions on macroeconomic policies and performance. In both these instances the work of economists has been quite fruitful—but also, we think, hampered by a characteristic overreliance on standard economic models and methods. However, in both areas, recent developments may point the way toward a more constructive research style combining the theoretical and empirical rigor of economics with a broader and more eclectic approach familiar to political scientists.

10.1257/000282803321946976.abstractZh: （2003年5月） - 邀请政治科学家向经济学家传授更好的研究方法，是一种学科上的慷慨行为。实际上，当代政治科学是从其他学科中吸收思想和方法的净进口者，而其中最为重要的来源就是经济学。事实上，过去40年政治科学中最令人兴奋的一些研究都涉及了经济学思想的运用。我们既没有空间也没有必要在这里总结这些研究，但建议感兴趣的读者参考Gary J. Miller在1997年发表的综述文章。我们的目的是通过两个具体的案例研究，展示经济学家和政治科学家在研究和兴趣方面的重叠之处。第一个案例研究重点在于描述和解释人们参与劳动力、政治活动以及许多其他社会活动和组织的情况。第二个案例研究则关注政治过程和制度对宏观经济政策与绩效的影响。在这两个领域中，经济学家的研究都取得了丰硕成果——但我们认为，这些研究也受到了对标准经济模型和方法过度依赖的制约。不过，在这两个领域，最近的发展或许为一种新的研究方式指明了方向，即结合经济学的理论和实证严谨性，以及政治科学家所熟悉的更广泛和多元化的研究方法。

abstract.text: (May 2003) - My first exposure to the psychological assumptions of economics was in a report that Bruno Frey wrote on that subject in the early 1970's. Its first or second sentence stated that the agent of economic theory is rational and selfish, and that his tastes do not change. I found this list quite startling, because I had been professionally trained as a psychologist not to believe a word of it. The gap between the assumptions of our disciplines appeared very large indeed. Has the gap been narrowed in the intervening 30 years? A search through some introductory textbooks in economics indicates that if there has been any change, it has not yet filtered down to that level: the same assumptions are still in place as the cornerstones of economic analysis. However, a behavioral approach to economics has emerged in which the assumptions are not held sacrosanct. In the following I comment selectively on the developments with regard to the three assumptions, on both sides of the disciplinary divide.

10.1257/000282803321946985.abstractZh: (2003年5月)——我第一次接触经济学的心理学假设是在Bruno Frey在20世纪70年代初撰写的一份报告中。报告的第一句或第二句就指出，经济理论中的主体具有理性且自私的特质，并且他们的偏好不会发生变化。这一观点让我感到非常震惊，因为我作为一名心理学家，接受过专业训练，绝不会相信这样的说法。我们两个学科之间的假设差异确实非常大。在这30年里，这种差异是否有所缩小呢？通过一些经济学入门教材的查阅发现，如果真有变化的话，那也还没有渗透到这个层面：同样的假设仍然作为经济分析的基石存在。不过，一种行为主义的经济学方法已经出现，在这种方法中，这些假设不再被视为不可动摇的真理。接下来，我将选择性地评论一下关于这三个假设的发展情况，以及这两个学科之间的分歧。

abstract.text: Many economists are libertarians and consider the term “paternalistic” to be derogatory. Most would think that the phrase libertarian paternalism is an oxymoron. The modest goal of this essay is to encourage economists to rethink their views on paternalism. We believe that the anti-paternalistic fervor expressed by many economists is based on a combination of a false assumption and at least two misconceptions. The false assumption is that people always (usually?) make choices that are in their best interest. This claim is either tautological, and therefore uninteresting, or testable. We claim that it is testable and false—indeed, obviously false. The first misconception is that there are viable alternatives to paternalism. In many situations, some organization or agent must make a choice that will affect the choices of some other people. The point applies to both private and public actors. Consider the problem facing the director of a company cafeteria who discovers that the order in which food is arranged influences the choices people make. To simplify, consider three alternative strategies: (1) she could make choices that she thinks would make the customers best off; (2) she could make choices at random; or (3) she could maliciously choose those items that she thinks would make the customers as obese as possible. Option 1 appears to be paternalistic, which it is, but would anyone advocate options 2 or 3? The second misconception is that paternalism always involves coercion. As the cafeteria example illustrates, the choice of which order to present food items does not coerce anyone to do anything, yet one might prefer some orders to others on paternalistic grounds. Would many object to putting the fruit before the desserts at an elementary school cafeteria if the outcome were to increase the consumption ratio of apples to Twinkies? Is this question fundamentally different if the customers are adults? If no coercion is involved, we think that some types of paternalism should be acceptable to even the most ardent libertarian. We call such actions libertarian paternalism. In our understanding, a policy counts as “paternalistic” if it is selected with the goal of influencing the choices of affected parties in a way that will make those parties better off. We intend “better off” to be measured as objectively as possible, and we clearly do not always equate revealed preference with welfare. That is, we emphasize the possibility that in some cases individuals make inferior choices, choices that they would change if they had complete information, unlimited cognitive abilities, and no lack of willpower. Once it is understood that some organizational decisions are inevitable, that a form of paternalism cannot be avoided, and that the alternatives to paternalism (such as choosing options to make people sick, obese, or generally worse off) are unattractive, we can abandon the less interesting question of whether to be paternalistic or not and turn to the more constructive question of how to choose among paternalistic options. 1 † Discussants: Robert E. Hall, Stanford University; Gary Becker, University of Chicago; Robert Barro, Harvard University.

10.1257/000282803321947001.abstractZh: 许多经济学家是自由意志主义者，他们认为“家长式”这一术语带有贬义。大多数人认为“自由意志主义家长主义”是一个矛盾的说法。本文的 modest 目标是鼓励经济学家重新思考他们对家长主义的看法。我们认为，许多经济学家所表达的反对家长主义的热情，基于一个错误的假设以及至少两个误解。这个错误的假设是，人们总是（通常？）做出符合自身最大利益的决策。这种说法要么是一种陈词滥调，因此毫无意义，要么是可以被验证的。我们认为这种说法是可以被验证的，并且显然是错误的。第一个误解是，存在可行的家长主义替代方案。在许多情况下，某个组织或个体必须做出会影响其他人的选择的决策。这一点适用于私人机构和公共机构。以一家公司食堂的主管为例，她发现食物的摆放顺序会影响人们的选择。为了简化，考虑三种替代策略：（1）她可以做出她认为能让顾客受益的选择；（2）她可以随机做出选择；或者（3）她可以恶意选择那些她认为会让顾客变得更胖的物品。选项1看起来像是家长主义，实际上确实如此，但有人会支持选项2或3吗？第二个误解是，家长主义总是涉及强制行为。正如食堂的例子所示，选择食物的摆放顺序并不会强制任何人做任何事情，但人们可能会基于家长主义的理由偏好某些摆放方式。如果将水果放在小学食堂的甜点之前，是否会让许多人反对，因为这样做会增加苹果与Twinkies的消费比例？如果顾客是成年人，这个问题是否会有本质上的不同？如果没有强制性的因素，我们认为某些类型的家长式干预即使对最坚定的自由主义者来说也是可以接受的。我们将这种行为称为自由意志主义家长式干预。在我们看来，如果一项政策的目的是以某种方式影响受影响方的选择，从而让这些方受益，那么这项政策就被视为“家长式”的。我们尽量以客观的方式来衡量“受益”，并且我们显然不总是将表露的偏好等同于福利。也就是说，我们强调在某些情况下，个人可能会做出次优的选择，这些选择在他们拥有完整信息、无限的认知能力和足够的意志力的情况下是可以改变的。一旦我们认识到某些组织决策是不可避免的，某种形式的家长式干预是无法避免的，而家长式干预的替代方案（比如选择那些会让人生病、肥胖或整体状况恶化的选项）并不吸引人，我们就可以放弃是否采用家长式干预这个不太有趣的问题，转而探讨如何在家长式干预选项中做出选择。1 † 讨论者：罗伯特·E·霍尔，斯坦福大学；加里·贝克尔，芝加哥大学；罗伯特·巴罗，哈佛大学。

abstract.text: Default options have an enormous impact on household “choices. ” Such effects are documented in the literature on 401(k) plans (see Madrian and Dennis Shea, 2001; Choi et al., 2002, 2003b). Defaults affect 401(k) participation, savings rates, rollovers, and asset allocation. For example, when employees are automatically enrolled in their 401(k) plan, only a tiny fraction opt out, producing nearly 100-percent enrollment. But when employees are not automatically enrolled, less than half enroll on their own during their first year of employment. Defaults matter for three key reasons modeled in this paper. First, acts of commission (e.g., opting out of a default) are costly. Second, these costs vary over time, generating an option value of waiting for a low-cost period to opt out. Third, people are susceptible to procrastination. Even if they want to make a change, they have a tendency to delay that change longer than they should. These three effects imply that the choice of defaults can have significant welfare consequences. If all employees share a common optimal savings rate, selecting an optimal default is trivial. But the calculation of an optimal default is not straightforward if employees have heterogeneous optimal savings rates. In such a world, it may sometimes be optimal to set defaults that

10.1257/000282803321947010.abstractZh: 默认选项对家庭的“选择”有着巨大的影响。这些影响在关于401(k)计划的文献中有详细记载（参见Madrian和Dennis Shea, 2001年；Choi等人，2002年、2003b年）。违约行为会影响401(k)计划的参与率、储蓄率、资金转移以及资产配置。例如，当员工被自动纳入401(k)计划时，只有极少数人会选择退出，导致几乎100%的人参与该计划。而当员工没有自动被纳入计划时，他们在入职的第一年只有不到一半的人会主动参与。本文通过模型分析，指出了违约行为存在的三个关键原因。首先，采取主动行动（如选择退出违约行为）是有成本的。其次，这些成本随时间变化，因此等待成本较低的时候选择退出是一种理性的选择。第三，人们容易拖延。即使他们想要做出改变，也往往会比应该的更长时间地推迟这一行动。这三大效应表明，默认选项的选择可能会带来显著的福利后果。如果所有员工都拥有相同的最优储蓄率，那么选择最优的默认选项就变得简单。但如果员工的最优储蓄率存在差异，那么计算最优默认选项就变得复杂了。在这种情况下，有时设定默认选项可能是最优的选择。

abstract.text: (May 2003) - Noncooperative game theory combines strategic thinking, best-response, and mutual consistency of beliefs and choices (equilibrium). Hundreds of experiments show that in actual behavior these three forces are limited, even when subjects are highly motivated and analytically skilled (Camerer, 2003). The challenge is to create models that are as general, precise, and parsimonious as equilibrium, but which also use cognitive details to explain experimental evidence more accurately and to predict new regularities. This paper describes three exemplar models of behavior in one-shot games (thinking), learning over time, and how repeated "partner" matching affects behavior (teaching) (see Camerer et al., 2002b).

10.1257/000282803321947038.abstractZh: （2003年5月）非合作博弈理论结合了战略思维、最佳响应以及信念和选择的相互一致性（均衡）。数百项实验表明，在实际行为中，这三种力量是有限的，即使实验对象具有高度的动机和分析能力也是如此（Camerer，2003）。挑战在于创建出既具有均衡的普遍性、精确性和简洁性，又能利用认知细节来更准确地解释实验证据并预测新的规律性的模型。本文描述了三种行为模型：一次性博弈中的思考行为、随时间的学习行为，以及重复的“伙伴”匹配如何影响行为（教学行为）（参见Camerer等人，2002b）。

abstract.text: In many of the decisions we make we rely on the advice of others who have preceded us. For example, before we buy a car, choose a dentist, choose a spouse, find a school for our children, sign on to a retirement plan, etc. we usually ask the advice of others who have experience with such decisions. The same is true when we make major financial decisions. Here people easily take advice from their fellow workers or relatives as to how to choose stock, balance a portfolio, or save for their child’s education. Although some advice we get is from experts, most of the time we make our decisions relying only on the rather uninformed word-of-mouth advice we get from our friends or neighbors. We call this ?aive advice? In this paper I will outline a set of experimental results that indicate that word-of-mouth advice is a very powerful force in shaping the decisions that people make and tends to push those decisions in the direction of the predictions of the rational theory.

10.1257/000282803321947047.abstractZh: 在我们做出的许多决定中，我们都会依赖前人的建议。例如，在购买汽车、选择牙医、选择配偶、为孩子选择学校、加入退休计划等时候，我们通常会向有相关经验的人寻求建议。在做出重大财务决策时也是如此。人们往往会向同事或亲戚寻求关于如何选择股票、平衡投资组合或为孩子的教育储蓄的建议。虽然我们获得的一些建议来自专家，但大多数时候，我们只是依赖朋友或邻居提供的不太可靠的口碑建议来做出决策。我们将其称为“被动建议”。在本文中，我将介绍一系列实验结果，这些结果表明，口碑建议在塑造人们的决策过程中具有非常强大的影响力，并且往往会使这些决策朝着理性理论所预测的方向发展。

abstract.text: (May 2003) - This paper synthesizes findings from an ongoing research program on learning in signaling games. The present paper focuses on crossgame learning (the ability of subjects to take what has been learned in one game and generalize it to related games), an issue that has been ignored in most of the learning literature. We begin by laying out the basic experimental design and recapitulating early results characterizing the learning process. We then report results from an initial experiment in which we find a surprising degree of positive cross-game learning, contrary to the predictions of commonly employed learning models and to the findings of cognitive psychologists. We next explore two features of the environment that help to explain when and why this positive transfer occurs. First, we examine the effects of abstract versus meaningful context, an issue that has been largely ignored by economists out of the belief that behavior is largely dictated by the deep mathematical structure of a game. In contrast, results from cognitive psychology suggest that behavior may well be sensitive to context employed. Our results show that the use of meaningful context serves as a catalyst for positive transfer. Second, we explore how play by two-person teams differs from play by individuals. The psychology literature is quite pessimistic about the ability of teams to beat a "truth wins" standard based on performance of individuals. But teams easily surpass this norm in our cross-game experiment. We use the dialogues between team members to gain insight into how this transfer occurs, gaining direct confirmation for hypotheses generated by econometric analysis of earlier data.

10.1257/000282803321947056.abstractZh: (2003年5月) - 本文综合了关于信号博弈中学习的研究成果。本文重点关注跨博弈学习（即主体将在一个游戏中学到的知识应用到相关游戏中的能力），这一主题在大多数学习文献中都被忽视了。我们首先介绍了基本的实验设计，并回顾了描述学习过程的早期结果。随后，我们报告了一项初步实验的结果，发现正向的跨博弈学习程度出乎意料，这与常用的学习模型以及认知心理学家的研究结果相悖。接下来，我们探讨了有助于解释这种正向迁移发生的时间和原因的两个环境因素。首先，我们研究了抽象环境与有意义环境的影响，经济学家通常认为行为主要由游戏的深层数学结构决定，因此这一因素被很大程度上忽视了。相比之下，认知心理学的研究结果表明，行为可能对所采用的情境非常敏感。我们的研究结果表明，使用有意义的情境可以促进正向迁移。其次，我们探讨了两人团队的行为与个体行为之间的差异。心理学文献对团队能否超越基于个体表现的“真理胜出”标准持悲观态度，但在我们的跨博弈实验中，团队轻松超越了这一标准。我们通过分析团队成员之间的对话，进一步了解这种迁移是如何发生的，这为之前通过计量经济学分析得出的假设提供了直接支持。

abstract.text: A fast-growing theoretical literature on the political economy of reform has provided a sizable collection of models that have deepened our understanding concerning how distributional conflict manifests itself in the political process and can prevent efficiency-enhancing economic reform from taking place (see e.g., Allan Drazen [2000 Ch. 10, 13] for an insightful review). Unfortunately, systematic empirical work that provides direct tests of the validity and significance of the mechanisms articulated in these models has been limited. As Torsten Persson and Guido Tabellini (2000 p. 481) note in their evaluation of the larger political economy literature, “The gap between theory and

10.1257/000282803321947065.abstractZh: 关于改革的政治经济理论文献迅速增长，提供了大量模型，这些模型加深了我们对分配冲突如何在政治过程中显现的理解，以及这些冲突如何阻碍能够提升效率的经济改革得以实施（例如，参见Allan Drazen [2000]第10章和第13章的深入评论）。不幸的是，系统性的实证工作直接检验这些模型中提出的机制的有效性和重要性仍然有限。正如Torsten Persson和Guido Tabellini在他们对更广泛的政治经济文献的评估中所指出的：“理论与现实之间的差距……”

abstract.text: Economists and other scholars have long sought to measure and analyze long-term trends and differences in social performance. Average stature supplements and lengthens data series on traditional measures of life expectancy and real GDP per capita. This paper presents a methodology for using skeletal remains to greatly extend the chronological and cultural reach of anthropometric measures. Bones are widely available for study and unlike stature, they portray health over the life cycle, depicting both childhood and processes of aging and degeneration. The paper briefly explains seven skeletal measures widely used in physical anthropology and discusses procedures for summarizing community health in the form of an index. Results are based on a sample of over 12, 000 individuals who lived at 65 localities in the Western Hemisphere over the past several millennia. Results challenge conceptions of the pre-Columbian disease environment, and the methods can be used to test models of very long-term economic growth and to study important aspects of human welfare during climate change.
