10.1257/000282803321947515.abstractZh: 经济学系面临着提高本科教学质量的压力日益增大（Becker, 2000）。教师培训计划是经济学系可以用来提升教学质量的一种策略。这种培训计划通常针对研究生助教，但也可以为新的初级教师提供宝贵的教育资源。本文的任务是对理想的教师培训计划进行描述。什么是理想，这因人而异。我的观点基于在北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校参与教师培训计划的长期经验，以及对内布拉斯加大学林肯分校、印第安纳大学和普渡大学教师培训计划的了解，以及作为美国经济学教育委员会主办的教学研讨会负责人的经验（Salemi, Saunders, and Walstad, 1996）。我首先介绍了创建教师培训计划应遵循的原则，然后描述了该计划的基本要素，最后探讨了资源问题。I. 教师培训计划的原则 有四条原则可以指导教师培训计划的创建。首先，项目工作人员应该是教授教师培训计划参与者将要教授的概念的经济学家。教育专家可以提供一般性的建议，但无法提供与经济学课堂相关的具体例子。在系级教师培训计划中，参与者学习如何教授经济学。而在全校范围内的教师培训计划中，

abstract.text: When we leave our closet, and engage in the common affairs of life, (reason's) conclusions seem to vanish, like the phantoms of the night on the appearance of the morning; and 'tis difficult for us to retain even that conviction, which we had attained with difficulty (Hume, 1739/, p 507). we must constantly adjust our lives, our thoughts and our emotions, in order to live simultaneously within different kinds of orders according to different rules. If we were to apply the unmodified, uncurbed rules (of caring intervention to do visible 'good') of the small band or troop, or our families to the (extended order of cooperation through markets), as our instincts and sentimental yearnings often make us wish to do, we would destroy it. Yet if we were to always apply the (noncooperative) rules of the extended order to our more intimate groupings, we would crush them. (Hayek, 1988, p 18). (Italics are his, parenthetical reductions are mine).

10.1257/000282803322156954.abstractZh: 当我们离开自己的房间，参与生活的日常事务时，（理性的）结论似乎消失了，就像黎明到来时夜间的幻影一样；我们甚至难以保持那些我们好不容易获得的信念。（休谟，1739年，第507页）我们必须不断调整我们的生活、思想和情感，以便根据不同的规则，同时存在于不同的秩序之中。如果我们像本能和情感上的渴望所要求的那样，将小团体或家庭中的那些未经修改、不受约束的“善行”干预规则应用到市场的广泛合作秩序中，我们就会破坏它。然而，如果我们总是将广泛秩序中的（非合作）规则应用到我们更亲密的群体上，我们就会摧毁它们。（哈耶克，1988年，第18页）。（斜体为原文，括号内的简化为我所加）。

abstract.text: The standard profit-maximizing multiunit auction intersects the submitted demand curve with a preset reservation supply curve, which is determined using the distribution from which the buyers' valuations are drawn. However, when this distribution is unknown, a preset supply curve cannot maximize monopoly profits. The optimal pricing mechanism in this situation sets a price for each buyer on the basis of the demand distribution inferred statistically from other buyers' bids. The resulting profit converges to the optimal monopoly profit with known demand as the number of buyers goes to infinity, and convergence can be substantially faster than with sequential price experimentation.

10.1257/000282803322156963.abstractZh: 标准的最大化利润的多单位拍卖会将提交的需求曲线与预设的保留供应曲线相交，该预设供应曲线是根据买家评估数据分布来确定的。然而，当这一分布未知时，预设的供应曲线无法最大化垄断利润。在这种情况下，最优定价机制会根据从其他买家的出价中统计得出的需求分布为每位买家设定价格。随着买家数量趋于无限，最终的利润会收敛到已知需求下的最优垄断利润，且收敛速度比顺序定价实验要快得多。

abstract.text: We show how a Schumpeterian process of creative destruction can induce rational, herd behavior by entrepreneurs across diverse sectors as if fueled by “animal spirits.” Consequently, a multisector economy, in which productivity improvements are made by independent, profit-seeking entrepreneurs, exhibits regular booms, slowdowns, and downturns as part of the long-run growth process. Our cyclical equilibrium has higher average growth, but lower welfare than the corresponding acyclical one. We show how a negative relationship can emerge between volatility and growth across cycling economies, and assess the extent to which our model matches several features of actual business cycles.

10.1257/000282803322156972.abstractZh: 我们展示了一种熊彼特式的创造性破坏过程如何通过“动物精神”的驱动，促使不同领域的企业家表现出理性的群体行为。因此，在一个由独立、追求利润的创业者推动生产力提升的多领域经济体系中，长期增长过程会伴随着周期性繁荣、衰退和低迷。我们的周期性均衡虽然平均增长率较高，但福利水平却低于相应的非周期性均衡。我们还揭示了周期性经济体系中波动性与增长率之间可能存在的负相关关系，并评估了我们的模型在多大程度上符合实际商业周期的特征。

abstract.text: Explaining patterns of asset ownership is a central goal of both organizational economics and industrial organization. We develop a model of asset ownership in trucking, which we test by examining how the adoption of different classes of on-board computers (OBCs) between 1987 and 1997 influenced whether shippers use their own trucks for hauls or contract with for-hire carriers. We find that OBCs' incentive-improving features pushed hauls toward private carriage, but their resource-allocation-improving features pushed them toward for-hire carriage. We conclude that ownership patterns in trucking reflect the importance of both incomplete contracts and of job design and measurement issues.

10.1257/000282803322156981.abstractZh: 解释资产所有权模式是组织经济学和工业组织学的一个核心目标。我们开发了一个关于卡车运输领域资产所有权的模型，并通过研究1987年至1997年间不同类别车载计算机的应用情况，来探讨这种应用是否影响了托运人选择自行驾驶车辆还是与预约运输公司合作。研究发现，车载计算机在激励方面的改进特性促使托运人选择私人运输方式，而在资源分配方面的改进特性则促使他们选择预约运输公司。我们得出结论，卡车运输领域的所有权模式反映了不完全契约、工作设计以及测量问题的重要性。

abstract.text: Over the last 20 years the wage-education relationships in the United States and Germany have evolved very differently, while the education compositions of employment have evolved in a parallel fashion. In this paper, we show how these patterns shed light on the nature of recent technological change and highlight the importance of taking into account movements in the ratio of human capital to physical capital when examining changes in the returns to skill. Our analysis indicates that the United States could have prevented the increase in wage inequality observed in the 1980's by a faster accumulation of physical capital.

10.1257/000282803322156990.abstractZh: 在过去的20年里，美国和德国的工资与教育关系发生了非常不同的演变，而就业中的教育构成则以类似的方式发生变化。本文揭示了这些模式如何反映近期技术变革的本质，并强调了在考察技能回报变化时，考虑人力资本与物质资本比例的变化的重要性。我们的分析表明，如果美国在20世纪80年代能够更快地积累物质资本，就可以避免工资不平等的加剧。

abstract.text: This paper presents a model of rational Bayesian agents with speculative attacks in a regime of exchange rate which is pegged within a band. Speculators learn from the observation of the exchange rate within the band whether their mass is sufficiently large for a successful attack. Multiple periods are necessary for the existence of speculative attacks. Various defense policies are analyzed. A trading policy by the central bank may defend the peg if it is unobserved and diminishes the market's information for the coordination of speculators.

10.1257/000282803322157007.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，该模型描述了在汇率被固定在一个区间内的情况下，理性贝叶斯代理人面临的投机性攻击。投机者通过观察汇率是否在区间内来判断自己的势力是否足够大，以成功发起攻击。投机性攻击的存在需要多个时期。文中分析了各种防御策略。如果中央银行采取交易策略，可以在不引起注意的情况下保护汇率的固定，但这会减少市场对于投机者协调行为的了解。

abstract.text: We investigate the performance of forecast-based monetary policy rules using five macroeconomic models that reflect a wide range of views on aggregate dynamics. We identify the key characteristics of rules that are robust to model uncertainty; such rules respond to the one-year-ahead inflation forecast and to the current output gap and incorporate a substantial degree of policy inertia. In contrast, rules with longer forecast horizons are less robust and are prone to generating indeterminacy. Finally, we identify a robust benchmark rule that performs very well in all five models over a wide range of policy preferences.

10.1257/000282803322157016.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于预测的货币政策规则的性能，使用了五个宏观经济模型来反映对总体动态的不同观点。我们确定了那些能够抵御模型不确定性的关键规则特征；这些规则会根据一年前的通胀预测以及当前的产出缺口作出反应，并包含相当程度的政策惯性。相比之下，具有更长时间预测范围的规则则不够稳健，容易产生不确定性。最后，我们确定了一个在五种模型中都能表现良好的稳健基准规则，该规则能够在广泛的政策偏好范围内表现出色。

abstract.text: Procurement of an innovation often requires substantial effort by potential suppliers. Motivating effort may be difficult if the level of effort and quality of the resulting innovation are unverifiable, if innovators cannot benefit directly by marketing their innovations, and if the buyer cannot extract up-front payments from suppliers. We study the use of contests to procure an innovation in such an environment. An auction in which two suppliers are invited to innovate and then bid their prizes is optimal in a large class of contests. If contestants are asymmetric, it is optimal to handicap the most efficient one.

10.1257/000282803322157025.abstractZh: 获取一项创新通常需要潜在供应商付出巨大的努力。如果付出的努力程度和创新成果的质量无法得到验证，或者创新者无法直接通过营销自己的创新来获得收益，又或者买方无法从供应商处获得预付款，那么激励供应商的努力就会变得困难。我们研究了在这种环境下通过竞赛来获取创新的方法。在一种拍卖中，邀请两名供应商进行创新，然后他们各自出价竞拍自己的“奖品”。在绝大多数竞赛中，这种拍卖方式是最优的。如果参赛者的能力不对称，那么对效率最高的参赛者进行一定的限制是最优选择。

abstract.text: The ultimatum game, by its all-or-nothing nature, makes it difficult to discern what kind of preferences may be generating choices. We explore a game that convexifies the decisions, allowing us a better look at the indifference curves of bargainers while maintaining the subgame-perfect equilibrium. We conclude that bargainers' preferences are convex and regular but not always monotonic. Money-maximization is the sole concern for about half of the subjects, while the other half reveal a preference for fairness. We also found, unexpectedly, the importance of risk aversion among money-maximizing proposers, which in turn generates significant bargaining power for fair-minded responders.

10.1257/000282803322157034.abstractZh: 终极博弈因其全有或全无的特性，使得很难判断究竟是什么类型的偏好在驱动着选择行为。我们探索了一种使决策过程更加凸形的博弈形式，从而能够更清晰地观察交易者的无差异曲线，同时保持子博弈完美均衡。研究结果表明，交易者的偏好是凸且规则的，但并不总是单调的。大约一半的参与者将金钱最大化作为唯一目标，而另一半则表现出对公平的偏好。我们还意外地发现，金钱最大化追求者中存在风险厌恶心理，这一特性反过来为秉持公平态度的回应者提供了显著的议价能力。

abstract.text: This paper introduces a new technique for testing the Heckscher-Ohlin model that allows for the possibility that countries with sufficiently disparate endowments specialize in unique subsets of goods. Results based upon industry-level data reject one-size-fits-all homogeneity in favor of Heckscher-Ohlin specialization. Results also reveal that industry-level data hide substantial intra-industry heterogeneity, violating the assumptions of the model and complicating the interpretation of results from earlier research. A methodology for adjusting industry output to reflect underlying product variation is introduced. Reestimation of the model using adjusted aggregates in place of standard industry classifications provides strong support for Heckscher-Ohlin specialization.

10.1257/000282803322157043.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种用于检验赫克歇尔-俄林模型的新技术，该技术考虑了各国拥有差异较大的资源禀赋，从而可能专门生产独特的商品子集的可能性。基于行业层面的数据得出的结果否定了“一刀切”的同质性假设，支持赫克歇尔-俄林专业化理论。研究结果还表明，行业层面的数据掩盖了行业内部的显著异质性，这违反了模型的假设，并使早期研究结果的解释变得复杂。文中还介绍了一种调整行业产出以反映产品差异性的方法。使用调整后的总量数据重新估计模型，而非使用标准的行业分类，为赫克歇尔-俄林专业化理论提供了强有力的支持。

abstract.text: This paper considers a dynamic model of innovations in which firms can endogenously bias the direction of technological change. Both in a North–North and North–South context, we show that, when globalization triggers an increased threat of technological leapfrogging or imitation, firms tend to respond to that threat by biasing the direction of their innovations towards skilled-labor-intensive technologies. We show that this process of defensive skill-biased innovations generates an increase in wage inequalities in both regions. We then discuss suggestive empirical evidence of the existence of defensive skill-biased technical change.

10.1257/000282803322157052.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一个动态创新模型，在该模型中，企业能够内生性地影响技术变革的方向。无论是在北北关系还是北南关系中，我们发现，当全球化引发技术超越或模仿的威胁时，企业往往会通过将创新方向转向以技术劳动力密集型技术为特征的创新来应对这一威胁。我们指出，这种防御性技能偏向型创新过程会导致两个地区的工资不平等加剧。随后，我们讨论了关于这种防御性技能偏向型技术变革存在的实证证据。

abstract.text: A central issue in school choice is the design of a student assignment mechanism. Education literature provides guidance for the design of such mechanisms but does not offer specific mechanisms. The flaws in the existing school choice plans result in appeals by unsatisfied parents. We formulate the school choice problem as a mechanism design problem and analyze some of the existing school choice plans including those in Boston, Columbus, Minneapolis, and Seattle. We show that these existing plans have serious shortcomings, and offer two alternative mechanisms each of which may provide a practical solution to some critical school choice issues.

10.1257/000282803322157061.abstractZh: 学校选择中的一个核心问题是学生分配机制的设计。教育文献为这类机制的设计提供了指导，但并未提出具体的实施方案。现有学校选择计划存在的缺陷导致了不满家长的上诉。我们将学校选择问题转化为机制设计问题，并分析了包括波士顿、哥伦布、明尼阿波利斯和西雅图在内的现有学校选择计划。我们发现这些现有计划存在严重缺陷，并提出了两种替代机制，每种机制都可能为一些关键性的学校选择问题提供实际解决方案。

abstract.text: Firms selling multiple quality-differentiated products frequently alter their product lines when a competitor enters the market. We present a model of multiproduct monopoly and duopoly using a general “upgrades” approach that yields a powerful analytical framework. We provide an explanation for the common strategies of using “fighting brands” and of product line “pruning.” The optimal strategy depends on whether entry prompts an incumbent to expand or contract its total output. We also present a general condition that guarantees that a monopolist will sell but a single product. Our model addresses other issues, including intertemporal price discrimination and “damaged goods.”

10.1257/000282803322157070.abstractZh: 销售多种质量差异产品的企业，在竞争对手进入市场时，往往会调整其产品线。我们提出了一个多产品垄断和双垄断模型，采用一种通用的“升级”方法，从而构建了一个强大的分析框架。我们解释了企业使用“品牌竞争”和产品线“修剪”的常见策略。最优策略取决于进入竞争是否促使现有企业扩大或缩减总产出。我们还提出了一个通用条件，确保垄断者只会销售单一产品。我们的模型还涉及其他问题，包括跨时价格歧视和“损坏商品”。

abstract.text: Improved information allows home firms to rule out more potential foreign trade partners in advance of attempting to form a match. The increased responsiveness to country wage or goods price differentials resulting from this better first cut causes the general-equilibrium elasticity of substitution between national labor forces or the Armington elasticity of substitution between domestic and imported output to increase. Further results include an increase in the elasticity of domestic labor demand, an increase in the extent to which reductions in conventional trade barriers equalize national wages, and reduced “natural protection” for domestic producers.

10.1257/000282803322157089.abstractZh: 更完善的信息使得国内企业能够在尝试建立贸易关系之前，排除更多的潜在外国贸易伙伴。由于这种更精确的信息，企业对国家工资或商品价格差异的反应能力增强，从而导致国内劳动力之间的一般均衡替代弹性，以及国内与进口产品之间的阿明顿替代弹性增加。进一步的结果包括国内劳动力需求的弹性增加、降低传统贸易壁垒在均衡国家工资方面的作用增强，以及国内生产者的“自然保护”减少。

abstract.text: Economists have long observed that crowding out of government grants to private charities is incomplete. The accepted belief is that givers treat the grants as imperfect substitutes for private giving. We theoretically and empirically investigate a second reason: the strategic response of a charity will be to reduce fund-raising efforts after receiving a grant. Employing panel data from arts and social service organizations, we find that government grants cause significant reductions in fund-raising. This adds a new dimension to the policy discussions—analysts should account for the behavioral responses of the charity, as well as the donors, to government grants.

10.1257/000282803322157098.abstractZh: 经济学家早就注意到，政府拨款对私人慈善机构的挤出效应并不全面。人们普遍认为，捐赠者将政府拨款视为私人捐赠的替代方案。我们在理论和实证上进一步探讨了另一个原因：慈善机构在获得政府拨款后，往往会减少筹款活动。通过运用艺术和社会服务组织的面板数据，我们发现政府拨款确实会导致筹款活动的显著减少。这一发现为政策讨论增添了新的维度——分析人士应考虑到慈善机构以及捐赠者对政府拨款的行为反应。

abstract.text: This paper studies the ability of nonmarket institutions to invest optimally in forward intergenerational goods (FIGs), such as education and the environment, when agents are selfish or exhibit paternalistic altruism. We show that backward intergenerational goods (BIGs), such as social security, play a crucial role in sustaining investment in FIGs: without them investment is inefficiently low, but with them optimal investment is possible. We also show that making the provision of BIGs mandatory crowds out the voluntary provision of FIGs, and that population aging can increase investment in FIGs.

10.1257/000282803322157106.abstractZh: 本文研究了在非市场制度下，当个体表现出自私或家长式利他主义行为时，如何最优地投资于前向代际商品（如教育和环境）。我们指出，后向代际商品（如社会保障）在维持对前向代际商品的投资方面起着关键作用：没有这些商品，投资效率会很低；而有了这些商品，则可以实现最优投资。此外，我们还发现，强制提供后向代际商品会抑制对前向代际商品的自愿提供，而人口老龄化则可以增加对前向代际商品的投资。

abstract.text: Standard incentive theory models provide a rich framework for studying informational problems but assume that contracts can be perfectly enforced. This paper studies the design of self-enforced relational contracts. I show that optimal contracts often can take a simple stationary form, but that self-enforcement restricts promised compensation and affects incentive provision. With hidden information, it may be optimal for an agent to supply the same inefficient effort regardless of cost conditions. With moral hazard, optimal contracts involve just two levels of compensation. This is true even if performance measures are subjective, in which case optimal contracts terminate following poor performance.

10.1257/000282803322157115.abstractZh: 标准激励理论模型为研究信息问题提供了丰富的框架，但假设合同可以完全执行。本文研究了自我执行的关联合同的设计。我表明，最优合同通常可以采取一个简单的静态形式，但自我执行限制了承诺的补偿，并影响了激励的提供。在信息不透明的情况下，无论成本条件如何，代理人提供同样低效的努力可能是最优的。在道德风险的情况下，最优合同涉及两个层次的补偿。即使绩效衡量是主观的，这种情况也成立，在这种情况下，最优合同会在表现不佳后终止。

abstract.text: Banning affirmative action from college admissions cannot prevent an admissions office that cares about diversity from achieving it in ways other than explicitly considering race. We model college admissions where candidates from two groups with different average qualiÞcations compete for a Þxed number of seats. Under affirmative action, an admissions office that cares both about quality and diversity admits the best-qualiÞed candidates from each group. Under a ban, it may promote diversity by partially ignoring candidates’ qualiÞcations and therefore not admitting the best-qualiÞed candidates from either group. A ban always reduces diversity and may also lower quality. (JEL J71 ,J 15, I28)

10.1257/000282803322157124.abstractZh: 禁止大学招生中的平权行动无法阻止那些重视多样性的招生办公室通过其他方式实现多样性，而不是明确考虑种族因素。我们模拟了大学招生的情况，两个具有不同平均资质的群体中的候选人竞争有限的招生名额。在平权行动下，招生办公室会同时考虑质量和多样性，录取每个群体中资质最好的候选人。而在禁令下，招生办公室可能会通过部分忽略候选人的资质来促进多样性，因此不会录取每个群体中资质最好的候选人。禁令总是会减少多样性，并可能降低质量。（JEL J71, J15, I28）

abstract.text: The probit is generally considered to be one of the easiest nonlinear maximum likelihood problems. Nonetheless, in the course of at-tempting to replicate G. S. Maddala’s (1992, pp. 335–38) probit example, Houston Stokes (2003) encountered great difficulty. Of the six coeffi-cients, five coefficients/standard errors he could duplicate, but the sixth was off by more than rounding error. So he tried another package. And another. And another.... Finally, five dif-ferent packages had declared convergence to five solutions that differed only in the sixth coefficient. Estimates of the sixth coefficient ranged from 4.4 to 8.1, and estimates on its standard error ranged from 46 to 114,550.

10.1257/000282803322157133.abstractZh: Probit模型通常被认为是最简单的一种非线性最大似然问题之一。然而，在尝试复制G. S. Maddala（1992年，第335-338页）的Probit模型示例时，Houston Stokes（2003年）遇到了很大的困难。在六个系数中，他能够复制五个系数及其标准误差，但第六个系数的数值偏差超过了四舍五入的误差范围。因此，他尝试了不同的软件包，但都未能成功。最终，他使用了五种不同的软件包，得到了五个不同的解，这些解在第六个系数上有所不同。第六个系数的估计值范围从4.4到8.1，而其标准误差的估计值则从46到114,550。

abstract.text: We examine demands for rewards and punishments in a simple proposer-responder game. The proposer first makes an offer to split a fixed-sized pie. According to the 2 x 2 design, the responder is or is not given a costly option of increasing or decreasing the proposer's payout. We find substantial demands for both punishments and rewards. While rewards alone have little influence on cooperation, punishments have some. When the two are combined the effect on cooperation is dramatic, suggesting that rewards and punishments are complements in producing cooperation. Providing new insights to what motivates these demands is the surprising finding that the demands for rewards depend on the availability of punishments.

10.1257/000282803322157142.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个简单的提议-回应游戏中的奖励与惩罚需求。提议者首先提出一个分配固定大小“馅饼”的提议。根据2×2的设计，回应者可以选择是否接受一个代价高昂的选项，即增加或减少提议者的收益。我们发现，对惩罚和奖励的需求都相当大。虽然奖励本身对合作的影响较小，但惩罚则有一定的作用。当这两种机制结合使用时，对合作的影响非常显著，这表明奖励和惩罚在促进合作方面是互补的。一个令人惊讶的发现是，奖励需求取决于惩罚的可用性。这一发现为理解这些需求背后的动机提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: We provide empirical evidence that risk sharing enhances specialization in production. First, we calculate an index of specialization for each of the European Community (EC) and non-EC OECD countries, U.S. states, Canadian provinces, Japanese prefectures, Latin American countries, and regions of Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Then, we estimate the degree of capital market integration (risk sharing) within each of these groups of regions. Finally, we perform a regression of the specialization index on the degree of risk sharing, controlling for relevant economic variables and find a positive relation between the degree of specialization and the amount of risk sharing within a group. Instrumental variables regressions confirm that risk sharing is a causal determinant of specialization.

10.1257/000282803322157151.abstractZh: 我们提供了实证证据，证明风险共享能够增强生产的专业化程度。首先，我们为欧洲共同体（EC）和非OECD国家的各个地区、美国各州、加拿大各省、日本各 prefecture、拉丁美洲国家以及意大利、西班牙和英国的各个地区计算了一个专业化指数。然后，我们估计了这些地区内部资本市场整合程度（风险共享）的情况。最后，我们将专业化指数与风险共享程度进行回归分析，同时控制了相关的经济变量，发现专业化程度与组内风险共享程度之间存在正相关关系。工具变量回归分析证实，风险共享是专业化程度的一个因果决定因素。

abstract.text: This paper develops an extremely simple formulation of the Laffont-Tirole principal agent model of cost-based procurement and regulation which is suitable for applied uses by restricting the principal to using a two item menu where one item is a cost-reimbursement contract and the other item is a fixed price contract. Menus of this form are called fixed-price-cost-reimbursement (FPCR) menus. In the case where the agent’s utility is quadratic and the agent’s type is distributed uniformly, it is shown that the optimal FPCR menu always captures at least three quarters of the gain that the optimal complex menu achieves. Therefore, at least for the uniform quadratic case, extremely simple menus with low informational requirements perform nearly as well as the fully optimal complex menu. In an influential paper, Laffont and Tirole (1986) formulated a principal agent model of cost-based procurement and regulation and showed that the principal can implement the optimal mechanism by offering the agent a menu consisting of a continuum of linear contracts. Two1 related problems with applying this theory in practice have been that the economic logic and the

10.1257/000282803322157160.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种极其简单的基于成本采购与监管的主从代理模型表述方式，该模型适用于实际应用。通过限制主方只能使用两种类型的合同，即成本补偿合同和固定价格合同，使得模型更加实用。这种形式的合同被称为固定价格-成本补偿合同。当代理人的效用为二次型函数且代理人的类型分布均匀时，研究表明，最优的固定价格-成本补偿合同总是至少能实现最优复杂合同所达到的收益的四分之三。因此，至少对于均匀二次型的情况而言，结构简单且信息需求较低的合同几乎能与完全最优的复杂合同一样有效。在具有影响力的论文中，Laffont和Tirole（1986年）提出了一种基于成本采购与监管的主从代理模型，并表明主方可以通过向代理人提供一系列线性合同的组合来实现最优机制。然而，在实际应用该理论时存在两个问题，即经济逻辑和

abstract.text: The permanent-income hypothesis (PIH) of Milton Friedman (1957) states that the agent saves in anticipation of possible future declines in labor income (John Y. Campbell, 1987). He also saves for precautionary reasons, and dissaves because of impatience. To justify the PIH in an intertemporal optimization framework, it has been conventional to assume both (i) quadratic utility, to turn off precautionary motives (Robert E. Hall, 1978), and (ii) equality between the subjective discount rate and the interest rate, in order to rule out dissavings for lack of patience. Neither assumption is plausible. Much work on consumption in the past decade has focused on individual’s precautionary savings motives and liquidity constraints. Impatience is a standard result in heterogeneousagents general-equilibrium incomplete-markets models, generally known as Bewley models. This paper shows that the PIH is in any case the optimal rule, in a Bewley model, in which each agent solves the precautionary-savings model of Caballero (1990, 1991). In addition to the demand for savings for a “rainy day,” Caballero’s model also predicts a constant precautionary-savings demand and constant dissavings due to impatience. In equilibrium, I show that these two forces must cancel each other. As a result, the agent behaves in accordance with the PIH. Section I describes the model. Section II concludes. The Appendix provides a heuristic derivation and a proof of the optimal consumption rule.

10.1257/000282803322157179.abstractZh: 米尔顿·弗里德曼在1957年提出的永久收入假说指出，个体会为了预期未来劳动收入的可能下降而进行储蓄（John Y. Campbell, 1987）。此外，个体还会出于预防性的原因进行储蓄，同时也会因急躁而减少储蓄。为了在跨时优化框架中证明永久收入假说，传统上会假设两个条件：(i) 二次效用函数，以消除预防性动机（Robert E. Hall, 1978）；(ii) 主观折现率与利率相等，以排除因缺乏耐心而导致的储蓄减少。然而，这两个假设都不太可能成立。过去十年中关于过去消费的研究大多集中在个体的预防性储蓄动机和流动性约束上。在异质代理人一般均衡不完全市场模型中，急躁是一个标准结果，这些模型通常被称为Bewley模型。本文表明，在任何情况下，永久收入假说都是最优的储蓄规则，在Bewley模型中，每个代理人都会遵循Caballero（1990, 1991）提出的预防性储蓄模型。除了为“雨天”储蓄的需求外，Caballero的模型还预测了恒定的预防性储蓄需求和因急躁而导致的恒定储蓄减少。在均衡状态下，这两种力量必须相互抵消。因此，个体的行为符合永久收入假说。第一部分描述了该模型，第二部分进行了总结。附录提供了最优消费规则的启发式推导和证明。

abstract.text: The consequences of bank distress for the economy during the Depression remain an area of unresolved controversy. Since John M. Keynes (1931) and Irving Fisher (1933), macroeconomists have argued that bank distress magnified the extent of the economic decline during the Depression. As the intermediaries controlling money and credit, banks were in a special position to transmit their distress to other sectors. But the mechanism through which banking distress mattered for the economy has been hotly contested.

10.1257/000282803322157188.abstractZh: 在经济大萧条期间，银行危机对经济的影响仍然是一个尚未解决的争议领域。自约翰·M·凯恩斯（1931年）和欧文·费雪（1933年）以来，宏观经济学家们认为银行危机加剧了经济衰退的严重程度。作为控制货币和信贷的中介机构，银行特别有能力将其危机传导到其他部门。然而，银行危机如何影响经济这一机制一直存在激烈的争论。

abstract.text: Presents an empirical analysis of the risk properties of human capital returns. Discussion on measures of human capital returns; Description of the mean-variance spanning methodology; Information on real human capital returns and U.S. equity index return for 1964 to 1996.

10.1257/000282803322157197.abstractZh: 本文对人力资本回报的风险特性进行了实证分析。讨论了衡量人力资本回报的方法；描述了均值-方差权衡方法；提供了1964年至1996年间实际人力资本回报与美国股票指数回报的数据。

10.1257/000282803322157214.abstractZh: 本次会议旨在进行有益的讨论和评论。我们同样感谢Sarah Lawson在研究中提供的出色协助。所有剩余的错误或遗漏均由我们自行负责。

abstract.text: The purpose of this note is to look at the rationale behind popular advice on portfolio allocation among cash, bonds, and stocks. We argue that the typical investment advice is not inconsistent with the behavior of risk-averse expected-utility maximizers. We propose an additional solution to the asset allocation puzzle posed by Niko Canner et al. (1997), who argue that popular advice contradicts financial theory because it is inconsistent with the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) mutual-fund separation theorem. The CAPM asserts that investors should hold the same selection of risky assets, while popular advice is that investors should hold a proportion of bonds to stocks that increases with risk aversion. Using mean-variance (MV) analysis and the CAPM, Canner et al. show that recommended portfolios are far from optimal and that losses from the apparent failure of optimization are not substantial. However, they failed to explain the popular advice within an economic model. We offer a rational model based on stochastic dominance to demonstrate that all popular financial advice portfolios belong to the efficient set for all risk-averse investors. Using the historical annual real returns on bonds and stocks in Canner et al., we cannot ascertain that investment advisors indeed offer bad advice. Rather, we maintain that acting as agents for numerous clients, advisors recommend portfolios that are not inefficient for all risk-averse investors.

10.1257/000282803322157232.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨关于现金、债券和股票投资组合分配的常见建议背后的逻辑。我们认为，典型的投资建议并不与风险厌恶的期望效用最大化者的行为相矛盾。我们提出了一种解决Niko Canner等人（1997年）提出的资产分配难题的额外解决方案。他们指出，常见建议与金融理论相悖，因为它与资本资产定价模型（CAPM）中的共同基金分离定理不一致。CAPM认为，投资者应该持有相同比例的风险资产，而常见建议则要求投资者持有的债券与股票的比例随着风险厌恶程度的增加而增加。通过均值-方差分析以及CAPM，Canner等人发现推荐的投资组合远非最优，且这种优化的失败所带来的损失并不显著。然而，他们未能在经济学模型中解释这些常见建议。我们提出了一个基于随机优势理论的合理模型，以证明所有常见的金融投资建议组合都属于所有风险厌恶投资者的有效集合。根据Canner等人提供的债券和股票的历史年度实际回报数据，我们无法确定投资顾问确实提供了错误的建议。相反，我们认为，作为众多客户的代理人，顾问推荐的投资组合并不对所有风险厌恶投资者来说都是低效的。

abstract.text: Segerstrom (1998) demonstrates that the social optimum requires radical tech-nological breakthroughs to be treated less favorably than incremental innovations in a growing economy. The aim of this note is to assess the robustness of this welfare result on the basis of two levels of generalization: (i) the elasticity of substitution between any two goods is allowed to be larger than one, and (ii) inter-industry spillovers are introduced. We show that Segerstroms results can be reversed. It is also shown that in contrast to Segerstrom, R&D subsidies can be globally optimal, irrespective of the size of innovation, when inter-industry spillovers are large.

10.1257/000282803322157241.abstractZh: Segerstrom（1998）指出，在社会最优条件下，与渐进式创新相比，重大技术突破在增长的经济中受到的待遇更为不利。本文旨在基于两个层次的泛化来评估这一福利结果的稳健性：（i）任意两种商品之间的替代弹性可以大于一；（ii）引入行业间溢出效应。我们证明，Segerstrom的结果可以被逆转。此外，与Segerstrom的观点不同，当行业间溢出效应较大时，研发补贴可以在不考虑创新规模的情况下达到全局最优。

abstract.text: The work cited by the Nobel committee was done jointly with Amos Tversky (1937-1996) during a long and unusually close collaboration. Together, we explored the psychology of intuitive beliefs and choices and examined their bounded rationality. Herbert A. Simon (1955, 1979) had proposed much earlier that decision makers should be viewed as boundedly rational, and had offered a model in which utility maximization was replaced by satisficing. Our research attempted to obtain a map of bounded rationality, by exploring the systematic biases that separate the beliefs that people have and the choices they make from the optimal beliefs and choices assumed in rational-agent models. The rational-agent model was our starting point and the main source of our null hypotheses, but Tversky and I viewed our research primarily as a contribution to psychology, with a possible contribution to economics as a secondary benefit. We were drawn into the interdisciplinary conversation by economists who hoped that psychology could be a useful source of assumptions for economic theorizing, and indirectly a

10.1257/000282803322655392.abstractZh: 诺贝尔委员会引用的这项工作是与阿莫斯·特弗斯基（1937-1996）共同完成的，期间我们进行了长期且紧密的合作。我们一起探讨了直觉信念和选择的心理学现象，并研究了其有限理性问题。赫伯特·A·西蒙早在1955年和1979年就提出，决策者应被视为有限理性的，并提出了一种模型，在该模型中，效用最大化被满足程度最小化所取代。我们的研究试图通过探索将人们持有的信念和做出的选择与理性代理人模型中假设的最优信念和选择区分开来的系统性偏差，来描绘出有限理性的图景。理性代理人模型是我们的起点，也是我们零假设的主要来源，但特弗斯基和我认为我们的研究主要是对心理学的贡献，而对经济学的可能贡献则是次要的。我们被那些希望心理学能够成为经济理论假设有用来源的经济学家们吸引到了这个跨学科的讨论中，而间接地……

abstract.text: We use a model of boundedly rational learning to account for the observations of recurrent hyperinflations in the 1980’s. In a standard monetary model we replace the assumption of full rational expectations by a formal definition of quasi-rational learning. The model under learning matches some crucial stylized facts observed during the recurrent hyperinflations experienced by several countries in the 1980’s remarkably well. We argue that, despite being a small departure from rational expectations, quasi-rational learning does not preclude falsifiability of the model, it does not violate reasonable rationality requirements, and it can be used for policy evaluation.

10.1257/000282803322655400.abstractZh: 我们采用一个有界理性学习模型来解释1980年代反复出现的恶性通货膨胀现象。在标准的货币模型中，我们用准理性学习的正式定义来替代完全理性预期的假设。在学习的模型下，与1980年代多个国家经历的反复恶性通货膨胀期间观察到的一些关键特征非常吻合。我们认为，尽管准理性学习与理性预期有轻微差异，但它并不妨碍模型的 falsifiability（可证伪性），也不违反合理的理性要求，并且可以用于政策评估。

abstract.text: Using three major U.K. pension reforms as natural experiments we investigate the relationship between pension saving and discretionary private savings. Unlike most differences-in-differences approaches which rely on average differences between control and treatment group, we use economic theory to model the response of each individual household. The empirical analysis, based on the Family Expenditure Survey, uses both time-series and cross-sectional variation to identify the behavioral response. The earnings-related tier of the pension scheme is found to have a negative impact on private savings with relatively high substitution elasticities; the impact of the flat-rate tier is not significantly different from zero.

10.1257/000282803322655419.abstractZh: 我们通过将英国三项主要的养老金改革作为自然实验，来研究养老金储蓄与自由私人储蓄之间的关系。与大多数基于对照组和处理组之间平均差异的差异-差异方法不同，我们运用经济理论来模拟每个家庭的反应。基于家庭支出调查进行的实证分析，通过时间序列和横截面变化来识别行为反应。研究发现，与收入相关的养老金计划层级对私人储蓄有负面影响，其替代弹性较高；而固定费率养老金计划层级的影响则与零无明显差异。

abstract.text: We consider monetary-fiscal interactions when the monetary authority is more conservative than the fiscal. With both policies discretionary, (1) Nash equilibrium yields lower output and higher price than the ideal points of both authorities, (2) of the two leadership possibilities, fiscal leadership is generally better. With fiscal discretion, monetary commitment yields the same outcome as discretionary monetary leadership for all realizations of shocks. But fiscal commitment is not similarly negated by monetary discretion. Second-best outcomes require either joint commitment, or identical targets for the two authorities—output socially optimal and price level appropriately conservative—or complete separation of tasks.

10.1257/000282803322655428.abstractZh: 我们研究了货币当局比财政当局更为保守时的货币-财政互动。当两种政策都具有自由裁量权时，(1)纳什均衡下的产出较低，价格较高，这低于两种当局的理想状态；(2)在两种领导可能性中，财政领导通常更为优效。当财政具有自由裁量权时，货币承诺与自由裁量货币领导在所有冲击情况下产生相同的结果。但财政承诺并不会因货币自由裁量而受到同样的抵消。第二优结果要求两种当局进行联合承诺，或者设定相同的目标——产出达到社会最优水平，价格水平适当保守，或者完全分离各自的任务。

abstract.text: This paper studies a model of random technical progress where technology diffuses at realistically slow rates. It fits smooth trends to the sum of GDP series generated by this model and series representing transitory, or cyclical, fluctuations. Detrended GDP is then largely unrelated to technical progress. The detrending method proposed by Rotemberg (1999) reconstructs cyclical variations somewhat more accurately than the HP filter. With sufficiently slow diffusion it is also more accurate than a method based on VARs fitted to hours and GDP growth. Consistent with the model’s predictions, permanent shocks initially depress both hours and output in these VARs.

10.1257/000282803322655437.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个随机技术进步模型，其中技术的扩散速度非常缓慢。该模型生成的GDP序列呈现出平滑趋势，而代表暂时性或周期性波动的序列则表现出不同的形态。去趋势后的GDP与技术进步基本无关。Rotemberg在1999年提出的去趋势方法，在重建周期性变化方面比HP滤波器更为准确。当扩散速度足够慢时，该方法比基于VARs的方法更为精确，后者通常用于拟合小时数和GDP增长数据。与模型预测一致的是，永久性冲击最初会同时降低小时数和产出。

abstract.text: This paper examines the short-term effect of school on juvenile crime. To do so, we bring together daily measures of criminal activity and detailed school calendar information from 29 jurisdictions across the country, and utilize the plausibly exogenous variation generated by teacher in-service days. We find that the level of property crime committed by juveniles decreases by 14 percent on days when school is in session, but the level of violent crime increases by 28 percent on such days. Our findings suggest that both incapacitation and concentration influence juvenile crime.

10.1257/000282803322655446.abstractZh: 本文探讨了学校对青少年犯罪的短期影响。为此，我们整合了全国29个司法管辖区的日常犯罪活动数据以及详细的学校日程信息，并利用了教师在职培训日所产生的可解释性外生变量。研究发现，在学校上课的日子里，青少年实施的财产犯罪率下降14%，而暴力犯罪率则上升28%。我们的研究结果表明，学校的不设防状态和集中教育都可能对青少年犯罪产生影响。

abstract.text: This paper compares hedonic to matched model indexes. Matched model indexes are averages of the price changes of goods that remain on sampled stores’ shelves. Since goods that disappear tend to have falling market values, matched model indexes select from the right tail of price changes. The BLS can construct hedonic indexes that correct for this selection and are justified by standard arguments. In an empirical study of PC’s hedonics produce sharp price declines while matched model indexes are near zero. Also, though there are modifications to hedonics that seem desirable, they are not those in current use.

10.1257/000282803322655455.abstractZh: 本文比较了享乐主义指数与匹配模型指数。匹配模型指数是在抽样商店货架上商品价格变化的平均值。由于消失的商品往往市场价值下降，匹配模型指数会选取价格变化中的右侧部分。劳工统计局可以构建能够纠正这种选择的享乐主义指数，并且这些指数有充分的依据。在关于个人电脑的实证研究中，享乐主义指数显示出显著的价格下降，而匹配模型指数则接近零。此外，虽然对享乐主义指数有一些改进措施似乎是可取的，但这些改进并不符合当前使用的标准。

abstract.text: We develop a conceptual framework for valuing biodiversity from an economic perspective. We argue for a dynamic economic welfare measure of biodiversity that complements the literature on benefit-cost approaches and genetic distance/phylogenic tree approaches. Using a unified model of optimal economic management of an ecosystem under ecological and genetic constraints, we identify gains from management policies leading to a more diverse system, using the Bellman state valuation function of the problem. We show that a more diverse system could attain a higher value although the genetic distance of the species in the more diverse system could be almost zero.

10.1257/000282803322655464.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个从经济角度评估生物多样性的概念框架。我们主张采用一种动态的经济福利衡量方法来评估生物多样性，以补充关于收益-成本方法和遗传距离/系统发育树方法的文献。通过构建一个统一的模型，该模型在生态和遗传约束下对生态系统进行最优经济管理，我们利用问题的贝尔曼状态估值函数来识别导致系统更加多样化的管理政策所带来的收益。我们表明，尽管更加多样化的系统中的物种遗传距离可能几乎为零，但这样的系统仍然可以获得更高的价值。

abstract.text: We assemble bank-level and other data for Fed member banks to model determinants of bank failure. Fundamentals explain bank failure risk well. The first two Friedman-Schwartz crises are not associated with positive unexplained residual failure risk, or increased importance of bank illiquidity for forecasting failure. The third Friedman-Schwartz crisis is more ambiguous, but increased residual failure risk is small in the aggregate. The final crisis (early 1933) saw a large unexplained increase in bank failure risk. Local contagion and illiquidity may have played a role in pre-1933 bank failures, even though those effects were not large in their aggregate impact.

10.1257/000282803322655473.abstractZh: 我们收集了联邦储备银行成员银行的银行级数据，以建模银行倒闭的决定因素。基本因素能够很好地解释银行倒闭的风险。前两次弗里德曼-施瓦茨危机并未伴随着正的未解释剩余倒闭风险，或者银行流动性不足对预测倒闭的影响增加。第三次弗里德曼-施瓦茨危机则更为模糊，但总体来看，增加的剩余倒闭风险较小。最后一次危机（1933年初）则出现了较大的未解释倒闭风险增加。局部传染和流动性不足可能在1933年之前的银行倒闭中起到了作用，尽管这些效应的总体影响并不显著。

abstract.text: This paper argues that long-run trends in geographic segregation are inconsistent with models where residential choice depends solely on local public goods (the Tiebout hypothesis). We develop an extension of the Tiebout model that predicts as mobility costs fall, the heterogeneity across communities of individual public good preferences and of public good provision must (weakly) increase. Given the secular decline in mobility costs, these predictions can be evaluated using historical data. We find decreasing heterogeneity in policies and proxies for preferences across (i) a sample of U.S. municipalities (1870–1990); (ii) all Boston-area municipalities (1870–1990); and (iii) all U.S. counties (1850–1990).

10.1257/000282803322655482.abstractZh: 本文认为，地理隔离的长期趋势与那些认为居住选择完全取决于当地公共产品的模型（即Tiebout假说）相矛盾。我们对该Tiebout模型进行了扩展，发现随着流动成本的降低，不同社区在公共产品偏好和提供方面的异质性必须（弱地）增加。鉴于流动成本的长期下降，这些预测可以通过历史数据进行评估。我们发现，在以下三个时间段内，政策和偏好代理指标的异质性呈现下降趋势：(i) 美国1870年至1990年的187个市镇；(ii) 波士顿地区的所有市镇，时间跨度同样为1870年至1990年；以及(iii) 美国所有县的1850年至1990年数据。

abstract.text: Studying the implications of uncoordinated borrowing, the paper first looks at whether and when countries borrow too much in the aggregate. It then revisits the “original sin” debate, analyzing whether and when equity portfolio investment, international portfolio diversification, domestic currency denomination and longer maturities enhance borrowing countries’ access to international lending. The paper thereby relates a country’s level and quality of access to international capital markets to a variety of institutional features such as the level of domestic savings, their location, the extent of control rights held by political authorities, and the interests of dominant domestic political forces.

10.1257/000282803322655491.abstractZh: 本文首先探讨了资金借贷不协同所带来的影响，考察了各国是否以及在何时会总体性地过度借贷。随后，文章重新审视了“原始罪过”的争论，分析股票投资组合、国际投资组合多元化、本国货币计价以及较长的债务期限是否以及在何时能够提升借贷国的国际融资能力。文章将一国获取国际资本市场的水平和质量与多种制度特征联系起来，这些特征包括国内储蓄水平、地理位置、政治当局所持有的控制权程度，以及国内主导政治力量的利益诉求。

abstract.text: We test whether a nonbinding price ceiling may serve as a focal point for tacit collusion, using data from the credit card market during the 1980’s. Our empirical model can distinguish instances when firms match a binding ceiling from instances when firms tacitly collude at a nonbinding ceiling. The results suggest that tacit collusion at nonbinding state-level ceilings was prevalent during the early 1980’s, but that national integration of the market reduced the sustainability of tacit collusion by the end of the decade. The results highlight a perverse effect of price regulation.

10.1257/000282803322655509.abstractZh: 我们测试了非强制性价格上限是否可能成为默契勾结的焦点，使用了20世纪80年代信用卡市场的数据。我们的实证模型能够区分企业遵守强制性上限的情况与企业在非强制性上限下默契勾结的情况。研究结果表明，在20世纪80年代初，非强制性州级价格上限下的默契勾结现象较为普遍，但到该十年末，市场的全国一体化降低了默契勾结的可持续性。这些结果凸显了价格监管带来的负面效应。

abstract.text: This paper studies kinship band networks as capital market institutions. Membership in a community where individuals are dynastically linked has two effects on informal credit. First, the nonanonymity of the dynastic link allows to sanction the defaulters’ offspring and induce compliance even in short-term interactions (social enforcement). Second, preferential agreements can arise in which kin members condition their behavior on the characteristics of a player’s predecessor, expecting others to do the same with their offspring (reciprocity). These effects are incorporated in an OLG game with endogenous matching between lenders and borrowers and tested using household-level data from Ghana.

10.1257/000282803322655518.abstractZh: 本文将亲属关系网络视为资本市场机构进行研究。在一个个体通过家族关系相互联系的社区中，成员身份对非正式信贷有两方面的影响。首先，家族关系的非匿名性使得可以制裁违约者的后代，从而在短期互动中也能促使其遵守规则（社会强制）。其次，亲属之间可能会达成优先协议，即亲属成员会根据前任的行为特征来约束自己的行为，并期望其他亲属也对其后代采取同样的做法（互惠关系）。这些效应被纳入一个具有内生匹配机制的OLG博弈中，并通过加纳的家庭数据进行了测试。

abstract.text: There has been much discussion of the relationships between crime, inequality and unemployment. We construct a model where all three are endogenous. Introducing crime into otherwise standard models affects the labor market in several interesting ways. For example, we show how the crime rate affects the unemployment rate and vice-versa; how the possibility of criminal activity can lead to wage inequality among homogeneous workers; and how the possibility of crime can generate multiple equilibria in natural but previously unexplored ways. In particular, two fundamentally identical neighborhoods may easily end up with different levels of unemployment, inequality, and crime. The model can be used to study the equilibrium effects of anti-crime policies, such as changes in apprehension rates or jail sentences, as well as more traditional labor market policies such as unemployment insurance.

10.1257/000282803322655536.abstractZh: 关于犯罪、不平等和失业之间的关系，已有许多讨论。我们构建了一个模型，其中这三个因素都是内生变量。将犯罪因素引入原本标准的模型中，会对劳动力市场产生多种有趣的影响。例如，我们展示了犯罪率如何影响失业率，反之亦然；犯罪活动的可能性如何导致同质工人之间的工资不平等；以及犯罪的可能性如何以自然但未被探索的方式产生多种均衡状态。特别是，两个基本相同的社区可能会面临不同的失业水平、不平等和犯罪率。该模型可用于研究反犯罪政策的均衡效应，如逮捕率或监禁时间的改变，以及更传统的劳动力市场政策，如失业保险。

abstract.text: We call a dynamical system uncoupled if the dynamic for each player does not depend on the payoffs of the other players. We show that there are no uncoupled dynamics that are guaranteed to converge to Nash equilibrium, even when the Nash equilibrium is unique. Journal of Economic Literature Classification: C7, D7 1

10.1257/000282803322655581.abstractZh: 我们称一个动态系统为未耦合的，如果每个参与者的动态行为并不依赖于其他参与者的收益。我们证明了即使纳什均衡是唯一的，也不存在能够保证收敛到纳什均衡的未耦合动态。经济文献期刊分类：C7, D7 1

abstract.text: The standard analysis of price controls assumes that goods are efficiently allocated, even when there are shortages. But if shortages mean that goods are randomly allocated across the consumers that want them, the welfare costs from misallocation may be greater than the undersupply costs. We develop a framework to empirically test for misallocation. The methodology compares consumption patterns for demographic subgroups in rent-controlled and free-market places. We find that in New York City, which is rent-controlled, an economically and statistically significant fraction of apartments appears to be misallocated across demographic subgroups.

10.1257/000282803769206188.abstractZh: 标准的价格控制分析假设，即使存在短缺，商品也能被有效分配。但倘若短缺意味着商品被随机分配给那些想要它们的消费者，那么由于分配不当而产生的福利成本可能会超过供应不足的成本。我们建立了一个框架，用于实证检验分配不当的情况。该方法比较了租金管制和自由市场地区不同人口统计子群体的消费模式。研究发现，在实行租金管制的纽约市，相当一部分公寓在人口统计子群体之间的分配存在经济和统计上的显著偏差。

abstract.text: This paper explores the general-equilibrium impact of social security portfolio diversification into private securities, either through the trust fund or private accounts. The analysis depends critically on heterogeneities in saving, production, assets, and taxes. Limited diversification weakly increases interest rates, reduces the expected return on short-term investment (and the equity premium), decreases safe investment, increases risky investment, and increases a suitably weighted social welfare function. However, the effects on aggregate investment, long-term capital values, and the utility of young savers hinges on assumptions about technology. Aggregate investment and long-term asset values can move in opposite directions.

10.1257/000282803769206197.abstractZh: 本文探讨了社会保障投资组合向私人证券多元化在一般均衡中的影响，这种多元化可以通过信托基金或私人账户实现。分析严重依赖于储蓄、生产、资产和税收方面的异质性。有限的多元化会弱化利率，降低短期投资的预期回报（以及股权溢价），减少安全投资，增加风险投资，并提升适当加权的社会福利函数。然而，对总体投资、长期资产价值以及年轻储蓄者的效用影响取决于对技术的假设。总体投资和长期资产价值可能会朝相反方向变动。

abstract.text: Using a comprehensive data set of Portuguese manufacturing firms, we show that the firm size distribution is significantly right-skewed, evolving over time toward a lognormal distribution. We also show that selection accounts for very little of this evolution. Instead, we propose a simple theory based on financing constraints. A calibrated version of our model does a good job at explaining the evolution of the firm size distribution.

10.1257/000282803769206205.abstractZh: 通过一套全面的葡萄牙制造企业数据，我们发现企业规模分布呈现出显著的右偏态，并且随着时间的推移逐渐趋向于对数正态分布。我们还发现，这种分布的变化几乎不受选择因素的影响。相反，我们提出了一个基于融资约束的简单理论。经过校准的模型能够很好地解释企业规模分布的演变过程。

abstract.text: We develop a new theoretical link between inequality and growth. In our model, fertility and education decisions are interdependent. Poor parents decide to have many children and invest little in education. A mean-preserving spread in the income distribution increases the fertility differential between the rich and the poor, which implies that more weight gets placed on families who provide little education. Consequently, an increase in inequality lowers average education and, therefore, growth. We find that this fertility-differential effect accounts for most of the empirical relationship between inequality and growth.

10.1257/000282803769206214.abstractZh: 我们提出了不平等与增长之间新的理论联系。在我们的模型中，生育决策和教育决策是相互依存的。贫困的父母倾向于生育多个孩子，并且对教育投入较少。收入分布的均值保持性扩散增加了富人与穷人之间的生育差异，这意味着提供较少教育的家庭会获得更多的重视。因此，不平等的加剧会降低平均教育水平，进而抑制经济增长。我们发现，这种生育差异效应解释了不平等与增长之间大部分的经验关系。

abstract.text: A new and easily implementable framework for the empirical analysis of the relationship between aggregate and individual wages is developed. Aggregate real wages are shown to contain three important bias terms: one associated with the dispersion of individual wages, a second deriving from compositional changes in the (selected) sample of workers, and a third reflecting the distribution of working hours. Their importance for interpreting the path of aggregate wages and of the returns to education for recent experience in Britain is highlighted. A close correspondence between the estimated biases and the patterns of differences shown by aggregate wages is established.

10.1257/000282803769206223.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的、易于实施的框架，用于实证分析总体工资与个人工资之间的关系。研究表明，总体实际工资包含三个重要的偏差因素：一个与个体工资的分散性相关，第二个源于（选定样本）工人群体的构成变化，第三个则反映了工作时间的分布。这些偏差因素对于解释英国近期总体工资的走势以及教育回报的演变具有重要意义。研究还发现，估计出的偏差因素与总体工资所呈现的差异模式之间存在密切对应关系。

abstract.text: A basic premise of representative democracy is that all those subject to policy should have a voice in its making. However, policies enacted by electorally accountable governments often fail to reflect the interests of disadvantaged minorities. This paper exploits the institutional features of political reservation, as practiced in Indian states, to examine the role of mandated political representation in providing disadvantaged groups influence over policy-making. I find that political reservation has increased transfers to groups which benefit from the mandate. This finding also suggests that complete policy commitment may be absent in democracies, as is found in this case.

10.1257/000282803769206232.abstractZh: 代议制民主的基本前提是，所有受政策影响的人都应该有参与决策的机会。然而，由选民负责管理的政府所制定的政策往往未能反映弱势群体的利益。本文利用印度各邦实行的政治配额制度这一制度特征，来探讨强制性政治代表制度在为弱势群体提供政策影响力方面的作用。研究发现，政治配额制度确实增加了对弱势群体的转移支付。这一发现也表明，在民主制度中，完全的政策承诺可能并不存在，正如本案例所示。

abstract.text: The general conclusion of the empirical literature is that in-market consolidation generates adverse price changes, harming consumers. Previous studies, however, look only at the short-run pricing impact of consolidation, ignoring effects that take longer to materialize. Using a database that includes detailed information on the deposit rates of individual banks in local markets for different categories of depositors, we investigate the long-run price effects of mergers. We find strong evidence that, although consolidation does generate adverse price changes, these are temporary. In the long run, efficiency gains dominate over the market power effect, leading to more favorable prices for consumers.

10.1257/000282803769206241.abstractZh: 实证文献的总体结论是，市场内的合并会导致不利的价格变动，从而损害消费者利益。然而，以往的研究仅关注合并对短期价格的影响，而忽略了需要更长时间才能显现的影响。我们利用一个包含各地方市场不同类别储户存款利率详细信息的数据库，研究了合并对长期价格的影响。我们发现，尽管合并确实会导致不利的价格变动，但这些影响是暂时的。从长期来看，效率的提升超过了市场力量的影响，从而为消费者带来了更有利的价格。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between exchange rate regimes and economic growth for a sample of 183 countries over the post-Bretton Woods period, using a new de facto classification of regimes based on the actual behavior of the relevant macroeconomic variables. In contrast with previous studies, we find that, for developing countries, less flexible exchange rate regimes are associated with slower growth, as well as with greater output volatility. For industrial countries, regimes do not appear to have any significant impact on growth. The results are robust to endogeneity corrections and a number of alternative specifications borrowed from the growth literature.

10.1257/000282803769206250.abstractZh: 我们研究了后布雷顿森林时期183个国家的汇率制度与经济增长之间的关系，采用了一种基于相关宏观经济变量实际表现的新分类方法。与以往的研究不同，我们发现对于发展中国家而言，灵活性较低的汇率制度与较慢的增长速度以及更大的产出波动性相关。而对于工业国家来说，汇率制度似乎对经济增长没有显著影响。这些结果在进行了内生性修正以及采用了一些来自增长文献的替代模型后仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: We examine two factors that explain air traffic congestion: network benefits due to hubbing and congestion externalities. While both factors impact congestion, we find that the hubbing effect dominates empirically. Hub carriers incur most of the additional travel time from hubbing, primarily because they cluster their flights in short time spans to provide passengers as many potential connections as possible with a minimum of waiting time. Non-hub flights at the same hub airports operate with minimal additional travel time. These results suggest that an optimal congestion tax might have a relatively small impact on flight patterns at hub airports.

10.1257/000282803769206269.abstractZh: 我们研究了两个导致航空交通拥堵的因素：由于枢纽设置带来的网络效益以及拥堵的外部性。虽然这两个因素都会对拥堵产生影响，但实证结果显示，枢纽设置效应更为显著。枢纽航空公司因枢纽设置而增加的飞行时间最多，主要是因为它们将航班集中在较短的时间段内，以在最短的等待时间内为乘客提供尽可能多的转机选择。而在同一枢纽机场的非枢纽航班则几乎没有额外的飞行时间。这些结果表明，对枢纽机场的拥堵征税可能对航班模式的影响相对较小。

abstract.text: The paper investigates the common dynamic properties of business-cycle fluctuations across countries, regions, and the world. We employ a Bayesian dynamic latent factor model to estimate common components in macroeconomic aggregates (output, consumption, and investment) in a 60-country sample covering seven regions of the world. The results indicate that a common world factor is an important source of volatility for aggregates in most countries, providing evidence for a world business cycle. We find that region-specific factors play only a minor role in explaining fluctuations in economic activity. We also document similarities and differences across regions, countries, and aggregates.

10.1257/000282803769206278.abstractZh: 本文研究了不同国家、地区乃至全球范围内商业周期波动的共同动态特性。我们采用贝叶斯动态潜在因子模型，对涵盖世界七大地区的60个国家样本中的宏观经济总量（产出、消费和投资）进行共同成分分析。研究结果表明，一个共同的全球因子是大多数国家经济总量波动的重要来源，这为全球商业周期的存在提供了证据。我们发现，地区特定的因素在解释经济活动的波动中作用较小。同时，我们还发现了不同地区、国家以及各类经济总量之间的相似性和差异。

abstract.text: Tobin's average q has usually been well above 1, but fell below 1 during 1974 – 1984. Our model explains this pattern and reconciles it with unchanging aggregate investment. The stock market value in the numerator of q reflects ownership of physical capital and knowledge, but the denominator measures just physical capital. Therefore, q is usually above 1. Periodic arrivals of important new technologies, such as the microprocessor in the 1970's, suddenly render old knowledge and capital obsolete, causing the stock market to drop. National accounts measures of physical capital miss this rapid obsolescence. Then q appears to drop below 1.

10.1257/000282803769206287.abstractZh: 托宾比率通常远高于1，但在1974年至1984年期间低于1。我们的模型解释了这一现象，并将其与不变的总投资相结合。托宾比率中的分子反映了对实物资本和知识的拥有情况，而分母则仅衡量实物资本。因此，托宾比率通常高于1。诸如1970年代的微处理器这类重要新技术的出现，会迅速使旧知识和资本变得过时，从而导致股市下跌。国家账户中对实物资本的计算未能反映这种快速过时现象。此时，托宾比率似乎会降至1以下。

abstract.text: We reconcile trade theory with plant-level export behavior, extending the Ricardian model to accommodate many countries, geographic barriers, and imperfect competition. Our model captures qualitatively basic facts about U.S. plants: (i) productivity dispersion, (ii) higher productivity among exporters, (iii) the small fraction who export, (iv) the small fraction earned from exports among exporting plants, and (v) the size advantage of exporters. Fitting the model to bilateral trade among the United States and 46 major trade partners, we examine the impact of globalization and dollar appreciation on productivity, plant entry and exit, and labor turnover in U.S. manufacturing.

10.1257/000282803769206296.abstractZh: 我们将贸易理论与工厂层面的出口行为相结合，将李嘉图模型扩展以适应多个国家、地理障碍以及不完全竞争的情况。我们的模型能够定性地捕捉到关于美国工厂的一些基本事实：(i) 生产力的差异；(ii) 出口商的生产力更高；(iii) 只有一小部分工厂进行出口；(iv) 出口工厂中仅有小部分收入来自出口；(v) 出口商在规模上具有优势。通过将模型与美国与46个主要贸易伙伴之间的双边贸易数据相结合，我们研究了全球化以及美元升值对美国制造业生产力、工厂的进入与退出以及劳动力流动的影响。

abstract.text: To address the economic significance of national border effects, this paper provides evidence on two fundamental questions: (1) Do large border effects arise because of high perceived-price wedges between foreign and domestic products, or because imports and domestic goods are very close substitutes?; and (2) If price wedges are important, do they reflect distortionary barriers to trade or do they arise from nondistortionary factors, such as differences in transactions costs or product characteristics? I conclude that, while border effects may imply barriers, welfare costs, and a role for policy, distortions are probably not as substantial as initial border results suggested.

10.1257/000282803769206304.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨国家边界效应的经济意义，对两个基本问题提供了证据支持：（1）巨大的边界效应是由于外国产品与国内产品之间存在较高的感知价格差距，还是因为进口商品与国内商品是高度替代品？；（2）如果价格差距确实存在，它们反映的是贸易中的扭曲性障碍，还是由非扭曲性因素引起，例如交易成本或产品特性的差异？我的结论是，虽然边界效应可能意味着存在障碍、福利成本以及政策干预的必要性，但实际的扭曲程度可能并不像最初的研究结果所暗示的那样严重。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of the Worker Profiling and Reemployment Services system. This program “profiles” Unemployment Insurance (UI) claimants to determine their probability of benefit exhaustion and then provides mandatory employment and training services to claimants with high predicted probabilities. Using a unique experimental design, we estimate that the program reduces mean weeks of UI benefit receipt by about 2.2 weeks, reduces mean UI benefits received by about $143, and increases subsequent earnings by over $1,050. Most of the effect results from a sharp increase in early UI exits in the treatment group relative to the control group.

10.1257/000282803769206313.abstractZh: 我们研究了“工人档案与再就业服务系统”的影响。该计划对失业救济金的申请者进行“档案分析”，以确定他们耗尽救济金的可能性，然后为那些预测可能耗尽救济金的申请者提供强制性的就业和培训服务。通过独特的实验设计，我们估计该计划使平均领取失业救济金的时间减少了约2.2周，使平均领取的失业救济金减少了约143美元，并使后续收入增加了超过1050美元。大部分效果是由于处理组相比对照组提前退出失业救济金的情况显著增加所致。

abstract.text: Productivity reflects not only how efficiently inputs are transformed into outputs, but also how well information is applied to resource allocation decisions. This paper examines how information technology has affected capacity utilization in the trucking industry. Estimates for 1997 indicate that advanced on-board computers (OBCs) have increased capacity utilization among adopting trucks by 13 percent. These increases are higher than for 1992, suggesting lags in the returns to adoption, and are highly skewed across hauls. The 1997 estimates imply that OBCs have enabled 3-percent higher capacity utilization in the industry, which translates to billions of dollars of annual benefits.

10.1257/000282803769206322.abstractZh: 生产力不仅反映了投入转化为产出的效率，还体现了信息在资源分配决策中的应用效果。本文探讨了信息技术如何影响卡车行业的产能利用率。1997年的估计数据显示，采用先进车载计算机的车辆，其产能利用率提高了13%。这一提升幅度高于1992年的水平，表明技术的采用存在滞后现象，并且不同运输任务之间的效果差异较大。1997年的估计表明，车载计算机使该行业的产能利用率提高了3%，这相当于每年带来数十亿美元的经济效益。

abstract.text: Macroeconomists have for some time been aware that the New Keynesian Phillips curve, though highly popular in the literature, cannot explain the persistence observed in actual inflation. We argue that one of the more prominent alternative formulations, the Fuhrer and Moore (1995) relative contracting model, is highly problematic. Fuhrer and Moore's 1995 formulation generates inflation persistence, but this is a consequence of their assuming that workers care about the past real wages of other workers. Making the more reasonable assumption that workers care about the current real wages of other workers, one obtains the standard formulation with no inflation persistence.

10.1257/000282803769206340.abstractZh: 宏观经济学家们早就意识到，尽管新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线在文献中非常流行，但它无法解释实际通胀中观察到的持续性现象。我们认为，其中一个较为突出的替代模型——Fuhrer和Moore在1995年提出的相对收缩模型，存在严重问题。Fuhrer和Moore在1995年的模型虽然能够解释通胀的持续性，但这是基于他们假设工人会关心其他工人的过去实际工资的假设。如果采用更合理的假设，即工人会关心其他工人的当前实际工资，那么就可以得到没有通胀持续性的标准模型。

abstract.text: In 1954, the Internal Revenue Service stipulated that employer contributions to the health insurance plans of their employees were to be excluded from employee taxable income. Today, the tax subsidy is major feature of the U.S. health care market. This paper examines the initial effects of the tax subsidy on the demand for health insurance using previously unexamined data from 1953 and 1958. Results suggest that the tax subsidy increased the growth of group insurance, particularly among union members and employed persons. This is a critical effect because group insurance is not only less expensive than individual insurance, but it is also easier to obtain, and households with access to group health insurance are far more likely to purchase health insurance coverage than those without similar access. By increasing access to group insurance, the tax subsidy fostered an increase in the purchase of group health insurance by people who may not have purchased individual coverage, and generated institutional change as it cemented an employment-based system of group health insurance in the United States.

10.1257/000282803769206359.abstractZh: 1954年，美国国税局规定，雇主为员工购买的医疗保险费用不得计入员工的应税收入。如今，税收补贴已成为美国医疗保健市场的重要特征。本文利用1953年和1958年之前未经过充分研究的数据，探讨了税收补贴对医疗保险需求的影响。研究结果表明，税收补贴促进了团体保险的增长，尤其是在工会成员和就业人群中。这一效应至关重要，因为团体保险不仅比个人保险更便宜，而且更容易获得。拥有团体医疗保险的家庭比没有这种保险的家庭更有可能购买医疗保险。通过增加团体保险的获取机会，税收补贴促使那些原本可能不会购买个人保险的人也购买了团体保险，并推动了制度变革，使基于就业的团体医疗保险体系在美国得以巩固。

abstract.text: The paper explains dowries and bequests in a comparative perspective using economic theory and historical data.

10.1257/000282803769206368.abstractZh: 该论文运用经济理论和历史数据，从比较的角度解释了嫁妆和遗产问题。

abstract.text: Because of the Depression’s place in both the popular and academic imagination, and the re-peated and justifiable emphasis on output that was not produced, income that was not earned, and expenditure that did not take place, it will seem startling to propose the following hypoth-esis: the years 1929–1941 were, in the aggre-gate, the most technologically progressive of any comparable period in U.S. economic history.1 The hypothesis entails two primary claims: that during this period businesses and government contractors implemented or adopted on a more widespread basis a wide range of new technol-ogies and practices, resulting in the highest rate of measured peacetime peak-to-peak multifac-tor productivity growth in the century, and sec-ondly, that the Depression years produced advances that replenished and expanded the lar-der of unexploited or only partially exploited techniques, thus providing the basis for much of the labor and multifactor productivity improve-ment of the 1950’s and 1960’s. The hypothesis does not imply that all of the effects of the advances registered in the decade were immediately felt in the productivity data, nor, on the other hand, does it dismiss the sig-nificance of larder-stocking during the 1920’s and earlier, upon which measured advance built. Rather, it draws our attention to the prob-ability that progress in invention and innovation in the 1930’s was significant, in ways not well appreciated, both in facilitating the remarkable U.S. economic performance before and during World War II, and in establishing foundations for the prosperity of the 1950’s and 1960’s. I. Output Growth, Input Growth, and the Productivity Data The starting point for this exploration is mac-roeconomic data on real output growth, labor force growth, and the growth of the real capital stock, series that underlie our conclusions about trends in labor productivity and multifactor pro-ductivity growth. Major contributors to the con-struction, adjustment, and interpretation of these data have included Edward Denison, John

10.1257/000282803769206377.abstractZh:
由于大萧条在大众和学术界的广泛影响，以及人们不断强调那些未被生产、未赚取的收入和未发生的支出，提出以下假设会显得令人惊讶：1929年至1941年是美国经济历史上技术最进步的时期。该假设包含两个主要观点：首先，在这段时间里，企业和政府承包商更广泛地采用了各种新技术和做法，使得 peacetime 期间的多因素生产率增长达到了一个世纪以来的最高水平；其次，大萧条时期取得的进步补充并扩展了那些未被充分利用或仅部分利用的技术，为1950年代和1960年代的生产率提升奠定了基础。该假设并不意味着所有这些进步的影响立即体现在生产率数据中，也不否认1920年代及更早时期的技术积累的重要性。相反，它提醒我们注意这样一个可能性：1930年代在发明和创新方面的进步在促进二战前后美国经济的显著表现方面发挥了重要作用，并为1950年代和1960年代的繁荣奠定了基础。产出增长、投入增长与生产率数据  
本次研究的起点是宏观经济数据，包括实际产出增长、劳动力增长以及实际资本存量的增长情况。这些数据是我们对劳动生产率及多因素生产率增长趋势进行结论分析的基础。在数据的收集、整理和解读方面，爱德华·德尼森、约翰等人发挥了重要作用。

abstract.text: Data from recent years indicate that employers are especially unlikely to cut the nominal wage rate paid for a job. Adjustments to real or relative wages that require absolute cuts in money wages are very rare, relative to the frequency one might expect to observe based on distributions of wage changes that do not require money wage cuts (Erica L. Groshen and Mark E. Schweitzer, 1995, 1997; David E. Lebow et al., 1999). A worker who remains with the same employer from one year to the next is accordingly unlikely to report an absolute reduction in the nominal wage he receives (David Card and Dean Hyslop, 1997; Shulamit Kahn, 1997; Joseph G. Altonji and Paul J. Devereux, 1999). The existence and causes of “downward nominal wage rigidity” have implications for macroeconomic outcomes and for practical issues in monetary policy. Presumably, efficient operation of labor markets requires many downward adjustments of relative wages, and occasional decreases in the overall wage level relative to product prices. If the average rate of wage inflation were close to zero, some of these relative or real wage adjustments would be blocked by a floor under current levels of nominal wage rates. George A. Akerlof et al. (1996) assert that downward nominal wage rigidity reflects fundamental preferences of workers, and argue that it implies a central bank should target a rate of price inflation greater than zero because “a target of zero inflation will impose permanent real costs on the economy” (p. 2). The notion that downward nominal wage rigidity is a fundamental constraint, so that inflation serves to “grease the wheels of the labor market,” is controversial even among those who accept the possibility of nominal rigidities in general. It has been argued that downward nominal wage rigidity, as distinct from such phenomena as “menu costs” [which would discourage adjustment of a wage in either direction (David Romer, 1993)], may be an artifact of an inflationary monetary regime, and would disappear in the absence of persistent inflation. “Nominal wage reductions would no longer be seen as unusual if the average nominal wage was not growing. Workers would not see them as unfair, and firms would not shy away from imposing them” (Robert J. Gordon, 1996, p. 62; see also N. Gregory Mankiw, 1996; William Poole, 1998; William B. English, 2000). To see whether downward nominal wage rigidity would exist in a noninflationary regime, it may be useful to examine data from times and places where there was no persistent wage inflation. For the United States, at least, that excludes data from years since the Second World War: throughout the postwar period, price inflation or real wage growth has been sufficient to keep average wage inflation above zero. Before the Second World War, on the other hand, long-run trend rates of price inflation were often close to zero or negative (Robert B. Barsky, 1987). If wage inflation was correspondingly low, U.S. historical data may offer tests of the proposition that downward nominal wage rigidity exists even in noninflationary

10.1257/000282803769206386.abstractZh: 近年来的数据表明，雇主不太可能削减所支付职位的名义工资率。相对于那些不需要削减货币工资的工资变化分布而言，需要绝对削减货币工资的实工资或相对工资的调整非常罕见（Erica L. Groshen和Mark E. Schweitzer，1995年，1997年；David E. Lebow等人，1999年）。因此，一个工人如果连续一年留在同一雇主处，不太可能报告其收到的名义工资有绝对下降的情况（David Card和Dean Hyslop，1997年；Shulamit Kahn，1997年；Joseph G. Altonji和Paul J. Devereux，1999年）。“名义工资刚性下降”的存在及其原因对宏观经济结果和货币政策的实际问题具有重要意义。显然，劳动力市场的有效运作需要许多相对工资的向下调整，以及相对于产品价格的整体工资水平的偶尔下降。如果工资通胀的平均率接近零，那么这些相对或实际工资的调整中的一些将被当前名义工资水平下的下限所阻碍。George A. Akerlof等人（1996年）认为，名义工资刚性下降反映了工人的基本偏好，并主张中央银行应将价格通胀率设定为大于零，因为“将通胀率设定为零将给经济带来永久性的实际成本”（第2页）。即使是在那些接受名义刚性普遍存在的人中，关于名义工资刚性下降是一种基本约束的观点，认为通胀有助于“润滑劳动力市场的齿轮”，这一说法仍然存在争议。有观点认为，与“菜单成本”等现象不同，向下的名义工资刚性可能是一种通货膨胀性货币制度的产物，而在没有持续通货膨胀的情况下，这种刚性将会消失。“如果平均名义工资没有增长，那么名义工资的降低就不会被视为异常现象。工人不会认为这种降低是不公平的，企业也不会回避实施这种调整”（罗伯特·J·戈登，1996年，第62页；另见N·格雷戈里·曼昆，1996年；威廉·普尔，1998年；威廉·B·英格利什，2000年）。为了验证在非通货膨胀制度下是否存在向下的名义工资刚性，可以考察那些没有持续工资通胀的地区和时间的数据。至少在美国，第二次世界大战后的数据无法用于此目的：在整个战后时期，价格通胀或实际工资增长足以使平均工资通胀保持在零以上。而第二次世界大战之前，长期的价格通胀率往往接近于零或为负值（罗伯特·B·巴斯基，1987年）。如果工资通胀相应地较低，那么美国的历史数据或许可以证明，即使在非通货膨胀制度下，向下的名义工资刚性也是存在的。

abstract.text: This paper examines how the degree of competition among firms in an industry affects the optimal incentives that firms provide to their managers. A central assumption is that there is free entry and exit in the industry, which implies that changes in the nature of competition lead to changes in the equilibrium market structure. The main result is that as the intensity of product market competition increases, principals unambiguously provide stronger incentives to their agents to reduce costs, and hence agents work harder. At the same time, more intense competition also leads to a higher volatility of both firm-level profits and managers' compensation. Consequently, managers' incentives are positively correlated with firm-level risk, consistent with empirical evidence.

10.1257/000282803769206395.abstractZh: 本文探讨了行业内企业之间的竞争程度如何影响企业向其管理者提供的激励措施。一个核心假设是行业内存在自由进入和退出机制，这意味着竞争性质的变化会导致市场结构的变化。主要结论是，随着产品市场竞争强度的增加，企业主会明确地向其管理者提供更强的降低成本激励，因此管理者会更加努力地工作。同时，更激烈的竞争也会使企业利润和管理者薪酬的波动性增加。因此，管理者的激励措施与企业风险呈正相关，这与实证研究结果一致。

abstract.text: Since 1999, health care costs have been growing faster than national income. This rapid growth has occurred as the ability of private and public purchasers to reduce service utilization and bargain for lower prices has fallen, insurers have recouped lost profits through higher premiums, and new technologies have driven up costs throughout the sector. Private insurance market responses to these rising costs may lead to reductions in the number of people with insurance and to increased fragmentation of the insurance market. Over time, technological change in medicine both increases costs and improves the quality of care. The challenge for public policy is to maintain insurance and some degree of equity in the face of these rising costs.

10.1257/089533003765888476.abstractZh: 自1999年以来，医疗保健成本的增长速度超过了国民收入的增长速度。这种快速增长是由于私人和公共购买者减少服务使用量和争取更低价格的能力下降，保险公司通过提高保费来弥补损失，以及新技术在整个行业中推高了成本。私人保险市场对这些上升成本的应对可能会导致参保人数减少，并导致保险市场的更加分散。随着时间的推移，医学技术的变化既增加了成本，也提高了护理质量。公共政策面临的挑战是在这些成本上升的情况下，维持保险制度以及一定程度的公平性。

abstract.text: We offer an econometric framework that models consumer's consideration set formation as an outcome of her costly information search behavior. Because frequently purchased products are characterized by frequent price promotions of varying depths of discounts, a consumer faces significant uncertainty about the prices of the brands. The consumers engage in a fixed-sample search strategy that results in their discovering the posted prices of a subset of the available brands. This subset is referred to as the consumer's “consideration set.” The proposed model is estimated using the scanner data set for liquid detergents. Our key empirical results are: (i) consumers zincur significant search costs to discover the posted prices of the brands; (ii) whereas in-store displays and feature ads do not influence consumers' quality perceptions of the brands, they significantly reduce search costs for observing the prices of the brands; (iii) per capita income of consumer's household significantly increases her search costs; and (iv) the consumers' price sensitivity is seriously underestimated if we were to assume that consumers get to know all the posted prices at zero cost. The proposed model is also estimated for the ketchup category to enable us to do cross-category comparisons of consumers' price search behavior

10.1287/mksc.22.1.58.12849.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个计量经济框架，将消费者的考虑集形成视为其昂贵信息搜索行为的结果。由于经常购买的产品会频繁进行各种深度的价格促销，消费者对于品牌的价格存在显著的不确定性。消费者采用固定样本搜索策略，从而发现可用品牌中一部分品牌的标价。这一子集被称为消费者的“考虑集”。该模型使用液体洗涤剂的数据集进行了估计。我们的主要实证结果包括：(i) 消费者在发现品牌标价时需要付出显著的搜索成本；(ii) 虽然店内展示和特色广告不会影响消费者对品牌质量的感知，但它们显著降低了观察品牌价格的搜索成本；(iii) 消费者家庭的人均收入会显著增加其搜索成本；(iv) 如果我们假设消费者可以零成本了解所有标价，那么消费者的价格敏感度会被严重低估。该模型还被用于番茄酱类别的估计，以便我们能够对不同类别消费者的价格搜索行为进行跨类别比较。

abstract.text: Academic health centers (AHCs) have higher costs per case and also lower margins than either other teaching hospitals or community hospitals. The differences in margins stem mostly from differences in the intensity with which similar patients are treated, as well as hospitals' ability to generate revenue to cover the costs of that greater intensity, rather than graduate medical education per se. How much patient care capacity should be supported in AHCs and who should be treated with the greater intensity they offer are open questions. If there is to be a public trust fund to subsidize AHCs, it should be financed from general revenues.

10.1377/hlthaff.22.6.126.abstractZh: 学术健康中心（AHCs）的每例病例成本较高，利润率也低于其他教学医院或社区医院。利润率差异主要源于对类似患者的治疗强度不同，以及医院能否通过增加治疗强度来弥补成本，而非与研究生医学教育本身相关。学术健康中心应支持多少患者护理能力，以及应由谁来接受他们提供的更密集治疗，这些问题仍不明确。如果设立公共信托基金来补贴学术健康中心，其资金应来自一般收入。

abstract.text: Variations in efficiency and market power are generating wide variations in the prices charged by hospitals to health insurance plans. Insurers are developing new network structures that expose the consumer to some of the cost differences, to encourage but not mandate differential use of the more economical facilities. The three leading designs include hospital "tiers" within a single broad network, multiple-network products, and the replacement of copayments by coinsurance in HMO as well as PPO products. This paper describes the new network designs and evaluates the challenges they face in influencing consumers' behavior, incorporating information on clinical quality, and supporting medical education and uncompensated care.

10.1377/hlthaff.w3.135.abstractZh: 医院向健康保险计划收取的价格存在显著的差异，这源于效率和市场力量的变化。保险公司正在开发新的网络结构，使消费者面临一些成本差异，以此鼓励消费者选择更经济的医疗服务，但并非强制要求。三种主要的网络设计包括：在单一广泛网络内的医院“层级”划分、多网络产品，以及HMO和PPO产品中将共付额替换为共同保险。本文描述了这些新的网络设计，并评估了它们在影响消费者行为方面所面临的挑战，同时考虑了临床质量、医学教育以及无补偿护理方面的因素。

abstract.text: As a result of rising health care costs, health plans are experimenting with insurance products that shift greater financial responsibility for medical care to consumers and create incentives for consumers to consider cost differences when choosing among providers. Based on an October 2002 roundtable discussion, this paper discusses insurance product trends, particularly tiered hospital networks. Issues addressed include these product features' potential to reduce system costs, the effect on the hospital-health plan relationship, consumers' ability to consider cost and quality in decision making, and financial barriers to care for the chronically ill.

10.1377/hlthaff.w3.147.abstractZh: 由于医疗保健成本的上升，健康计划正在尝试推出一些保险产品，这些产品将更多的医疗费用责任转移给消费者，并促使消费者在选择医疗服务提供者时考虑成本差异。本文基于2002年10月的圆桌讨论，探讨了保险产品的趋势，特别是分层医院网络。讨论的问题包括这些产品特性在降低系统成本方面的潜力、对医院与健康计划关系的影响、消费者在决策时考虑成本和质量的能力，以及长期病患者就医的财务障碍。

abstract.text: We call markets in which intermediaries sell networks of suppliers to consumers who are uncertain about their needs "option demand markets." In these markets, suppliers may grant the intermediaries discounts in order to be admitted to their networks. We derive a measure of each supplier's market power within the network; the measure is based on the additional ex ante expected utility consumers obtain from the supplier's inclusion. We empirically validate the WTP measure by considering managed care purchases of hospital services in the San Diego market. Finally, we present three applications, including an analysis of hospital mergers in San Diego.

10.2307/1593786.abstractZh: 我们将那些中介向对自身需求不确定的消费者出售供应商网络的市场称为“选择需求市场”。在这些市场中，供应商可能会给予中介折扣，以便被纳入其网络。我们提出了一种衡量每个供应商在网络内市场力量的方法；该衡量标准基于消费者因供应商被纳入网络而获得的额外预期效用。我们通过研究圣地亚哥市场中医院服务的管理式医疗购买情况，对选择需求衡量方法进行了实证验证。最后，我们提出了三个应用案例，包括对圣地亚哥地区医院合并的分析。

abstract.text: Our objective is to determine the effect of ownership type (for-profit, not-for-profit, government) on firm conduct in hospital markets. Secondary objectives include estimating hospital demand systems useful for market definition and merger simulation. To this end, we estimate a structural model of demand and pricing in the short term hospital industry in California, and then use the estimates to simulate the effect of a merger. Demand is modeled at the level of individual consumers using discrete choice techniques and micro data on individuals. Price in the demand equation is endogenous, and we use recently developed instrumental variables techniques to correct for this. We allow the behavior of for-profit and not-for-profit firms to differ, modeling these differences structurally following the relevant theory literature. We find that California hospitals in 1995 faced a downward-sloping demand for their products, with an average price elasticity of demand of -5.67. Not-for-profit hospitals face less elastic demand and have lower marginal costs. Their prices are lower, but markups are higher than those of for-profits. We simulate the effects of the 1997 merger of two hospital chains. In unconcentrated markets such as Los Angeles and San Diego, the merger has virtually no effect on prices. However, in San Luis Obispo County, where the merger creates a near monopoly, prices rise by up to 58%, and the predicted price increase would not be substantially smaller were the chains to be not-for-profit.

10.2307/1593787.abstractZh: 我们的目标是确定所有权类型（营利性、非营利性、政府）对医院市场企业行为的影响。次要目标包括估算有助于市场定义和合并模拟的医院需求系统。为此，我们建立了加州短期医院行业的需求和定价结构模型，并利用这些估计结果来模拟合并的影响。需求模型以个体消费者为层次进行建模，采用离散选择技术和微观数据。需求方程中的价格具有内生性，我们采用了最近开发的工具变量技术来纠正这一特性。我们允许营利性和非营利性企业之间存在行为差异，并在结构层面根据相关理论文献对这些差异进行建模。研究发现，1995年加州的医院产品需求呈下降趋势，平均需求弹性为-5.67。非营利性医院的需求弹性较低，边际成本也较低。它们的价格较低，但价格加成高于营利性企业。我们模拟了1997年两家医院连锁企业合并的影响。在洛杉矶和圣地亚哥等未集中化的市场中，合并对价格几乎没有影响。然而，在圣路易斯奥比斯波县，由于合并形成了近乎垄断的局面，价格上升了高达58%，如果这两家连锁企业是非营利性的，预计价格涨幅不会这么大。

abstract.text: Quality differentiation is especially important in the hospital industry, where the choices of Medicare patients are unaffected by prices. Unlike previous studies that use geographic market concentration to estimate hospital competitiveness, this article emphasizes the importance of quality differentiation in this spatially differentiated market. I estimate a random-coefficients discrete-choice model that predicts patient flow to different hospitals and find that demand responses to both distance and quality are substantial. The estimates suggest that patients do not substitute toward alternative hospitals in proportion to current market shares, implying that geographic market concentration is an inappropriate measure of hospital competitiveness.

10.2307/1593788.abstractZh: 质量差异在医院行业中尤为重要，因为医疗保险患者的选择不受价格影响。与那些使用地理市场集中度来估算医院竞争力的先前研究不同，本文强调了在这种空间差异化的市场中，质量差异的重要性。我建立了一个随机系数离散选择模型，该模型能够预测患者流向不同的医院，并发现患者对距离和质量的双重需求都相当大。模型估计表明，患者不会按照当前的市场份额比例选择其他医院，这意味着地理市场集中度并不是衡量医院竞争力的合适指标。

abstract.text: This chapter focuses on the way in which the operation of the medical-care industry and the efficacy with which it satisfies the needs of society differ from a norm. The term norm that the economist usually uses for the purposes of such comparisons is the operation of a competitive model, that is, the flows of services that would be offered and purchased and the prices that would be paid for them. The interest in the competitive model stems partly from its presumed descriptive power and partly from its implications for economic efficiency. If a competitive equilibrium exists at all and if all commodities relevant to costs or utilities are in fact priced in the market, then the equilibrium is necessarily optimal. There is no other allocation of resources to services that will make all participants in the market better off. The most obvious distinguishing characteristics of an individual's demand for medical services is that it is not steady in origin as, for example, for food or clothing but is irregular and unpredictable. Medical services, apart from preventive services, afford satisfaction only in the event of illness, a departure from the normal state of affairs.

10.2307/j.ctv11sn34h.6.abstractZh: 本章重点探讨医疗服务业的运作方式及其满足社会需求的有效性如何与某种“规范”不同。经济学家在进行比较时通常使用的“规范”一词，指的是竞争模型的运作情况，即服务供给与需求的流动方式以及相应的价格。对竞争模型的兴趣部分源于其预期的描述性能力，部分则源于其对经济效率的影响。如果确实存在竞争均衡，并且所有与成本或效用相关的商品在市场上都有合理的定价，那么这种均衡必然是最优的。没有其他资源分配方式能使市场中的所有参与者都获得更好的收益。个人对医疗服务需求最明显的特征是，这种需求并非像食物或衣物那样具有稳定性，而是不规则且不可预测的。除了预防性服务外，医疗服务只有在生病时才能带来满足感，这与正常状态有所不同。

abstract.text: Most transplanted kidneys are from cadavers, but there are also substantial numbers of transplants from live donors. Recently, there have started to be kidney exchanges involving two donor-patient pairs such that each donor cannot give a kidney to the intended recipient because of immunological incompatibility, but each patient can receive a kidney from the other donor. Exchanges are also made in which a donor-patient pair makes a donation to someone on the queue for a cadaver kidney, in return for the patient in the pair receiving the highest priority for a compatible cadaver kidney when one becomes available. We explore how such exchanges can be arranged efficiently and incentive compatibly. The problem resembles some of the housing' problems studied in the mechanism design literature for indivisible goods, with the novel feature that while live donor kidneys can be assigned simultaneously, the cadaver kidneys must be transplanted immediately upon becoming available. In addition to studying the theoretical properties of the design we propose for a kidney exchange, we present simulation results suggesting that the welfare gains would be substantial, both in increased number of feasible live donation transplants, and in improved match quality of transplanted kidneys.

10.3386/w10002.abstractZh: 大多数移植的肾脏来自尸体捐赠者，但也有相当数量的肾脏来自活体捐赠者。最近，开始出现一种肾脏交换方式，即两个捐赠者-患者配对，由于免疫不相容性，每个捐赠者无法将肾脏捐赠给预定的接收者，但每个患者都可以从另一个捐赠者那里获得肾脏。这种交换方式还包括一种情况，即一个捐赠者-患者配对向另一个等待尸体肾脏的配对者捐赠肾脏，以换取在获得兼容尸体肾脏时优先级最高的那个患者。我们探讨如何高效且具有激励性地安排这种交换。这个问题类似于机制设计文献中研究的不可分割商品的住房问题，但有一个新的特点：虽然活体捐赠者的肾脏可以同时进行分配，但尸体肾脏必须在可用时立即进行移植。除了研究我们提出的肾脏交换设计的理论特性外，我们还展示了模拟结果，表明这种交换方式会带来显著的福利收益，包括增加可行的活体捐赠移植数量，以及提高移植肾脏的匹配质量。

abstract.text: Two surveys conducted in Taiwan during the spring 2003 SARS epidemic reveal a high degree of concern about the threat posed by SARS to Taiwan and to residents, although respondents believe they are knowledgeable about the risk of SARS and that it is susceptible to individual control. WTP to reduce the risk of infection and death from SARS is elicited using contingent valuation methods. Estimated WTP is high, implying values per statistical life of US$3 to 12 million.
