In contrast to previous work in this area that has used aggregated ecological designs, we exploit census data to estimate individual-level models. Theoretical and empirical econometric results indicate that aggregation can introduce substantial upward biases in the insurance effects. Overall we find a statistically significant but quite small effect of health insurance on child mortality in Costa Rica.

10.3386/w9827.abstractZh: 政府健康保险计划的一个目标是改善健康状况，然而，关于这种政府干预在解释健康转变方面的重要性，目前缺乏实证数据。我们分析了哥斯达黎加一项重大健康保险扩展对儿童死亡率的影响。与以往使用汇总性生态设计的研究不同，我们利用了人口普查数据来估计个体层面的模型。理论和实证计量经济学结果表明，汇总性数据可能会引入显著的向上偏差。总体而言，我们发现哥斯达黎加的健康保险对儿童死亡率的影响在统计上显著，但幅度相当小。

abstract.text: By age two a child who is up to date for immunizations will have received up to 19 shots delivered over eight visits at a market cost of $525 dollars for the vaccines alone, a far more expensive and demanding regimen that the 8 shots received in 1987. In recognition of the potential importance of health insurance to immunization coverage rates, the State Children's Health Insurance Program (SCHIP) mandated that all plans cover the cost and administration of childhood vaccines. We use data from the recently released National Immunization Survey for the years 1995 to 2001 to test whether SCHIP was associated with differential changes among poor and near-poor children relative to their non-poor counterparts in either age-appropriate immunization rates or in the proportion of vaccines delivered by private providers. We show that the probability that a child was up to date for the varicella vaccine increased between 7 and 16 percentage points more among poor and near-poor relative to non-poor children after implementation of SCHIP. The increase was greater among children from urban areas, among Hispanics and among those from states with the highest rates of uninsured children prior to SCHIP than among children nationally. We found small to inconsequential changes for other vaccines. We also found that the probability that a poor or near-poor child obtained all vaccines at a private provider fell relative to the same probability among non-poor children over the study period. SCHIP appears to have affected the uptake of a recently introduced vaccine, which suggests that insurance coverage may be important for the rapid adoption of the latest and increasingly more expensive agents such as the pneumococcal conjugate vaccine.

10.3386/w9831.abstractZh: 到两岁时，已完成免疫接种的儿童在八次接种中总共会接受19次注射，仅疫苗的费用就高达525美元，这比1987年接受的8次注射要昂贵得多，且要求也更高。鉴于健康保险对免疫覆盖率的重要性，州儿童健康保险计划（SCHIP）规定所有保险计划都必须承担儿童疫苗的费用和管理费用。我们利用1995年至2001年最新发布的全国免疫调查数据，来检验SCHIP是否导致了贫困和接近贫困儿童与非贫困儿童在适龄免疫率或私人医疗机构提供的疫苗比例方面的差异。结果显示，在实施SCHIP后，贫困和接近贫困儿童完成水痘疫苗接种的概率比非贫困儿童高出7到16个百分点。这种增加在来自城市地区的儿童、西班牙裔儿童以及SCHIP实施前无保险儿童比例最高的州中的儿童更为明显，而全国范围内的儿童则没有这种差异。其他疫苗的相关数据则显示出较小的、不显著的变动。我们还发现，在研究期间，贫困或接近贫困儿童在私人医疗机构获得所有疫苗的概率相对于非贫困儿童有所下降。SCHIP似乎对最近引入的一种疫苗的使用产生了影响，这表明保险覆盖可能对快速采用最新且越来越昂贵的疫苗（如肺炎球菌结合疫苗）非常重要。

abstract.text: In a simple representative consumer model, vaccines and drug treatments yield the same revenue for a pharmaceutical manufacturer, implying that the firm would have the same incentive to develop either ceteris paribus. We provide more realistic models in which the revenue equivalence breaks down for two reasons. First, drug treatments are sold after the firm has learned who has contracted the disease; in the case of heterogeneous consumers who vary with respect to the probability of contracting the disease, there is less asymmetric information to prevent the firm from extracting consumer surplus with drug treatments than with vaccines. We prove that, due to this aspect of pharmaceutical pricing, the ratio of drug-treatment to vaccine revenue can be arbitrarily high; we calculate that the ratio is about two to one for empirical distributions of HIV risk. The second reason for the breakdown of revenue equivalence is that vaccines are more likely to interfere with the spread of the disease than are drug treatments, thus reducing demand for the product. By embedding an economic model within a standard dynamic epidemiological model, we show that the steady-state flow of revenue is greater for drug treatments than for vaccines.

10.3386/w9833.abstractZh: 在一个简单的代表性消费者模型中，疫苗和药物治疗为制药公司带来相同的收入，这意味着公司在其他条件不变的情况下，会有相同的动机去开发这两种产品。然而，在更现实的模型中，收入等价性会打破，原因有两个。首先，药物治疗是在公司了解到谁已经感染疾病之后才出售的；对于在感染概率上差异较大的异质消费者来说，信息不对称的情况使得公司通过药物治疗获取消费者剩余的可能性低于通过疫苗获取的可能性。我们证明，由于这种药品定价的特点，药物治疗与疫苗收入的比例可以任意高；根据HIV风险的实际数据，这一比例大约为二比一。导致收入等价性打破的第二个原因是，疫苗比药物治疗更有可能阻碍疾病的传播，从而减少对产品的需求。通过将经济模型嵌入标准的动态流行病学模型中，我们发现，在稳态下，药物治疗的收入流比疫苗的收入流更大。

abstract.text: We seek to understand the relationship between employer decisions regarding which health plans firms choose to offer to their employees and the performance of those plans. We measure performance using data from the Health Plan Employer Data Information Set (HEDIS) and the Consumer Assessment of Health Plan Survey (CAHPS). We use a unique data set that lists the Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs) available to, and offered by, large employers across markets in the year 2000, and examine the relationship between plan offerings, performance measures and other plan characteristics. We estimate two sets of specifications that differ in whether they model plan choice as a function of absolute plan performance or plan performance relative to competitors. We find that employers are more likely to offer plans with strong absolute and relative HEDIS and CAHPS performance measures. Our results are consistent with the view that large employers are responsive to the interests of their employees.

10.3386/w9847.abstractZh: 我们旨在了解雇主在选择向员工提供何种健康计划时所作的决策与该计划绩效之间的关系。我们通过“健康计划雇主数据信息集”（HEDIS）和“消费者健康计划评估调查”（CAHPS）的数据来衡量绩效。我们使用一个独特的数据集，该数据集列出了2000年各大雇主在市场中可提供的健康维护组织（HMOs），并研究计划提供情况、绩效指标以及其他计划特征之间的关系。我们估计了两组模型，这两组模型在模型构建上有所不同，一组将计划选择视为基于绝对绩效的模型，另一组则基于相对于竞争对手的绩效来构建模型。研究发现，雇主更倾向于提供在HEDIS和CAHPS绩效指标方面表现优异的计划。我们的研究结果与“大型雇主会考虑员工利益”的观点一致。

abstract.text: Individuals' risk preferences are estimated and employed in a variety of settings, notably including choices in financial, labor, and product markets. Recent work, especially in financial economics, provides estimates of individuals' coefficients of relative risk aversion (CRRA's) in excess of one, and often significantly higher. However, it can be shown that high CRRA's imply equally high values for the income elasticity of the value of a statistical life. Yet estimates of this elasticity, derived from labor and product markets, are in the range of 0.5 to 0.6. Furthermore, it turns out that even a CRRA below one is difficult to reconcile with these elasticity estimates. Thus, there appears to be an important (additional) anomaly involving individuals' risk-taking behavior in different market settings.

10.3386/w9852.abstractZh: 个体的风险偏好被估算并应用于多种情境，尤其是在金融、劳动和产品市场中的决策。最近的研究，尤其是在金融经济学领域，提供了个体相对风险厌恶系数（CRRA）的估算结果，这些系数往往超过1，甚至更高。然而，可以证明，高CRRA值同样意味着统计生命价值对收入弹性的高值。然而，从劳动和产品市场得到的这一弹性的估算值通常在0.5到0.6之间。此外，即使CRRA低于1，也很难与这些弹性估算值相协调。因此，不同市场环境下个体的风险行为似乎存在一个重要的（额外）异常现象。

abstract.text: Several recent proposals have advocated using the income tax system to collect user fees to help fund the health care system. While there is a considerable amount of research investigating both how individuals respond to tax incentives for employer provided health insurance and on the effects of user fees payable at the point of service on the use of health care services, there is limited evidence on how individuals respond to tax incentives when these are not realized until taxes are paid. This paper uses existing exemptions in the Canadian tax code that allow individuals to deduct the cost of health care or health insurance from their taxable income in order to identify the tax price elasticity of demand for health care when price changes are realized at the end of the tax year. Our results suggest that despite not realizing the tax benefit at the time of purchase, individuals are quite responsive to changes in the tax price of health care. Our elasticity estimates for a wide range of health care products are well within the range of traditional price elasticity estimates, including in particular our estimates for prescription drugs. We also find some evidence that suggests individuals trade off risk sharing through traditional insurance companies with risk sharing through the tax code. That is, as the tax price of health care decreases, individuals spend more on health care, but spend less on health insurance.

10.3386/w9855.abstractZh: 近期有一些提议建议使用所得税制度来收取用户费用，以帮助资助医疗保健系统。虽然已有大量研究探讨个人对雇主提供的健康保险税收优惠的反应，以及在服务环节收取用户费用对医疗服务使用的影响，但关于个人在税收优惠未能在纳税时实现时的反应，相关的研究却很少。本文利用加拿大税法中允许个人从应税收入中扣除医疗保健或健康保险费用的免税条款，来研究在纳税年度结束时价格发生变化时，人们对医疗保健的需求价格弹性。我们的研究结果表明，尽管税收优惠在购买时未能实现，但个人对医疗保健价格的变化反应相当积极。我们对各种医疗保健产品的弹性估计值都处于传统价格弹性估计值的范围内，尤其是处方药方面的估计。我们还发现一些证据表明，个人通过税法进行风险分担，而放弃了通过传统保险公司进行风险分担的机会。也就是说，随着医疗保健的价格下降，个人在医疗保健上的支出增加，但在健康保险上的支出减少。

abstract.text: We construct and implement a test of rational consumer behavior in a highstakes financial market. In particular, we test whether consumers make systematic mistakes in perceiving their mortality risks. We implement this test using data from secondary life insurance markets where consumers with a lifethreatening illness sell their life insurance policies to firms in return for an up-front payment. We compare predictions from two models: one with consumers who correctly perceive their mortality risk, and one with consumers who are misguided about their life expectancy, and find that our data are most consistent with the predictions made by the second model.

10.3386/w9863.abstractZh: 我们构建并实施了一项关于理性消费者行为的测试，该测试适用于高风险金融市场。具体而言，我们旨在检验消费者在感知自身死亡风险时是否存在系统性错误。我们通过来自次级人寿保险市场的数据来进行这项测试，在这些市场中，患有致命疾病的消费者将其人寿保险保单出售给保险公司，以换取预付款。我们比较了两种模型的预测结果：一种模型假设消费者能够准确感知自己的死亡风险，另一种模型则假设消费者对预期寿命的估计存在偏差。研究发现，我们的数据最符合第二种模型的预测结果。

abstract.text: Around the world, as in the United States, concern is growing about who gets health care. Individuals from different socioeconomic backgrounds face distressingly different prospects of living a healthy life. Disparities in various measures of health between the privileged and the deprived still remain wide, despite the long-term tendency toward a healthier society. Some investigators believe the shift in the health care system in industrial countries from the principle of universal access to a more market-oriented system may be one cause of the growing disparities; rising income inequality is another potential culprit. Policy makers worldwide speak of more efficiently delivering essential' health care---but disagree on what counts as essential and on the optimal mix of private and government components of service. After reviewing the economic and epidemiological literature on disparities in health and health care systems, the question of how to define essential' health care is considered. The paper concludes with a discussion of the policy implications of the analysis.

10.3386/w9870.abstractZh: 在全球范围内，包括美国在内，人们对谁能够获得医疗保健的关注日益增加。来自不同社会经济背景的人们在享有健康生活的前景上面临着令人担忧的差异。尽管长期趋势是朝着更健康的社会发展，但特权阶层与贫困阶层在各项健康指标上的差异仍然很大。一些研究者认为，工业国家医疗保健体系从普遍可及原则向更加市场化的转变可能是造成这种差异的原因之一；收入不平等的加剧则是另一个潜在因素。全球的政策制定者都在谈论如何更有效地提供基本医疗保健——但对于什么是基本医疗保健以及私人与政府服务的最佳组合存在分歧。本文回顾了关于健康与医疗保健体系差异的经济学和流行病学文献，并探讨了如何定义基本医疗保健的问题。文章最后讨论了这一分析的政策意义。

abstract.text: This paper examines the strategic behavior of hospitals in one of their primary output markets: inpatient surgical procedures. High levels of learning-by-doing in surgical fields may act as a barrier to entry. I investigate whether incumbent hospitals facing prospective entry in a procedure market manipulate their procedure volumes to produce such a barrier. I derive straightforward empirical tests from a model of patient demand, procedure quality, and differentiated product competition. Using hospital data on electrophysiological studies, an invasive cardiac procedure, I find evidence of entry-deterring investment in procedure volume. These findings suggest that competitive motivations may play a role in treatment decisions.

10.3386/w9871.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医院在其主要产出市场之一——住院外科手术领域的战略行为。外科手术领域的高学习效应可能成为进入的障碍。我研究了面临潜在进入者竞争的医院是否通过操纵手术量来形成这种障碍。基于患者需求、手术质量以及差异化产品竞争模型，我提出了直接的实证检验方法。通过利用关于电生理学研究及一项侵入性心脏手术的医院数据，我发现存在阻碍进入者投资手术量的现象。这些发现表明，竞争动机可能在治疗决策中起到作用。

abstract.text: This study analyzes the effect of pharmaceutical price regulation on delays in new drug launches. Because low price in one market may 'spill-over' to others, though parallel trade and external referencing, manufacturers may rationally prefer longer delay or non-launch to accepting a low price. We use a Cox proportional hazard model to analyze the launch experience in 25 major markets of 85 new chemical entities (NCEs) launched in the UK or US between 1994 and 1998. There are 1,167 observed launches, or about 55% of the maximum. The US leads with 73 launches, followed by Germany (66) and the UK (64). Only 13 NCEs launched in Japan, 26 in Portugal and 28 in New Zealand. Countries with fewer launches also have longer average launch lags. The launch hazard is positively related to expected price and to expected volume, controlling for income per capita. The originator firm(s) characteristics, specifically, launch in home country and global experience, also significantly reduce launch delay. Within the EU, likely parallel export countries have the most negative effects. Our results suggest that countries with lower expected prices or smaller expected market size experience longer delays in new drug access, controlling for per capita income and other country and firm characteristics.

10.3386/w9874.abstractZh: 本研究分析了药品价格调控对新药上市延迟的影响。由于一个市场的低价可能会“溢出”到其他市场，尽管存在平行贸易和外部参考，制造商可能更偏好较长的上市延迟或不予上市，而非接受低价。我们使用Cox比例风险模型分析了1994年至1998年间在英国或美国上市的85种新化学实体在25个主要市场的上市情况。共有1,167次上市记录，约占最大数量的55%。美国以73次上市领先，其次是德国（66次）和英国（64次）。日本仅有13种新化学实体上市，葡萄牙有26种，新西兰有28种。上市数量较少的国家平均上市延迟也较长。在控制人均收入等因素后，上市风险与预期价格及预期销量呈正相关。原研企业的特征，特别是在本国上市和全球经验，也能显著减少上市延迟。在欧盟范围内，可能的平行出口国家受到的影响最为负面。我们的研究结果表明，在控制人均收入和其他国家和企业特征的情况下，预期价格较低或预期市场规模较小的国家，新药上市延迟时间更长。

abstract.text: Multi-period theoretical models of renewable insurance display front-loaded premium schedules that both cover lifetime total claims of low-risk and high-risk individuals and provide an incentive for those who remain low-risk to continue to purchase the policy. In practice, however, an age profile of premiums that decreases with age might result in relatively high premiums for younger individuals which they may consider unaffordable. In this paper, we use medical expenditure data to estimate an optimal competitive age-based premium schedule for a benchmark renewable health insurance policy. We find that the amount of prepayment by younger individuals that would be necessary to cover future claims is mitigated by three factors: high-risk individuals will either recover or die, low-risk expected expense increases with age, and the likelihood of developing a high-risk condition increases with age. Although medical cost growth over time increases the amount of prepayment necessary, the resulting optimal premium path generally increases with age. We also find that actual premium paths exhibited by purchasers of individual insurance with guaranteed renewability is close to the optimal schedule we estimate. Finally, we examine consumers' gain in expected utility associated with the guaranteed renewability feature.

10.3386/w9888.abstractZh: 关于可再生保险的多期理论模型显示，保费安排具有前期高、后期低的特性，既能覆盖低风险和高风险个体的终身总索赔，又能激励那些保持低风险状态的个体继续购买保险。然而在实践中，随着年龄增长而下降的保费结构可能导致年轻个体的保费相对较高，他们可能会认为这种保费难以承受。在本文中，我们利用医疗支出数据来估算一个最优的基于年龄的竞争性保费安排，用于基准可再生健康保险政策。我们发现，年轻个体为覆盖未来索赔而需预先支付的金额因三个因素而有所减轻：高风险个体要么康复，要么死亡；低风险个体的预期费用会随年龄增长而增加；以及患高风险疾病的可能性也会随年龄增长而增加。尽管随着时间的推移，医疗成本的增长增加了预先支付的金额，但由此产生的最优保费路径通常随年龄增长而上升。我们还发现，具有保证续保功能的个人保险购买者所呈现的实际保费路径与我们估算的最优方案非常接近。最后，我们研究了消费者在获得保证续保功能后预期效用的提升情况。

abstract.text: Recent research into the implications of low birth weight may be plagued by unobserved variable bias. It is unclear whether the later-life consequences found to be associated with low birth weight are a true effect of poundage' at birth, or whether this association results from underlying factors related to birth weight such as genetics, gestational age, pregnancy-related behavior, or prenatal environment. In this study, we employ twin comparisons to rule out such unobserved factors and to isolate more precise effects of birth weight on infant mortality. Using data from the 1995-1997 Matched Multiple Birth Database and deducing zygosity based on the sex ratio of twin births, we examine the effects of birth weight for both fraternal and identical twins on both neonatal and post-neonatal mortality. Results suggest that in the neonatal period, low birth weight may partially be acting as a proxy for underlying genetic conditions, but in the post-neonatal period birth weight per se increases the risk of mortality. Thus, it appears that after an initial weeding-out' period in which the more severe ailments associated with genetics may be behind birth weight effects, poundage' itself has a significant impact on life chances net of genes and other pregnancy-specific health or social conditions.

10.3386/w9901.abstractZh: 近期关于低出生体重影响的研究可能受到未观测变量偏差的困扰。目前尚不清楚与低出生体重相关的后期后果究竟是出生体重的真实效应，还是由于与出生体重相关的潜在因素导致的，例如遗传、妊娠年龄、妊娠相关行为或产前环境。在本研究中，我们采用双胞胎比较的方法来排除这些未观测因素，并分离出出生体重对婴儿死亡率的更精确影响。利用1995-1997年匹配多胎出生数据库的数据，并根据双胞胎出生的性别比例推断性别，我们研究了出生体重对异卵和同卵双胞胎在新生儿期及产后死亡率的影响。结果表明，在新生儿期，低出生体重可能部分作为潜在遗传状况的代理指标，但在产后期，出生体重本身会增加死亡风险。因此，在最初经过筛选期后，那些与遗传相关的严重疾病可能成为出生体重效应的背后原因，而出生体重本身在排除基因和其他妊娠特定健康或社会条件后，对生命机会仍有显著影响。

abstract.text: During the 1990s many states extended Medicaid eligibility to low-income parents who were not receiving welfare. We evaluate the effects of those expansions on health insurance coverage. To account for unobservable differences between expansion states and non-expansion states that may be correlated with both policy decisions and insurance coverage, we employ a within-state difference-in-difference technique that makes use of data only from expansion states. We find that the parental eligibility expansions increased Medicaid coverage of mothers with only small effects on private coverage. The expansions also increased the coverage of children, presumably by raising the benefit to the family of applying for coverage. We find substantial racial and ethnic differences in the effects of the expansions. As a result, the expansions help reduce racial and ethnic gaps in insurance coverage, particularly for adults.

10.3386/w9907.abstractZh: 在1990年代，许多州将医疗补助的资格扩展至未领取福利的低收入父母。我们评估了这些扩展对健康保险覆盖范围的影响。为了考虑扩展州与非扩展州之间可能存在的不可观测差异，这些差异可能与政策决策和保险覆盖有关，我们采用了一种基于扩展州数据的“州内差异-差异”技术。研究发现，父母资格扩展增加了母亲的医疗补助覆盖范围，但对私人保险覆盖范围的提升幅度较小。这些扩展还增加了儿童的保险覆盖，可能是通过提高申请保险的家庭的福利来实现的。我们发现，扩展对不同种族和族裔群体的影响存在显著差异。因此，这些扩展有助于缩小不同种族和族裔在保险覆盖方面的差距，尤其是在成年人方面。

abstract.text: In 1992, the United States Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) introduced new insurance coverage for two preventive services influenza vaccinations and mammograms. Economists typically assume transactions occur with perfect information and foresight. As a test of the value of information, we estimate the effect of consumer knowledge of these benefits on their demand. Treating knowledge as endogenous in a two-part model of demand, we find that consumer knowledge has a substantial positive effect on the use of preventive services. Our findings suggest that strategies to educate the insured Medicare population about coverage of preventive services may have substantial social value.

10.3386/w9912.abstractZh: 1992年，美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）为两项预防服务引入了新的保险覆盖范围，即流感疫苗接种和乳腺X光检查。经济学家通常假设交易是在完全信息和预见性的基础上进行的。为了检验信息的价值，我们估计了消费者对这些福利的了解对其需求的影响。在需求的两部分模型中，将知识视为内生变量，我们发现消费者的知识对预防服务的使用有显著的积极影响。我们的研究结果表明，向参保的医疗保险人群宣传预防服务的覆盖范围可能具有重大的社会价值。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of poor child health on the labor supply of mothers and fathers post welfare reform, using a national sample of mostly unwed parents and their children-a group at high risk of living in poverty. We account for the potential endogeneity of child health and find that having a young child in poor health reduces the mother's probability of working, the mother's hours of work, and the father's hours of work. These results suggest that children's health problems may diminish their parents' capacity to invest in their health.

10.3386/w9918.abstractZh: 我们使用全国范围内的样本数据，这些样本主要由未婚父母及其子女组成，他们属于生活贫困的高风险群体，来估计儿童健康状况不佳对父母劳动力供给的影响。我们考虑了儿童健康状况可能存在的内生性问题，并发现，有健康状况不佳的幼童时，母亲工作的可能性、工作时长以及父亲的工作时长都会降低。这些结果表明，儿童的健康问题可能会削弱父母对自身健康的投资能力。

abstract.text: This paper investigates a possible predictor of adverse selection problems in unsubsidized stand-alone' prescription drug insurance: the persistence of an individual's high spending over multiple years. Using MEDSTAT claims data and data from the Medicare Survey of Current Beneficiaries, we find that persistence is much higher for outpatient drug expenses than for other categories of medical expenses. We then use these estimates to develop a simple and intuitive model of adverse selection in competitive insurance markets and show that this high relative persistence makes it unlikely that unsubsidized drug insurance can be offered for sale, even with premiums partially risk adjusted, without a probable adverse selection death spiral. We show that this outcome can be avoided if drug coverage is bundled with other coverage, and briefly discuss the need either for comprehensive coverage or generous subsidies if adverse selection is to be avoided in private and Medicare insurance markets.

10.3386/w9919.abstractZh: 本文研究了未获得补贴的独立处方药品保险中不良选择问题的可能预测因素：即个人在多年内持续高额支出的现象。通过MEDSTAT索赔数据以及Medicare当前受益人调查的数据，我们发现门诊药品费用的持续支出比其他类别的医疗费用更为显著。随后，我们利用这些估计结果构建了一个简单直观的竞争性保险市场不良选择模型，并表明这种高程度的持续支出使得即使对保费进行部分风险调整，未补贴的药品保险也难以被市场接受，且很可能出现不良选择的死亡螺旋。我们指出，如果将药品保险与其他保险服务捆绑提供，就可以避免这种结果。同时，我们简要讨论了在私人保险和Medicare保险市场中避免不良选择所需的全面保险覆盖或慷慨补贴措施。

abstract.text: This paper provides an empirical estimate of price' and risk' elasticities of demand for term life insurance for those who purchase some insurance. It finds that the elasticity with respect to changes in premiums is generally higher than the elasticity with respect to changes in risk. It also finds that the elasticity, in the range of -0.3 to -0.5, is sufficiently low that adverse selection in term life insurance is unlikely to lead to a death spiral and may not even lead to measured effects of adverse selection on total purchases.

10.3386/w9925.abstractZh: 本文对购买定期人寿保险的人群的需求价格弹性与风险弹性进行了实证估计。研究发现，相对于保费变化而言，需求弹性通常高于风险变化带来的弹性。此外，该弹性值在-0.3到-0.5的范围内，这一数值足够低，表明定期人寿保险中的逆向选择现象不太可能导致死亡螺旋，甚至可能无法对总购买量产生可测量的负面影响。

abstract.text: Most existing studies of risk selection in the employer-sponsored health insurance market are case studies of a single employer or of an employer coalition in a single market. We examine risk selection in the employer-sponsored market by applying a switcher' methodology to a national, panel data set of enrollees in employer-sponsored health plans. We find that people who switched from a non-HMO to an HMO plan used 11 percent fewer medical services in the period prior to switching than people who remained in the non-HMO plan, and that this relatively low use persists once they enroll in an HMO. Furthermore, people who switch from an HMO to a non-HMO plan used 18 percent more medical services in the period prior to switching than those who remained in an HMO plan. HMOs would most likely continue to experience favorable risk selection if employers adjusted health plan payments based on enrollees' gender and age because the selection appears to occur based on enrollee characteristics that are difficult to observe such as preferences for medical care and health status.

10.3386/w9937.abstractZh: 目前关于雇主赞助的医疗保险市场中的风险选择的研究大多是针对单个雇主或单一市场内的雇主联盟的案例研究。我们通过应用“切换者”方法，对雇主赞助医疗保险计划中的全国面板数据进行了分析。研究发现，从非HMO计划切换到HMO计划的人在切换前的医疗服务使用量比继续留在非HMO计划中的人减少了11%；而一旦他们加入HMO计划，这种相对较低的医疗服务使用量仍然存在。此外，从HMO计划切换到非HMO计划的人在切换前的医疗服务使用量比继续留在HMO计划中的人多了18%。如果雇主能够根据参保者的性别和年龄来调整医疗保险计划的支付金额，HMO计划很可能会继续获得有利的风险选择结果，因为风险选择似乎是基于一些难以观察到的参保者特征来进行的，比如对医疗服务的偏好和健康状况等。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to examine the effectiveness of mental health and substance abuse treatment in reducing crimes committed by juveniles. The observed high correlations between crime, substance abuse and poor mental health suggests that factors which reduce substance abuse and improve mental health may also be effective in reducing criminal activities. This paper uses detention data in conjunction with substance abuse and mental health treatment data for youth enrolled in the Colorado state foster care program. We analyze the impact of treatment in delaying or preventing this group of at-risk youth from engaging in criminal behavior. Results show a negative effect, i.e., longer duration before detention, for youth who receive treatment and for youth in areas with high treatment rates.

10.3386/w9952.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨心理健康和物质滥用治疗在减少青少年犯罪方面的有效性。研究发现，犯罪、物质滥用与不良心理健康状况之间存在高度相关性，这表明能够减少物质滥用并改善心理健康的因素，也可能对减少犯罪活动有效。本文以科罗拉多州寄养计划中的青少年数据为基础，结合物质滥用和心理健康治疗数据，分析治疗对延缓或预防这些高危青少年犯罪行为的影响。结果显示，接受治疗的青少年以及治疗率较高的地区，其被拘留前的等待时间更长，这表明治疗具有负面影响。

abstract.text: To assess the consequences of advance medical directives -- which explicitly specify a patient's preferences for one or more specific types of medical treatment in the event of a loss of competence we analyze the medical care of elderly Medicare beneficiaries who died between 1985-1995. We compare the care of patients from states that adopted laws enhancing incentives for compliance with advance directives and laws requiring the appointment of a health care surrogate in the absence of an advance directive to the care of patients from states that did not. We report three key findings. First, laws enhancing incentives for compliance significantly reduce the probability of dying in an acute care hospital. Second, laws requiring the appointment of a surrogate significantly increase the probability of receiving acute care in the last month of life, but decrease the probability of receiving nonacute care. Third, neither type of law leads to any savings in medical expenditures.

10.3386/w9955.abstractZh: 为了评估预先医疗指示的后果——这些指示明确规定了患者在丧失行为能力时对于某一或多种特定类型医疗治疗的偏好——我们分析了1985年至1995年间去世的老年医疗保险受益人的医疗护理情况。我们比较了那些通过法律增强遵守预先指示激励措施以及要求在没有预先指示的情况下指定医疗代理人州的患者的护理情况，与那些没有这些法律的州的患者的护理情况。我们得出了三个关键发现：首先，增强遵守激励措施的法律显著降低了在急性护理医院死亡的几率；其次，要求指定代理人的法律显著增加了在生命最后一个月接受急性护理的概率，但降低了接受非急性护理的概率；第三，这两种法律都没有带来医疗支出的节省。

abstract.text: This paper examines the standard test for asymmetric information in insurance markets: that its presence will result in a positive correlation between insurance coverage and risk occurrence. We show empirically that while there is no evidence of this positive correlation in the long-term care insurance market, asymmetric information still exists. We use individuals' subjective assessments of the chance they will enter a nursing home, together with the insurance companies' own assessment, to show that individuals do have private information about their risk type. Moreover, this private information is positively correlated with insurance coverage. We reconcile this direct evidence of asymmetric information with the lack of a positive correlation between insurance coverage and risk occurrence by demonstrating the existence of other unobserved characteristics that are positively related to coverage and negatively related to risk occurrence. Specifically, we find that more cautious individuals are both more likely to have long-term care insurance and less likely to enter a nursing home. Our results demonstrate that insurance markets may suffer from asymmetric information, and its negative efficiency consequences, even if those with more insurance are not higher risk. The results also suggest an alternative approach to testing for asymmetric information in insurance markets.

10.3386/w9957.abstractZh: 本文探讨了保险市场中不对称信息的标准检验方法：即这种信息不对称会导致保险覆盖与风险发生之间存在正相关关系。我们通过实证分析发现，尽管在长期护理保险市场中并未发现这种正相关关系，但信息不对称现象仍然存在。我们利用个人对进入养老院可能性的主观评估，以及保险公司自身的评估数据，表明个人确实拥有关于自身风险类型的私人信息。此外，这些私人信息与保险覆盖之间存在正相关关系。我们通过证明存在其他与保险覆盖正相关、与风险发生负相关的未观测特征，来调和这一直接证据与保险覆盖与风险发生之间缺乏正相关关系的现象。具体而言，我们发现更谨慎的个体不仅更有可能获得长期护理保险，也不太可能进入养老院。我们的研究结果表明，即使保险覆盖较多的个体风险并不更高，保险市场仍可能受到不对称信息的负面影响，从而导致效率低下。这些结果还提出了一种测试保险市场中不对称信息的替代方法。

abstract.text: In this paper we examine the relationship between marijuana use and human capital formation by examining performance on standardized tests among a nationally representative sample of youths from the National Education Longitudinal Survey. We find that much of the negative association between cross-sectional measures of marijuana use and cognitive ability appears to be attenuated by individual differences in school attachment and general deviance. However, difference-in-difference estimates examining changes in test scores across 10th and 12th grade reveal that marijuana use remains statistically associated with a 15% reduction in performance on standardized math tests.

10.3386/w9963.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过分析全国教育纵向调查中的全国代表性青年群体在标准化测试中的表现，来研究大麻使用与人类资本形成之间的关系。我们发现，大麻使用与认知能力之间的负相关关系在很大程度上因个体在学校归属感及整体行为偏差方面的差异而得到缓解。然而，通过差异-差异估计法分析从十年级到十二年级期间测试成绩的变化，发现大麻使用仍然与标准化数学测试成绩下降15%之间存在统计学上的关联。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether hospitals respond in profit-maximizing ways to changes in diagnosis-specific prices determined by Medicare's Prospective Payment System and other public and private insurers. Previous studies have been unable to isolate this response because changes in reimbursement amounts (prices) are typically endogenous: they are adjusted to reflect changes in hospital costs. I exploit an exogenous 1988 policy change that generated large price changes for 43 percent of all Medicare admissions. I find that hospitals responded to these price changes by upcoding' patients to diagnosis codes associated with large reimbursement increases, garnering $330-$425 million in extra reimbursement annually. This response was particularly strong among for-profit hospitals. With the important exception of elective diagnoses, I find little evidence that hospitals increased the intensity of care in diagnoses subject to price increases, where intensity is measured by total costs, length of stay, number of surgical procedures, and number of intensive-care-unit days. Neither did hospitals increase the volume of patients admitted to more remunerative diagnoses, notwithstanding the strong a priori expectation that such a response should prevail in fixed-price settings. Taken together, these findings suggest that, for the most part, hospitals do not alter their treatment or admissions policies based on diagnosis-specific prices; however they employ sophisticated coding strategies in order to maximize total reimbursement. The results also suggest that models of quality competition among hospitals may be inappropriate at the level of specific diagnoses ( products').

10.3386/w9972.abstractZh: 本文研究医院是否以利润最大化的方式应对由医疗保险的预付支付系统以及其他公共和私人保险公司决定的特定诊断价格变化。先前的研究未能分离出这种反应，因为报销金额（价格）的变化通常是内生的：它们会根据医院成本的变化进行调整。我利用1988年的一项政策变化作为外生变量，该变化导致43%的医疗保险患者诊断价格出现大幅上涨。我发现，医院通过将患者编码到与报销增加相关的诊断代码来应对这些价格变化，每年额外获得3.3亿至4.25亿美元的报销收入。这种反应在营利性医院中尤为明显。除了择期诊断外，我几乎没有发现医院在价格上升的病例中增加了护理强度的情况，而护理强度是通过总成本、住院时间、手术次数以及重症监护病房天数来衡量的。此外，尽管人们普遍认为在固定价格环境下这种反应应该存在，但医院并没有增加因价格上升而增加的诊断病例数量。综合来看，这些发现表明，在大多数情况下，医院并不会根据特定诊断的价格变化来调整其治疗或入院政策；然而，它们会采用复杂的编码策略来最大化总报销金额。研究结果还表明，在特定诊断层面，医院之间的质量竞争模型可能并不适用。

abstract.text: Many states have passed laws mandating insurance companies to provide or offer some form of mental health benefits. These laws presumably lower the price of obtaining mental health services for many adults, and as a result, might improve health outcomes. This paper analyzes the effectiveness of mental health insurance mandates by examining the influence of mandates on adult suicides, which are strongly correlated with mental illness. Data on completed suicides in each state for the period 1981-2000 are analyzed. Ordinary least squares and two-stage least squares results show that mental health mandates are not effective in reducing suicide rates.

10.3386/w9994.abstractZh: 许多州已经通过法律，要求保险公司提供或提供某种形式的心理健康福利。这些法律显然降低了许多成年人获得心理健康服务的成本，因此可能会改善健康结果。本文通过分析心理健康保险强制要求对成年人自杀行为的影响，来评估其有效性。自杀数据来自1981年至2000年期间各州的记录。普通最小二乘法和两阶段最小二乘分析结果显示，心理健康强制要求并未有效降低自杀率。

abstract.text: Over the last two decades, employers have increasingly offered workers a choice of health plans. The availability of choice has the potentially beneficial effects of lowering the cost and increasing the quality of health care through greater competition among health plans for enrollees as well as allowing consumers to enroll in the type of coverage that most closely matches their preferences. On the other hand, concerns about the potential for adverse selection within employment-based purchasing in response to the availability of choice exist. In this paper, I examine the effects of offering choice in employment-based purchasing groups on access to and the cost of employer-sponsored coverage. I find that greater availability of choice was associated with a reduction in the premium of employer-sponsored coverage and an increase in the proportion of workers covered by the plans offered by employers. However, most of the premium reductions were due to a shift from family to single coverage within employment-based purchasing groups and a reduction in the generosity of the plans in which employees were enrolled. The results are not consistent with the availability of choice leading to lower premiums through greater competition among plans for workers.

10.3386/w9996.abstractZh: 在过去的二十年里，雇主们越来越向员工提供多种健康计划选择。这种选择性的存在具有潜在的好处，可以通过健康计划之间的竞争降低医疗成本并提高医疗质量，同时让消费者能够选择最符合自己需求的保险类型。然而，对于基于雇佣关系的购买行为中可能出现的逆向选择问题，人们也持有担忧。在本文中，我研究了在基于雇佣关系的购买群体中提供选择对获取雇主提供的保险以及保险成本的影响。我发现，选择性的增加与雇主提供的保险保费降低以及被这些计划覆盖的工人比例上升有关。然而，大部分保费降低是由于从家庭保险转向个人保险，以及员工所参与的计划的保障水平降低所致。这些结果并不支持选择性增加会通过计划之间的竞争从而降低保费的观点。

abstract.text: This chapter attempts to synthesize a few of the dominant theories of not-for-profit (NFP) firms into a common framework, and to connect existing empirical literature on NFPs to this common theoretical framework. It is organized as follows. Section 6.1 synthesizes existing theories of NFP behavior into a common empirical framework. The goal is to generate, for each theory, predictions regarding a common set of observable outcomes. Section 6.2 extends existing theories by generating predictions about industry-level behavior in equilibrium under perfect competition. Section 6.3 examines a large number of the existing empirical studies of NFP firms to determine the extent to which they provide evidence, comparing the behavior of NFP and FP firms on outcomes with regard to which existing theories generate different predictions. Section 6.4 concludes that, if forced to choose among existing theories, we would select theories which argue that the distinctive behavior of NFP firms can be explained by the altruistic motives of these firms' principals as most consistent with available evidence.

10.7208/chicago/9780226297866.003.0007.abstractZh: 本章试图将一些关于非营利组织（NFP）的主流理论整合到一个共同的框架中，并将现有关于NFP的实证文献与这一共同理论框架联系起来。具体结构如下：第6.1节将现有的NFP行为理论整合到一个共同的实证框架中，目的是为每个理论生成关于一组可观测结果的预测。第6.2节通过生成关于在完全竞争条件下行业层面行为的预测，对现有理论进行了扩展。第6.3节通过大量分析现有关于NFP公司的实证研究，以确定这些研究在多大程度上提供了证据，并比较NFP公司和营利性公司在不同结果上的行为，这些结果正是现有理论产生不同预测的关键点。第6.4节得出结论：如果必须在现有理论中选择，我们会选择那些认为NFP公司的独特行为可以由这些公司的负责人出于利他动机来解释的理论，因为这些解释与现有证据最为一致。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: The health implications of regional differences in Medicare spending are unknown. OBJECTIVE: To determine whether regions with higher Medicare spending provide better care. DESIGN: Cohort study. SETTING: National study of Medicare beneficiaries. PATIENTS: Patients hospitalized between 1993 and 1995 for hip fracture (n = 614,503), colorectal cancer (n = 195,429), or acute myocardial infarction (n = 159,393) and a representative sample (n = 18,190) drawn from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey (1992-1995). EXPOSURE MEASUREMENT: End-of-life spending reflects the component of regional variation in Medicare spending that is unrelated to regional differences in illness. Each cohort member's exposure to different levels of spending was therefore defined by the level of end-of-life spending in his or her hospital referral region of residence (n = 306). OUTCOME MEASUREMENTS: Content of care (for example, frequency and type of services received), quality of care (for example, use of aspirin after acute myocardial infarction, influenza immunization), and access to care (for example, having a usual source of care). RESULTS: Average baseline health status of cohort members was similar across regions of differing spending levels, but patients in higher-spending regions received approximately 60% more care. The increased utilization was explained by more frequent physician visits, especially in the inpatient setting (rate ratios in the highest vs. the lowest quintile of hospital referral regions were 2.13 [95% CI, 2.12 to 2.14] for inpatient visits and 2.36 [CI, 2.33 to 2.39] for new inpatient consultations), more frequent tests and minor (but not major) procedures, and increased use of specialists and hospitals (rate ratio in the highest vs. the lowest quintile was 1.52 [CI, 1.50 to 1.54] for inpatient days and 1.55 [CI, 1.50 to 1.60] for intensive care unit days). Quality of care in higher-spending regions was no better on most measures and was worse for several preventive care measures. Access to care in higher-spending regions was also no better or worse. CONCLUSIONS: Regional differences in Medicare spending are largely explained by the more inpatient-based and specialist-oriented pattern of practice observed in high-spending regions. Neither quality of care nor access to care appear to be better for Medicare enrollees in higher-spending regions.

10.7326/0003-4819-138-4-200302180-00006.abstractZh: 背景：医疗保险支出地区差异对健康的影响尚不清楚。目的：确定支出较高的地区是否提供更好的医疗服务。设计：队列研究。设置：全国范围内的医疗保险受益人研究。患者：1993年至1995年间因髋部骨折（n = 614,503）、结直肠癌（n = 195,429）或急性心肌梗死（n = 159,393）住院的患者，以及从1992-1995年的医疗保险当前受益人调查中选取的代表性样本（n = 18,190）。暴露测量：临终支出反映了与疾病地区差异无关的医疗保险支出区域差异部分。因此，每个队列成员的不同支出水平是通过其住院所在地区的临终支出水平来定义的（n = 306）。结果测量：护理内容（例如，接受的服务频率和类型）、护理质量（例如，急性心肌梗死后使用阿司匹林、流感免疫接种）以及获得护理的便利性（例如，有常规的护理来源）。结果：不同支出水平地区的队列成员平均基线健康状况相似，但支出较高的地区的患者接受的护理大约多60%。这种增加的利用程度可以通过更频繁的医生就诊来解释，尤其是在住院期间（最高与最低住院地区五分位数的住院就诊比率分别为2.13 [95% CI, 2.12至2.14]和2.36 [CI, 2.33至2.39]），更频繁的检查和小型（而非大型）手术，以及更多使用专科医生和医院（最高与最低住院地区五分位数的新住院咨询比率分别为2.13 [95% CI, 2.12至2.14]和2.36 [CI, 2.33至2.39]）。最低五分位数的住院天数达到1.52[置信区间：1.50至1.54]，重症监护室天数达到1.55[置信区间：1.50至1.60]。在支出较高的地区，大多数护理质量指标并不优于其他地区，某些预防保健措施的表现甚至更差。在支出较高的地区，护理的可及性也没有明显改善。结论：医疗保险支出在地区间的差异主要源于支出较高的地区以住院治疗和专科治疗为主的医疗模式。对于医疗保险参保者来说，这些地区的护理质量和可及性似乎都不如其他地区。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: The health implications of regional differences in Medicare spending are unknown. OBJECTIVE: To determine whether regions with higher Medicare spending achieve better survival, functional status, or satisfaction with care. DESIGN: Cohort study. SETTING: National study of Medicare beneficiaries. PATIENTS: Patients hospitalized between 1993 and 1995 for hip fracture (n = 614,503), colorectal cancer (n = 195,429), or acute myocardial infarction (n = 159,393) and a representative sample (n = 18,190) drawn from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey (MCBS) (1992-1995). EXPOSURE MEASUREMENT: End-of-life spending reflects the component of regional variation in Medicare spending that is unrelated to regional differences in illness. Each cohort member's exposure to different levels of spending was therefore defined by the level of end-of-life spending in his or her hospital referral region of residence (n = 306). OUTCOME MEASUREMENTS: 5-year mortality rate (all four cohorts), change in functional status (MCBS cohort), and satisfaction (MCBS cohort). RESULTS: Cohort members were similar in baseline health status, but those in regions with higher end-of-life spending received 60% more care. Each 10% increase in regional end-of-life spending was associated with the following relative risks for death: hip fracture cohort, 1.003 (95% CI, 0.999 to 1.006); colorectal cancer cohort, 1.012 (CI, 1.004 to 1.019); acute myocardial infarction cohort, 1.007 (CI, 1.001 to 1.014); and MCBS cohort, 1.01 (CI, 0.99 to 1.03). There were no differences in the rate of decline in functional status across spending levels and no consistent differences in satisfaction. CONCLUSIONS: Medicare enrollees in higher-spending regions receive more care than those in lower-spending regions but do not have better health outcomes or satisfaction with care. Efforts to reduce spending should proceed with caution, but policies to better manage further spending growth are warranted.

10.7326/0003-4819-138-4-200302180-00007.abstractZh: 背景：医疗保险支出地区差异对健康的影响尚不明确。目的：探讨医疗保险支出较高的地区在生存率、功能状态或护理满意度方面是否更优。设计：队列研究。设置：全国医疗保险受益人研究。患者：1993年至1995年间因髋部骨折（n = 614,503）、结直肠癌（n = 195,429）或急性心肌梗死（n = 159,393）住院的患者，以及从医疗保险当前受益人调查（MCBS）（1992-1995年）中抽取的代表性样本（n = 18,190）。暴露测量：临终期支出反映了与疾病地区差异无关的医疗保险支出区域差异部分。因此，每个队列成员的不同支出水平是由其所在医院所在地区的临终期支出水平来定义的（n = 306）。结果测量：5年死亡率（所有四个队列）、功能状态变化（MCBS队列）和满意度（MCBS队列）。结果：队列成员在基线健康状况上相似，但那些在临终期支出较高的地区接受的治疗量增加了60%。区域临终期支出每增加10%，死亡的相对风险分别如下：髋部骨折队列为1.003（95%置信区间，0.999至1.006）；结直肠癌队列为1.012（置信区间，1.004至1.019）；急性心肌梗死队列为1.007（置信区间，1.001至1.014）；MCBS队列为1.01（置信区间，0.99至1.03）。不同支出水平下功能状态下降的速率没有差异，满意度也没有一致的差异。结论：在支出较高的地区，参加医疗保险的参保人员获得的医疗服务比在支出较低的地区的人更多，但他们的健康结果和对医疗服务的满意度并不更好。减少支出的努力应该谨慎进行，但采取措施以更好地管理进一步的支出增长是必要的。
